sanskrit_iast: ime vai lokā apsu pratiṣṭhitāḥ | tadeṣā'bhyanūktā | apāṃ rasamudayaṃ san | sūrye śukraṃ samābhṛtam | apāṃ rasasya yo rasaḥ | taṃ vo gṛhṇāmyuttamamiti | ime vai lokā apāṃ rasaḥ | te'muṣminnāditye samābhṛtāḥ | jānudaghnīmuttaravedīṅkhātvā | apāṃ pūrayitvā gulphadaghnam
meaning: इमे वै लोका अप्सु प्रतिष्ठिताः | तदेषाऽभ्यनूक्ता | अपां रसमुदयं सन् | सूर्ये शुक्रं समाभृतम् | अपां रसस्य यो रसः | तं वो गृह्णाम्युत्तममिति | इमे वै लोका अपां रसः | तेऽमुष्मिन्नादित्ये समाभृताः | जानुदघ्नीमुत्तरवेदीङ्खात्वा | अपां पूरयित्वा गुल्फदघ्नम्
text_mt: These worlds are established upon the waters. / Therefore this [verse] is recited: / “Arising, the essence of the waters, / the bright [light] gathered into the sun: / what is the essence of the essence of the waters, / that highest one I draw for you.” / These worlds are indeed the essence of the waters; / they are gathered together in yonder Āditya. / Having dug the high altar knee-deep, / having filled it with water ankle-deep,

sanskrit_iast: puṣkaraparṇaiḥ puṣkaradaṇḍaiḥ puṣkaraiśca saṃstīrya | tasminvihāyase | agniṃ praṇīyopasamādhāya | brahmavādino vadanti | kasmātpraṇīte'yamagniścīyate | sāpraṇīte'yamapsu hyayañcīyate | asau bhuvane'pyanāhitāgniretāḥ | tamabhita etā abīṣṭakā upadadhāti | agnihotre darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ | paśubandhe cāturmāsyeṣu
meaning: पुष्करपर्णैः पुष्करदण्डैः पुष्करैश्च संस्तीर्य | तस्मिन्विहायसे | अग्निं प्रणीयोपसमाधाय | ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति | कस्मात्प्रणीतेऽयमग्निश्चीयते | साप्रणीतेऽयमप्सु ह्ययञ्चीयते | असौ भुवनेऽप्यनाहिताग्निरेताः | तमभित एता अबीष्टका उपदधाति | अग्निहोत्रे दर्शपूर्णमासयोः | पशुबन्धे चातुर्मास्येषु
text_mt: having strewn it with lotus-leaves, lotus-stalks, and lotus-flowers, / into that open space, / having brought forward the fire and laid it down— / the theologians say: / “Why is this fire piled after [the fire] is brought forward?” / [One should answer:] “In that which is not brought forward, for this [fire] is piled in the waters.” / Yonder in the world is the semen of one who has not established the fires. / Round about him he places these water-bricks / at the Agnihotra, at the new- and full-moon sacrifices, / at the animal sacrifice, at the four-month sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: atho āhuḥ | sarveṣu yajñakratuṣviti | etaddha sma vā āhuḥ śaṇḍilāḥ | kamagniṃcinute | satriyamagniṃcinvānaḥ | saṃvathsaraṃ pratyakṣeṇa | kamagniṃcinute | sāvitramagniṃcinvānaḥ | amumādityaṃ pratyakṣeṇa | kamagniṃcinute
meaning: अथो आहुः | सर्वेषु यज्ञक्रतुष्विति | एतद्ध स्म वा आहुः शण्डिलाः | कमग्निंचिनुते | सत्रियमग्निंचिन्वानः | संवथ्सरं प्रत्यक्षेण | कमग्निंचिनुते | सावित्रमग्निंचिन्वानः | अमुमादित्यं प्रत्यक्षेण | कमग्निंचिनुते
text_mt: Now they say: "In all sacrificial rites." Indeed, the Śāṇḍilas used to say this: / Which Agni does he pile up who piles the Agni of the satra? The year directly. / Which Agni does he pile up who piles the Sāvitra Agni? Yonder Āditya directly. / Which Agni does he pile up

sanskrit_iast: nāciketamagniṃcinvānaḥ | prāṇānpratyakṣeṇa | kamagniṃcinute | cāturhotriyamagniṃcinvānaḥ | brahma pratyakṣeṇa | kamagniṃcinute | vaiśvasṛjamagniṃcinvānaḥ | śarīraṃ pratyakṣeṇa | kamagniṃcinute | upānuvākyamāśumagniṃcinvānaḥ
meaning: नाचिकेतमग्निंचिन्वानः | प्राणान्प्रत्यक्षेण | कमग्निंचिनुते | चातुर्होत्रियमग्निंचिन्वानः | ब्रह्म प्रत्यक्षेण | कमग्निंचिनुते | वैश्वसृजमग्निंचिन्वानः | शरीरं प्रत्यक्षेण | कमग्निंचिनुते | उपानुवाक्यमाशुमग्निंचिन्वानः
text_mt: who piles the Nāciketa Agni? The vital breaths directly. Which Agni does he pile up / who piles the Cāturhotriya Agni? Brahman directly. Which Agni does he pile up / who piles the Vaiśvasṛja Agni? The body directly. Which Agni does he pile up / who piles the Upānuvākya Āśu Agni?

sanskrit_iast: imān lokānpratyakṣeṇa | kamagniṃcinute | imamāruṇaketukamagniṃcinvāna iti | ya evāsau | itaścāmutaścā'vyatīpātī | tamiti | yo'gnermithūyā veda | mithunavānbhavati | āpo vā agnermithūyāḥ | mithunavānbhavati | ya evaṃ veda

text_mt: These worlds directly. Which Agni does he pile up who piles this Āruṇaketuka Agni? "That very one who from here and from yonder does not fail—him." Whosoever knows the pairing of Agni becomes possessed of a pair. Waters indeed are the pairing of Agni. He becomes possessed of a pair who knows thus. / [Prapāṭhaka index words]

sanskrit_iast: āpo vā idamāsanthsalilameva | sa prajāpatirekaḥ puṣkaraparṇe samabhavat | tasyāntarmanasi kāmaḥ samavartata | idaṃ sṛjeyamiti | tasmādyatpuruṣo manasā'bhigacchati | tadvācā vadati | tatkarmaṇā karoti | tadeṣā'bhyanūktā | kāmastadagre samavartatādhi | manaso retaḥ prathamaṃ yadāsīt
meaning: आपो वा इदमासन्थ्सलिलमेव | स प्रजापतिरेकः पुष्करपर्णे समभवत् | तस्यान्तर्मनसि कामः समवर्तत | इदं सृजेयमिति | तस्माद्यत्पुरुषो मनसाऽभिगच्छति | तद्वाचा वदति | तत्कर्मणा करोति | तदेषाऽभ्यनूक्ता | कामस्तदग्रे समवर्तताधि | मनसो रेतः प्रथमं यदासीत्
text_mt: Waters indeed were this [universe] in the beginning, an undifferentiated flood. That Prajāpati arose alone upon a lotus leaf. Within his mind desire arose: "May I create this." / Therefore what a man conceives with his mind, that he speaks with speech, that he performs with action. / Regarding that, this [verse] has been recited: / In the beginning desire arose upon it, / which was the first seed of mind.

sanskrit_iast: sato bandhumasati niravindan | hṛdi pratīṣyā kavayo manīṣeti | upainantadupanamati | yatkāmo bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | sa tapo'tapyata | sa tapastaptvā | śarīramadhūnuta | tasya yanmāṃsamāsīt | tato'ruṇāḥ ketavo vātaraśanā ṛṣaya udatiṣṭhan
meaning: सतो बन्धुमसति निरविन्दन् | हृदि प्रतीष्या कवयो मनीषेति | उपैनन्तदुपनमति | यत्कामो भवति | य एवं वेद | स तपोऽतप्यत | स तपस्तप्त्वा | शरीरमधूनुत | तस्य यन्मांसमासीत् | ततोऽरुणाः केतवो वातरशना ऋषय उदतिष्ठन्
text_mt: Sages, searching in the heart with reflection, / discovered the bond of the existent in the non-existent. / That comes to pass for him, whatever he desires, who knows thus. He performed ascetic heat. / Having performed ascetic heat, he shook his body. What was his flesh, from that arose the Aruṇa Ketus, the wind-girdled seers.

sanskrit_iast: ye nakhāḥ | te vaikhānasāḥ | ye vālāḥ | te vālakhilyāḥ | yo rasaḥ | so'pām | antarataḥ kūrmaṃ bhūtaṃ sarpantam | tamabravīt | mama vaitvaṅmāṃsā | samabhūt
meaning: ये नखाः | ते वैखानसाः | ये वालाः | ते वालखिल्याः | यो रसः | सोऽपाम् | अन्तरतः कूर्मं भूतं सर्पन्तम् | तमब्रवीत् | मम वैत्वङ्मांसा | समभूत्
text_mt: What were the nails, they were the Vaikhānasa [seers]; what were the hairs, they were the Vālakhilyas; what was the sap, that was of the waters. / Inside, there was a tortoise creeping. To him he said: "You have indeed arisen from my skin and flesh."

sanskrit_iast: netyabravīt | pūrvamevāhamihāsamiti | tatpuruṣasya puruṣatvam | sa sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ | sahasrākṣassahasrapāt | bhūtvodatiṣṭhat | tamabravīt | tvaṃ vai pūrvaṃ samabhūḥ | tvamidaṃ pūrvaḥ kuruṣveti | sa ita ādāyāpaḥ
meaning: नेत्यब्रवीत् | पूर्वमेवाहमिहासमिति | तत्पुरुषस्य पुरुषत्वम् | स सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः | सहस्राक्षस्सहस्रपात् | भूत्वोदतिष्ठत् | तमब्रवीत् | त्वं वै पूर्वं समभूः | त्वमिदं पूर्वः कुरुष्वेति | स इत आदायापः
text_mt: "Not so," he said, "I was here before [you]." That is the Puruṣa-hood of the Puruṣa. He, becoming the thousand-headed, thousand-eyed, thousand-footed Puruṣa, arose. / He said to him: "You indeed arose before; do you make this first." He, taking waters from here,

sanskrit_iast: añjalinā purastādupādadhāt | evāhyeveti | tata āditya udatiṣṭhat | sā prācī dik | athāruṇaḥ keturdakṣiṇata upādadhāt | evāhyagna iti | tato vā agnirudatiṣṭhat | sā dakṣiṇā dik | athāruṇaḥ ketuḥ paścādupādadhāt | evāhi vāyo iti
meaning: अञ्जलिना पुरस्तादुपादधात् | एवाह्येवेति | तत आदित्य उदतिष्ठत् | सा प्राची दिक् | अथारुणः केतुर्दक्षिणत उपादधात् | एवाह्यग्न इति | ततो वा अग्निरुदतिष्ठत् | सा दक्षिणा दिक् | अथारुणः केतुः पश्चादुपादधात् | एवाहि वायो इति
text_mt: laid [them] down in front with his joined hands, [saying]: "Indeed so!" Thence arose Āditya. / That is the eastern direction. Then Aruṇa Ketu laid [them] down to the south, [saying]: "Indeed so, O Agni!" Thence indeed arose Agni. That is the southern direction. Then Aruṇa Ketu laid [them] down to the west, [saying]: / "Indeed so, O Vāyu!"

sanskrit_iast: tato vāyurudatiṣṭhat | sā pratīcī dik | athāruṇaḥ keturuttarata upādadhāt | evāhīndreti | tato vā indra udatiṣṭhat | sodīcī dik | athāruṇaḥ keturmadhya upādadhāt | evāhi pūṣanniti | tato vai pūṣodatiṣṭhat | seyandik
meaning: ततो वायुरुदतिष्ठत् | सा प्रतीची दिक् | अथारुणः केतुरुत्तरत उपादधात् | एवाहीन्द्रेति | ततो वा इन्द्र उदतिष्ठत् | सोदीची दिक् | अथारुणः केतुर्मध्य उपादधात् | एवाहि पूषन्निति | ततो वै पूषोदतिष्ठत् | सेयन्दिक्
text_mt: Thence arose Vāyu. That is the western direction. Then Aruṇa Ketu laid [them] down to the north, [saying]: "Indeed so, O Indra!" Thence indeed arose Indra. That is the northern direction. Then Aruṇa Ketu laid [them] down in the middle, [saying]: "Indeed so, O Pūṣan!" Thence indeed arose Pūṣan. That is this direction.

sanskrit_iast: athāruṇaḥ keturupariṣṭādupādadhāt | evāhi devā iti | tato devamanuṣyāḥ pitaraḥ | gandharvāpsarasaścodatiṣṭhan | sordhvā dik | yā vipruṣo viparāpatan | tābhyo'surā rakṣāṃsi piśācāścodatiṣṭhan | tasmātte parābhavan | vipruḍbhyo hi te samabhavan | tadeṣā'bhyanūktā
meaning: अथारुणः केतुरुपरिष्टादुपादधात् | एवाहि देवा इति | ततो देवमनुष्याः पितरः | गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चोदतिष्ठन् | सोर्ध्वा दिक् | या विप्रुषो विपरापतन् | ताभ्योऽसुरा रक्षांसि पिशाचाश्चोदतिष्ठन् | तस्मात्ते पराभवन् | विप्रुड्भ्यो हि ते समभवन् | तदेषाऽभ्यनूक्ता
text_mt: Then Aruṇa Ketu laid [them] down above, [saying]: "Indeed so, O gods!" Thence arose gods, men, fathers, gandharvas, and apsarases. That is the upward direction. The drops that scattered down, from them arose asuras, rakṣases, and piśācas. / Therefore they were defeated, for they arose from scattered drops. Regarding that, this [verse] has been recited:

sanskrit_iast: āpo ha yadbṛhatīrgarbhamāyan | dakṣandadhānā janayantīḥ svayaṃbhum | tata ime'ddhyasṛjyanta sargāḥ | adbhyo vā idaṃ samabhūt | tasmādidaṃ sarvaṃ brahma svayaṃbhviti | tasmādidaṃ sarvaṃ śithilamivāddhruvamivābhavat | prajāpatirvāva tat | ātmanātmānaṃ vidhāya | tadevānuprāviśat | tadeṣā'bhyanūktā
meaning: आपो ह यद्बृहतीर्गर्भमायन् | दक्षन्दधाना जनयन्तीः स्वयंभुम् | तत इमेऽद्ध्यसृज्यन्त सर्गाः | अद्भ्यो वा इदं समभूत् | तस्मादिदं सर्वं ब्रह्म स्वयंभ्विति | तस्मादिदं सर्वं शिथिलमिवाद्ध्रुवमिवाभवत् | प्रजापतिर्वाव तत् | आत्मनात्मानं विधाय | तदेवानुप्राविशत् | तदेषाऽभ्यनूक्ता
text_mt: When the great waters went as a womb, / bearing Dakṣa, generating the self-existent, / thence these creations were fashioned above. / From the waters indeed this [all] arose; therefore all this is self-existent brahman. Therefore all this became as if loose, as if unsteady. Prajāpati indeed, having arranged himself by himself, entered into that very [creation]. Regarding that, this [verse] has been recited:

sanskrit_iast: vidhāya lokān vidhāya bhūtāni | vidhāya sarvāḥ pradiśo diśaśca | prajāpatiḥ prathamajā ṛtasya | ātmanātmānamabhisaṃviveśeti | sarvamevedamāptvā | sarvamavaruddhya | tadevānupraviśati | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: विधाय लोकान् विधाय भूतानि | विधाय सर्वाः प्रदिशो दिशश्च | प्रजापतिः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य | आत्मनात्मानमभिसंविवेशेति | सर्वमेवेदमाप्त्वा | सर्वमवरुद्ध्य | तदेवानुप्रविशति | य एवं वेद
text_mt: Having arranged the worlds, having arranged the beings, / having arranged all intermediate quarters and directions, / Prajāpati, the firstborn of cosmic order, / entered into himself by himself. / Having attained all this, having enclosed all, he enters into that very [creation], who knows thus. / [Prapāṭhaka index words]

sanskrit_iast: catuṣṭayya āpo gṛhṇāti | catvāri vā apāṃ rūpāṇi | megho vidyut | stanayitnurvṛṣṭiḥ | tānyevāvarundhe | ātapati varṣyā gṛhṇāti | tāḥ purastādupadadhāti | etā vai brahmavarcasyā āpaḥ | mukhata eva brahmavarcasamavarundhe | tasmānmukhato brahmavarcasitaraḥ
meaning: चतुष्टय्य आपो गृह्णाति | चत्वारि वा अपां रूपाणि | मेघो विद्युत् | स्तनयित्नुर्वृष्टिः | तान्येवावरुन्धे | आतपति वर्ष्या गृह्णाति | ताः पुरस्तादुपदधाति | एता वै ब्रह्मवर्चस्या आपः | मुखत एव ब्रह्मवर्चसमवरुन्धे | तस्मान्मुखतो ब्रह्मवर्चसितरः
text_mt: He takes fourfold waters. Four indeed are the forms of the waters: cloud, lightning, thunder, rain. These very ones he secures. He takes rain-waters while the sun shines. / He places them in front. These indeed are waters endowed with brāhmaṇa lustre. At the mouth [of the sacrifice] he secures brāhmaṇa lustre; therefore one is more endowed with brāhmaṇa lustre in the face.

sanskrit_iast: kūpyā gṛhṇāti | tā dakṣiṇata upadadhāti | etā vai tejasvinīrāpaḥ | teja evāsya dakṣiṇato dadhāti | tasmāddakṣiṇo'rdhastejasvitaraḥ | sthāvarā gṛhṇāti | tāḥ paścādupadadhāti | pratiṣṭhitā vai sthāvarāḥ | paścādeva pratitiṣṭhati | vahantīrgṛhṇāti
meaning: कूप्या गृह्णाति | ता दक्षिणत उपदधाति | एता वै तेजस्विनीरापः | तेज एवास्य दक्षिणतो दधाति | तस्माद्दक्षिणोऽर्धस्तेजस्वितरः | स्थावरा गृह्णाति | ताः पश्चादुपदधाति | प्रतिष्ठिता वै स्थावराः | पश्चादेव प्रतितिष्ठति | वहन्तीर्गृह्णाति
text_mt: He takes well-waters. He places them to the south. These indeed are fiery waters. He places fiery energy on his south side; therefore the right half is more endowed with fiery energy. / He takes standing waters. He places them to the west. Firmly established indeed are standing waters. / He becomes firmly established in the west. He takes flowing waters.

sanskrit_iast: tā uttarata upadadhāti | ojasā vā etā vahantīrivodgatīriva ākūjatīriva dhāvantīḥ | oja evāsyottarato dadhāti | tasmāduttaro'rdha ojasvitaraḥ | saṃbhāryā gṛhṇāti | tā madhya upadadhāti | iyaṃ vai saṃbhāryāḥ | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhati | palvalyā gṛhṇāti | tā upariṣṭādupādadhāti
meaning: ता उत्तरत उपदधाति | ओजसा वा एता वहन्तीरिवोद्गतीरिव आकूजतीरिव धावन्तीः | ओज एवास्योत्तरतो दधाति | तस्मादुत्तरोऽर्ध ओजस्वितरः | संभार्या गृह्णाति | ता मध्य उपदधाति | इयं वै संभार्याः | अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठति | पल्वल्या गृह्णाति | ता उपरिष्टादुपादधाति
text_mt: He places them to the north. With vigour indeed do these [flow], as if carrying along, as if rising up, as if murmuring, running. He places vigour on his north side; therefore the northern half is more vigorous. / He takes collected waters. He places them in the middle. This [earth] indeed is the collected [waters]. In this very [earth] he becomes firmly established. He takes pool-waters. He places them above.

sanskrit_iast: asau vai palvalyāḥ | amuṣyāmeva pratitiṣṭhati | dikṣūpadadhāti | dikṣu vā āpaḥ | annaṃ vā āpaḥ | adbhyo vā annañjāyate | yadevadbhyo'nnañjāyate | tadavarundhe | taṃ vā etamaruṇāḥ ketavo vātaraśanā ṛṣayo'cinvan | tasmādāruṇaketukaḥ
meaning: असौ वै पल्वल्याः | अमुष्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठति | दिक्षूपदधाति | दिक्षु वा आपः | अन्नं वा आपः | अद्भ्यो वा अन्नञ्जायते | यदेवद्भ्योऽन्नञ्जायते | तदवरुन्धे | तं वा एतमरुणाः केतवो वातरशना ऋषयोऽचिन्वन् | तस्मादारुणकेतुकः
text_mt: Yonder [sky] indeed is the pool-waters. In yonder [sky] he becomes firmly established. He places [them] in the directions. In the directions indeed are the waters. Food indeed is the waters. From the waters indeed food is born. Whatever food is born from the waters, that he secures. That very this [fire] the Aruṇa Ketus, the wind-girdled seers, piled up; / therefore it is named Āruṇaketuka.

sanskrit_iast: tadeṣā'bhyanūktā | ketavo aruṇāsaśca | ṛṣayo vātaraśanāḥ | pratiṣṭhāṃ śatadhāhi | samāhitāso sahasradhāyasamiti | śataśaścaiva sahasraśaśca pratitiṣṭhati | ya etamagniṃcinute | ya ucainamevaṃ veda
meaning: तदेषाऽभ्यनूक्ता | केतवो अरुणासश्च | ऋषयो वातरशनाः | प्रतिष्ठां शतधाहि | समाहितासो सहस्रधायसमिति | शतशश्चैव सहस्रशश्च प्रतितिष्ठति | य एतमग्निंचिनुते | य उचैनमेवं वेद
text_mt:
Regarding this, [a verse] has been recited:
“The Ketus and the Aruṇas,
the wind-girdled seers,
established firmly in a hundredfold way,
united, bearing a thousandfold [strength].”
He is established in hundredfold and thousandfold ways—he who piles this Agni, and he who knows it thus.
“Possessing more brahma-splendour, he takes flowing waters, he places them above, the Āruṇaketuka,” and eight.

sanskrit_iast: jānudaghnīmuttaravedīṅkhātvā | apāṃ pūrayati | apāṃ sarvatvāya | puṣkaraparṇaṃ rukmaṃ puruṣamityupadadhāti | tapo vai puṣkaraparṇam | satyaṃ rukmaḥ | amṛtaṃ puruṣaḥ | etāvadvāvāsti | yāvadetat | yāvadevāsti
meaning: जानुदघ्नीमुत्तरवेदीङ्खात्वा | अपां पूरयति | अपां सर्वत्वाय | पुष्करपर्णं रुक्मं पुरुषमित्युपदधाति | तपो वै पुष्करपर्णम् | सत्यं रुक्मः | अमृतं पुरुषः | एतावद्वावास्ति | यावदेतत् | यावदेवास्ति
text_mt:
Having dug the high altar knee-deep, he fills it with waters, for the completeness of the waters.
He deposits a lotus leaf, a gold plate, and a man.
The lotus leaf is ascetic heat, the gold plate is truth, the man is the immortal.
Whatever exists is just this much, as much as this.
Whatever exists,

sanskrit_iast: tadavarundhe | kūrmamupadadhāti | apāmeva medhamavarundhe | atho svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | āpamāpāmapassarvāḥ | asmādasmādito'mutaḥ | agnirvāyuśca sūryaśca | sahasañcaskararddhiyā iti | vāyvaśvā raśmipatayaḥ | lokaṃ pṛṇacchidraṃ pṛṇa
meaning: तदवरुन्धे | कूर्ममुपदधाति | अपामेव मेधमवरुन्धे | अथो स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै | आपमापामपस्सर्वाः | अस्मादस्मादितोऽमुतः | अग्निर्वायुश्च सूर्यश्च | सहसञ्चस्करर्द्धिया इति | वाय्वश्वा रश्मिपतयः | लोकं पृणच्छिद्रं पृण
text_mt:
he secures that. He deposits a tortoise; he secures the sap of the waters, and also for the attainment of the heavenly world.
“The waters, the waters, all the waters,
from here and here, from there and there,
may Agni, Vāyu, and Sūrya
fashion with their radiant power together.”
“Possessing wind-horses, lords of rays,” “Fill the space, fill the void,”

sanskrit_iast: yāstisraḥ paramajāḥ | indraghoṣā vo vasubhirevāhyeveti | pañcacitaya upadadhāti | pāṅkto'gniḥ | yāvānevāgniḥ | taṃcinute | lokaṃpṛṇayā dvitīyāmupadadhāti | pañcapadā vai virāṭ | tasyā vā iyaṃ pādaḥ | antarikṣaṃ pādaḥ | dyauḥ pādaḥ | diśaḥ pādaḥ | parorajāḥ pādaḥ | virājyeva pratitiṣṭhati | ya etamagniṃcinute | ya u cainamevaṃ veda
meaning: यास्तिस्रः परमजाः | इन्द्रघोषा वो वसुभिरेवाह्येवेति | पञ्चचितय उपदधाति | पाङ्क्तोऽग्निः | यावानेवाग्निः | तंचिनुते | लोकंपृणया द्वितीयामुपदधाति | पञ्चपदा वै विराट् | तस्या वा इयं पादः | अन्तरिक्षं पादः | द्यौः पादः | दिशः पादः | परोरजाः पादः | विराज्येव प्रतितिष्ठति | य एतमग्निंचिनुते | य उ चैनमेवं वेद
text_mt:
“Those three highest-born,” “Indra’s voice with the Vasus, even thus.”
He lays [the bricks] in five layers. Agni is fivefold; as great as Agni is, so much he piles.
With the space-filler [formula], he places the second [layer]. The virāj has five feet; this [earth] is indeed a foot of it, the intermediate space is a foot, the sky is a foot, the quarters are a foot, beyond the dusty realm is a foot.
He is established in the virāj—he who piles this Agni, and he who knows it thus.
“Exists, fill, the intermediate space is a foot,” and six.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ praṇīyopasamādhāya | tamabhita etā abīṣṭakā upadadhāti | agnihotre darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ | paśubandhe cāturmāsyeṣu | atho āhuḥ | sarveṣu yajñakratuṣviti | atha hasmāhāruṇaḥ svāyaṃbhuvaḥ | sāvitraḥ sarvo'gnirityananuṣaṅgaṃ manyāmahe | nānā vā eteṣāṃ vīryāṇi | kamagniṃcinute
meaning: अग्निं प्रणीयोपसमाधाय | तमभित एता अबीष्टका उपदधाति | अग्निहोत्रे दर्शपूर्णमासयोः | पशुबन्धे चातुर्मास्येषु | अथो आहुः | सर्वेषु यज्ञक्रतुष्विति | अथ हस्माहारुणः स्वायंभुवः | सावित्रः सर्वोऽग्निरित्यननुषङ्गं मन्यामहे | नाना वा एतेषां वीर्याणि | कमग्निंचिनुते
text_mt:
Having brought forward Agni and having placed fuel upon it, around him he places these water-bricks: at the Agnihotra, at the new- and full-moon sacrifices, at the animal sacrifice, at the four-month sacrifices.
And then they say: “At all sacrificial rites.” Then indeed said Āruṇa Svāyambhuva:
“Every Agni is related to Savitṛ; we consider that there should be no combination [of bricks]. Distinct indeed are their potencies.
Which Agni does he pile

sanskrit_iast: satriyamagniṃcinvānaḥ | kamagniṃcinute | sāvitramagniṃcinvānaḥ | kamagniṃcinute | nāciketamagniṃcinvānaḥ | kamagniṃcinute | cāturhotriyamagniṃcinvānaḥ | kamagniṃcinute | vaiśvasṛjamagniṃcinvānaḥ | kamagniṃcinute
meaning: सत्रियमग्निंचिन्वानः | कमग्निंचिनुते | सावित्रमग्निंचिन्वानः | कमग्निंचिनुते | नाचिकेतमग्निंचिन्वानः | कमग्निंचिनुते | चातुर्होत्रियमग्निंचिन्वानः | कमग्निंचिनुते | वैश्वसृजमग्निंचिन्वानः | कमग्निंचिनुते
text_mt: who piles the Satriya-fire? Which Agni does he pile who piles the Sāvitra-fire? Which Agni does he pile who piles the Nāciketa-fire? Which Agni does he pile who piles the Cāturhotriya-fire? Which Agni does he pile who piles the Vaiśvasṛja-fire? Which Agni does he pile

sanskrit_iast: upānuvākyamāśumagniṃcinvānaḥ | kamagniṃcinute | imamāruṇaketukamagniṃcinvāna iti | vṛṣā vā agniḥ | vṛṣāṇau saṃsphālayet | hanyetāsya yajñaḥ | tasmānnānuṣajyaḥ | sottaravediṣu kratuṣu cinvīta | uttaravedyāg hyagniścīyate | prajākāmaścinvīta
meaning: उपानुवाक्यमाशुमग्निंचिन्वानः | कमग्निंचिनुते | इममारुणकेतुकमग्निंचिन्वान इति | वृषा वा अग्निः | वृषाणौ संस्फालयेत् | हन्येतास्य यज्ञः | तस्मान्नानुषज्यः | सोत्तरवेदिषु क्रतुषु चिन्वीत | उत्तरवेद्याग् ह्यग्निश्चीयते | प्रजाकामश्चिन्वीत
text_mt:
who piles the Upānuvākya-Āśu-fire? Which Agni does he pile who piles this Āruṇaketuka-fire?”
Agni is a male; he would cause two males to clash, his sacrifice would be ruined; therefore, they should not be combined.
One should pile it in rites with a high altar, for Agni is piled on the high altar. One desirous of offspring should pile it.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyo vā eṣo'gniḥ | prājāpatyāḥ prajāḥ | prajāvānbhavati | ya evaṃ veda | paśukāmaścinvīta | saṃjñānaṃ vā etatpaśūnām | yadāpaḥ | paśūnāmeva saṃjñāne'gniṃcinute | paśumānbhavati | ya evaṃ veda
meaning: प्राजापत्यो वा एषोऽग्निः | प्राजापत्याः प्रजाः | प्रजावान्भवति | य एवं वेद | पशुकामश्चिन्वीत | संज्ञानं वा एतत्पशूनाम् | यदापः | पशूनामेव संज्ञानेऽग्निंचिनुते | पशुमान्भवति | य एवं वेद
text_mt:
This Agni belongs to Prajāpati; offspring belong to Prajāpati; he becomes possessed of offspring, he who knows thus.
One desirous of cattle should pile it; the waters are the concord of cattle; he piles Agni in the very concord of cattle; he becomes possessed of cattle, he who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭikāmaścinvīta | āpo vai vṛṣṭiḥ | parjanyo varṣuko bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | āmayāvī cinvīta | āpo vai bheṣajam | bheṣajamevāsmai karoti | sarvamāyureti | abhicaraṃścinvīta | vajro vā āpaḥ
meaning: वृष्टिकामश्चिन्वीत | आपो वै वृष्टिः | पर्जन्यो वर्षुको भवति | य एवं वेद | आमयावी चिन्वीत | आपो वै भेषजम् | भेषजमेवास्मै करोति | सर्वमायुरेति | अभिचरंश्चिन्वीत | वज्रो वा आपः

sanskrit_iast: vajrameva bhrātṛvyebhyaḥ praharati | stṛṇuta enam | tejaskāmo yaśaskāmaḥ | brahmavarcasakāmaḥ svargakāmaścinvīta | etāvadvā vāsti | yāvadetat | yāvadevāsti | tadavarundhe | tasyaitadvratam | varṣati na dhāvet
meaning: वज्रमेव भ्रातृव्येभ्यः प्रहरति | स्तृणुत एनम् | तेजस्कामो यशस्कामः | ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः स्वर्गकामश्चिन्वीत | एतावद्वा वास्ति | यावदेतत् | यावदेवास्ति | तदवरुन्धे | तस्यैतद्व्रतम् | वर्षति न धावेत्
text_mt:
he hurls a thunderbolt at his rivals; he strikes down this [enemy].
One desirous of fiery energy, desirous of fame, desirous of brahma-splendour, desirous of heaven should pile it.
Whatever exists is just this much, as much as this; whatever exists, he secures that.
This is his observance: when it rains, he should not run;

sanskrit_iast: amṛtaṃ vā āpaḥ | amṛtasyānantarityai | nāpsu mūtrapurīṣaṅkuryāt | na niṣṭhīvet | na vivasanassnāyāt | guhyo vā eṣo'gniḥ | etasyāgneranatidāhāya | na puṣkaraparṇāni hiraṇyaṃ vā'dhitiṣṭhet | etasyāgneranabhyārohāya | na kūrmasyāśnīyāt | nodakasyāghātukānyenamodakāni bhavanti | aghātukā āpaḥ | ya etamagniṃcinute | ya ucainamevaṃ veda
meaning: अमृतं वा आपः | अमृतस्यानन्तरित्यै | नाप्सु मूत्रपुरीषङ्कुर्यात् | न निष्ठीवेत् | न विवसनस्स्नायात् | गुह्यो वा एषोऽग्निः | एतस्याग्नेरनतिदाहाय | न पुष्करपर्णानि हिरण्यं वाऽधितिष्ठेत् | एतस्याग्नेरनभ्यारोहाय | न कूर्मस्याश्नीयात् | नोदकस्याघातुकान्येनमोदकानि भवन्ति | अघातुका आपः | य एतमग्निंचिनुते | य उचैनमेवं वेद
text_mt:
the waters are the immortal, so as not to be excluded from the immortal.
He should not pass urine or feces in water; he should not spit; he should not bathe naked; this Agni is hidden, so as not to cause excessive burning of this Agni.
He should not step upon lotus leaves or gold, so as not to mount upon this Agni.
He should not eat tortoise [flesh]; he should not eat of water-creatures; the waters do not harm him, the waters are harmless—for him who piles this Agni, and who knows it thus.
“Piles, piles, desirous of offspring should pile, he who knows thus, waters, run, eat,” and four.

sanskrit_iast: imānukaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhema | indraśca viśve ca devāḥ | yajñañca nastanvañca prajāñca | ādityairindrassaha sīṣadhātu | ādityairindrassagaṇo marudbhiḥ | asmākaṃ bhūtvavitā tanūnām | āplavasva praplavasva | āṇḍī bhava ja mā muhuḥ | sukhādīnduḥkhanidhanām | pratimuñcasva svāṃ puram
meaning: इमानुकं भुवना सीषधेम | इन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः | यज्ञञ्च नस्तन्वञ्च प्रजाञ्च | आदित्यैरिन्द्रस्सह सीषधातु | आदित्यैरिन्द्रस्सगणो मरुद्भिः | अस्माकं भूत्वविता तनूनाम् | आप्लवस्व प्रप्लवस्व | आण्डी भव ज मा मुहुः | सुखादीन्दुःखनिधनाम् | प्रतिमुञ्चस्व स्वां पुरम्
text_mt:
May we make these worlds succeed,
Indra and all the gods!
And our sacrifice, our body, and our offspring,
may Indra along with the Ādityas make succeed!
May Indra, together with the Ādityas and the host of Maruts,
become the protector of our bodies.
Float on, swim forth!
Become an egg, do not be bewildered again!
Having cast off that which ends in sorrow although beginning in pleasure,
put on your own stronghold!

sanskrit_iast: marīcayaḥ svāyaṃbhuvāḥ | ye śarīrāṇyakalpayan | te te dehaṅkalpayantu | mā ca te khyā sma tīriṣat | uttiṣṭhata mā svapta | agnimicchadhvaṃ bhāratāḥ | rājñassomasya tṛptāsaḥ | sūryeṇa sayujoṣasaḥ | yuvā suvāsāḥ | aṣṭācakrā navadvārā
meaning: मरीचयः स्वायंभुवाः | ये शरीराण्यकल्पयन् | ते ते देहङ्कल्पयन्तु | मा च ते ख्या स्म तीरिषत् | उत्तिष्ठत मा स्वप्त | अग्निमिच्छध्वं भारताः | राज्ञस्सोमस्य तृप्तासः | सूर्येण सयुजोषसः | युवा सुवासाः | अष्टाचक्रा नवद्वारा
text_mt:
The self-born rays,
who fashioned the bodies,
may they fashion your body;
and may your vision not be impaired!
Arise, do not sleep!
Seek Agni, O Bhāratas!
Satisfied with king Soma,
united with Sūrya at dawn!
Youthful, well-clothed,
eight-wheeled, nine-gated,

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ pūrayodhyā | tasyāṃ hiraṇmayaḥ kośaḥ | svargo loko jyotiṣā''vṛtaḥ | yo vai tāṃ brahmaṇo veda | amṛtenā''vṛtāṃ purīm | tasmai brahma ca brahmā ca | āyuḥ kīrtiṃ prajāndaduḥ | vibhrājamānāṃ hariṇīm | yaśasā saṃparīvṛtām | puraṃ hiraṇmayīṃ brahmā
meaning: देवानां पूरयोध्या | तस्यां हिरण्मयः कोशः | स्वर्गो लोको ज्योतिषा'ऽवृतः | यो वै तां ब्रह्मणो वेद | अमृतेना'ऽवृतां पुरीम् | तस्मै ब्रह्म च ब्रह्मा च | आयुः कीर्तिं प्रजान्ददुः | विभ्राजमानां हरिणीम् | यशसा संपरीवृताम् | पुरं हिरण्मयीं ब्रह्मा
text_mt:
the impregnable city of the gods;
in it is a golden sheath,
the heavenly world covered with light.
He who knows that city of brahman,
covered with immortality,
to him brahman and Brahmā
have given life, fame, and offspring.
Resplendent, yellowish-golden,
completely surrounded with glory,
the golden city, Brahmā

sanskrit_iast: viveśā'parājitā | parāṅetyajyāmayī | parāṅetyanāśakī | iha cāmutra cānveti | vidvāndevāsurānubhayān | yatkumārī mandrayate | yadyoṣadyatpativratā | ariṣṭaṃ yatkiñca kriyate | agnistadanuvedhati | aśṛtāsaḥ śṛtāsaśca
meaning: विवेशाऽपराजिता | पराङेत्यज्यामयी | पराङेत्यनाशकी | इह चामुत्र चान्वेति | विद्वान्देवासुरानुभयान् | यत्कुमारी मन्द्रयते | यद्योषद्यत्पतिव्रता | अरिष्टं यत्किञ्च क्रियते | अग्निस्तदनुवेधति | अशृतासः शृतासश्च
text_mt:
has entered, unconquered.
Turning away, it is non-decaying;
turning away, it is imperishable.
Here and in the other world it follows,
knowing both gods and asuras.
What a young girl murmurs,
what a woman, what a faithful wife,
whatever harmless thing is done,
Agni penetrates after that.
Those uncooked and those cooked,

sanskrit_iast: yajvāno ye'pyayajvanaḥ | svaryanto nāpekṣante | indramagniñca ye viduḥ | sikatā iva saṃyanti | raśmibhissamudīritāḥ | asmāllokādamuṣmācca | ṛṣibhiradātpṛśnibhiḥ | apeta vīta vi ca sarpatātaḥ | ye'tra stha purāṇā ye ca nūtanāḥ | ahobhiradbhiraktubhirvyaktam
meaning: यज्वानो येऽप्ययज्वनः | स्वर्यन्तो नापेक्षन्ते | इन्द्रमग्निञ्च ये विदुः | सिकता इव संयन्ति | रश्मिभिस्समुदीरिताः | अस्माल्लोकादमुष्माच्च | ऋषिभिरदात्पृश्निभिः | अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातः | येऽत्र स्थ पुराणा ये च नूतनाः | अहोभिरद्भिरक्तुभिर्व्यक्तम्
text_mt:
those who sacrifice and also those who do not sacrifice,
going to heaven, they do not look back,
they who know Indra and Agni.
Like sands they unite,
impelled by rays,
from this world and from that,
[the light] which the dappled seers gave.
Depart, go away, crawl away from here,
ye who are here, both ancient and new!
Manifested through days, waters, and nights

sanskrit_iast: yamo dadātvavasānamasmai | nṛ muṇantu nṛ pātvaryaḥ | akṛṣṭā ye ca kṛṣṭajāḥ | kumārīṣu kanīnīṣu | jāriṇīṣu ca ye hitāḥ | retaḥpītā āṇḍapītāḥ | aṅgāreṣu ca ye hutāḥ | ubhayānputrapautrakān | yuve'haṃ yamarājagān | śataminnu śaradaḥ | ado yadbrahma vilabam | pitṛṇāñca yamasya ca | varuṇasyāśvinoragneḥ | marutāñca vihāyasām | kāmaprayavaṇaṃ me astu | sa hyevāsmi sanātanaḥ | iti nāko brahmiśravo rāyo dhanam | putrānāpo devīrihāhitā
meaning: यमो ददात्ववसानमस्मै | नृ मुणन्तु नृ पात्वर्यः | अकृष्टा ये च कृष्टजाः | कुमारीषु कनीनीषु | जारिणीषु च ये हिताः | रेतःपीता आण्डपीताः | अङ्गारेषु च ये हुताः | उभयान्पुत्रपौत्रकान् | युवेऽहं यमराजगान् | शतमिन्नु शरदः | अदो यद्ब्रह्म विलबम् | पितृणाञ्च यमस्य च | वरुणस्याश्विनोरग्नेः | मरुताञ्च विहायसाम् | कामप्रयवणं मे अस्तु | स ह्येवास्मि सनातनः | इति नाको ब्रह्मिश्रवो रायो धनम् | पुत्रानापो देवीरिहाहिता
text_mt: May Yama give a resting-place to this one. / May the noble crush, may the noble protect [him]. / Both those not cultivated and those born of cultivated [land], / those placed in young girls, in maidens, / and in unchaste women; / those swallowed as semen, swallowed as eggs, / and those offered in the glowing coals, / both [classes of] sons and grandsons / who have gone to Yama's realm, I summon. / A full hundred autumns / is that open portal of brahman, / both of the fathers and of Yama, / of Varuṇa, of the Aśvins, of Agni, / and of the aerial Maruts. / May my desire's departure be [granted], / for I indeed am the eternal one. / Thus: heaven, glory of brahman, wealth, riches, sons, waters, divine, deposited here, city of nine gates, and brahman, revealed, and eight autumns.

sanskrit_iast: viśīrṣṇīṃ gṛdhraśīrṣṇīñca | apeto nirṛtiṃ hathaḥ | paribādhaṃ śvetakukṣam | nijaṅghaṃ śabalodaram | sa tān vācyāyayā saha | agne nāśaya saṃdṛśaḥ | īrṣyāsūye bubhukṣām | manyuṃ kṛtyāñca dīdhire | rathena kiṃśukāvatā | agne nāśaya saṃdṛśaḥ
meaning: विशीर्ष्णीं गृध्रशीर्ष्णीञ्च | अपेतो निरृतिं हथः | परिबाधं श्वेतकुक्षम् | निजङ्घं शबलोदरम् | स तान् वाच्यायया सह | अग्ने नाशय संदृशः | ईर्ष्यासूये बुभुक्षाम् | मन्युं कृत्याञ्च दीधिरे | रथेन किंशुकावता | अग्ने नाशय संदृशः
text_mt: The headless one and the vulture-headed one / you strike away from here, Nirṛti; / the obstruction, the white-bellied, / the low-shanked, the dappled-bellied— / them, along with the vocal [fiend], / make vanish from sight, O Agni! / Envy, malice, hunger, / wrath, and witchcraft they have brought forth; / with your chariot made of kiṃśuka wood, / make [them] vanish from sight, O Agni!

sanskrit_iast: parjanyāya pragāyata | divasputrāya mīḍhuṣe | sa no yavasamicchatu | idaṃ vacaḥ parjanyāya svarāje | hṛdo astvantarantadyuyota | mayobhūrvāto viśvakṛṣṭayaḥ santvasme | supippalā oṣadhīrdevagopāḥ | yo garbhamoṣadhīnām | gavāṅkṛṇotyarvatām | parjanyaḥ puruṣīṇām
meaning: पर्जन्याय प्रगायत | दिवस्पुत्राय मीढुषे | स नो यवसमिच्छतु | इदं वचः पर्जन्याय स्वराजे | हृदो अस्त्वन्तरन्तद्युयोत | मयोभूर्वातो विश्वकृष्टयः सन्त्वस्मे | सुपिप्पला ओषधीर्देवगोपाः | यो गर्भमोषधीनाम् | गवाङ्कृणोत्यर्वताम् | पर्जन्यः पुरुषीणाम्
text_mt: Sing forth to Parjanya, / to the bounteous son of the sky; / may he seek barley for us. / May this speech to Parjanya, the sovereign ruler, / reach deep into his heart; avert that [drought]. / May the wind bring comfort; may all peoples belong to us; / may the plants, guarded by the gods, bear good fruit. / He who makes the embryo of plants, / of cows, of swift horses, / Parjanya, of women. / Headless, to Parjanya, ten [and] ten.

sanskrit_iast: punarmāmaitvindriyam | punarāyuḥ punarbhagaḥ | punarbrāhmaṇamaitu mā | punardraviṇamaitu mā | yanme'dya retaḥ pṛthivīmaskān | yadoṣadhīrapyasaradyadāpaḥ | idantatpunarādade | dīrghāyuttvāya varcase | yanme retaḥ prasicyate | yanma ājāyate punaḥ | tena māmamṛtaṅkuru | tena suprajasaṅkuru
meaning: पुनर्मामैत्विन्द्रियम् | पुनरायुः पुनर्भगः | पुनर्ब्राह्मणमैतु मा | पुनर्द्रविणमैतु मा | यन्मेऽद्य रेतः पृथिवीमस्कान् | यदोषधीरप्यसरद्यदापः | इदन्तत्पुनराददे | दीर्घायुत्त्वाय वर्चसे | यन्मे रेतः प्रसिच्यते | यन्म आजायते पुनः | तेन माममृतङ्कुरु | तेन सुप्रजसङ्कुरु
text_mt: May my faculty return to me, / life-span again, good fortune again; / may brahmanhood return to me, / may property return to me. / The semen of mine that was spilled today upon the earth, / that flowed into the plants, that [flowed into] the waters, / that I now take back / for long life, for lustre. / The semen of mine that is poured out, / that which is born in me again, / by that make me immortal, / by that make me rich in offspring. / Again, and two.

sanskrit_iast: adbhyastirodhā'jāyata | tava vaiśravaṇassadā | tirodhehi sapatnānnaḥ | ye apo'śnanti kecana | tvāṣṭrīṃ māyāṃ vaiśravaṇaḥ | rathaṃ sahasravandhuram | puruścakraṃ sahasrāśvam | āsthāyāyāhi no balim | yasmai bhūtāni balimāvahanti | dhanaṅgāvo hastihiraṇyamaśvān
meaning: अद्भ्यस्तिरोधाऽजायत | तव वैश्रवणस्सदा | तिरोधेहि सपत्नान्नः | ये अपोऽश्नन्ति केचन | त्वाष्ट्रीं मायां वैश्रवणः | रथं सहस्रवन्धुरम् | पुरुश्चक्रं सहस्राश्वम् | आस्थायायाहि नो बलिम् | यस्मै भूतानि बलिमावहन्ति | धनङ्गावो हस्तिहिरण्यमश्वान्
text_mt: Concealment was born from the waters; / it is ever thine, O Vaiśravaṇa. / Conceal our rivals, / all who eat of the waters. / Mounting the craft of Tvaṣṭṛ, O Vaiśravaṇa, / the chariot with a thousand seats, / with many wheels, with a thousand horses, / come to our offering! / To whom beings bring an offering— / wealth, cattle, elephants, gold, horses—

sanskrit_iast: asāma sumatau yajñiyasya | śriyaṃ bibhrato'nnamukhīṃ virājam | sudarśane ca kroñce ca | maināge ca mahāgirau | satadvāṭṭāragamantā | saṃhāryannagaraṃ tava | iti mantrāḥ | kalpo'ta ūrdhvam | yadi baliṃ haret | hiraṇyanābhaye vitudaye kauberāyāyaṃ baliḥ
meaning: असाम सुमतौ यज्ञियस्य | श्रियं बिभ्रतोऽन्नमुखीं विराजम् | सुदर्शने च क्रोञ्चे च | मैनागे च महागिरौ | सतद्वाट्टारगमन्ता | संहार्यन्नगरं तव | इति मन्त्राः | कल्पोऽत ऊर्ध्वम् | यदि बलिं हरेत् | हिरण्यनाभये वितुदये कौबेरायायं बलिः
text_mt: may we abide in the favor of the worshipful one, / bearing prosperity, the virāj whose mouth is food. / Both on Sudarśana and on Kroñca, / and on the great mountain Maināga, / Satadvā, Ṭāragamanta, / and Saṃhārya is thy city. / Thus the mantras. / Next is the ritual procedure. / If one should offer a bali: / “To the golden-naveled, to the piercer, to the son of Kubera is this offering,

sanskrit_iast: sarvabhūtādhipataye nama iti | atha baliṃ hṛtvopatiṣṭheta | kṣattraṃ kṣattraṃ vaiśravaṇaḥ | brāhmaṇā vayaṃsmaḥ | namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ | asmātpraviśyānnamaddhīti | atha tamagnimādadhīta | yasminnetatkarma prayuṃjīta | tirodhā bhūḥ | tirodhā bhuvaḥ
meaning: सर्वभूताधिपतये नम इति | अथ बलिं हृत्वोपतिष्ठेत | क्षत्त्रं क्षत्त्रं वैश्रवणः | ब्राह्मणा वयंस्मः | नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः | अस्मात्प्रविश्यान्नमद्धीति | अथ तमग्निमादधीत | यस्मिन्नेतत्कर्म प्रयुंजीत | तिरोधा भूः | तिरोधा भुवः
text_mt: homage to the overlord of all beings!” / Then, having offered the bali, he should attend [the fire]: / “Vaiśravaṇa is royal power, royal power; / we are brāhmaṇas. / Homage be to thee, do not harm me! / Entering from this [place], eat food!” / Then he should establish that fire / in which he would perform this rite: / “Concealment, bhūḥ! Concealment, bhuvaḥ!

sanskrit_iast: tirodhāssvaḥ | tirodhā bhūrbhuvassvaḥ | sarveṣāṃ lokānāmādhipatye sīdeti | atha tamagnimindhīta | yasminnetatkarma prayuṃjīta | tirodhā bhūssvāhā | tirodhā bhuvassvāhā | tirodhā svassvāhā | tirodhā bhūrbhuvassvassvāhā | yasminnasya kāle sarvā āhutīrhutā bhaveyuḥ
meaning: तिरोधास्स्वः | तिरोधा भूर्भुवस्स्वः | सर्वेषां लोकानामाधिपत्ये सीदेति | अथ तमग्निमिन्धीत | यस्मिन्नेतत्कर्म प्रयुंजीत | तिरोधा भूस्स्वाहा | तिरोधा भुवस्स्वाहा | तिरोधा स्वस्स्वाहा | तिरोधा भूर्भुवस्स्वस्स्वाहा | यस्मिन्नस्य काले सर्वा आहुतीर्हुता भवेयुः
text_mt: Concealment, svaḥ! / Concealment, bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ! / Sit down for the lordship of all worlds!” / Then he should kindle that fire / in which he would perform this rite: / “Concealment, bhūḥ, svāhā! / Concealment, bhuvaḥ, svāhā! / Concealment, svaḥ, svāhā! / Concealment, bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ, svāhā!” / At whatever time of day all his oblations would be offered,

sanskrit_iast: api brāhmaṇamukhīnāḥ | tasminnahnaḥ kāle prayuṃjīta | paraḥ suptajanādvepi | māsma pramādyantamādhyāpayet | sarvārthāḥ siddhyante | ya evaṃ veda | kṣudhyannidamajānatām | sarvārthā na siddhyante | yaste vighātuko bhrātā | mamāntarhṛdaye śritaḥ
meaning: अपि ब्राह्मणमुखीनाः | तस्मिन्नह्नः काले प्रयुंजीत | परः सुप्तजनाद्वेपि | मास्म प्रमाद्यन्तमाध्यापयेत् | सर्वार्थाः सिद्ध्यन्ते | य एवं वेद | क्षुध्यन्निदमजानताम् | सर्वार्था न सिद्ध्यन्ते | यस्ते विघातुको भ्राता | ममान्तर्हृदये श्रितः
text_mt: even [before] the foremost of brāhmaṇas, / at that time of the day he should perform it, / or after people have gone to sleep. / One should not teach one who is careless. / All aims are accomplished / for him who knows thus. / When one who does not know this is hungry, / all aims are not accomplished. / That destructive brother of thine / who has taken refuge inside my heart—

sanskrit_iast: tasmā imamagrapiṇḍañjuhomi | same'rthānmā vivadhīt | mayi svāhā | rājādhirājāya prasahyasāhine | namo vayaṃ vaiśravaṇāya kurmahe | sa me kāmānkāmakāmāya mahyam | kāmeśvaro vaiśravaṇo dadātu | kuberāya vaiśravaṇāya | mahārājāya namaḥ | ketavo aruṇāsaśca | ṛṣayo vātaraśanāḥ | pratiṣṭhāṃ śatadhā hi | samāhitāso sahasradhāyasam | śivā naḥ śantamā bhavantu | divyā āpa oṣadhayaḥ | sumṛḍīkā sarasvati | mā te vyoma saṃdṛśi

text_mt: to him I offer this foremost lump of food; / may he not destroy my aims! / In me, svāhā! / To the king over kings, who conquers by force, / we pay homage to Vaiśravaṇa. / May he grant me my desires, to me who desire desires; / may Vaiśravaṇa, the lord of desires, grant [them]. / To Kubera, son of Viśravas, / to the great king, homage! / The Aruṇa banners, / the wind-girdled seers, / [attained] a foundation a hundredfold, / gathered together, yielding a thousandfold. / Auspicious for us, most soothing may they be, / the heavenly waters, the plants! / Gracious, O Sarasvatī, / may we not see an emptiness in thee! / Horses, bali, bhuvaḥ, would be, and refuge, and seven.

text_mt: He should observe this vow for a year, / or for two months; / the rule is in summary. / In it are specific observances: / bathing in water at the three pressings; / he should partake of food and drink at the fourth meal-time, / or day by day he should eat begged food; / he should attend the fire with firewood of udumbara wood, / with this anuvāka, “May my faculty return to me”; / he should perform his duty with water drawn up and purified;

meaning: सह वै देवानाञ्चासुराणाञ्च यज्ञौ प्रततावास्तां वयं स्वर्गं लोकमेष्यामो वयमेष्याम इति तेऽसुराः संनह्य सहसैवाचरन्ब्रह्मचर्येण तपसैव देवास्तेऽसुरा अमुह्यंस्ते न प्राजानंस्ते पराभवन्ते न स्वर्गं लोकमायन्प्रसृतेन वै यज्ञेन देवास्स्वर्गं लोकमायन्नप्रसृतेनासुरान् पराऽभावयन् प्रसृतो ह वै यज्ञोपवीतिनो यज्ञोऽप्रसृतोऽनुपवीतिनो यत्किञ्च ब्राह्मणो यज्ञोपवीत्यधीते यजत एव तत्तस्माद्यज्ञोपवीत्येवाधीयीत याजयेद्यजेत वा यज्ञस्य प्रसृत्या अजिनं वासो वा दक्षिणत उपवीय दक्षिणं बाहुमुद्धरतेऽवधत्ते सव्यमिति यज्ञोपवीतमेतदेव विपरीतं प्राचीनावीतं संवीतं मानुषम्
text_mt: Together indeed the sacrifices of the gods and the asuras were stretched out: “We shall go to the heavenly world,” “We shall go.” Those asuras, arming themselves, acted through sheer force; the gods [acted] only through celibate studenthood and ascetic heat. Those asuras became bewildered; they did not discern; they were defeated; they did not go to the heavenly world. The gods indeed went to the heavenly world through the sacrificial rite performed continuously; through the interrupted one they defeated the asuras. Continuous indeed is the sacrifice of one wearing the sacred thread; interrupted is that of one not wearing the sacred thread. Whatever a brāhmaṇa studies while wearing the sacred thread, he indeed sacrifices thereby. Therefore, wearing the sacred thread alone, one should study, officiate at sacrifice, or sacrifice, for the continuity of the sacrifice. Having placed the deer-skin or garment over the right [shoulder], one raises the right arm and lowers the left: this is the yajñopavīta. The reverse of this is the prācīnāvīta; [worn around the neck] it is saṃvīta, [characteristic of] human beings.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣāṃsi havā puronuvāke tapogramatiṣṭhanta tānprajāpatirvareṇopāmantrayata tāni varamavṛṇītādityo no yoddhā iti tān prajāpatirabravīdyodhayadhvamiti tasmāduttiṣṭhantaṃ havā tāni rakṣāṃsyādityaṃ yodhayanti yāvadastamanvagāttāni ha vā etāni rakṣāṃsi gāyatriyā'bhimantritenāmbhasā śāmyanti tadu ha vā ete brahmavādinaḥ pūrvābhimukhāḥ sandhyāyāṃ gāyatriyā'bhimantritā āpa ūrdhvaṃ vikṣipanti tā etā āpo vajrībhūtvā tāni rakṣāṃsi mandehā'ruṇe dvīpe prakṣipanti yatpradakṣiṇaṃ prakramanti tena pāpmānamava dhūnvantyudyantamastaṃ yantamādityamabhi dhyāyan kurvan brāhmaṇo vidvānthsakalaṃ bhadramaśnute'sāvādityo brahmeti brahmaiva sanbrahmāpyeti ya evaṃ veda
meaning: रक्षांसि हवा पुरोनुवाके तपोग्रमतिष्ठन्त तान्प्रजापतिर्वरेणोपामन्त्रयत तानि वरमवृणीतादित्यो नो योद्धा इति तान् प्रजापतिरब्रवीद्योधयध्वमिति तस्मादुत्तिष्ठन्तं हवा तानि रक्षांस्यादित्यं योधयन्ति यावदस्तमन्वगात्तानि ह वा एतानि रक्षांसि गायत्रियाऽभिमन्त्रितेनाम्भसा शाम्यन्ति तदु ह वा एते ब्रह्मवादिनः पूर्वाभिमुखाः सन्ध्यायां गायत्रियाऽभिमन्त्रिता आप ऊर्ध्वं विक्षिपन्ति ता एता आपो वज्रीभूत्वा तानि रक्षांसि मन्देहाऽरुणे द्वीपे प्रक्षिपन्ति यत्प्रदक्षिणं प्रक्रमन्ति तेन पाप्मानमव धून्वन्त्युद्यन्तमस्तं यन्तमादित्यमभि ध्यायन् कुर्वन् ब्राह्मणो विद्वान्थ्सकलं भद्रमश्नुतेऽसावादित्यो ब्रह्मेति ब्रह्मैव सन्ब्रह्माप्येति य एवं वेद
text_mt: The rakṣases indeed stood in fierce ascetic heat before the puronuvākā [verse]. Prajāpati invited them with a boon. They chose a boon: “Āditya shall be our combatant.” Prajāpati said to them: “Fight [him].” Therefore, indeed, rising up, those rakṣases fight Āditya until he goes down into sunset. Those rakṣases indeed are pacified by water consecrated with the gāyatrī. Therefore these teachers of brahman, facing east at the twilight juncture, cast upward water consecrated with the gāyatrī. These waters, having become the thunderbolt, cast those rakṣases into the Mandehāruṇa island. In that they circumambulate clockwise, by that they shake off evil. The learned brāhmaṇa who, meditating upon Āditya as he rises and as he sets, acts [thus], attains all auspiciousness. “That Āditya is brahman”: being brahman itself, he merges into brahman, who knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: yaddevā devaheḷanaṃ devāsaścakṛmā vayam | ādityāstasmānmā muñcatartasyartena māmita | devā jīvanakāmyā yadvācā'nṛtamūdima | tasmānna iha muñcata viśve devāssajoṣasaḥ | ṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtena tvaṃ sarasvati | kṛtānnaḥ pāhyenaso yatkiñcānṛtamūdima | indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇau somo dhātā bṛhaspatiḥ | te no muñcantvenaso yadanyakṛtamārima | sajātaśaṃsāduta jāmiśaṃsājjyāyasaḥ śaṃsāduta vā kanīyasaḥ | anādhṛṣṭaṃ devakṛtaṃ yadenastasmāttvamasmāñjātavedo mumugdhi
meaning: यद्देवा देवहेऌअनं देवासश्चकृमा वयम् | आदित्यास्तस्मान्मा मुञ्चतर्तस्यर्तेन मामित | देवा जीवनकाम्या यद्वाचाऽनृतमूदिम | तस्मान्न इह मुञ्चत विश्वे देवास्सजोषसः | ऋतेन द्यावापृथिवी ऋतेन त्वं सरस्वति | कृतान्नः पाह्येनसो यत्किञ्चानृतमूदिम | इन्द्राग्नी मित्रावरुणौ सोमो धाता बृहस्पतिः | ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वेनसो यदन्यकृतमारिम | सजातशंसादुत जामिशंसाज्ज्यायसः शंसादुत वा कनीयसः | अनाधृष्टं देवकृतं यदेनस्तस्मात्त्वमस्माञ्जातवेदो मुमुग्धि
text_mt: Whatever offense against the gods we have committed, O gods, release me from that, O Ādityas, through truth by means of the truth. / O gods, desiring life, whatever untruth we have spoken with speech, from that release us here, all gods in concord. / In truth, O heaven and earth, in truth, O Sarasvatī, protect us from the sin committed, whatever untruth we have spoken. / Indra and Agni, Mitra and Varuṇa, Soma, Dhātṛ, Bṛhaspati—let them release us from sin, whatever committed by another we have incurred. / From the curse of a kinsman and from the curse of a sister, from the curse of an elder or of a younger, from the unassailable, god-made sin—from that, O Jātavedas, deliver us.

sanskrit_iast: yadvācā yanmanasā bāhubhyāmūrubhyāmaṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ śiśnairyadanṛtaṃ cakṛmā vayam | agnirmā tasmādenaso gārhapatyaḥ pramuñcatu cakṛma yāni duṣkṛtā | yena trito arṇavānnirbabhūva yena sūryaṃ tamaso nirmumoca | yenendro viśvā ajahādarātīstenāhaṃ jyotiṣā jyotirānaśāna ākṣi | yatkusīdamapratīttaṃ mayeha yena yamasya nidhinā carāmi | etattadagne anṛṇo bhavāmi jīvanneva prati tatte dadhāmi | yanmayi mātā yadā pipeṣa yadantarikṣaṃ yadāśasātikrāmāmi trite devā divi jātā yadāpa imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne tvamagne ayāsi
meaning: यद्वाचा यन्मनसा बाहुभ्यामूरुभ्यामष्ठीवद्भ्यां शिश्नैर्यदनृतं चकृमा वयम् | अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसो गार्हपत्यः प्रमुञ्चतु चकृम यानि दुष्कृता | येन त्रितो अर्णवान्निर्बभूव येन सूर्यं तमसो निर्मुमोच | येनेन्द्रो विश्वा अजहादरातीस्तेनाहं ज्योतिषा ज्योतिरानशान आक्षि | यत्कुसीदमप्रतीत्तं मयेह येन यमस्य निधिना चरामि | एतत्तदग्ने अनृणो भवामि जीवन्नेव प्रति तत्ते दधामि | यन्मयि माता यदा पिपेष यदन्तरिक्षं यदाशसातिक्रामामि त्रिते देवा दिवि जाता यदाप इमं मे वरुण तत्त्वा यामि त्वं नो अग्ने स त्वं नो अग्ने त्वमग्ने अयासि
text_mt: Whatever untruth we have committed with speech, with mind, with arms, with thighs, with knee-joints, with genitals—may Agni Gārhapatya release me from that sin, whatever misdeeds we have committed. / That by which Trita emerged from the ocean, that by which he released Sūrya from darkness, that by which Indra abandoned all foes—reaching the light with that light, I dwell. / Whatever debt has not been paid by me here, by which pledge of Yama I walk, in that, O Agni, I become free from debt; living indeed, I repay that to you. / Whatever my mother pounded in me, when I transgress the intermediate space with longing, O Trita, O gods born in heaven, when the waters... “This [prayer] of mine, O Varuṇa”, “I come to you with praise”, “You, our Agni”, “So you, our Agni”, “You, Agni, are ayās”... / “Deliver” and seven.

sanskrit_iast: yadadīvyannṛṇamahaṃ babhūvādithsanvā saṃjagara janebhyaḥ | agnirmā tasmādindraśca saṃvidānau pramuñcatām | yaddhastābhyāṃ cakara kilbiṣāṇyakṣāṇāṃ vagnumupajighnamānaḥ | ugraṃpaśyā ca rāṣṭrabhṛcca tānyapsarasāvanudattāmṛṇāni | ugraṃpaśye rāṣṭrabhṛtkilbiṣāṇi yadakṣavṛttamanudattametat | nenna ṛṇānṛṇava ithsamāno yamasya loke adhirajjurāya | ava te heḷa uduttama mimaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne | saṃkusuko vikusuko nirṛtho yaśca nisvanaḥ | te'smadyakṣmamanāgaso dūrāddūramacīcatam | niryakṣmamacīcate kṛtyāṃ nirṛtiṃ ca | tena yo'smathsamṛcchātai tamasmai prasuvāmasi | duśśaṃsānuśaṃsābhyāṃ ghaṇenānughaṇena ca | tenānyo'smathsamṛcchātai tamasmai prasuvāmasi | saṃ varcasā payasā saṃtanūbhiraganmahi manasā saṃśivena | tvaṣṭā no atra vidadhātu rāyo'numārṣṭu tanvo yadviliṣṭam
meaning: यददीव्यन्नृणमहं बभूवादिथ्सन्वा संजगर जनेभ्यः | अग्निर्मा तस्मादिन्द्रश्च संविदानौ प्रमुञ्चताम् | यद्धस्ताभ्यां चकर किल्बिषाण्यक्षाणां वग्नुमुपजिघ्नमानः | उग्रंपश्या च राष्ट्रभृच्च तान्यप्सरसावनुदत्तामृणानि | उग्रंपश्ये राष्ट्रभृत्किल्बिषाणि यदक्षवृत्तमनुदत्तमेतत् | नेन्न ऋणानृणव इथ्समानो यमस्य लोके अधिरज्जुराय | अव ते हेऌअ उदुत्तम मिमं मे वरुण तत्त्वा यामि त्वं नो अग्ने स त्वं नो अग्ने | संकुसुको विकुसुको निरृथो यश्च निस्वनः | तेऽस्मद्यक्ष्ममनागसो दूराद्दूरमचीचतम् | निर्यक्ष्ममचीचते कृत्यां निरृतिं च | तेन योऽस्मथ्समृच्छातै तमस्मै प्रसुवामसि | दुश्शंसानुशंसाभ्यां घणेनानुघणेन च | तेनान्योऽस्मथ्समृच्छातै तमस्मै प्रसुवामसि | सं वर्चसा पयसा संतनूभिरगन्महि मनसा संशिवेन | त्वष्टा नो अत्र विदधातु रायोऽनुमार्ष्टु तन्वो यद्विलिष्टम्
text_mt: What debt I incurred without gambling, or promised to people not intending to give, let Agni and Indra, being in accord, release me from that. / What sins I committed with my hands, checking the sound of the dice, let Ugraṃpaśyā and Rāṣṭrabhṛt, the two apsarases, forgive those debts. / O Ugraṃpaśyā and Rāṣṭrabhṛt, what sins have occurred at the dice, forgive that. Lest, seeking to pay debts, [the creditor] bind me in debt, coming with a halter in the world of Yama. / “Loosen your wrath”, “O most high”, “This [prayer] of mine, O Varuṇa”, “I come to you with praise”, “You, our Agni”, “So you, our Agni”. / Saṃkusuka, Vikusuka, Nirṛtha, and he who is Nisvana: drive far and further away from us the disease, we being guiltless. / You two have driven away the disease, the spell, and Nirṛti. By that, whoever shall attack us, to him we send that. / With malicious blame and backbiting, with a stroke and a counterstroke, by that, whoever else shall attack us, to him we send that. / We have come together with radiance, with milk, with our bodies, with an auspicious mind. Let Tvaṣṭṛ distribute wealth to us here, [and] let him smooth over whatever is injured of the body. / “Spell, Nirṛti” and five.

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣṭe viśvato dadhadayamagnirvareṇyaḥ | punaste prāṇa āyāti parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te | āyurdā agne haviṣo juṣāṇo ghṛtapratīko ghṛtayoniredhi | ghṛtaṃ pītvā madhu cāru gavyaṃ piteva putramabhirakṣatādimam | imamagna āyuṣe varcase kṛdhi tigmamojo varuṇa saṃśiśādhi | mātevāsmā adite śarma yaccha viśve devā jaradaṣṭiryathā'sat | agna āyūṃṣi pavasa āsuvorjamiṣañca naḥ | āre bādhasva ducchunām | agne pavasva svapā asme varcassuvīryam | dadhadrayiṃ mayi poṣam
meaning: आयुष्टे विश्वतो दधदयमग्निर्वरेण्यः | पुनस्ते प्राण आयाति परा यक्ष्मं सुवामि ते | आयुर्दा अग्ने हविषो जुषाणो घृतप्रतीको घृतयोनिरेधि | घृतं पीत्वा मधु चारु गव्यं पितेव पुत्रमभिरक्षतादिमम् | इममग्न आयुषे वर्चसे कृधि तिग्ममोजो वरुण संशिशाधि | मातेवास्मा अदिते शर्म यच्छ विश्वे देवा जरदष्टिर्यथाऽसत् | अग्न आयूंषि पवस आसुवोर्जमिषञ्च नः | आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् | अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चस्सुवीर्यम् | दधद्रयिं मयि पोषम्
text_mt: Granting you lifespan from every side, this Agni is most desirable; your vital breath returns again; I dispel disease far from you. / Giver of lifespan, O Agni, enjoying the oblation, with a ghee-face, be one whose source is ghee. Having drunk the sweet, lovely ghee of the cow, protect this man like a father his son. / Make him fit for lifespan and radiance, O Agni; O Varuṇa, sharpen sharp vigor; O Aditi, grant shelter to him like a mother, so that all the gods [grant] that he reach old age. / O Agni, you purify lifespans: send vigor and food to us; ward misfortune far away. / O Agni, purify yourself, skillful, [granting] us radiance, goodly heroes, bestowing wealth and nourishment upon me.

sanskrit_iast: agnirṛṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ | tamīmahe mahāgayam | agne jātānpraṇudānassapatnānpratya jātāñjātavedo nudasva | asme dīdihi sumanā aheḷañcharmante syāma trivarūtha udbhau | sahasā jātānpraṇudānaḥ sapatnānpratyajātāñjātavedo nudasva | adhi no brūhi sumanasyamāno vayaṃ syāma praṇudānaḥ sapatnān | agne yo no'bhito jano vṛko vāro jighāṃsati | tāṃstvaṃ vṛtrahañjahi vasvasmabhyamābhara | agne yo no'bhidāsati samāno yaśca niṣṭyaḥ | taṃ vayaṃ samidhaṃ kṛtvā tubhyamagne'pidadhmasi
meaning: अग्निरृषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः | तमीमहे महागयम् | अग्ने जातान्प्रणुदानस्सपत्नान्प्रत्य जाताञ्जातवेदो नुदस्व | अस्मे दीदिहि सुमना अहेऌअञ्छर्मन्ते स्याम त्रिवरूथ उद्भौ | सहसा जातान्प्रणुदानः सपत्नान्प्रत्यजाताञ्जातवेदो नुदस्व | अधि नो ब्रूहि सुमनस्यमानो वयं स्याम प्रणुदानः सपत्नान् | अग्ने यो नोऽभितो जनो वृको वारो जिघांसति | तांस्त्वं वृत्रहञ्जहि वस्वस्मभ्यमाभर | अग्ने यो नोऽभिदासति समानो यश्च निष्ट्यः | तं वयं समिधं कृत्वा तुभ्यमग्नेऽपिदध्मसि
text_mt: Agni is the seer, Pavamāna, belonging to the five peoples, the domestic priest; him we implore for broad domain. / O Agni, driving away rivals that are born, drive back those yet unborn, O Jātavedas. Shine upon us, gracious, unangered; may we be under your triple shelter, triumphant. / Driving away born rivals by force, drive back those yet unborn, O Jātavedas. Speak for us, being well-disposed; may we be drivers-away of rivals. / O Agni, whatever person around us, a wolf or a rogue, wishes to slay [us], slay them, O slayer of Vṛtra; bring us wealth. / O Agni, whoever harms us, whether an equal or an outsider, turning him into fuel, O Agni, we lay him down for you.

sanskrit_iast: yo naḥ śapādaśapato yaśca naḥ śapataḥ śapāt | uṣāśca tasmai nimrukca sarvaṃ pāpaṃ samūhatām | yo nassapatno yo raṇo marto'bhidāsati devāḥ | idhmasyeva prakṣāyato mā tasyoccheṣi kiñcana | yo māṃ dveṣṭi jātavedo yaṃ cāhaṃ dveṣmi yaśca mām | sarvāṃstānagne sandaha yāṃścāhaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām | yo asmabhyamarātīyādyaśca no dveṣate janaḥ | nindādyo asmāndipsācca sarvāṃstānmaṣmaṣā kuru | saṃśitaṃ me brahma saṃśitaṃ vīryāṃ balam | saṃśitaṃ kṣattraṃ me jiṣṇu yasyāhamasmi purohitaḥ | udeṣāṃ bāhū atiramudvarco atho balam | kṣiṇomi brahmaṇā'mitrānunnayāmi svāṃ aham | punarmanaḥ punarāyurma āgātpunaścakṣuḥ punaḥ śrotraṃ ma āgātpunaḥ prāṇaḥ punarākūtaṃ ma āgātpunaścittaṃ punarādhītaṃ ma āgāt | vaiśvānaro me'dabdhastanūpā avabādhatāṃ duritāni viśvā
meaning: यो नः शपादशपतो यश्च नः शपतः शपात् | उषाश्च तस्मै निम्रुक्च सर्वं पापं समूहताम् | यो नस्सपत्नो यो रणो मर्तोऽभिदासति देवाः | इध्मस्येव प्रक्षायतो मा तस्योच्छेषि किञ्चन | यो मां द्वेष्टि जातवेदो यं चाहं द्वेष्मि यश्च माम् | सर्वांस्तानग्ने सन्दह यांश्चाहं द्वेष्मि ये च माम् | यो अस्मभ्यमरातीयाद्यश्च नो द्वेषते जनः | निन्दाद्यो अस्मान्दिप्साच्च सर्वांस्तान्मष्मषा कुरु | संशितं मे ब्रह्म संशितं वीर्यां बलम् | संशितं क्षत्त्रं मे जिष्णु यस्याहमस्मि पुरोहितः | उदेषां बाहू अतिरमुद्वर्चो अथो बलम् | क्षिणोमि ब्रह्मणाऽमित्रानुन्नयामि स्वां अहम् | पुनर्मनः पुनरायुर्म आगात्पुनश्चक्षुः पुनः श्रोत्रं म आगात्पुनः प्राणः पुनराकूतं म आगात्पुनश्चित्तं पुनराधीतं म आगात् | वैश्वानरो मेऽदब्धस्तनूपा अवबाधतां दुरितानि विश्वा
text_mt: Whoever curses us when we curse not, and whoever curses us when we curse— / may both Dawn and Sunset sweep all evil upon him! / What enemy, what rival mortal assails us, O gods, / like a piece of firewood burning up, let nothing remain of him! / He who hates me, O Jātavedas, and whom I hate, and he who [hates] me— / burn them all up completely, O Agni, those whom I hate and those who [hate] me! / The person who would act hostilely toward us, and who hates us, / who would revile us and wish to harm us—grind them all into dust! / Sharpened is my brahman, sharpened is my manly strength and power; / sharpened is the victorious kṣatra of him whose purohita I am. / I raise up their arms, I raise up their luster and also their strength; / with brahman I destroy the foes, and I lift up my own folk. / Mind has come back to me, life has come back to me, sight has come back to me, hearing has come back to me, vital breath has come back to me, intention has come back to me, thought has come back to me, reflection has come back to me! / May Vaiśvānara, my unbeguiled guardian of the body, ward off all misfortunes. / [Pratīka and number:] 'poṣaṃ dadhmasi purohitaścatvāri ca' [5.1–4].

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānarāya prativedayāmo yadīnṛṇaṃ saṅgaro devatāsu | sa etānpāśānpramucanpraveda sa no muñcātu duritādavadyāt | vaiśvānaraḥ pavayānnaḥ pavitrairyathsaṅgaramabhidhāvāmyāśām | anājānanmanasā yācamāno yadatraino ava tathsuvāmi | amī ye subhage divi vicṛtau nāma tārake | prehāmṛtasya yacchatāmetadbaddhakamocanam | vijihīrṣva lokānkṛdhi bandhānmuñcāsi baddhakam | yoneriva pracyuto garbhassarvānpatho anuṣva | sa prajānanpratigṛbhṇīta vidvānprajāpatiḥ prathamajā ṛtasya | asmābhirdattaṃ jarasaḥ parastādacchinnaṃ tantumanusañcarema
meaning: वैश्वानराय प्रतिवेदयामो यदीनृणं सङ्गरो देवतासु | स एतान्पाशान्प्रमुचन्प्रवेद स नो मुञ्चातु दुरितादवद्यात् | वैश्वानरः पवयान्नः पवित्रैर्यथ्सङ्गरमभिधावाम्याशाम् | अनाजानन्मनसा याचमानो यदत्रैनो अव तथ्सुवामि | अमी ये सुभगे दिवि विचृतौ नाम तारके | प्रेहामृतस्य यच्छतामेतद्बद्धकमोचनम् | विजिहीर्ष्व लोकान्कृधि बन्धान्मुञ्चासि बद्धकम् | योनेरिव प्रच्युतो गर्भस्सर्वान्पथो अनुष्व | स प्रजानन्प्रतिगृभ्णीत विद्वान्प्रजापतिः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य | अस्माभिर्दत्तं जरसः परस्तादच्छिन्नं तन्तुमनुसञ्चरेम
text_mt: We make known to Vaiśvānara whatever debt or promise [made] among the deities; / he, unloosing these fetters, knows it; may he release us from misfortune, from blame. / May Vaiśvānara purify us with purifiers, according to the promise, as I run to the quarter; / asking with an unmindful mind, whatever sin is here, that I drive away. / Those two auspicious stars in the sky named Vicṛtau— / let them reach forth here release from the bond for this bound one. / Open wide, make worlds, release the bound one from bonds! / Like an embryo dropped from the womb, follow all paths. / Knowing, may he receive it, the wise Prajāpati, the firstborn of truth; / given by us, beyond old age, may we travel along the unbroken thread!

sanskrit_iast: tataṃ tantumanveke anusañcaranti yeṣāṃ dattaṃ pitryamāyanavat | abandhveke dadataḥ prayacchāddātuṃ cecchaknavāṃsassvarga eṣām | ārabhethāmanusaṃrabhethāṃ samānaṃ panthāmavatho ghṛtena | yadvāṃ pūrtaṃ pariviṣṭaṃ yadagnau tasmai gotrāyeha jāyāpatī saṃrabhethām | yadantarikṣaṃ pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ yanmātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā jihiṃsima | agnirmā tasmādenaso gārhapatya unno neṣadduritā yāni cakṛma | bhūmirmātā'ditirno janitraṃ bhrātā'ntarikṣamabhiśasta enaḥ | dyaurnaḥ pitā pitṛyācchaṃ bhavāsi jāmi mitvā mā vivithsi lokāt | yatra suhārdaḥ sukṛto madante vihāya rogaṃ tanvāṃ svāyām | aśloṇāṅgairahrutāssvarge tatra paśyema pitaraṃ ca putram | yadannamadmyanṛtena devā dāsyannadāsyannuta vā kariṣyann | yaddevānāṃ cakṣuṣyāgo asti yadeva kiñca pratijagrāhamagnirmā tasmādanṛṇaṃ kṛṇotu | yadannamadmi bahudhā virūpaṃ vāso hiraṇyamuta gāmajāmavim | yaddevānāṃ cakṣuṣyāgo asti yadeva kiñca pratijagrāhamagnirmā tasmādanṛṇaṃ kṛṇotu | yanmayā manasā vācā kṛtamenaḥ kadācana | sarvasmāttasmānmeḷito mogdhi tvaṃ hi vettha yathātatham
meaning: ततं तन्तुमन्वेके अनुसञ्चरन्ति येषां दत्तं पित्र्यमायनवत् | अबन्ध्वेके ददतः प्रयच्छाद्दातुं चेच्छक्नवांसस्स्वर्ग एषाम् | आरभेथामनुसंरभेथां समानं पन्थामवथो घृतेन | यद्वां पूर्तं परिविष्टं यदग्नौ तस्मै गोत्रायेह जायापती संरभेथाम् | यदन्तरिक्षं पृथिवीमुत द्यां यन्मातरं पितरं वा जिहिंसिम | अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसो गार्हपत्य उन्नो नेषद्दुरिता यानि चकृम | भूमिर्माताऽदितिर्नो जनित्रं भ्राताऽन्तरिक्षमभिशस्त एनः | द्यौर्नः पिता पितृयाच्छं भवासि जामि मित्वा मा विविथ्सि लोकात् | यत्र सुहार्दः सुकृतो मदन्ते विहाय रोगं तन्वां स्वायाम् | अश्लोणाङ्गैरह्रुतास्स्वर्गे तत्र पश्येम पितरं च पुत्रम् | यदन्नमद्म्यनृतेन देवा दास्यन्नदास्यन्नुत वा करिष्यन्न् | यद्देवानां चक्षुष्यागो अस्ति यदेव किञ्च प्रतिजग्राहमग्निर्मा तस्मादनृणं कृणोतु | यदन्नमद्मि बहुधा विरूपं वासो हिरण्यमुत गामजामविम् | यद्देवानां चक्षुष्यागो अस्ति यदेव किञ्च प्रतिजग्राहमग्निर्मा तस्मादनृणं कृणोतु | यन्मया मनसा वाचा कृतमेनः कदाचन | सर्वस्मात्तस्मान्मेऌइतो मोग्धि त्वं हि वेत्थ यथातथम्
text_mt: Along the extended thread some travel, whose ancestral gift has proved fruitful; / some without relations give from their hand; if they are able to give, heaven is theirs. / Take hold, take hold together; preserve the common path with ghee! / What is fulfilled by you two, what is offered in the fire—for that ancestral line, take hold here, husband and wife! / If we have injured intermediate space, earth, or sky, or if mother or father, / may Agni Gārhapatya lead us up from that sin, [from] the misfortunes we have committed. / Earth is mother, Aditi is our birthplace, intermediate space is brother; the sin is denounced; / sky is our father; from the ancestral side may you be peace; having known our kin, may I not be deprived of the world! / Where the good-hearted doers of good rejoice, having left behind disease in their own body, / with limbs not crippled, not twisted, in heaven, there may we see father and son! / What food I eat in untruth, O gods, intending to give or not intending to give, or about to act, / whatever offense there is in the eyes of the gods, whatever I have accepted, may Agni make me free of debt from that! / What food I eat of various forms, garment, gold, or cow, goat, sheep— / whatever offense there is in the eyes of the gods, whatever I have accepted, may Agni make me free of debt from that! / Whatever sin has been committed by me at any time in mind or speech, / from all that, being united [with me], release me, for you know truly as it is. / [Pratīka and number:] 'carema putraṃ ṣaṭca' [5.1–6].

sanskrit_iast: vātaraśanā ha vā ṛṣayaḥ śramaṇā ūrdhvamanthino babhūvustānṛṣayo'rthamāyaṃste nilāyamacaraṃste'nupraviśuḥ kūśmāṇḍāni tāṃsteṣvanvavindañchraddhayā ca tapasā ca tānṛṣayo'bruvankathā nilāyaṃ caratheti ta ṛṣīnabruvannamo vo'stu bhagavanto'smindhāmni kena vassaparyāmeti tānṛṣayo'bruvanpavitraṃ no brūta yenārepasassyāmeti ta etāni sūktānyapaśyan yaddevā devaheḷanaṃ yaddīvyannṛṇamahaṃ babhuvāyuṣṭe viśvato dadhadityetairājyaṃ juhuta vaiśvānarāya prativedayāma ityupatiṣṭhata yadarvācīnameno bhrūṇahatyāyāstasmānmokṣyadhva iti ta etairajuhuvuste'repaso'bhavan karmādiṣvetairjuhuyāt pūto devalokānthsamaśnute
meaning: वातरशना ह वा ऋषयः श्रमणा ऊर्ध्वमन्थिनो बभूवुस्तानृषयोऽर्थमायंस्ते निलायमचरंस्तेऽनुप्रविशुः कूश्माण्डानि तांस्तेष्वन्वविन्दञ्छ्रद्धया च तपसा च तानृषयोऽब्रुवन्कथा निलायं चरथेति त ऋषीनब्रुवन्नमो वोऽस्तु भगवन्तोऽस्मिन्धाम्नि केन वस्सपर्यामेति तानृषयोऽब्रुवन्पवित्रं नो ब्रूत येनारेपसस्स्यामेति त एतानि सूक्तान्यपश्यन् यद्देवा देवहेऌअनं यद्दीव्यन्नृणमहं बभुवायुष्टे विश्वतो दधदित्येतैराज्यं जुहुत वैश्वानराय प्रतिवेदयाम इत्युपतिष्ठत यदर्वाचीनमेनो भ्रूणहत्यायास्तस्मान्मोक्ष्यध्व इति त एतैरजुहुवुस्तेऽरेपसोऽभवन् कर्मादिष्वेतैर्जुहुयात् पूतो देवलोकान्थ्समश्नुते
text_mt: The wind-girdled seers were wandering ascetics with upward-drawn semen. The seers went looking for them; they went into hiding; they entered into the kūśmāṇḍa [verses]. They found them among them through faith and ascetic heat. The seers said to them: 'Why did you go into hiding?' They said to the seers: 'Homage be to you, venerable ones, in this abode! With what may we serve you?' The seers said to them: 'Declare to us a purifier by which we may be spotless.' They saw these hymns: 'yaddevā devaheḻanaṃ', 'yaddīvyannṛṇamahaṃ babhūva', 'āyuṣṭe viśvato dadhad'—with these offer ghee; 'vaiśvānarāya prativedayāma'—with this attend [the fire]. 'Whatever sin is short of abortion, from that you shall be released.' They offered with these; they became spotless. One should offer with these at the beginning of rites; purified, he fully attains the worlds of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: kūśmāṇḍairjuhuyādyo'pūta iva manyeta yathā steno yathā bhrūṇahaivameṣa bhavati yo'yonau retassiñcati yadarvācīnameno bhrūṇahatyāyāstasmānmucyate yāvadeno dīkṣāmupaiti dīkṣita etaissatati juhoti saṃvathsaraṃ dīkṣito bhavati saṃvathsarādevātmānaṃ punīte māsaṃ dīkṣito bhavati yo māsassa saṃvathsaraḥ saṃvathsarādevātmānaṃ punīte caturviṃśatiṃ rātrīrdīkṣito bhavati caturviṃśatirardhamāsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ saṃvathsarādevātmānaṃ punīte dvādaśa rātrīrdīkṣito bhavati dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ saṃvathsarādevātmānaṃ punīte ṣaḍrātrīrdīkṣito bhavati ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ saṃvathsaraḥ saṃvathsarādevātmānaṃ punīte tisro rātrīrdīkṣito bhavati tripadā gāyatrī gāyatriyā evātmānaṃ punīte na māṃsamaśnīyānna striyamupeyānnoparyāsīta jugupsetānṛtātpayo brāhmaṇasya vrataṃ yavāgū rājanyasyāmikṣā vaiśyasyātho saumye'pyadhvara etadvrataṃ brūyādyadi manyetopadasyāmītyodanaṃ dhānāḥ saktūnghṛtamityanuvratayedātmano'nupadāsāya
meaning: कूश्माण्डैर्जुहुयाद्योऽपूत इव मन्येत यथा स्तेनो यथा भ्रूणहैवमेष भवति योऽयोनौ रेतस्सिञ्चति यदर्वाचीनमेनो भ्रूणहत्यायास्तस्मान्मुच्यते यावदेनो दीक्षामुपैति दीक्षित एतैस्सतति जुहोति संवथ्सरं दीक्षितो भवति संवथ्सरादेवात्मानं पुनीते मासं दीक्षितो भवति यो मासस्स संवथ्सरः संवथ्सरादेवात्मानं पुनीते चतुर्विंशतिं रात्रीर्दीक्षितो भवति चतुर्विंशतिरर्धमासाः संवथ्सरः संवथ्सरादेवात्मानं पुनीते द्वादश रात्रीर्दीक्षितो भवति द्वादश मासाः संवथ्सरः संवथ्सरादेवात्मानं पुनीते षड्रात्रीर्दीक्षितो भवति षड्वा ऋतवः संवथ्सरः संवथ्सरादेवात्मानं पुनीते तिस्रो रात्रीर्दीक्षितो भवति त्रिपदा गायत्री गायत्रिया एवात्मानं पुनीते न मांसमश्नीयान्न स्त्रियमुपेयान्नोपर्यासीत जुगुप्सेतानृतात्पयो ब्राह्मणस्य व्रतं यवागू राजन्यस्यामिक्षा वैश्यस्याथो सौम्येऽप्यध्वर एतद्व्रतं ब्रूयाद्यदि मन्येतोपदस्यामीत्योदनं धानाः सक्तून्घृतमित्यनुव्रतयेदात्मनोऽनुपदासाय
text_mt: One who considers himself as if unpurified should offer with the kūśmāṇḍa [verses]. As a thief, as an abortionist, so he becomes who spills semen out of the womb. Whatever sin is short of abortion, from that he is released. As long as his sin is, he undergoes consecration. Consecrated, he offers continuously with these. If he is consecrated for a year, he purifies himself from the year itself. If he is consecrated for a month—what the month is, that is the year—he purifies himself from the year itself. If he is consecrated for twenty-four nights—the twenty-four half-months are the year—he purifies himself from the year itself. If he is consecrated for twelve nights—the twelve months are the year—he purifies himself from the year itself. If he is consecrated for six nights—six indeed are the seasons, the year—he purifies himself from the year itself. If he is consecrated for three nights—the gāyatrī has three feet—he purifies himself through the gāyatrī itself. He should not eat meat; he should not approach a woman; he should not sit upon an elevated seat; he should shrink from untruth. Milk is the observance of a brāhmaṇa, barley-gruel of a rājanya, curd-mixture of a vaiśya. And in the Soma sacrifice too he should declare this observance. If he thinks, 'I am running out [of strength]', he should continue his observance with boiled rice, roasted grains, barley-meal, [and] ghee, so that he does not run out.

sanskrit_iast: ajān ha vai pṛśnīṃstapasyamānānbrahma svayambhvabhyānarṣatta ṛṣayo'bhavantadṛṣīṇāmṛṣitvaṃ tāṃ devatāmupātiṣṭhanta yajñakāmāsta etaṃ brahmayajñamapaśyantamā'harantenāyajanta yadṛco'dhyagīṣata tāḥ paya āhutayo devānāmabhavan yadyajūṃṣi ghṛtāhutayo yathsāmāni somāhutayo yadatharvāṃgiraso madhvāhutayo yadbrāhmaṇānītihāsānpurāṇāni kalpāngāthā nārāśaṃsīrmedāhutayo devānāmabhavantābhiḥ kṣudhaṃ pāpmānamapāghnannapahatapāpmāno devāssvargaṃ lokamāyanbrahmaṇaḥ sāyujyamṛṣayo'gacchan
meaning: अजान् ह वै पृश्नींस्तपस्यमानान्ब्रह्म स्वयम्भ्वभ्यानर्षत्त ऋषयोऽभवन्तदृषीणामृषित्वं तां देवतामुपातिष्ठन्त यज्ञकामास्त एतं ब्रह्मयज्ञमपश्यन्तमाऽहरन्तेनायजन्त यदृचोऽध्यगीषत ताः पय आहुतयो देवानामभवन् यद्यजूंषि घृताहुतयो यथ्सामानि सोमाहुतयो यदथर्वांगिरसो मध्वाहुतयो यद्ब्राह्मणानीतिहासान्पुराणानि कल्पान्गाथा नाराशंसीर्मेदाहुतयो देवानामभवन्ताभिः क्षुधं पाप्मानमपाघ्नन्नपहतपाप्मानो देवास्स्वर्गं लोकमायन्ब्रह्मणः सायुज्यमृषयोऽगच्छन्
text_mt: The self-existent brahman streamed down upon the Ajas and Pṛśnis while they were practicing ascetic heat; they became seers: that is the seership of the seers. Desiring sacrifice, they attended upon that deity. They saw this brahmayajña; they fetched it; with it they sacrificed. When they recited the ṛc verses, those became milk oblations of the gods; when the yajus formulas, ghee oblations; when the sāman chants, Soma oblations; when the Atharvāṅgiras formulas, honey oblations; when the brāhmaṇas, traditional histories, ancient lore, ritual guidelines, songs, and praises of men, they became fat oblations of the gods. By these they struck away hunger and evil; with evil struck away, the gods went to the heavenly world; the seers attained union with brahman.

sanskrit_iast: pañca vā ete mahāyajñāḥ satati pratāyante satati santiṣṭhante devayajñaḥ pitṛyajño bhūtayajño manuṣyayajño brahmayajña iti yadagnau juhotyapi samidhaṃ taddevayajñaḥ santiṣṭhate yatpitṛbhyaḥ svadhākarotyapyapastatpitṛyajñaḥ santiṣṭhate yadbhūtebhyo baliṃ harati tadbhūtayajñaḥ santiṣṭhate yadbrāhmaṇebhyo'nnaṃ dadāti tanmanuṣyayajñaḥ santiṣṭhate yathsvādhyāyamadhīyītaikāmapyṛcaṃ yajussāma vā tadbrahmayajñaḥ santiṣṭhate yadṛco'dhīte payasaḥ kūlyā asya pitṝnthsvadhā abhivahanti yadyajūṃṣi ghṛtasya kūlyā yathsāmāni soma ebhyaḥ pavate yadatharvāṃgiraso madhoḥ kūlyā yadbrāhmaṇānītihāsānpurāṇāni kalpāngāthā nārāśaṃsīrmedasaḥ kūlyā asya pitṝnthsvadhā abhivahanti yadṛco'dhīte paya āhutibhireva taddevāṃstarpayati yadyajūṃṣi ghṛtāhutibhiryathsāmāni somāhutibhiryadatharvāṃgiraso madhvāhutibhiryadbrāhmaṇānītihāsān purāṇāni kalpāngāthā nārāśaṃsīrmedāhutibhireva taddevāṃstarpayati ta enaṃ tṛptā āyuṣā tejasā varcasā śriyā yaśasā brahmavarcasenānnādyena ca tarpayanti
meaning: पञ्च वा एते महायज्ञाः सतति प्रतायन्ते सतति सन्तिष्ठन्ते देवयज्ञः पितृयज्ञो भूतयज्ञो मनुष्ययज्ञो ब्रह्मयज्ञ इति यदग्नौ जुहोत्यपि समिधं तद्देवयज्ञः सन्तिष्ठते यत्पितृभ्यः स्वधाकरोत्यप्यपस्तत्पितृयज्ञः सन्तिष्ठते यद्भूतेभ्यो बलिं हरति तद्भूतयज्ञः सन्तिष्ठते यद्ब्राह्मणेभ्योऽन्नं ददाति तन्मनुष्ययज्ञः सन्तिष्ठते यथ्स्वाध्यायमधीयीतैकामप्यृचं यजुस्साम वा तद्ब्रह्मयज्ञः सन्तिष्ठते यदृचोऽधीते पयसः कूल्या अस्य पितॄन्थ्स्वधा अभिवहन्ति यद्यजूंषि घृतस्य कूल्या यथ्सामानि सोम एभ्यः पवते यदथर्वांगिरसो मधोः कूल्या यद्ब्राह्मणानीतिहासान्पुराणानि कल्पान्गाथा नाराशंसीर्मेदसः कूल्या अस्य पितॄन्थ्स्वधा अभिवहन्ति यदृचोऽधीते पय आहुतिभिरेव तद्देवांस्तर्पयति यद्यजूंषि घृताहुतिभिर्यथ्सामानि सोमाहुतिभिर्यदथर्वांगिरसो मध्वाहुतिभिर्यद्ब्राह्मणानीतिहासान् पुराणानि कल्पान्गाथा नाराशंसीर्मेदाहुतिभिरेव तद्देवांस्तर्पयति त एनं तृप्ता आयुषा तेजसा वर्चसा श्रिया यशसा ब्रह्मवर्चसेनान्नाद्येन च तर्पयन्ति
text_mt: Five great sacrifices, indeed, are continuously performed, continuously concluded: the sacrifice to the gods, the sacrifice to the fathers, the sacrifice to the beings, the sacrifice to humans, and the sacrifice to brahman. When one offers into the fire, even a fuel stick, then the sacrifice to the gods is concluded. When one makes an offering to the fathers with svadhā, even with water, then the sacrifice to the fathers is concluded. When one presents an offering of food to the beings, then the sacrifice to the beings is concluded. When one gives food to brāhmaṇas, then the sacrifice to humans is concluded. When one recites his daily Vedic recitation, even a single ṛc, yajus, or sāman, then the sacrifice to brahman is concluded. When one recites the ṛcs, streams of milk convey the svadhā to his fathers. When the yajuses, streams of clarified butter. When the sāmans, Soma purifies itself for them. When the Atharvāṅgirases, streams of honey. When the Brāhmaṇas, Itihāsas, Purāṇas, Kalpas, and Gāthās celebrating men, streams of melted fat convey the svadhā to his fathers. When one recites the ṛcs, one satisfies the gods with oblations of milk. When the yajuses, with oblations of clarified butter; when the sāmans, with oblations of Soma; when the Atharvāṅgirases, with oblations of honey; when the Brāhmaṇas, Itihāsas, Purāṇas, Kalpas, and Gāthās celebrating men, one satisfies the gods with oblations of melted fat. Satisfied, they satisfy him with lifespan, fiery energy, splendor, prosperity, fame, Vedic luster, and edible food.

sanskrit_iast: brahmayajñena yakṣyamāṇaḥ prācyāṃ diśi grāmādachadirdarśa udīcyāṃ prāgudīcyāṃ vodita āditye dakṣiṇata upavīyopaviśya hastāvavanijya trirācāmeddviḥ parimṛjya sakṛdupaspṛśya śiraścakṣuṣī nāsike śrotre hṛdayamālabhya yattrirācāmati tena ṛcaḥ prīṇāti yaddviḥ parimṛjati tena yajūṃṣi yathsakṛdupaspṛśati tena sāmāni yathsavyaṃ pāṇiṃ pādau prokṣati yacchiraścakṣuṣī nāsike śrotre hṛdayamālabhate tenātharvāṃgiraso brāhmaṇānītihāsānpurāṇāni kalpāngāthā nārāśaṃsīḥ prīṇāti darbhāṇāṃ mahadupastīryopasthaṃ kṛtvā prāṅāsīnaḥ svādhyāyamadhīyītāpāṃ vā eṣa oṣadhīnāṃ raso yaddarbhāḥ sarasameva brahma kurute dakṣiṇottarau pāṇī pādau kṛtvā sapavitrāvomiti pratipadyata etadvai yajustrayīṃ vidyāṃ pratyeṣā vāgetatparamamakṣaraṃ tadetadṛcā'bhyukta mṛco akṣare parame vyoman yasmindevā adhi viśve niṣeduryastanna veda kimṛcā kariṣyati ya ittadvidusta ime samāsata iti trīneva prāyuṅkta bhūrbhuvassvarityāhaitadvai vācassatyaṃ yadeva vācassatyaṃ tatprāyuṅktātha sāvitrīṃ gāyatrīṃ triranvāha paccho'rdharcaśo'navānaṃ savitā śriyaḥ prasavitā śriyamevāpnotyatho prajñātayaiva pratipadā chandāṃsi pratipadyate
meaning: ब्रह्मयज्ञेन यक्ष्यमाणः प्राच्यां दिशि ग्रामादछदिर्दर्श उदीच्यां प्रागुदीच्यां वोदित आदित्ये दक्षिणत उपवीयोपविश्य हस्ताववनिज्य त्रिराचामेद्द्विः परिमृज्य सकृदुपस्पृश्य शिरश्चक्षुषी नासिके श्रोत्रे हृदयमालभ्य यत्त्रिराचामति तेन ऋचः प्रीणाति यद्द्विः परिमृजति तेन यजूंषि यथ्सकृदुपस्पृशति तेन सामानि यथ्सव्यं पाणिं पादौ प्रोक्षति यच्छिरश्चक्षुषी नासिके श्रोत्रे हृदयमालभते तेनाथर्वांगिरसो ब्राह्मणानीतिहासान्पुराणानि कल्पान्गाथा नाराशंसीः प्रीणाति दर्भाणां महदुपस्तीर्योपस्थं कृत्वा प्राङासीनः स्वाध्यायमधीयीतापां वा एष ओषधीनां रसो यद्दर्भाः सरसमेव ब्रह्म कुरुते दक्षिणोत्तरौ पाणी पादौ कृत्वा सपवित्रावोमिति प्रतिपद्यत एतद्वै यजुस्त्रयीं विद्यां प्रत्येषा वागेतत्परममक्षरं तदेतदृचाऽभ्युक्त मृचो अक्षरे परमे व्योमन् यस्मिन्देवा अधि विश्वे निषेदुर्यस्तन्न वेद किमृचा करिष्यति य इत्तद्विदुस्त इमे समासत इति त्रीनेव प्रायुङ्क्त भूर्भुवस्स्वरित्याहैतद्वै वाचस्सत्यं यदेव वाचस्सत्यं तत्प्रायुङ्क्ताथ सावित्रीं गायत्रीं त्रिरन्वाह पच्छोऽर्धर्चशोऽनवानं सविता श्रियः प्रसविता श्रियमेवाप्नोत्यथो प्रज्ञातयैव प्रतिपदा छन्दांसि प्रतिपद्यते
text_mt: One who is about to sacrifice with the sacrifice to brahman, having gone out of the village to the east, north, or northeast, where the roof is out of sight, after the sun has risen, having placed [his sacred thread] over the left shoulder [hanging] down to the right, having sat down and washed both hands, should sip water three times, wipe [his mouth] twice, touch [water] once, and touch his head, two eyes, two nostrils, two ears, and heart. In that he sips water three times, with that he gratifies the ṛcs; in that he wipes twice, with that the yajuses; in that he touches once, with that the sāmans; in that he sprinkles his left hand and two feet, and touches his head, two eyes, two nostrils, two ears, and heart, with that he gratifies the Atharvāṅgirases, Brāhmaṇas, Itihāsas, Purāṇas, Kalpas, and Gāthās celebrating men. Having spread out a large [seat] of darbha grass and made a lap, seated facing east, he should recite the daily Vedic recitation. Darbha grass is the sap of the waters and plants; he makes the brahman endowed with sap. Placing the right hand and foot over the left, holding strainers, he begins with 'om'. This yajus indeed corresponds to the triple knowledge; this speech is this supreme syllable. Regarding this, it has been stated in a verse: 'The ṛcs are in the supreme firmament, the syllable in which all the gods have sat down. He who does not know that, what will he do with the ṛc? Those who know it sit here together.' He has joined three indeed. He says 'bhūr bhuvas suvar'. This indeed is the truth of speech; whatever is the truth of speech, he has joined that. Then he recites the Sāvitrī gāyatrī three times, verse-quarter by verse-quarter, half-verse by half-verse, and without breathing out. Savitṛ is the impeller of prosperity; he obtains prosperity. Moreover, with a well-known introductory verse, he enters upon the meters.

sanskrit_iast: grāme manasā svādhyāyamadhīyīta divā naktaṃ veti ha smāha śauca āhneya utāraṇye'bala uta vācota tiṣṭhannuta vrajannutāsīna uta śayāno'dhīyītaiva svādhyāyaṃ tapasvī puṇyo bhavati ya evaṃ vidvānthsvādhyāyamadhīte namo brahmaṇe namo astvagnaye namaḥ pṛthivyai nama oṣadhībhyaḥ | namo vāce namo vācaspataye namo viṣṇave bṛhate karomi
meaning: ग्रामे मनसा स्वाध्यायमधीयीत दिवा नक्तं वेति ह स्माह शौच आह्नेय उतारण्येऽबल उत वाचोत तिष्ठन्नुत व्रजन्नुतासीन उत शयानोऽधीयीतैव स्वाध्यायं तपस्वी पुण्यो भवति य एवं विद्वान्थ्स्वाध्यायमधीते नमो ब्रह्मणे नमो अस्त्वग्नये नमः पृथिव्यै नम ओषधीभ्यः | नमो वाचे नमो वाचस्पतये नमो विष्णवे बृहते करोमि
text_mt: 'In the village one should recite the daily Vedic recitation mentally, or by day, or by night,' Śauca Āhneya used to say; 'or in the forest, [be it] weakly, or with voice, or standing, or walking, or sitting, or lying down, one should indeed recite the daily Vedic recitation.' Ascetic and meritorious becomes he who, knowing thus, recites the daily Vedic recitation. / Homage to brahman! Homage be to Agni! Homage to the earth! Homage to the plants! / Homage to speech! Homage to the lord of speech! Homage to the great Viṣṇu I offer.

sanskrit_iast: madhyandine prabalamadhīyītāsau khalu vāvaiṣa ādityo yadbrāhmaṇastasmāttarhi tekṣṇiṣṭhaṃ tapati tadeṣā'bhyuktā | citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ | ā'prā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśceti sa vā eṣa yajñaḥ sadyaḥ pratāyate sadyaḥ santiṣṭhate tasya prāksāyamavabhṛtho namo brahmaṇa iti paridhānīyāṃ triranvāhāpa upaspṛśya gṛhāneti tato yatkiñca dadāti sā dakṣiṇā
meaning: मध्यन्दिने प्रबलमधीयीतासौ खलु वावैष आदित्यो यद्ब्राह्मणस्तस्मात्तर्हि तेक्ष्णिष्ठं तपति तदेषाऽभ्युक्ता | चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकं चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः | आऽप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्चेति स वा एष यज्ञः सद्यः प्रतायते सद्यः सन्तिष्ठते तस्य प्राक्सायमवभृथो नमो ब्रह्मण इति परिधानीयां त्रिरन्वाहाप उपस्पृश्य गृहानेति ततो यत्किञ्च ददाति सा दक्षिणा
text_mt: At midday he should recite loudly. That sun indeed is that brāhmaṇa; therefore at that time it burns most fiercely. Regarding that, this [verse] has been uttered: / 'The wondrous front of the gods has arisen, the eye of Mitra, of Varuṇa, of Agni; / it has filled sky and earth and intermediate space; Sūrya is the self of all that moves and stands.' / This sacrifice is performed on the same day, concludes on the same day. Its final purifying bath is before evening. He recites the concluding verse, 'Homage to brahman,' three times. Having touched water, he goes to the houses. Then whatever he gives, that is the priestly gift.

sanskrit_iast: tasya vā etasya yajñasya megho havirdhānaṃ vidyudagnirvarṣaṃ havisstanayitnurvaṣaṭkāro yadavasphūrjati so'nuvaṣaṭkāro vāyurātmā'māvāsyā sviṣṭakṛdya evaṃ vidvānmeghe varṣati vidyotamāne stanayatyavasphūrjati pavamāne vāyāvamāvāsyāyāg svādhyāyamadhīte tapa eva tattapyate tapo hi svādhyāya ityuttamaṃ nākaṃ rohatyuttamaḥ samānānāṃ bhavati yāvantaṃ ha vā imāṃ vittasya pūrṇāṃ dadathsvargaṃ lokaṃ jayati tāvantaṃ lokaṃ jayati bhūyāṃsaṃ cākṣayyaṃ cāpapunarmṛtyuñjayati brahmaṇassāyujyaṃ gacchati
meaning: तस्य वा एतस्य यज्ञस्य मेघो हविर्धानं विद्युदग्निर्वर्षं हविस्स्तनयित्नुर्वषट्कारो यदवस्फूर्जति सोऽनुवषट्कारो वायुरात्माऽमावास्या स्विष्टकृद्य एवं विद्वान्मेघे वर्षति विद्योतमाने स्तनयत्यवस्फूर्जति पवमाने वायावमावास्यायाग् स्वाध्यायमधीते तप एव तत्तप्यते तपो हि स्वाध्याय इत्युत्तमं नाकं रोहत्युत्तमः समानानां भवति यावन्तं ह वा इमां वित्तस्य पूर्णां ददथ्स्वर्गं लोकं जयति तावन्तं लोकं जयति भूयांसं चाक्षय्यं चापपुनर्मृत्युञ्जयति ब्रह्मणस्सायुज्यं गच्छति
text_mt: Of this sacrifice, indeed, the cloud is the cart-shed for oblations, lightning is the fire, rain is the oblation, thunder is the vaṣaṭ-call, the rumbling [of thunder] is the after-vaṣaṭ-call, Vāyu is the self, the new-moon day is the [offering to Agni] Sviṣṭakṛt. He who, knowing thus, recites the daily Vedic recitation when the cloud rains, lightnings flash, thunders roar, it rumbles, the wind purifies itself, or on the new-moon day, he performs ascetic heat indeed; for the daily Vedic recitation is ascetic heat. He ascends to the highest firmament, he becomes the foremost of his peers. As great a world as one wins by giving this [earth] full of wealth, so great a world does he win, and greater, imperishable, and he wins beyond recurrent death; he goes to union with brahman.
