sanskrit_iast: tasya vā etasya yajñasya dvāvanadhyāyau yadātmā'śuciryaddeśaḥ samṛddhirdaivatāni ya evaṃ vidvānmahārātra uṣasyudite vrajaṃstiṣṭhannāsīnaḥ śayāno'raṇye grāme vā yāvattarasaṃ svādhyāyamadhīte sarvān lokān jayati sarvān lokānanṛṇo'nusañcarati tadeṣā'bhyuktā | anṛṇā asminnanṛṇāḥ parasmiṃstṛtīye loke anṛṇāssyāma | ye devayānā uta pitṛyāṇāssarvānpatho anṛṇā ākṣīyemetyagniṃ vai jātaṃ pāpmā jagrāha taṃ devā āhutībhiḥ pāpmānamapāghnannāhutīnāṃ yajñena yajñasya dakṣiṇābhirdakṣiṇānāṃ brāhmaṇena brāhmaṇasya chandobhiśchandasāg svādhyāyenāpahatapāpmā svādhyāyo devapavitraṃ vā etattaṃ yo'nūthsṛjatyabhāgo vāci bhavatyabhāgo nāke tadeṣā'bhyuktā | yastityāja sakhividaṃ sakhāyaṃ na tasya vācyapi bhāgo asti | yadīṃ śṛṇotyalakaṃ śṛṇoti na hi praveda sukṛtasya panthāmiti tasmāthsvādhyāyo'dhyetavyo yaṃ yaṃ kratumadhīte tena tenāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavatyagnervāyorādityasya sāyujyaṃ gacchati tadeṣā'bhyuktā | ye arvāṅuta vā purāṇe vedaṃ vidvāṃsamabhito vadantyādityameva te parivadanti sarve agniṃ dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca haṃsamiti yāvatīrvai devatāstāssarvā vedavidi brāhmaṇe vasanti tasmādbrāhmaṇebhyo vedavidbhyo dive dive namaskuryānnāślīlaṃ kīrtayedetā eva devatāḥ prīṇāti
meaning: तस्य वा एतस्य यज्ञस्य द्वावनध्यायौ यदात्माऽशुचिर्यद्देशः समृद्धिर्दैवतानि य एवं विद्वान्महारात्र उषस्युदिते व्रजंस्तिष्ठन्नासीनः शयानोऽरण्ये ग्रामे वा यावत्तरसं स्वाध्यायमधीते सर्वान् लोकान् जयति सर्वान् लोकाननृणोऽनुसञ्चरति तदेषाऽभ्युक्ता | अनृणा अस्मिन्ननृणाः परस्मिंस्तृतीये लोके अनृणास्स्याम | ये देवयाना उत पितृयाणास्सर्वान्पथो अनृणा आक्षीयेमेत्यग्निं वै जातं पाप्मा जग्राह तं देवा आहुतीभिः पाप्मानमपाघ्नन्नाहुतीनां यज्ञेन यज्ञस्य दक्षिणाभिर्दक्षिणानां ब्राह्मणेन ब्राह्मणस्य छन्दोभिश्छन्दसाग् स्वाध्यायेनापहतपाप्मा स्वाध्यायो देवपवित्रं वा एतत्तं योऽनूथ्सृजत्यभागो वाचि भवत्यभागो नाके तदेषाऽभ्युक्ता | यस्तित्याज सखिविदं सखायं न तस्य वाच्यपि भागो अस्ति | यदीं शृणोत्यलकं शृणोति न हि प्रवेद सुकृतस्य पन्थामिति तस्माथ्स्वाध्यायोऽध्येतव्यो यं यं क्रतुमधीते तेन तेनास्येष्टं भवत्यग्नेर्वायोरादित्यस्य सायुज्यं गच्छति तदेषाऽभ्युक्ता | ये अर्वाङुत वा पुराणे वेदं विद्वांसमभितो वदन्त्यादित्यमेव ते परिवदन्ति सर्वे अग्निं द्वितीयं तृतीयं च हंसमिति यावतीर्वै देवतास्तास्सर्वा वेदविदि ब्राह्मणे वसन्ति तस्माद्ब्राह्मणेभ्यो वेदविद्भ्यो दिवे दिवे नमस्कुर्यान्नाश्लीलं कीर्तयेदेता एव देवताः प्रीणाति
text_mt: Of this sacrifice, indeed, there are two occasions for cessation of study: when one's own self is impure, and when the place [is impure]. Prosperity belongs to the deities. He who, knowing thus, recites the daily Vedic recitation in the deep of the night, when dawn has risen, walking, standing, sitting, or lying down, in the forest or in the village, as far as he can, wins all worlds and wanders through all worlds free of debt. Regarding that, this [verse] has been uttered: / 'Free of debt in this [world], free of debt in the other, in the third world may we be free of debt. / Which are the paths of the gods and the paths of the fathers—free of debt may we dwell in all paths.' / Evil indeed seized Agni when he was born; the gods struck off that evil with oblations, of the oblations with the sacrifice, of the sacrifice with priestly gifts, of the priestly gifts with the brāhmaṇa, of the brāhmaṇa with the meters, of the meters with the daily Vedic recitation. The daily Vedic recitation is free of evil; it is indeed a divine purifier. He who abandons it becomes portionless in speech, portionless in the firmament. Regarding that, this [verse] has been uttered: / 'He who has abandoned the friend who knows friendship, he has no share even in speech; / if he hears, he hears in vain; for he does not know the path of good action.' / Therefore the daily Vedic recitation is to be studied. Whatever rite he recites, with that rite sacrifice has been offered by him; he goes to union with Agni, with Vāyu, with Āditya. Regarding that, this [verse] has been uttered: / 'Those who, modern or ancient, speak all around the one who knows the Veda, all of them speak around Āditya himself, Agni as the second, and the goose as the third.' / As many deities as there are, all of them dwell in the brāhmaṇa who knows the Veda. Therefore to brāhmaṇas who know the Veda one should make obeisance day by day, and not utter anything unseemly; [thus] he gratifies these deities alone.

sanskrit_iast: ricyata iva vā eṣa preva ricyate yo yājayati prati vā gṛhṇāti yājayitvā pratigṛhya vā'naśnantriḥ svādhyāyaṃ vedamadhīyīta trirātraṃ vā sāvitrīṃ gāyatrīmanvātirecayati varo dakṣiṇā vareṇaiva varagg spṛṇotyātmā hi varaḥ
meaning: रिच्यत इव वा एष प्रेव रिच्यते यो याजयति प्रति वा गृह्णाति याजयित्वा प्रतिगृह्य वाऽनश्नन्त्रिः स्वाध्यायं वेदमधीयीत त्रिरात्रं वा सावित्रीं गायत्रीमन्वातिरेचयति वरो दक्षिणा वरेणैव वरग्ग् स्पृणोत्यात्मा हि वरः
text_mt: He is indeed emptied out, as it were—emptied out completely—who officiates for another or accepts [gifts]. Having officiated or accepted [gifts], fasting, he should study the Veda as his private recitation three times, or for three nights follow it with the Sāvitrī gāyatrī. An excellent boon is the sacrificial fee: with an excellent boon he rescues [himself], for the self is the excellent boon.

sanskrit_iast: duhe ha vā eṣa chandāṃsi yo yājayati sa yena yajñakratunā yājayethso'raṇyaṃ paretya śucau deśe svādhyāyamevainamadhīyannāsīta tasyānaśanaṃ dīkṣā sthānamupasada āsanaṃ sutyā vāgjuhūrmana upabhṛddhṛtirdhruvā prāṇo haviḥ sāmādhvaryussa vā eṣa yajñaḥ prāṇadakṣiṇo'nantadakṣiṇaḥ samṛddhataraḥ
meaning: दुहे ह वा एष छन्दांसि यो याजयति स येन यज्ञक्रतुना याजयेथ्सोऽरण्यं परेत्य शुचौ देशे स्वाध्यायमेवैनमधीयन्नासीत तस्यानशनं दीक्षा स्थानमुपसद आसनं सुत्या वाग्जुहूर्मन उपभृद्धृतिर्ध्रुवा प्राणो हविः सामाध्वर्युस्स वा एष यज्ञः प्राणदक्षिणोऽनन्तदक्षिणः समृद्धतरः
text_mt: He indeed milks the meters dry who officiates for another. With whatever sacrificial rite he might officiate, going out to the forest, in a clean place, he should sit studying this very private recitation. For him, fasting is the consecration, standing is the upasads, sitting is the Soma-pressing day, speech is the juhū ladle, mind is the upabhṛt ladle, steadfastness is the dhruvā ladle, the vital breath is the oblation, and the Sāman is the Adhvaryu. That sacrifice indeed has the vital breath as its sacrificial fee, an endless sacrificial fee, [and is] more fully prosperous.

sanskrit_iast: katidhā'vakīrṇī praviśati caturdhetyāhurbrahmavādino marutaḥ prāṇairindraṃ balena bṛhaspatiṃ brahmavarcasenāgnimevetareṇa sarveṇa tasyaitāṃ prāyaścittiṃ vidāñcakāra sudevaḥ kāśyapo yo brahmacāryavakiredamāvāsyāyāṃ rātryāmagniṃ praṇīyopasamādhāya dvirājyasyopaghātaṃ juhoti kāmāvakīrṇo'smyavakīrṇo'smi kāma kāmāya svāhā kāmābhidrugdho'smyabhidrugdho'smi kāma kāmāya svāhetyamṛtaṃ vā ājyamamṛtamevātmandhatte hutvā prayatāñjaliḥ kavātiryaṅṅagnimabhimantrayeta saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ samindrassaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | saṃ mā'yamagniḥ siñcatvāyuṣā ca balena cāyuṣmantaṃ karota meti prati hāsmai marutaḥ prāṇāndadhati pratīndro balaṃ prati bṛhaspatirbrahmavarcasaṃ pratyagniritarathsarvaṃ sarvatanurbhūtvā sarvamāyureti trirabhimantrayeta triṣatyā hi devā yo'pūta iva manyeta sa itthaṃ juhuyāditthamabhimantrayeta punīta evātmānamāyurevātmandhatte varo dakṣiṇā vareṇaiva varaṃ spṛṇotyātmā hi varaḥ
meaning: कतिधाऽवकीर्णी प्रविशति चतुर्धेत्याहुर्ब्रह्मवादिनो मरुतः प्राणैरिन्द्रं बलेन बृहस्पतिं ब्रह्मवर्चसेनाग्निमेवेतरेण सर्वेण तस्यैतां प्रायश्चित्तिं विदाञ्चकार सुदेवः काश्यपो यो ब्रह्मचार्यवकिरेदमावास्यायां रात्र्यामग्निं प्रणीयोपसमाधाय द्विराज्यस्योपघातं जुहोति कामावकीर्णोऽस्म्यवकीर्णोऽस्मि काम कामाय स्वाहा कामाभिद्रुग्धोऽस्म्यभिद्रुग्धोऽस्मि काम कामाय स्वाहेत्यमृतं वा आज्यममृतमेवात्मन्धत्ते हुत्वा प्रयताञ्जलिः कवातिर्यङ्ङग्निमभिमन्त्रयेत सं मा सिञ्चन्तु मरुतः समिन्द्रस्सं बृहस्पतिः | सं माऽयमग्निः सिञ्चत्वायुषा च बलेन चायुष्मन्तं करोत मेति प्रति हास्मै मरुतः प्राणान्दधति प्रतीन्द्रो बलं प्रति बृहस्पतिर्ब्रह्मवर्चसं प्रत्यग्निरितरथ्सर्वं सर्वतनुर्भूत्वा सर्वमायुरेति त्रिरभिमन्त्रयेत त्रिषत्या हि देवा योऽपूत इव मन्येत स इत्थं जुहुयादित्थमभिमन्त्रयेत पुनीत एवात्मानमायुरेवात्मन्धत्ते वरो दक्षिणा वरेणैव वरं स्पृणोत्यात्मा हि वरः
text_mt: In how many parts does one who has broken his vow enter? 'In four,' say the expounders of brahman: 'the Maruts with his vital breaths, Indra with his strength, Bṛhaspati with his spiritual radiance, and Agni with all the rest.' For him Sudeva Kāśyapa knew this expiation: whichever student of sacred lore should break his vow, having brought forward the fire and added fuel to it on the night of the new moon, he offers two ladlings of clarified butter: 'Desire-broken-vow am I, a breaker of vows am I, O Desire; to Desire, svāhā! Desire-defrauded am I, defrauded am I, O Desire; to Desire, svāhā!' Clarified butter is indeed immortal; it is immortality that he places in himself. Having offered, with cupped hands respectfully outstretched, turned slightly sideways, he should address the fire with mantras: 'May the Maruts sprinkle me, may Indra, may Bṛhaspati; / may this Agni sprinkle me with lifespan and with strength; make me possess lifespan!' The Maruts restore his vital breaths to him, Indra his strength, Bṛhaspati his spiritual radiance, and Agni all the rest; becoming possessed of his whole body, he attains a full lifespan. Three times he should address it with mantras, for the gods are threefold-true. He who considers himself as if unpurified should offer thus, should address [the fire] thus. He purifies his self; he places a lifespan in his self. An excellent boon is the sacrificial fee: with an excellent boon he rescues [himself], for the self is the excellent boon.

sanskrit_iast: bhūḥ prapadye bhuvaḥ prapadye svaḥ prapadye bhūrbhūvassvaḥ prapadye brahma prapadye brahmakośaṃ prapadye'mṛtaṃ prapadye'mṛtakośaṃ prapadye caturjālaṃ brahmakośaṃ yaṃ mṛtyurnāvapaśyati taṃ prapadye devānprapadye devapuraṃ prapadye parīvṛto varīvṛto brahmaṇā varmaṇā'haṃ tejasā kaśyapasya yasmai namastacchiro dharmo mūrdhānaṃ brahmottarā hanuryajño'dharā viṣṇurhṛdayaṃ saṃvathsaraḥ prajananamaśvinau pūrvapādāvatrirmadhyaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvaparapādāvagniḥ pucchasya prathamaṃ kāṇḍaṃ tata indrastataḥ prajāpatirabhayaṃ caturthaṃ sa vā eṣa divyaḥ śākvaraḥ śiśumārastaṃ ha ya evaṃ vedāpa punarmṛtyuṃ jayati jayati svargaṃ lokaṃ nādhvani pramīyate nāgnau pramīyate nāpsu pramīyate nānapatyaḥ pramīyate laghvānno bhavati dhruvastvamasi dhruvasya kṣitamasi tvaṃ bhūtānāmadhipatirasi tvaṃ bhūtānāg śreṣṭho'si tvāṃ bhūtānyupaparyāvartante namaste namassarvaṃ te namo namaḥ śiśukumārāya namaḥ
meaning: भूः प्रपद्ये भुवः प्रपद्ये स्वः प्रपद्ये भूर्भूवस्स्वः प्रपद्ये ब्रह्म प्रपद्ये ब्रह्मकोशं प्रपद्येऽमृतं प्रपद्येऽमृतकोशं प्रपद्ये चतुर्जालं ब्रह्मकोशं यं मृत्युर्नावपश्यति तं प्रपद्ये देवान्प्रपद्ये देवपुरं प्रपद्ये परीवृतो वरीवृतो ब्रह्मणा वर्मणाऽहं तेजसा कश्यपस्य यस्मै नमस्तच्छिरो धर्मो मूर्धानं ब्रह्मोत्तरा हनुर्यज्ञोऽधरा विष्णुर्हृदयं संवथ्सरः प्रजननमश्विनौ पूर्वपादावत्रिर्मध्यं मित्रावरुणावपरपादावग्निः पुच्छस्य प्रथमं काण्डं तत इन्द्रस्ततः प्रजापतिरभयं चतुर्थं स वा एष दिव्यः शाक्वरः शिशुमारस्तं ह य एवं वेदाप पुनर्मृत्युं जयति जयति स्वर्गं लोकं नाध्वनि प्रमीयते नाग्नौ प्रमीयते नाप्सु प्रमीयते नानपत्यः प्रमीयते लघ्वान्नो भवति ध्रुवस्त्वमसि ध्रुवस्य क्षितमसि त्वं भूतानामधिपतिरसि त्वं भूतानाग् श्रेष्ठोऽसि त्वां भूतान्युपपर्यावर्तन्ते नमस्ते नमस्सर्वं ते नमो नमः शिशुकुमाराय नमः
text_mt: I enter Bhūḥ; I enter Bhuvaḥ; I enter Svaḥ; I enter Bhūr-Bhuvas-Svaḥ; I enter brahman; I enter the treasure of brahman; I enter the immortal; I enter the treasure of the immortal; I enter the four-meshed treasure of brahman which death does not see down upon; that I enter; I enter the gods; I enter the fortress of the gods. Covered, completely covered by brahman as an armor, by the radiance of Kaśyapa. Reverence to him whose head is that: Dharma is his cranium, brahman his upper jaw, sacrifice his lower jaw, Viṣṇu his heart, the year his reproductive organ, the Aśvins his forefeet, Atri his middle, Mitra and Varuṇa his hindfeet, Agni the first section of his tail, then Indra, then Prajāpati, and Fearlessness the fourth. This is indeed the celestial, mighty Śiśumāra. He who knows him thus conquers redeath, conquers the heavenly world; he does not die on the road, he does not die in fire, he does not die in the waters, he does not die childless; he becomes one whose food is light. You are firm; you are the dwelling-place of the firm; you are the lord of beings; you are the best of beings; to you beings turn. Reverence to you, reverence, all reverence to you, reverence, reverence to the young Śiśu, reverence.

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ prācyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṃ prativasantyetābhyaśca namo namo dakṣiṇāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṃ prativasantyetābhyaśca namo namaḥ pratīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṃ prativasantyetābhyaśca namo nama udīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṃ prativasantyetābhyaśca namo nama ūrdhvāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṃ prativasantyetābhyaśca namo namo'dharāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṃ prativasantyetābhyaśca namo namo'vāntarāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṃ prativasantyetābhyaśca namo namo gaṅgāyamunayormadhye ye vasanti te me prasannātmānaściraṃ jīvitaṃ vardhayanti namo gaṅgāyamunayormunibhyaśca namo namo gaṅgāyamunayormunibhyaśca namaḥ
meaning: नमः प्राच्यै दिशे याश्च देवता एतस्यां प्रतिवसन्त्येताभ्यश्च नमो नमो दक्षिणायै दिशे याश्च देवता एतस्यां प्रतिवसन्त्येताभ्यश्च नमो नमः प्रतीच्यै दिशे याश्च देवता एतस्यां प्रतिवसन्त्येताभ्यश्च नमो नम उदीच्यै दिशे याश्च देवता एतस्यां प्रतिवसन्त्येताभ्यश्च नमो नम ऊर्ध्वायै दिशे याश्च देवता एतस्यां प्रतिवसन्त्येताभ्यश्च नमो नमोऽधरायै दिशे याश्च देवता एतस्यां प्रतिवसन्त्येताभ्यश्च नमो नमोऽवान्तरायै दिशे याश्च देवता एतस्यां प्रतिवसन्त्येताभ्यश्च नमो नमो गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये ये वसन्ति ते मे प्रसन्नात्मानश्चिरं जीवितं वर्धयन्ति नमो गङ्गायमुनयोर्मुनिभ्यश्च नमो नमो गङ्गायमुनयोर्मुनिभ्यश्च नमः
text_mt:
Reverence to the eastern quarter, and to whichever deities dwell in this one, to them too reverence! Reverence to the southern quarter, and to whichever deities dwell in this one, to them too reverence! Reverence to the western quarter, and to whichever deities dwell in this one, to them too reverence! Reverence to the northern quarter, and to whichever deities dwell in this one, to them too reverence! Reverence to the upper quarter, and to whichever deities dwell in this one, to them too reverence! Reverence to the lower quarter, and to whichever deities dwell in this one, to them too reverence! Reverence to the intermediate quarter, and to whichever deities dwell in this one, to them too reverence! Reverence to those who dwell between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā; may they, with gracious minds, increase my long life! Reverence to the sages between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā, and reverence, reverence to the sages between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā, reverence!
'Together the rakṣases,' 'when the gods, seventeen,' 'when they gambled, fifteen,' 'lifespan for you, thirty-four,' 'to Vaiśvānara, twenty-six,' 'the wind-girt indeed,' 'by the kūśmāṇḍas,' 'the unborn goats indeed, five,' 'by the sacrifice to brahman,' 'in the village,' 'at midday,' 'of it indeed a cloud,' 'of it indeed two,' 'is emptied,' 'milks dry,' 'in how many parts, the breaker of vows,' 'Bhūḥ,' 'reverence to the eastern': twenty. 'Together,' 'the wind-girt,' 'milks dry': twenty-four. 'Together indeed,' 'and to the sages, reverence.'

sanskrit_iast: cittissruk | cittamājyam | vāgvediḥ | ādhītaṃ barhiḥ | keto agniḥ | vijñātamagniḥ | vākpatirhotā | mana upavaktā | prāṇo haviḥ | sāmādhvaryuḥ | vācaspate vidhe nāmann | vidhema te nāma | vidhestvamasmākaṃ nāma | vācaspatissomaṃ pibatu | ā'smāsu nṛmṇaṃ dhāthsvāhā
meaning: चित्तिस्स्रुक् | चित्तमाज्यम् | वाग्वेदिः | आधीतं बर्हिः | केतो अग्निः | विज्ञातमग्निः | वाक्पतिर्होता | मन उपवक्ता | प्राणो हविः | सामाध्वर्युः | वाचस्पते विधे नामन्न् | विधेम ते नाम | विधेस्त्वमस्माकं नाम | वाचस्पतिस्सोमं पिबतु | आऽस्मासु नृम्णं धाथ्स्वाहा
text_mt: Thought is the sruk ladle; intellect is the clarified butter; speech is the altar; what is studied is the sacrificial grass; intention is the fire; what is understood is the fire; the lord of speech is the Hotṛ; the mind is the Upavaktṛ; the vital breath is the oblation; / the Sāman is the Adhvaryu. O lord of speech, in your name we worship; we would worship your name; may you worship our name. May the lord of speech drink Soma; place courage in us, svāhā! / 'The Adhvaryu', and five.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivī hotā | dyauradhvaryuḥ | rudro'gnīt | bṛhaspatirupavaktā | vācaspate vāco vīryeṇa | saṃbhṛtatamenāyakṣyase | yajamānāya vāryam | ā suvaskarasmai | vācaspatiḥ somaṃ pibati | jajanadindramindriyāya svāhā
meaning: पृथिवी होता | द्यौरध्वर्युः | रुद्रोऽग्नीत् | बृहस्पतिरुपवक्ता | वाचस्पते वाचो वीर्येण | संभृततमेनायक्ष्यसे | यजमानाय वार्यम् | आ सुवस्करस्मै | वाचस्पतिः सोमं पिबति | जजनदिन्द्रमिन्द्रियाय स्वाहा
text_mt: The earth is the Hotṛ; the sky is the Adhvaryu; Rudra is the Agnīdh; Bṛhaspati is the Upavaktṛ. / O lord of speech, by the strength of speech, / most fully gathered, you will sacrifice. For the patron of the sacrifice, a choice thing, / bring heaven to him. The lord of speech drinks Soma; / he has begotten Indra for heroic power, svāhā! / 'The earth is the Hotṛ': ten.

sanskrit_iast: agnirhotā | aśvinā'dhvaryū | tvaṣṭā'gnīt | mitra upavaktā | somassomasya purogāḥ | śukraḥ śukrasya purogāḥ | śrātāsta indra somāḥ | vātāperhavanaśrutassvāhā
meaning: अग्निर्होता | अश्विनाऽध्वर्यू | त्वष्टाऽग्नीत् | मित्र उपवक्ता | सोमस्सोमस्य पुरोगाः | शुक्रः शुक्रस्य पुरोगाः | श्रातास्त इन्द्र सोमाः | वातापेर्हवनश्रुतस्स्वाहा
text_mt: Agni is the Hotṛ; the Aśvins are the two Adhvaryus; Tvaṣṭṛ is the Agnīdh; Mitra is the Upavaktṛ. Soma is the forerunner of Soma; the pure [Soma] is the forerunner of the pure [Soma]. Cooked for you, O Indra, are the Somas, hearing the call of Vātāpi, svāhā! / 'Agni is the Hotṛ': eight.

sanskrit_iast: sūryaṃ te cakṣuḥ | vātaṃ prāṇaḥ | dyāṃ pṛṣṭham | antarikṣamātmā | aṅgairyajñam | pṛthivīṃ śarīraiḥ | vācaspate'cchidrayā vācā | acchidrayā juhvā | divi devāvṛdhaṃ hotrāmerayasva svāhā
meaning: सूर्यं ते चक्षुः | वातं प्राणः | द्यां पृष्ठम् | अन्तरिक्षमात्मा | अङ्गैर्यज्ञम् | पृथिवीं शरीरैः | वाचस्पतेऽच्छिद्रया वाचा | अच्छिद्रया जुह्वा | दिवि देवावृधं होत्रामेरयस्व स्वाहा
text_mt: To the sun your eye, / to the wind your vital breath, / to the sky your back, / to the intermediate space your self, / with your limbs the sacrifice, / with your bodies the earth. / O lord of speech, with unslit speech, / with an unslit juhū ladle, / speed the hotrā offering in heaven, which gladdens the gods, svāhā! / 'To the sun your': nine.

sanskrit_iast: mahāhavirhotā | satyahaviradhvaryuḥ | acyutapājā agnīt | acyutamanā upavaktā | anādhṛṣyaścāpratidhṛṣyaśca yajñasyābhigarau | ayāsya udgātā | vācaspate hṛdvidhe nāmann | vidhema te nāma | vidhestvamasmākaṃ nāma | vācaspatissomamapāt | mā daivyastantuśchedi mā manuṣyaḥ | namo dive | namaḥ pṛthivyai svāhā
meaning: महाहविर्होता | सत्यहविरध्वर्युः | अच्युतपाजा अग्नीत् | अच्युतमना उपवक्ता | अनाधृष्यश्चाप्रतिधृष्यश्च यज्ञस्याभिगरौ | अयास्य उद्गाता | वाचस्पते हृद्विधे नामन्न् | विधेम ते नाम | विधेस्त्वमस्माकं नाम | वाचस्पतिस्सोममपात् | मा दैव्यस्तन्तुश्छेदि मा मनुष्यः | नमो दिवे | नमः पृथिव्यै स्वाहा
text_mt: The great oblation is the hotṛ; the true oblation is the adhvaryu; he of unfailing splendor is the āgnīdhra; he of unfailing mind is the upavaktṛ; the unassailable and the irresistible are the two responders of the sacrifice; Ayāsya is the udgātṛ. O lord of speech, who arranges the heart, by name, may we honor your name; may you honor our name. The lord of speech has drunk the soma. Let not the divine thread be cut, nor the human. Homage to the sky; homage to the earth, svāhā! / [He has drunk; three.]

sanskrit_iast: vāgghotā | dīkṣā patnī | vāto'dhvaryuḥ | āpo'bhigaraḥ | mano haviḥ | tapasi juhomi | bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | brahma svayambhu | brahmaṇe svayambhuve svāhā
meaning: वाग्घोता | दीक्षा पत्नी | वातोऽध्वर्युः | आपोऽभिगरः | मनो हविः | तपसि जुहोमि | भूर्भुवस्सुवः | ब्रह्म स्वयम्भु | ब्रह्मणे स्वयम्भुवे स्वाहा
text_mt: Speech is the hotṛ; consecration is the wife; the wind is the adhvaryu; the waters are the responder; the mind is the oblation. / I offer into ascetic heat. Bhūr, bhuvaḥ, suvar! Brahman is self-existent; to the self-existent brahman, svāhā! / [Speech is the hotṛ; nine.]

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇa ekahotā | sa yajñaḥ | sa me dadātu prajāṃ paśūnpuṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ | yajñaśca me bhūyāt | agnirdvihotā | sa bhartā | sa me dadātu prajāṃ paśūnpuṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ | bhartā ca me bhūyāt | pṛthivī trihotā | sa pratiṣṭhā
meaning: ब्राह्मण एकहोता | स यज्ञः | स मे ददातु प्रजां पशून्पुष्टिं यशः | यज्ञश्च मे भूयात् | अग्निर्द्विहोता | स भर्ता | स मे ददातु प्रजां पशून्पुष्टिं यशः | भर्ता च मे भूयात् | पृथिवी त्रिहोता | स प्रतिष्ठा
text_mt:
The brāhmaṇa is the one-hotṛ; he is the sacrifice; may he give me offspring, cattle, nourishment, renown; and may the sacrifice be mine. Agni is the two-hotṛ; he is the supporter; may he give me offspring, cattle, nourishment, renown; and may the supporter be mine. The earth is the three-hotṛ; / she is the firm foundation;

may she give me offspring, cattle, nourishment, renown; and may the firm foundation be mine. The intermediate space is the four-hotṛ; it is the wide extension; may it give me offspring, cattle, nourishment, renown; and may the wide extension be mine. Vāyu is the five-hotṛ; he is the vital breath; may he give me offspring, cattle, nourishment, renown; and may the vital breath be mine.

sanskrit_iast: sa me dadātu prajāṃ paśūnpuṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ | pratiṣṭhā ca me bhūyāt | antarikṣaṃ caturhotā | sa viṣṭhāḥ | sa me dadātu prajāṃ paśūnpuṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ | viṣṭhāśca me bhūyāt | vāyuḥ pañcahotā | sa prāṇaḥ | sa me dadātu prajāṃ paśūnpuṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ | prāṇaśca me bhūyāt
meaning: स मे ददातु प्रजां पशून्पुष्टिं यशः | प्रतिष्ठा च मे भूयात् | अन्तरिक्षं चतुर्होता | स विष्ठाः | स मे ददातु प्रजां पशून्पुष्टिं यशः | विष्ठाश्च मे भूयात् | वायुः पञ्चहोता | स प्राणः | स मे ददातु प्रजां पशून्पुष्टिं यशः | प्राणश्च मे भूयात्

sanskrit_iast: candramāṣṣaḍḍhotā | sa ṛtūnkalpayāti | sa me dadātu prajāṃ paśūnpuṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ | ṛtavaśca me kalpantām | annaṃ saptahotā | sa prāṇasya prāṇaḥ | sa me dadātu prajāṃ paśūnpuṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ | prāṇasya ca me prāṇo bhūyāt | dyauraṣṭahotā | so'nādhṛṣyaḥ
meaning: चन्द्रमाष्षड्ढोता | स ऋतून्कल्पयाति | स मे ददातु प्रजां पशून्पुष्टिं यशः | ऋतवश्च मे कल्पन्ताम् | अन्नं सप्तहोता | स प्राणस्य प्राणः | स मे ददातु प्रजां पशून्पुष्टिं यशः | प्राणस्य च मे प्राणो भूयात् | द्यौरष्टहोता | सोऽनाधृष्यः
text_mt:
The moon is the six-hotṛ; he arranges the seasons; may he give me offspring, cattle, nourishment, renown; and may the seasons be arranged for me. Food is the seven-hotṛ; it is the vital breath of vital breath; may it give me offspring, cattle, nourishment, renown; and may the vital breath of vital breath be mine. / The sky is the eight-hotṛ; it is unassailable;

may it give me offspring, cattle, nourishment, renown; and may I be unassailable. Āditya is the nine-hotṛ; he is radiant; may he give me offspring, cattle, nourishment, renown; and may I be radiant. Prajāpati is the ten-hotṛ; he is this all; / may he give me offspring, cattle, nourishment, renown; and may the all be mine. / [Firm foundation, vital breath, may it be mine, unassailable, all, and may it be mine. 7. The brāhmaṇa sacrifice, Agni supporter, earth firm foundation, intermediate space wide extension, Vāyu vital breath, moon seasons, food he vital breath of vital breath, sky unassailable, Āditya he radiant, Prajāpati this all.]

sanskrit_iast: sa me dadātu prajāṃ paśūnpuṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ | anādhṛṣyaśca bhūyāsam | ādityo navahotā | sa tejasvī | sa me dadātu prajāṃ paśūnpuṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ | tejasvī ca bhūyāsam | prajāpatirdaśahotā | sa idaṃ sarvam | sa me dadātu prajāṃ paśūnpuṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ | sarvaṃ ca me bhūyāt
meaning: स मे ददातु प्रजां पशून्पुष्टिं यशः | अनाधृष्यश्च भूयासम् | आदित्यो नवहोता | स तेजस्वी | स मे ददातु प्रजां पशून्पुष्टिं यशः | तेजस्वी च भूयासम् | प्रजापतिर्दशहोता | स इदं सर्वम् | स मे ददातु प्रजां पशून्पुष्टिं यशः | सर्वं च मे भूयात्

sanskrit_iast: agniryajurbhiḥ | savitā stomaiḥ | indra ukthāmadaiḥ | mitrāvaruṇāvāśiṣā | aṃgiraso dhiṣṇiyairagnibhiḥ | marutaḥ sadohavirdhānābhyām | āpaḥ prokṣaṇībhiḥ | oṣadhayo barhiṣā | aditirvedyā | somo dīkṣayā
meaning: अग्निर्यजुर्भिः | सविता स्तोमैः | इन्द्र उक्थामदैः | मित्रावरुणावाशिषा | अंगिरसो धिष्णियैरग्निभिः | मरुतः सदोहविर्धानाभ्याम् | आपः प्रोक्षणीभिः | ओषधयो बर्हिषा | अदितिर्वेद्या | सोमो दीक्षया
text_mt: Agni with the yajus verses; Savitṛ with the chants; Indra with the hymn recitations; Mitra and Varuṇa with the blessing; the Aṅgirases with the dhiṣṇya fires; the Maruts with the sadas and havirdhāna sheds; the waters with the sprinkling waters; the plants with the strew; Aditi with the altar; Soma with consecration;

sanskrit_iast: tvaṣṭedhmena | viṣṇuryajñena | vasava ājyena | ādityā dakṣiṇābhiḥ | viśve devā ūrjā | pūṣā svagākāreṇa | bṛhaspatiḥ purodhayā | prajāpatirudgīthena | antarikṣaṃ pavitreṇa | vāyuḥ pātraiḥ | ahaṃ śraddhayā
meaning: त्वष्टेध्मेन | विष्णुर्यज्ञेन | वसव आज्येन | आदित्या दक्षिणाभिः | विश्वे देवा ऊर्जा | पूषा स्वगाकारेण | बृहस्पतिः पुरोधया | प्रजापतिरुद्गीथेन | अन्तरिक्षं पवित्रेण | वायुः पात्रैः | अहं श्रद्धया
text_mt: Tvaṣṭṛ with the kindling wood; Viṣṇu with the sacrifice; the Vasus with the clarified butter; the Ādityas with the sacrificial gifts; the All-gods with refreshment; Pūṣan with the svagā utterance; Bṛhaspati with the office of purohita; / Prajāpati with the udgītha; the intermediate space with the filter; Vāyu with the vessels; I with faith. / [With consecration; with vessels; and one.]

sanskrit_iast: senendrasya | dhenā bṛhaspateḥ | pathyā pūṣṇaḥ | vāgvāyoḥ | dīkṣā somasya | pṛthivyagneḥ | vasūnāṃ gāyatrī | rudrāṇāṃ triṣṭuk | ādityānāṃ jagatī | viṣṇoranuṣṭuk
meaning: सेनेन्द्रस्य | धेना बृहस्पतेः | पथ्या पूष्णः | वाग्वायोः | दीक्षा सोमस्य | पृथिव्यग्नेः | वसूनां गायत्री | रुद्राणां त्रिष्टुक् | आदित्यानां जगती | विष्णोरनुष्टुक्
text_mt: The army belongs to Indra; the milk-cow to Bṛhaspati; the path to Pūṣan; speech to Vāyu; consecration to Soma; the earth to Agni; the gāyatrī to the Vasus; the triṣṭubh to the Rudras; the jagatī to the Ādityas; the anuṣṭubh to Viṣṇu;

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasya virāṭ | yajñasya paṅktiḥ | prajāpateranumatiḥ | mitrasya śraddhā | savituḥ prasūtiḥ | sūryasya marīciḥ | candramaso rohiṇī | ṛṣīṇāmarundhatī | parjanyasya vidyut | catasro diśaḥ | catasro'vāntaradiśāḥ | ahaśca rātriśca | kṛṣiśca vṛṣṭiśca | tviṣiścāpacitiśca | āpaścauṣadhayaśca | ūrkca sūnṛtā ca devānāṃ patnayaḥ
meaning: वरुणस्य विराट् | यज्ञस्य पङ्क्तिः | प्रजापतेरनुमतिः | मित्रस्य श्रद्धा | सवितुः प्रसूतिः | सूर्यस्य मरीचिः | चन्द्रमसो रोहिणी | ऋषीणामरुन्धती | पर्जन्यस्य विद्युत् | चतस्रो दिशः | चतस्रोऽवान्तरदिशाः | अहश्च रात्रिश्च | कृषिश्च वृष्टिश्च | त्विषिश्चापचितिश्च | आपश्चौषधयश्च | ऊर्क्च सूनृता च देवानां पत्नयः
text_mt: the virāj to Varuṇa; the paṅkti to the sacrifice; approval to Prajāpati; / faith to Mitra; impulse to Savitṛ; the ray of light to Sūrya; Rohiṇī to the moon; Arundhatī to the seers; lightning to Parjanya; the four directions; / the four intermediate directions; day and night; agriculture and rain; / brilliance and reverence; the waters and the plants; refreshment and gracious truth are the wives of the gods. / [Anuṣṭubh; directions; and six.]

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave | aśvinorbāhubhyām | pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ pratigṛhṇāmi | rājā tvā varuṇo nayatu devi dakṣiṇe'gnaye hiraṇyam | tenāmṛtatvamaśyām | vayo dātre | mayo mahyamastu pratigrahītre | ka idaṃ kasmā adāt | kāmaḥ kāmāya | kāmo dātā
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे | अश्विनोर्बाहुभ्याम् | पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां प्रतिगृह्णामि | राजा त्वा वरुणो नयतु देवि दक्षिणेऽग्नये हिरण्यम् | तेनामृतत्वमश्याम् | वयो दात्रे | मयो मह्यमस्तु प्रतिग्रहीत्रे | क इदं कस्मा अदात् | कामः कामाय | कामो दाता
text_mt: At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I accept you. Let King Varuṇa lead you, O divine sacrificial gift, gold to Agni! / Through that may I attain immortality. May there be life for the giver; may there be joy for me, the receiver. Who gave this to whom? Desire gave to desire. Desire is the giver;

sanskrit_iast: kāmaḥ pratigṛhītā | kāmaṃ samudramāviśa | kāmena tvā pratigṛhṇāmi | kāmaitatte | eṣā te kāma dakṣiṇā | uttānastvā''ṅgirasaḥ pratigṛhṇātu | somāya vāsaḥ | rudrāya gām | varuṇāyāśvam | prajāpataye puruṣam
meaning: कामः प्रतिगृहीता | कामं समुद्रमाविश | कामेन त्वा प्रतिगृह्णामि | कामैतत्ते | एषा ते काम दक्षिणा | उत्तानस्त्वा'ऽङ्गिरसः प्रतिगृह्णातु | सोमाय वासः | रुद्राय गाम् | वरुणायाश्वम् | प्रजापतये पुरुषम्
text_mt: desire is the receiver. Enter into desire, the ocean! With desire I accept you. / O desire, this is yours. This, O desire, is your sacrificial gift. May Uttāna Āṅgirasa accept you! A garment for Soma; a cow for Rudra; a horse for Varuṇa; a man for Prajāpati;

sanskrit_iast: manave talpam | tvaṣṭre'jām | pūṣṇe'vim | nirṛtyā aśvataragardabhau | himavato hastinam | gandharvāpsarābhyaḥ sragalaṅkaraṇe | viśvebhyo devebhyo dhānyam | vāce'nnam | brahmaṇa odanam | samudrāyāpaḥ
meaning: मनवे तल्पम् | त्वष्ट्रेऽजाम् | पूष्णेऽविम् | निरृत्या अश्वतरगर्दभौ | हिमवतो हस्तिनम् | गन्धर्वाप्सराभ्यः स्रगलङ्करणे | विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो धान्यम् | वाचेऽन्नम् | ब्रह्मण ओदनम् | समुद्रायापः
text_mt: a couch for Manu; a she-goat for Tvaṣṭṛ; a sheep for Pūṣan; a mule and a donkey for Nirṛti; an elephant of the Himavat for the Gandharvas and Apsarases, [along with] garlands and ornaments; grain for the All-gods; food for speech; cooked rice for brahman; waters for the ocean;

sanskrit_iast: uttānāyāṃgīrasāyānaḥ | vaiśvānarāya ratham | vaiśvānaraḥ pratnathā nākamāruhat | divaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhandamānaḥ sumanmabhiḥ | sa pūrvavajjanayajjantave dhanam | samānamajmā pariyāti jāgṛviḥ | rājā tvā varuṇo nayatu devi dakṣiṇe vaiśvānarāya ratham | tenāmṛtatvamaśyām | vayo dātre | mayo mahyamastu pratigrahītre
meaning: उत्तानायांगीरसायानः | वैश्वानराय रथम् | वैश्वानरः प्रत्नथा नाकमारुहत् | दिवः पृष्ठं भन्दमानः सुमन्मभिः | स पूर्ववज्जनयज्जन्तवे धनम् | समानमज्मा परियाति जागृविः | राजा त्वा वरुणो नयतु देवि दक्षिणे वैश्वानराय रथम् | तेनामृतत्वमश्याम् | वयो दात्रे | मयो मह्यमस्तु प्रतिग्रहीत्रे
text_mt: a cart for Uttāna Āṅgirasa; a chariot for Vaiśvānara. Vaiśvānara mounted the firmament as of old, / praised with good thoughts on the back of the sky; / generating wealth for the creature as formerly, / vigilant, he traverses the same path. / Let King Varuṇa lead you, O divine sacrificial gift, a chariot to Vaiśvānara! Through that may I attain immortality. May there be life for the giver; may there be joy for me, the receiver.

sanskrit_iast: ka idaṃ kasmā adāt | kāmaḥ kāmāya | kāmo dātā | kāmaḥ pratigrahītā | kāmaṃ samudramāviśa | kāmena tvā pratigṛhṇāmi | kāmaitatte | eṣā te kāma dakṣiṇā | uttānastvā''ṅgirasaḥ pratigṛhṇātu
meaning: क इदं कस्मा अदात् | कामः कामाय | कामो दाता | कामः प्रतिग्रहीता | कामं समुद्रमाविश | कामेन त्वा प्रतिगृह्णामि | कामैतत्ते | एषा ते काम दक्षिणा | उत्तानस्त्वा'ऽङ्गिरसः प्रतिगृह्णातु
text_mt: Who gave this to whom? Desire gave to desire. Desire is the giver; desire is the receiver. / Enter into desire, the ocean! With desire I accept you. O desire, this is yours. This, O desire, is your sacrificial gift. May Uttāna Āṅgirasa accept you! / [The giver; a man; waters; for the receiver; and nine.]

sanskrit_iast: suvarṇaṃ gharmaṃ pariveda venam | indrasyātmānaṃ daśadhā carantam | antassamudre manasā carantam | brahmā'nvavindaddaśahotāramarṇe | antaḥ praviṣṭaḥ śāstā janānām | ekassanbahudhā vicāraḥ | śataṃ śukrāṇi yatraikaṃ bhavanti | sarve vedā yatraikaṃ bhavanti | sarve hotāro yatraikaṃ bhavanti | sa mānasīna ātmā janānām
meaning: सुवर्णं घर्मं परिवेद वेनम् | इन्द्रस्यात्मानं दशधा चरन्तम् | अन्तस्समुद्रे मनसा चरन्तम् | ब्रह्माऽन्वविन्दद्दशहोतारमर्णे | अन्तः प्रविष्टः शास्ता जनानाम् | एकस्सन्बहुधा विचारः | शतं शुक्राणि यत्रैकं भवन्ति | सर्वे वेदा यत्रैकं भवन्ति | सर्वे होतारो यत्रैकं भवन्ति | स मानसीन आत्मा जनानाम्
text_mt: I have recognized the golden gharma, the longing one, / the self of Indra, moving in tenfold ways, / moving within the ocean through the mind; / the priest found the ten-hotṛ in the flood. / Entered within, the ruler of men, / being one, he is variously active; / where a hundred bright elements become one; / where all the Vedas become one; / where all the hotṛs become one; / he is the mental self of men.

sanskrit_iast: antaḥ praviṣṭaḥ śāstā janānāṃ sarvātmā | sarvāḥ prajā yatraikaṃ bhavanti | caturhotāro yatra sampadaṃ gacchanti devaiḥ | sa mānasīna ātmā janānām | brahmendramagniṃ jagataḥ pratiṣṭhām | diva ātmānaṃ savitāraṃ bṛhaspatim | caturhotāraṃ pradiśo'nuklṛptam | vāco vīryaṃ tapasā'nvavindat | antaḥ praviṣṭaṃ kartārametam | tvaṣṭāraṃ rūpāṇi vikurvantaṃ vipaścim
meaning: अन्तः प्रविष्टः शास्ता जनानां सर्वात्मा | सर्वाः प्रजा यत्रैकं भवन्ति | चतुर्होतारो यत्र सम्पदं गच्छन्ति देवैः | स मानसीन आत्मा जनानाम् | ब्रह्मेन्द्रमग्निं जगतः प्रतिष्ठाम् | दिव आत्मानं सवितारं बृहस्पतिम् | चतुर्होतारं प्रदिशोऽनुक्लृप्तम् | वाचो वीर्यं तपसाऽन्वविन्दत् | अन्तः प्रविष्टं कर्तारमेतम् | त्वष्टारं रूपाणि विकुर्वन्तं विपश्चिम्
text_mt: Entered within, the ruler of men, the self of all, / where all creatures become one, / where the four-hotṛs attain union with the gods: / he is the mental self of men. / Brahman, Indra, Agni, the firm foundation of the world, / the self of the sky, Savitṛ, Bṛhaspati, / the four-hotṛ arranged according to the quarters, / the vigor of speech, he found through ascetic heat. / Him, the creator entered within, / Tvaṣṭṛ who transforms forms, the wise one—

sanskrit_iast: amṛtasya prāṇaṃ yajñametam | caturhotṛṇāmātmānaṃ kavayo nicikyuḥ | antaḥ praviṣṭaṃ kartārametam | devānāṃ bandhu nihitaṃ guhāsu | amṛtena klṛptaṃ yajñametam | caturhotṛṇāmātmānaṃ kavayo nicikyuḥ | śataṃ niyutaḥ pariveda viśvā viśvavāraḥ | viśvamidaṃ vṛṇāti | indrasyātmā nihitaḥ pañcahotā | amṛtaṃ devānāmāyuḥ prajānām
meaning: अमृतस्य प्राणं यज्ञमेतम् | चतुर्होतृणामात्मानं कवयो निचिक्युः | अन्तः प्रविष्टं कर्तारमेतम् | देवानां बन्धु निहितं गुहासु | अमृतेन क्लृप्तं यज्ञमेतम् | चतुर्होतृणामात्मानं कवयो निचिक्युः | शतं नियुतः परिवेद विश्वा विश्ववारः | विश्वमिदं वृणाति | इन्द्रस्यात्मा निहितः पञ्चहोता | अमृतं देवानामायुः प्रजानाम्
text_mt: This sacrifice, the vital breath of the immortal, / the self of the four Hotṛs, the wise have perceived. / This agent entered within, / the kinsman of the gods placed in the secret places, / this sacrifice prepared with the immortal, / the self of the four Hotṛs, the wise have perceived. / Possessing all desirable things, he fully knows the hundred bays; / he chooses all this. / The five Hotṛs are deposited as Indra's self, / the immortal life of the gods, of creatures.

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ rājānaṃ savitārametam | vāyorātmānaṃ kavayo nicikyuḥ | raśmiṃ raśmīnāṃ madhye tapantam | ṛtasya pade kavayo nipānti | ya āṇḍakośe bhuvanaṃ bibharti | anirbhiṇṇaḥ sannatha lokān vicaṣṭe | yasyāṇḍakośaṃ śuṣmamāhuḥ prāṇamulbam | tena klṛpto'mṛtenāhamasmi | suvarṇaṃ kośaṃ rajasā parīvṛtam | devānāṃ vasudhānīṃ virājam
meaning: इन्द्रं राजानं सवितारमेतम् | वायोरात्मानं कवयो निचिक्युः | रश्मिं रश्मीनां मध्ये तपन्तम् | ऋतस्य पदे कवयो निपान्ति | य आण्डकोशे भुवनं बिभर्ति | अनिर्भिण्णः सन्नथ लोकान् विचष्टे | यस्याण्डकोशं शुष्ममाहुः प्राणमुल्बम् | तेन क्लृप्तोऽमृतेनाहमस्मि | सुवर्णं कोशं रजसा परीवृतम् | देवानां वसुधानीं विराजम्
text_mt: This Indra, the king, Savitṛ, / the self of Vāyu, the wise have perceived. / The ray shining in the midst of the rays, / the wise guard in the station of truth. / He who bears the world within the shell of the egg, / being unbroken, then surveys the worlds; / whose egg-shell they call the vigor, the vital breath, the womb-covering— / by him, by the immortal, am I prepared. / The golden vessel covered with dust, / the virāj, the container of wealth of the gods,

sanskrit_iast: amṛtasya pūrṇāṃ tāmu kalāṃ vicakṣate | pādaṃ ṣaḍḍhoturna kilā vivithse | yenartavaḥ pañcadhota klṛptāḥ | uta vā ṣaḍdhā manasota klṛptāḥ | taṃ ṣaḍḍhotāramṛtubhiḥ kalpamānam | ṛtasya pade kavayo nipānti | antaḥ praviṣṭaṃ kartārametam | antaścandramasi manasā carantam | sahaiva santaṃ na vijānanti devāḥ | indrasyātmānaṃ śatadhā carantam
meaning: अमृतस्य पूर्णां तामु कलां विचक्षते | पादं षड्ढोतुर्न किला विविथ्से | येनर्तवः पञ्चधोत क्लृप्ताः | उत वा षड्धा मनसोत क्लृप्ताः | तं षड्ढोतारमृतुभिः कल्पमानम् | ऋतस्य पदे कवयो निपान्ति | अन्तः प्रविष्टं कर्तारमेतम् | अन्तश्चन्द्रमसि मनसा चरन्तम् | सहैव सन्तं न विजानन्ति देवाः | इन्द्रस्यात्मानं शतधा चरन्तम्
text_mt: filled with the immortal, that digit they declare. / You do not surely know the foot of the six Hotṛs, / by which the seasons are arranged fivefold, / or arranged sixfold by the mind. / Him, the six Hotṛs adapting with the seasons, / the wise guard in the station of truth. / This agent entered within, / moving within the moon through the mind, / though he is with them, the gods do not recognize him, / Indra's self moving a hundredfold.

sanskrit_iast: indro rājā jagato ya īśe | saptahotā saptadhā viklṛptaḥ | pareṇa tantuṃ pariṣicyamānam | antarāditye manasā carantam | devānāṃ hṛdayaṃ brahmā'nvavindat | brahmaitadbrahmaṇa ujjabhāra | arkaṃścotantaṃ sarirasya madhye | ā yasminthsapta peravaḥ | mehanti bahulāg śriyam | bahvaśvāmindra gomatīm
meaning: इन्द्रो राजा जगतो य ईशे | सप्तहोता सप्तधा विक्लृप्तः | परेण तन्तुं परिषिच्यमानम् | अन्तरादित्ये मनसा चरन्तम् | देवानां हृदयं ब्रह्माऽन्वविन्दत् | ब्रह्मैतद्ब्रह्मण उज्जभार | अर्कंश्चोतन्तं सरिरस्य मध्ये | आ यस्मिन्थ्सप्त पेरवः | मेहन्ति बहुलाग् श्रियम् | बह्वश्वामिन्द्र गोमतीम्
text_mt: Indra is the king who rules over the moving world; / as the seven Hotṛs he is fashioned sevenfold, / being sprinkled beyond the thread, / moving within the sun through the mind. / The heart of the gods the brahman found out; / this brahman brought it forth for the brāhmaṇa. / The sun dripping in the midst of the cosmic water, / into which the seven swelling streams / pour abundant fortune, / rich in horses, O Indra, rich in cattle,

sanskrit_iast: acyutāṃ bahulāg śriyam | sa harirvasuvittamaḥ | perurindrāya pinvate | bahvaśvāmindra gomatīm | acyutāṃ bahulāg śriyam | mahyamindro niyacchatu | śataṃśatā asya yuktā harīṇām | arvāṅāyātu vasubhī raśmirindraḥ | pramaṃhamāṇo bahulāg śriyam | raśmirindrassavitā me niyacchatu
meaning: अच्युतां बहुलाग् श्रियम् | स हरिर्वसुवित्तमः | पेरुरिन्द्राय पिन्वते | बह्वश्वामिन्द्र गोमतीम् | अच्युतां बहुलाग् श्रियम् | मह्यमिन्द्रो नियच्छतु | शतंशता अस्य युक्ता हरीणाम् | अर्वाङायातु वसुभी रश्मिरिन्द्रः | प्रमंहमाणो बहुलाग् श्रियम् | रश्मिरिन्द्रस्सविता मे नियच्छतु
text_mt: unfailing, abundant fortune. / He, the tawny one, most wealthy, / the swelling stream swells for Indra. / Rich in horses, O Indra, rich in cattle, / unfailing, abundant fortune— / may Indra grant that to me. / By hundreds his tawny steeds are yoked; / may Indra, the ray, come hither with his Vasus. / Bestowing abundant fortune, / may Indra, the ray, Savitṛ, grant [it] to me.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtantejo madhumadindriyam | mayyayamagnirdadhātu | hariḥ pataṅgaḥ paṭarī suparṇaḥ | divikṣayo nabhasā ya eti | sa na indraḥ kāmavaraṃ dadātu | pañcāraṃ cakraṃ parivartate pṛthu | hiraṇyajyotiḥ sarirasya madhye | ajasraṃ jyotirnabhasā sarpadeti | sa na indraḥ kāmavaraṃ dadātu | sapta yuñjanti rathamekacakram
meaning: घृतन्तेजो मधुमदिन्द्रियम् | मय्ययमग्निर्दधातु | हरिः पतङ्गः पटरी सुपर्णः | दिविक्षयो नभसा य एति | स न इन्द्रः कामवरं ददातु | पञ्चारं चक्रं परिवर्तते पृथु | हिरण्यज्योतिः सरिरस्य मध्ये | अजस्रं ज्योतिर्नभसा सर्पदेति | स न इन्द्रः कामवरं ददातु | सप्त युञ्जन्ति रथमेकचक्रम्
text_mt: Ghee, brilliance, sweet power— / may this Agni place [them] in me. / The tawny bird, flying, fair-winged, / who dwells in the sky and moves through the atmosphere— / may that Indra grant us our chosen wish. / The broad wheel of five spokes turns around, / with golden light in the midst of the cosmic water. / The ceaseless light moves creeping through the atmosphere— / may that Indra grant us our chosen wish. / Seven yoke the one-wheeled chariot;

sanskrit_iast: eko aśvo vahati saptanāmā | trinābhi cakramajaramanarvam | yenemā viśvā bhuvanāni tasthuḥ | bhadraṃ paśyanta upaseduragre | tapo dīkṣāmṛṣayaḥ suvarvidaḥ | tataḥ kṣatraṃ balamojaśca jātam | tadasmai devā abhisannamantu | śvetaṃ raśmiṃ bobhujyamānam | apānnetāraṃ bhuvanasya gopām | indraṃ nicikyuḥ parame vyoman
meaning: एको अश्वो वहति सप्तनामा | त्रिनाभि चक्रमजरमनर्वम् | येनेमा विश्वा भुवनानि तस्थुः | भद्रं पश्यन्त उपसेदुरग्रे | तपो दीक्षामृषयः सुवर्विदः | ततः क्षत्रं बलमोजश्च जातम् | तदस्मै देवा अभिसन्नमन्तु | श्वेतं रश्मिं बोभुज्यमानम् | अपान्नेतारं भुवनस्य गोपाम् | इन्द्रं निचिक्युः परमे व्योमन्
text_mt: one horse, seven-named, draws it. / The three-naved wheel, ageless and unslackened, / on which all these worlds have stood. / Seeing the auspicious, they approached in the beginning, / the seers who know heaven, [practicing] ascetic heat and consecration. / From that, royal power, strength, and vigor were born; / let the gods bow down to it for him. / The white ray, enjoying itself, / the leader of the waters, the guardian of the world, / Indra, they perceived in the highest heaven.

sanskrit_iast: rohiṇīḥ piṅgalā ekarūpāḥ | kṣarantīḥ piṅgalā ekarūpāḥ | śataṃ sahasrāṇi prayutāni nāvyānām | ayaṃ yaḥ śveto raśmiḥ | pari sarvamidaṃ jagat | prajāṃ paśūndhanāni | asmākaṃ dadātu | śveto raśmiḥ pari sarvaṃ babhūva | suvanmahyaṃ paśūn viśvarūpān | pataṅgamaktamasurasya māyayā
meaning: रोहिणीः पिङ्गला एकरूपाः | क्षरन्तीः पिङ्गला एकरूपाः | शतं सहस्राणि प्रयुतानि नाव्यानाम् | अयं यः श्वेतो रश्मिः | परि सर्वमिदं जगत् | प्रजां पशून्धनानि | अस्माकं ददातु | श्वेतो रश्मिः परि सर्वं बभूव | सुवन्मह्यं पशून् विश्वरूपान् | पतङ्गमक्तमसुरस्य मायया
text_mt: Red, reddish-brown, uniform, / flowing, reddish-brown, uniform, / hundreds, thousands, myriads of navigable waters— / this which is the white ray / [encompasses] all this moving world. / Offspring, cattle, wealth— / let him grant to us. / The white ray has encompassed everything; / may it impel for me cattle of all forms. / The bird anointed with the asura's māyā,

sanskrit_iast: hṛdā paśyanti manasā manīṣiṇaḥ | samudre antaḥ kavayo vicakṣate | marīcīnāṃ padamicchanti vedhasaḥ | pataṅgo vācaṃ manasā bibharti | tāṃ gandharvo'vadadgarbhe antaḥ | tāṃ dyotamānāg svaryaṃ manīṣām | ṛtasya pade kavayo nipānti | ye grāmyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpāḥ | virūpāssanto bahudhaikarūpāḥ | agnistāṃ agre pramumoktu devaḥ
meaning: हृदा पश्यन्ति मनसा मनीषिणः | समुद्रे अन्तः कवयो विचक्षते | मरीचीनां पदमिच्छन्ति वेधसः | पतङ्गो वाचं मनसा बिभर्ति | तां गन्धर्वोऽवदद्गर्भे अन्तः | तां द्योतमानाग् स्वर्यं मनीषाम् | ऋतस्य पदे कवयो निपान्ति | ये ग्राम्याः पशवो विश्वरूपाः | विरूपास्सन्तो बहुधैकरूपाः | अग्निस्तां अग्रे प्रमुमोक्तु देवः
text_mt: the wise see with the heart, with the mind; / the seers behold [him] within the ocean. / The wise seek the station of the rays. / The bird bears speech with the mind; / that the Gandharva spoke within the womb. / That shining, heavenly inspiration / the wise guard in the station of truth. / The domestic animals of all forms, / being diverse, yet manifoldly uniform— / may the god Agni release them in the beginning,

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ | vītaṃ stukestuke | yuvamasmāsu niyacchatam | prapra yajñapatintira | ye grāmyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpāḥ | virūpāssanto bahudhaikarūpāḥ | teṣāṃ saptānāmiha rantirastu | rāyaspoṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya | ya āraṇyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpāḥ | virūpāssanto bahudhaikarūpāḥ
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजया संविदानः | वीतं स्तुकेस्तुके | युवमस्मासु नियच्छतम् | प्रप्र यज्ञपतिन्तिर | ये ग्राम्याः पशवो विश्वरूपाः | विरूपास्सन्तो बहुधैकरूपाः | तेषां सप्तानामिह रन्तिरस्तु | रायस्पोषाय सुप्रजास्त्वाय सुवीर्याय | य आरण्याः पशवो विश्वरूपाः | विरूपास्सन्तो बहुधैकरूपाः
text_mt: Prajāpati, united with his offspring. / Enjoy, hair by hair; / do you two grant [it] to us; / lead the lord of the sacrifice ever forward. / The domestic animals of all forms, / being diverse, yet manifoldly uniform— / may there be delight here of those seven, / for the increase of wealth, for good offspring, for good vigor. / The wild animals of all forms, / being diverse, yet manifoldly uniform—

sanskrit_iast: vāyustāṃ agre pramumoktu devaḥ | prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ | iḍāyai sṛptaṃ ghṛtavaccarācaram | devā anvavindanguhāhitam | ya āraṇyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpāḥ | virūpāssanto bahudhaikarūpāḥ | teṣāṃ saptānāmiha rantirastu | rāyaspoṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya
meaning: वायुस्तां अग्रे प्रमुमोक्तु देवः | प्रजापतिः प्रजया संविदानः | इडायै सृप्तं घृतवच्चराचरम् | देवा अन्वविन्दन्गुहाहितम् | य आरण्याः पशवो विश्वरूपाः | विरूपास्सन्तो बहुधैकरूपाः | तेषां सप्तानामिह रन्तिरस्तु | रायस्पोषाय सुप्रजास्त्वाय सुवीर्याय
text_mt: may the god Vāyu release them in the beginning, / Prajāpati, united with his offspring. / What has crept for Iḍā, full of ghee, moving and unmoving, / the gods found hidden in the secret place. / The wild animals of all forms, / being diverse, yet manifoldly uniform— / may there be delight here of those seven, / for the increase of wealth, for good offspring, for good vigor. / The self of creatures, fashioning forms, wise, of creatures, the container of wealth, virāj, moving, rich in cattle, may he grant to me, the one-wheeled, in the heaven, by māyā, the god, uniform, and eight.

sanskrit_iast: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ | sahasrākṣassahasrapāt | sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvā | atyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam | puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam | yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhavyam | utāmṛtatvasyeśānaḥ | yadannenātirohati | etāvānasya mahimā | ato jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ
meaning: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः | सहस्राक्षस्सहस्रपात् | स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वा | अत्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम् | पुरुष एवेदं सर्वम् | यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यम् | उतामृतत्वस्येशानः | यदन्नेनातिरोहति | एतावानस्य महिमा | अतो ज्यायांश्च पूरुषः
text_mt: A thousand-headed is the Puruṣa, / thousand-eyed, thousand-footed. / Having covered the earth on all sides, / he stood beyond [it] by ten fingers. / The Puruṣa alone is all this, / whatever has been and whatever is to be; / and he is the lord of immortality, / since he grows beyond through food. / Such is his greatness, / and greater than this is the Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast: pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni | tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi | tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ | pādo'syehābhavātpunaḥ | tato viśvaṅvyakrāmat | sāśanānaśane abhi | tasmādvirāḍajāyata | virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ | sa jāto atyaricyata | paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ
meaning: पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि | त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि | त्रिपादूर्ध्व उदैत्पुरुषः | पादोऽस्येहाभवात्पुनः | ततो विश्वङ्व्यक्रामत् | साशनानशने अभि | तस्माद्विराडजायत | विराजो अधि पूरुषः | स जातो अत्यरिच्यत | पश्चाद्भूमिमथो पुरः
text_mt: A quarter of him is all beings; / three quarters of him are the immortal in the sky. / With three quarters the Puruṣa rose upward; / a quarter of him came to be here again. / Thence he strode out in all directions / over that which eats and that which eats not. / From him the Virāj was born; / above the Virāj, the Puruṣa. / Being born, he reached beyond / the earth behind and also before.

sanskrit_iast: yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā | devā yajñamatanvata | vasanto asyāsīdājyam | grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ | saptāsyāsanparidhayaḥ | trissapta samidhaḥ kṛtāḥ | devā yadyajñaṃ tanvānāḥ | abadhnanpuruṣaṃ paśum | taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣann | puruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ
meaning: यत्पुरुषेण हविषा | देवा यज्ञमतन्वत | वसन्तो अस्यासीदाज्यम् | ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः | सप्तास्यासन्परिधयः | त्रिस्सप्त समिधः कृताः | देवा यद्यज्ञं तन्वानाः | अबध्नन्पुरुषं पशुम् | तं यज्ञं बर्हिषि प्रौक्षन्न् | पुरुषं जातमग्रतः
text_mt: When with the Puruṣa as oblation / the gods prepared the sacrifice, / spring was its clarified butter, / summer the kindling, autumn the oblation. / Seven were its enclosing sticks; / thrice seven kindling sticks were made, / when the gods, spreading the sacrifice, / bound the Puruṣa as the victim. / That sacrifice, the Puruṣa born in the beginning, / they sprinkled upon the sacred grass;

sanskrit_iast: tena devā ayajanta | sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye | tasmādyajñāthsarvahutaḥ | saṃbhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājyam | paśūṃstāṃścakre vāyavyān | āraṇyāngrāmyāśca ye | tasmādyajñāthsarvahutaḥ | ṛcassāmāni jajñire | chandāṃsi jajñire tasmāt | yajustasmādajāyata
meaning: तेन देवा अयजन्त | साध्या ऋषयश्च ये | तस्माद्यज्ञाथ्सर्वहुतः | संभृतं पृषदाज्यम् | पशूंस्तांश्चक्रे वायव्यान् | आरण्यान्ग्राम्याश्च ये | तस्माद्यज्ञाथ्सर्वहुतः | ऋचस्सामानि जज्ञिरे | छन्दांसि जज्ञिरे तस्मात् | यजुस्तस्मादजायत
text_mt: with him the gods sacrificed, / and the Sādhyas and the seers. / From that sacrifice of universal offering / the speckled butter was gathered. / He made those cattle belonging to Vāyu, / those of the forest and those of the village. / From that sacrifice of universal offering / the ṛc and sāman verses were born; / the metres were born from it; / the yajus was born from it.

sanskrit_iast: tasmādaśvā ajāyanta | ye ke cobhayādataḥ | gāvo ha jajñire tasmāt | tasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ | yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ | katidhā vyakalpayann | mukhaṃ kimasya kau bāhū | kāvūrū pādāvucyete | brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīt | bāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ
meaning: तस्मादश्वा अजायन्त | ये के चोभयादतः | गावो ह जज्ञिरे तस्मात् | तस्माज्जाता अजावयः | यत्पुरुषं व्यदधुः | कतिधा व्यकल्पयन्न् | मुखं किमस्य कौ बाहू | कावूरू पादावुच्येते | ब्राह्मणोऽस्य मुखमासीत् | बाहू राजन्यः कृतः
text_mt: From it horses were born, and all those that have teeth in both jaws; / cattle indeed were born from it; / from it goats and sheep were born. / When they divided the Puruṣa, / into how many parts did they arrange him? / What was his mouth? What were his two arms? / What are his two thighs, his two feet called? / The brāhmaṇa was his mouth; / his two arms were made the rājanya;

sanskrit_iast: ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ | padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata | candramā manaso jātaḥ | cakṣossūryo ajāyata | mukhādindraścāgniśca | prāṇādvāyurajāyata | nābhyā āsīdantarikṣam | śīrṣṇo dyaussamavartata | padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāt | tathā lokāṃ akalpayann
meaning: ऊरू तदस्य यद्वैश्यः | पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत | चन्द्रमा मनसो जातः | चक्षोस्सूर्यो अजायत | मुखादिन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च | प्राणाद्वायुरजायत | नाभ्या आसीदन्तरिक्षम् | शीर्ष्णो द्यौस्समवर्तत | पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात् | तथा लोकां अकल्पयन्न्
text_mt: his two thighs, that was the vaiśya; / from his two feet the śūdra was born. / The moon was born from his mind; / from his eye Sūrya was born; / from his mouth Indra and Agni; / from his vital breath Vāyu was born. / From his navel the intermediate space arose; / from his head the sky came into being; / from his two feet the earth, the quarters from his ear: / thus they arranged the worlds.

sanskrit_iast: vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam | ādityavarṇaṃ tamasastu pāre | sarvāṇi rūpāṇi vicitya dhīraḥ | nāmāni kṛtvā'bhivadan yadāste | dhātā purastādyamudājahāra | śakraḥ pravidvānpradiśaścatasraḥ | tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati | nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya vidyate | yajñena yajñamayajanta devāḥ | tāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan | te ha nākaṃ mahimānassacante | yatra pūrve sādhyāssanti devāḥ
meaning: वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्तम् | आदित्यवर्णं तमसस्तु पारे | सर्वाणि रूपाणि विचित्य धीरः | नामानि कृत्वाऽभिवदन् यदास्ते | धाता पुरस्ताद्यमुदाजहार | शक्रः प्रविद्वान्प्रदिशश्चतस्रः | तमेवं विद्वानमृत इह भवति | नान्यः पन्था अयनाय विद्यते | यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवाः | तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन् | ते ह नाकं महिमानस्सचन्ते | यत्र पूर्वे साध्यास्सन्ति देवाः
text_mt: I know this great Puruṣa, / of the colour of the sun, beyond darkness. / Having fashioned all forms, the wise one / abides, having made their names and speaking them. / Whom Dhātṛ revealed in the beginning, / and Śakra, knowing well the four quarters: / knowing him thus, one becomes immortal here; / there is no other path for going. / With sacrifice the gods sacrificed to sacrifice; / those were the first dharmas. / Those mighty ones attend upon the firmament, / where the ancient gods, the Sādhyas, dwell. / [The words] pūruṣaḥ, puraḥ, agrataḥ, ajāyata, kṛtaḥ, akalpayan, āsan, and two [times]. 12. / (jyāyān adhi pūruṣaḥ; elsewhere puruṣaḥ.)

sanskrit_iast: adbhyassaṃbhūtaḥ pṛthivyai rasācca | viśvakarmaṇaḥ samavartatādhi | tasya tvaṣṭā vidadhadrūpameti | tatpuruṣasya viśvamājānamagre | vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam | ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt | tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati | nānyaḥ panthā vidyate'yanāya | prajāpatiścarati garbhe antaḥ | ajāyamāno bahudhā vijāyate
meaning: अद्भ्यस्संभूतः पृथिव्यै रसाच्च | विश्वकर्मणः समवर्तताधि | तस्य त्वष्टा विदधद्रूपमेति | तत्पुरुषस्य विश्वमाजानमग्रे | वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्तम् | आदित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् | तमेवं विद्वानमृत इह भवति | नान्यः पन्था विद्यतेऽयनाय | प्रजापतिश्चरति गर्भे अन्तः | अजायमानो बहुधा विजायते
text_mt: Produced from the waters and from the essence of the earth, / he came into being above Viśvakarman. / Tvaṣṭṛ, determining his form, comes [to him]; / that was the manifestation of the Puruṣa in the beginning as all. / I know this great Puruṣa, / of the colour of the sun, beyond darkness. / Knowing him thus, one becomes immortal here; / there is no other path found for going. / Prajāpati moves within the womb; / unborn, he is born in many ways.

sanskrit_iast: tasya dhīrāḥ parijānanti yonim | marīcīnāṃ padamicchanti vedhasaḥ | yo devebhya ātapati | yo devānāṃ purohitaḥ | pūrvo yo devebhyo jātaḥ | namo rucāya brāhmaye | rucaṃ brāhmaṃ janayantaḥ | devā agre tadabruvann | yastvaivaṃ brāhmaṇo vidyāt | tasya devā asanvaśe | hrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyau | ahorātre pārśve | nakṣatrāṇi rūpam | aśvinau vyāttam | iṣṭaṃ maniṣāṇa | amuṃ maniṣāṇa | sarvaṃ maniṣāṇa
meaning: तस्य धीराः परिजानन्ति योनिम् | मरीचीनां पदमिच्छन्ति वेधसः | यो देवेभ्य आतपति | यो देवानां पुरोहितः | पूर्वो यो देवेभ्यो जातः | नमो रुचाय ब्राह्मये | रुचं ब्राह्मं जनयन्तः | देवा अग्रे तदब्रुवन्न् | यस्त्वैवं ब्राह्मणो विद्यात् | तस्य देवा असन्वशे | ह्रीश्च ते लक्ष्मीश्च पत्न्यौ | अहोरात्रे पार्श्वे | नक्षत्राणि रूपम् | अश्विनौ व्यात्तम् | इष्टं मनिषाण | अमुं मनिषाण | सर्वं मनिषाण
text_mt: The wise recognise his womb; / the wise seekers desire the realm of the sunbeams. / He who shines forth for the gods, / who is the domestic priest of the gods, / who was born before the gods— / homage to the radiant [offspring] of brahman! / Generating the light of brahman, / the gods said in the beginning: / 'The brāhmaṇa who shall know you thus, / the gods shall be in his control.' / Hrī and Lakṣmī are your two wives; / day and night your two sides; / the lunar mansions your form; / the two Aśvins your open mouth. / Grant what is desired! / Grant that [world]! / Grant all! / [The words] jāyate, vaśe, and seven.

sanskrit_iast: bhartā sanbhriyamāṇo bibharti | eko devo bahudhā niviṣṭaḥ | yada bhāraṃ tandrayate sa bhartum | nidhāya bhāraṃ punarastameti | tameva mṛtyumamṛtaṃ tamāhuḥ | taṃ bhartāraṃ tamu goptāramāhuḥ | sa bhṛto bhriyamāṇo bibharti | ya enaṃ veda satyena bhartum | sadyo jātamuta jahātyeṣaḥ | uto jarantaṃ na jahātyekam
meaning: भर्ता सन्भ्रियमाणो बिभर्ति | एको देवो बहुधा निविष्टः | यद भारं तन्द्रयते स भर्तुम् | निधाय भारं पुनरस्तमेति | तमेव मृत्युममृतं तमाहुः | तं भर्तारं तमु गोप्तारमाहुः | स भृतो भ्रियमाणो बिभर्ति | य एनं वेद सत्येन भर्तुम् | सद्यो जातमुत जहात्येषः | उतो जरन्तं न जहात्येकम्
text_mt: Being the supporter, being supported, he supports; / the one god entered in many ways. / When he grows weary of supporting the burden, / having laid down the burden, he goes home again. / Him indeed they call death, him immortal; / him the supporter, him indeed the guardian they call. / Supported, being supported, he supports, / he who knows him to be supported by truth. / He abandons the newly born, / and he does not abandon the single one who grows old.

sanskrit_iast: uto bahūnekamaharjahāra | atandro devassadameva prārthaḥ | yastadveda yata ābabhūva | sandhāṃ ca yāṃ saṃdadhe brahmaṇaiṣaḥ | ramate tasminnuta jīrṇe śayāne | nainaṃ jahātyahassu pūrvyeṣu | tvāmāpo anu sarvāścaranti jānatīḥ | vathsaṃ payasā punānāḥ | tvamagniṃ havyavāhaṃ saminthse | tvaṃ bhartā mātariśvā prajānām
meaning: उतो बहूनेकमहर्जहार | अतन्द्रो देवस्सदमेव प्रार्थः | यस्तद्वेद यत आबभूव | सन्धां च यां संदधे ब्रह्मणैषः | रमते तस्मिन्नुत जीर्णे शयाने | नैनं जहात्यहस्सु पूर्व्येषु | त्वामापो अनु सर्वाश्चरन्ति जानतीः | वथ्सं पयसा पुनानाः | त्वमग्निं हव्यवाहं समिन्थ्से | त्वं भर्ता मातरिश्वा प्रजानाम्
text_mt: And in one day he took away many; / untiring is the god, ever on his journey. / He who knows that from which he came into being, / and the compact which he formed with brahman, / he delights in him even when worn out, lying down; / he does not abandon him in the former days. / To you all the waters, knowing, flow, / purifying the calf with milk. / You kindle Agni, bearer of oblations; / you are Mātariśvan, the supporter of creatures.

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ yajñastvamu vevāsi somaḥ | tava devā havamāyanti sarve | tvameko'si bahūnanupraviṣṭaḥ | namaste astu suhavo ma edhi | namo vāmastu śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ me | prāṇāpānāvajiraṃ saṃcarantau | hvayāmi vāṃ brahmaṇā tūrtametam | yo māṃ dveṣṭi taṃ jahitaṃ yuvānā | prāṇāpānau saṃvidānau jahitam | amuṣyāsunā mā saṃgasāthām
meaning: त्वं यज्ञस्त्वमु वेवासि सोमः | तव देवा हवमायन्ति सर्वे | त्वमेकोऽसि बहूननुप्रविष्टः | नमस्ते अस्तु सुहवो म एधि | नमो वामस्तु शृणुतं हवं मे | प्राणापानावजिरं संचरन्तौ | ह्वयामि वां ब्रह्मणा तूर्तमेतम् | यो मां द्वेष्टि तं जहितं युवाना | प्राणापानौ संविदानौ जहितम् | अमुष्यासुना मा संगसाथाम्
text_mt: You are sacrifice, and you indeed are Soma; / all the gods come to your call. / You are the one who has entered into the many; / homage be to you, be easy of invocation for me! / Homage be to you both! Hear my call, / prāṇa and apāna, swiftly moving! / With brahman I call you both, who have arrived quickly; / slay him who hates me, you two youths! / Prāṇa and apāna, being in concord, slay him; / do not unite with that man's life-breath!

sanskrit_iast: taṃ me devā brahmaṇā saṃvidānau | vadhāya dattaṃ tamahaṃ hanāmi | asajjajāna sata ābabhūva | yaṃyaṃ jajāna sa u gopo asya | yadā bhāraṃ tandrayate sa bhartum | parāsya bhāraṃ punarastameti | tadvai tvaṃ prāṇo abhavaḥ | mahānbhogaḥ prajāpateḥ | bhujaḥ kariṣyamāṇaḥ | yaddevānprāṇayo nava
meaning: तं मे देवा ब्रह्मणा संविदानौ | वधाय दत्तं तमहं हनामि | असज्जजान सत आबभूव | यंयं जजान स उ गोपो अस्य | यदा भारं तन्द्रयते स भर्तुम् | परास्य भारं पुनरस्तमेति | तद्वै त्वं प्राणो अभवः | महान्भोगः प्रजापतेः | भुजः करिष्यमाणः | यद्देवान्प्राणयो नव
text_mt: In concord with brahman, O gods, / deliver him to me for slaying; I slay him. / The nonexistent gave birth; he came into being from the existent. / Whomever he generated, he indeed is his guardian. / When he grows weary of supporting the burden, / having cast away the burden, he goes home again. / Truly then you became prāṇa, / the great enjoyment of Prajāpati, / about to grant enjoyment, / when you made the nine gods breathe. / [The words] ekam, prajānām, gasāthām, nine.

sanskrit_iast: hariṃ harantamanuyanti devāḥ | viśvasyeśānaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ matīnām | brahma sarūpamanu medamāgāt | ayanaṃ mā vivadhīrvikramasva | mā chido mṛtyo mā vadhīḥ | mā me balaṃ vivṛho mā pramoṣīḥ | prajāṃ mā me rīriṣa āyurugna | nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā haviṣā vidhema | sadyaścakamānāya | pravepānāya mṛtyave
meaning: हरिं हरन्तमनुयन्ति देवाः | विश्वस्येशानं वृषभं मतीनाम् | ब्रह्म सरूपमनु मेदमागात् | अयनं मा विवधीर्विक्रमस्व | मा छिदो मृत्यो मा वधीः | मा मे बलं विवृहो मा प्रमोषीः | प्रजां मा मे रीरिष आयुरुग्न | नृचक्षसं त्वा हविषा विधेम | सद्यश्चकमानाय | प्रवेपानाय मृत्यवे
text_mt: The gods follow the tawny one as he carries [all] away, / the lord of all, the bull of thoughts. / Brahman of identical form has come to me; / do not strike down my path; stride forth! / Do not cut [me] off, O death; do not slay [me]; / do not uproot my strength; do not rob [me]; / do not injure my offspring, O fierce one, [nor] my lifespan! / May we worship you, who watch over men, with an oblation! / For him who yearns immediately, / for the trembling death—

sanskrit_iast: prāsmā āśā aśṛṇvann | kāmenājanayanpunaḥ | kāmena me kāma āgāt | hṛdayāddhṛdayaṃ mṛtyoḥ | yadamīṣāmadaḥ priyam | tadaitūpa māmabhi | paraṃ mṛtyo anuparehi panthām | yaste sva itaro devayānāt | cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi | mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān | pra pūrvyaṃ manasā vandamānaḥ | nādhamāno vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām | yaḥ prajānāmekarāṇmānuṣīṇām | mṛtyuṃ yaje prathamajāmṛtasya
meaning: प्रास्मा आशा अशृण्वन्न् | कामेनाजनयन्पुनः | कामेन मे काम आगात् | हृदयाद्धृदयं मृत्योः | यदमीषामदः प्रियम् | तदैतूप मामभि | परं मृत्यो अनुपरेहि पन्थाम् | यस्ते स्व इतरो देवयानात् | चक्षुष्मते शृण्वते ते ब्रवीमि | मा नः प्रजां रीरिषो मोत वीरान् | प्र पूर्व्यं मनसा वन्दमानः | नाधमानो वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् | यः प्रजानामेकराण्मानुषीणाम् | मृत्युं यजे प्रथमजामृतस्य
text_mt: The quarters listened to him; / with desire they generated [him] again. / With desire my desire has come / from the heart to the heart of death. / What is dear to these [gods] over there, / let that come over to me! / Follow the further path, O death, / which is your own, other than the path of the gods. / I speak to you who have eyes, who have ears: / do not injure our offspring, nor our heroes! / Praising the ancient one with my mind, / supplicating the bull of the peoples, / who is the sole king of human creatures, / I sacrifice to death, the firstborn of the cosmic order. / [The words] mṛtyave, vīrān, and four.

sanskrit_iast: taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya | viśvamābhāsi rocanam | upayāmagṛhīto'si sūryāya tvā bhrājasvata eṣa te yonissūryāya tvā bhrājasvate
meaning: तरणिर्विश्वदर्शतो ज्योतिष्कृदसि सूर्य | विश्वमाभासि रोचनम् | उपयामगृहीतोऽसि सूर्याय त्वा भ्राजस्वत एष ते योनिस्सूर्याय त्वा भ्राजस्वते
text_mt: Swift, visible to all, a maker of light are you, O Sūrya; / you illumine the entire bright realm. / You are taken with a support; for radiant Sūrya [I take] you; this is your womb; for radiant Sūrya [I offer] you.

sanskrit_iast: āpyāyasva madintama soma viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | bhavā nassaprathastamaḥ

text_mt: Swell up, most exhilarating Soma, with all aids; / be for us most spacious.

text_mt: Those mortals have gone who saw the earlier dawn shining forth; / and now she has become visible to us, and those go who shall see her in future [dawns].

text_mt:
[I gratify] thought with the pericardium, Bhava with the liver, Rudra with the pericardium's thin tissue, Paśupati with the thick heart, Agni with the heart, Rudra with the blood, Śarva with the two kidneys, Mahādeva with the inner flank, Auṣiṣṭhahana with the two bile ducts.
Mind, earth, Agni; Sūrya thy eye; the Great Oblation, the hotṛ, speech the hotṛ, the brāhmaṇa, the single hotṛ, Agni through the Yajus formulas, the army, of Indra, of the god, golden, the gharma, the thousand-headed, from the waters, the bearer, the bay, the crossing one, swell, these have departed, those, bright, for effort, thought: twenty-one.
Mind, Agni through the Yajus formulas, entered within, Prajāpati in agreement with offspring, his wise ones, bright: fifty-three.
Mind; with the two bile ducts.

text_mt:
Homage! May they approve / Oṃ, peace, peace, peace.

The wise harness the mind and harness the insights / the inspired priests of the inspired, great, wise one / He alone, knowing the ordinances, arranges the invocations / Great is the praise of the god Savitṛ / At the impulse of the god Savitṛ / with the arms of the Aśvins / with the hands of Pūṣan, I take thee / A spade art thou, a woman art thou / preparing the rite for the gods / Rise up, O Brahmaṇaspati

sanskrit_iast: devayantastvemahe | upaprayantu marutaḥ sudānavaḥ | indra prāśūrbhavā sacā | praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ | pra devyetu sūnṛtā | acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasam | devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ | devī dyāvāpṛthivī anu me'maṃsāthām | ṛddhyāsamadya | makhasya śiraḥ

text_mt: Seeking the gods, we approach thee / May the Maruts, of good gifts, come forward / O Indra, be swift in companionship / May Brahmaṇaspati go forth / May the divine Bounty go forth / towards the manly hero who brings gifts in fivefold rows / May the gods lead our sacrifice / O divine Sky and Earth, give your approval to me / May I succeed today / in [making] the head of Makha

text_mt:
Ye two are the footsteps of the sacrifice / I make thee with the gāyatrī metre / I make thee with the triṣṭubh metre / I make thee with the jagatī metre / Thou art Makha's girdle / May Aditi grasp thy opening / with the paṅkti metre / Cook with the heat of Sūrya / Makha art thou
Lord, head, observers of Ṛta, may I succeed today, Makha's head, head, head art thou, and nine. [Anuvāka] 2. So much, divine, Indra's strength art thou, born of Agni art thou, bestow lifespan, prāṇa, five.

text_mt: Thou art the excrement of the vigorous horse / May Varuṇa, firm in his vow, fumigate thee / with the stable ordinance of Mitra and Varuṇa / Thee for the flame / Thee for the blaze / Thee for the light / Thee for ascetic heat / Mitra, widely extended, surpassed this sky / in greatness / and the earth in fame

text_mt: The fame of Mitra, upholder of men / the divine, won of old / brilliant, most richly renowned / Thee for success / May the god Savitṛ dig thee out / fair of hands, fair of fingers / fair of arms, and with his might / Not falling down upon the earth / fill the quarters and intermediate directions / Stand up, become great
