meaning: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठ ध्रुवस्त्वम् | सूर्यस्य त्वा चक्षुषाऽन्वीक्षे | ऋजवे त्वा | साधवे त्वा | सुक्षित्यै त्वा भूत्यै त्वा | इदमहममुमामुष्यायणं विशा पशुभिर्ब्रह्मवर्चसेन पर्यूहामि | गायत्रेण त्वा छन्दसा'ऽच्छृणद्मि | त्रैष्टुभेन त्वा छन्दसा'ऽच्छृणद्मि | जागतेन त्वा छन्दसा'ऽच्छृणद्मि | छृणत्तु त्वा वाक् | छृणत्तु त्वोर्क् | छृणत्तु त्वा हविः | छृन्धि वाचम् | छृन्ध्यूर्जम् | छृन्धि हविः | देव पुरश्चर सघ्यासं त्वा
text_mt:
Stand upright, firm art thou / I gaze upon thee with Sūrya's eye / Thee for the straight / Thee for the good / Thee for secure dwelling, thee for prosperity / Here do I surround this one, son of such-a-one, with the people, with cattle, with the splendour of brahman / With the gāyatrī metre I pierce thee / With the triṣṭubh metre I pierce thee / With the jagatī metre I pierce thee / May speech pierce thee / May vigour pierce thee / May the oblation pierce thee / Pierce speech / Pierce vigour / Pierce the oblation / O god, going in front, may I be able to bear thee
Earth, become, speech, and six.

sanskrit_iast: brahmanpravargyeṇa pracariṣyāmaḥ | hotargharmamabhiṣṭuhi | agnīdrauhiṇau puroḍāśāvadhiśraya | pratiprasthātarvihara | prastotassāmāni gāya | yajuryuktaṃ sāmabhirāktakhaṃ tvā | viśvairdevairanumataṃ marudbhiḥ | dakṣiṇābhiḥ pratataṃ pārayiṣṇum | stubho vahantu sumanasyamānam | sa no rucaṃ dhehyahṛṇīyamānaḥ | bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | omindravantaḥ pracarata
meaning: ब्रह्मन्प्रवर्ग्येण प्रचरिष्यामः | होतर्घर्ममभिष्टुहि | अग्नीद्रौहिणौ पुरोडाशावधिश्रय | प्रतिप्रस्थातर्विहर | प्रस्तोतस्सामानि गाय | यजुर्युक्तं सामभिराक्तखं त्वा | विश्वैर्देवैरनुमतं मरुद्भिः | दक्षिणाभिः प्रततं पारयिष्णुम् | स्तुभो वहन्तु सुमनस्यमानम् | स नो रुचं धेह्यहृणीयमानः | भूर्भुवस्सुवः | ओमिन्द्रवन्तः प्रचरत
text_mt:
O brahman, we shall proceed with the pravargya / O hotṛ, praise the gharma / O agnīdh, set the two rauhiṇa sacrificial cakes on the fire / O pratiprasthātṛ, distribute [the fires] / O prastotṛ, sing the sāmans / Thee, yoked with the Yajus, anointed with sāmans across the cavity / assented to by all the gods, by the Maruts / extended with priestly fees, capable of saving / may the praises carry thee, as thou art well-disposed / Do thou, without resentment, grant us radiance / Bhūr, bhuvaḥ, suvaḥ / Oṃ, proceed, accompanied by Indra
Without resentment, and two.

sanskrit_iast: brahmanpracariṣyāmaḥ | hotargharmamabhiṣṭuhi | yamāya tvā makhāya tvā | sūryasya harase tvā | prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā'pānāya svāhā | cakṣuṣe svāhā śrotrāya svāhā | manase svāhā vāce sarasvatyai svāhā | dakṣāya svāhā kratave svāhā | ojase svāhā balāya svāhā | devastvā savitā madhvā'naktu
meaning: ब्रह्मन्प्रचरिष्यामः | होतर्घर्ममभिष्टुहि | यमाय त्वा मखाय त्वा | सूर्यस्य हरसे त्वा | प्राणाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहाऽपानाय स्वाहा | चक्षुषे स्वाहा श्रोत्राय स्वाहा | मनसे स्वाहा वाचे सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा | दक्षाय स्वाहा क्रतवे स्वाहा | ओजसे स्वाहा बलाय स्वाहा | देवस्त्वा सविता मध्वाऽनक्तु
text_mt: "O brahman priest, we shall proceed. O hotṛ priest, recite in praise of the gharma." / To Yama, to Makha! To the glowing heat of Sūrya! / To prāṇa svāhā! To vyāna svāhā! To apāna svāhā! / To the eye svāhā! To the ear svāhā! / To the mind svāhā! To speech, to Sarasvatī svāhā! / To ability svāhā! To intention svāhā! / To power svāhā! To strength svāhā! / May the god Savitṛ anoint you with sweetness!

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivīṃ tapasastrāyasva | arcirasi śocirasi jyotirasi taposi | saṃ sīdasva mahāṃ asi | śocasva devavītamaḥ | vidhūmamagne aruṣaṃ miyedhya | sṛja praśasta darśatam | añjanti yaṃ prathayanto na viprāḥ | vapāvantaṃ nāgninā tapantaḥ | piturna putra upasi preṣṭhaḥ | ā gharmo agnimṛtayannasādīt
meaning: पृथिवीं तपसस्त्रायस्व | अर्चिरसि शोचिरसि ज्योतिरसि तपोसि | सं सीदस्व महां असि | शोचस्व देववीतमः | विधूममग्ने अरुषं मियेध्य | सृज प्रशस्त दर्शतम् | अञ्जन्ति यं प्रथयन्तो न विप्राः | वपावन्तं नाग्निना तपन्तः | पितुर्न पुत्र उपसि प्रेष्ठः | आ घर्मो अग्निमृतयन्नसादीत्
text_mt: Protect the earth from ascetic heat! / You are the flame, you are the blaze, you are the light, you are the heat. / Sit down, you are great; shine brightly, most eager for the gods. / O Agni worthy of the sacrificial feast, release the smoke-free, radiant [steam], splendid, lovely to behold. / Whom wise men anoint as if stretching [a cloth], heating with fire like a fatty [offering]— / dearest, like a son in his father's lap, the gharma has sat down, making for the fire [its] path of order.

sanskrit_iast: anādhṛṣyā purastāt | agnerādhipatye | āyurme dāḥ | putravatī dakṣiṇataḥ | indrasyādhipatye | prajāṃ me dāḥ | suṣadā paścāt | devasya saviturādhipatye | prāṇaṃ me dāḥ | āśrutiruttarataḥ
meaning: अनाधृष्या पुरस्तात् | अग्नेराधिपत्ये | आयुर्मे दाः | पुत्रवती दक्षिणतः | इन्द्रस्याधिपत्ये | प्रजां मे दाः | सुषदा पश्चात् | देवस्य सवितुराधिपत्ये | प्राणं मे दाः | आश्रुतिरुत्तरतः
text_mt: Unassailable in the east, under the overlordship of Agni; grant me lifespan! / Possessed of sons in the south, under the overlordship of Indra; grant me offspring! / Easy to sit upon in the west, under the overlordship of the god Savitṛ; grant me vital breath! / Renowned in the north,

sanskrit_iast: mitrāvaruṇayorādhipatye | śrotraṃ me dāḥ | vidhṛtirupariṣṭāt | bṛhaspaterādhipatye | brahma me dāḥ kṣattraṃ me dāḥ | tejo me dhā varco me dhāḥ | yaśo me dhāstapo me dhāḥ | mano me dhāḥ | manoraśvā'si bhūriputrā | viśvābhyo mā nāṣṭrābhyaḥ pāhi
meaning: मित्रावरुणयोराधिपत्ये | श्रोत्रं मे दाः | विधृतिरुपरिष्टात् | बृहस्पतेराधिपत्ये | ब्रह्म मे दाः क्षत्त्रं मे दाः | तेजो मे धा वर्चो मे धाः | यशो मे धास्तपो मे धाः | मनो मे धाः | मनोरश्वाऽसि भूरिपुत्रा | विश्वाभ्यो मा नाष्ट्राभ्यः पाहि
text_mt: under the overlordship of Mitra and Varuṇa; grant me hearing! / Support from above, under the overlordship of Bṛhaspati; grant me brahman, grant me temporal power! / Bestow brilliance upon me, bestow spiritual lustre upon me! / Bestow fame upon me, bestow ascetic heat upon me! Bestow mind upon me! / You are Manu's mare, mother of many sons; / protect me from all destructions!

sanskrit_iast: sūpasadā me bhūyā mā mā hiṃsīḥ | tapo ṣvagne antarāṃ amitrān | tapā śaṃsamararuṣaḥ parasya | tapā vaso cikitāno acittān | vi te tiṣṭhantāmajarā ayāsaḥ | citasstha paricitaḥ | svāhā marudbhiḥ pariśrayasva | mā asi | pramā asi | pratimā asi
meaning: सूपसदा मे भूया मा मा हिंसीः | तपो ष्वग्ने अन्तरां अमित्रान् | तपा शंसमररुषः परस्य | तपा वसो चिकितानो अचित्तान् | वि ते तिष्ठन्तामजरा अयासः | चितस्स्थ परिचितः | स्वाहा मरुद्भिः परिश्रयस्व | मा असि | प्रमा असि | प्रतिमा असि
text_mt: Be easy of approach to me; do not harm me! / Burn well, O Agni, the enemies within; / burn the curse of the hostile outsider; / burn, O Vasu, knowing, the ignorant ones! / May your ageless, untiring [flames] spread apart! / You are piled; you are enclosed. Svāhā! / Enclose yourself with the Maruts! / You are the measure; you are the fore-measure; you are the counter-measure;

sanskrit_iast: saṃmā asi | vimā asi | unmā asi | antarikṣasyāntardhirasi | divaṃ tapasastrāyasva | ābhirgīrbhiryadato na ūnam | āpyāyaya harivo vardhamānaḥ | yadā stotṛbhyo mahi gotrā rujāsi | bhūyiṣṭhabhājo adha te syāma | śukraṃ te anyadyajataṃ te anyat
meaning: संमा असि | विमा असि | उन्मा असि | अन्तरिक्षस्यान्तर्धिरसि | दिवं तपसस्त्रायस्व | आभिर्गीर्भिर्यदतो न ऊनम् | आप्यायय हरिवो वर्धमानः | यदा स्तोतृभ्यो महि गोत्रा रुजासि | भूयिष्ठभाजो अध ते स्याम | शुक्रं ते अन्यद्यजतं ते अन्यत्
text_mt: you are the gathering measure; you are the wide measure; you are the up-measure. / You are the concealment of the intermediate space; protect the sky from ascetic heat! / With these songs, that which of ours is deficient, / make swell, O lord of bay horses, waxing great! / When for the praisers you break open the great cow-pens, / then may we be the ones with the largest share! / One is your bright form, another is your sacrificial form;

sanskrit_iast: viṣurūpe ahanī dyaurivāsi | viśvā hi māyā avasi svadhāvaḥ | bhadrā te pūṣanniha rātirastu | arhanbibharṣi sāyakāni dhanva | arhanniṣkaṃ yajataṃ viśvarūpam | arhannidaṃ dayase viśvamabbhuvam | na vā ojīyo rudra tvadasti | gāyatramasi | traiṣṭubhamasi | jāgatamasi | madhu madhu madhu
meaning: विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिवासि | विश्वा हि माया अवसि स्वधावः | भद्रा ते पूषन्निह रातिरस्तु | अर्हन्बिभर्षि सायकानि धन्व | अर्हन्निष्कं यजतं विश्वरूपम् | अर्हन्निदं दयसे विश्वमब्भुवम् | न वा ओजीयो रुद्र त्वदस्ति | गायत्रमसि | त्रैष्टुभमसि | जागतमसि | मधु मधु मधु
text_mt: having diverse forms, you are like heaven with day [and night]. / For you protect all wondrous powers, O self-ruling one! / May your bounty here be auspicious, O Pūṣan! / Worthily you bear the arrows and bow; / worthily [you wear] the golden necklace, sacrificial, of all forms; / worthily you distribute all this wide world; / for there is nothing more powerful than you, O Rudra! / You are the gāyatrī; you are the triṣṭubh; you are the jagatī. / Honey, honey, honey!

sanskrit_iast: daśa prācīrdaśa bhāsi dakṣiṇā | daśa pratīcīrdaśa bhāsyudīcīḥ | daśordhvā bhāsi sumanasyamānaḥ | sa no rucaṃ dhehyahṛṇīyamānaḥ | agniṣṭvā vasubhiḥ purastādrocayatu gāyatreṇa chandasā | sa mā rucito rocaya | indrastvā rudrairdakṣiṇato rocayatu traiṣṭubhena chandasā | sa mā rucito rocaya | varuṇastvādityaiḥ paścādrocayatu jāgatena chandasā | sa mā rucito rocaya
meaning: दश प्राचीर्दश भासि दक्षिणा | दश प्रतीचीर्दश भास्युदीचीः | दशोर्ध्वा भासि सुमनस्यमानः | स नो रुचं धेह्यहृणीयमानः | अग्निष्ट्वा वसुभिः पुरस्ताद्रोचयतु गायत्रेण छन्दसा | स मा रुचितो रोचय | इन्द्रस्त्वा रुद्रैर्दक्षिणतो रोचयतु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा | स मा रुचितो रोचय | वरुणस्त्वादित्यैः पश्चाद्रोचयतु जागतेन छन्दसा | स मा रुचितो रोचय
text_mt: Ten [rays] eastwards, ten you shine southwards; / ten westwards, ten you shine northwards; / ten upwards you shine, being gracious; / as such, grant us splendour, not bearing wrath! / May Agni with the Vasus make you shine from the east with the gāyatrī metre! Shining, make me shine! / May Indra with the Rudras make you shine from the south with the triṣṭubh metre! Shining, make me shine! / May Varuṇa with the Ādityas make you shine from the west with the jagatī metre! Shining, make me shine!

sanskrit_iast: dyutānastvā māruto marudbhiruttarato rocayatvānuṣṭubhena chandasā | sa mā rucito rocaya | bṛhaspatistvā viśvairdevairupariṣṭādrocayatu pāṅktena chandasā | sa mā rucito rocaya | rocitastvaṃ deva gharma deveṣvasi | rociṣīyāhaṃ manuṣyeṣu | samrāḍgharma rucitastvaṃ deveṣvāyuṣmāṃstejasvī brahmavarcasyasi | rucito'haṃ manuṣyeṣvāyuṣmāṃstejasvī brahmavarcasī bhūyāsam | rugasi | rucaṃ mayi dhehi
meaning: द्युतानस्त्वा मारुतो मरुद्भिरुत्तरतो रोचयत्वानुष्टुभेन छन्दसा | स मा रुचितो रोचय | बृहस्पतिस्त्वा विश्वैर्देवैरुपरिष्टाद्रोचयतु पाङ्क्तेन छन्दसा | स मा रुचितो रोचय | रोचितस्त्वं देव घर्म देवेष्वसि | रोचिषीयाहं मनुष्येषु | सम्राड्घर्म रुचितस्त्वं देवेष्वायुष्मांस्तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चस्यसि | रुचितोऽहं मनुष्येष्वायुष्मांस्तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी भूयासम् | रुगसि | रुचं मयि धेहि
text_mt: May Dyutāna Māruta with the Maruts make you shine from the north with the anuṣṭubh metre! / Shining, make me shine! / May Bṛhaspati with all the gods make you shine from above with the paṅkti metre! / Shining, make me shine! / Made to shine, O god gharma, you are among the gods; / may I shine among mortals! / O sovereign gharma, shining among the gods, you are possessed of lifespan, brilliant, endowed with spiritual lustre; / made to shine among mortals, may I become possessed of lifespan, brilliant, endowed with spiritual lustre! / You are light; place light in me!

sanskrit_iast: mayi ruk | daśa purastādrocase | daśa dakṣiṇā | daśa pratyaṅ | daśodaṅṅ | daśordhvo bhāsi sumanasyamānaḥ | sa naḥ samrāḍiṣamūrjaṃ dhehi | vājī vājine pavasva | rocito gharmo rucīya
meaning: मयि रुक् | दश पुरस्ताद्रोचसे | दश दक्षिणा | दश प्रत्यङ् | दशोदङ्ङ् | दशोर्ध्वो भासि सुमनस्यमानः | स नः सम्राडिषमूर्जं धेहि | वाजी वाजिने पवस्व | रोचितो घर्मो रुचीय
text_mt: In me is light! / Ten [rays] you shine eastwards; ten southwards; ten westwards; / ten northwards; ten upwards you shine, being gracious. / As such, O sovereign, grant us food and sap! / O runner, flow for the runner! / The gharma has been made to shine; may I shine!

sanskrit_iast: apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānam | ā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam | sa saddhrīcīssa viṣūcīrvasānaḥ | āvarīvarti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ | atra prāvīḥ | madhumādhvībhyāṃ madhumādhūcībhyām | anu vāṃ devavītaye | samagniragninā gata | saṃ devena savitrā | saṃ sūryeṇa rocate
meaning: अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानम् | आ च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम् | स सद्ध्रीचीस्स विषूचीर्वसानः | आवरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः | अत्र प्रावीः | मधुमाध्वीभ्यां मधुमाधूचीभ्याम् | अनु वां देववीतये | समग्निरग्निना गत | सं देवेन सवित्रा | सं सूर्येण रोचते
text_mt: I saw the herdsman who never tires, / moving to and fro along the paths; / clothing himself in those [regions] converging and diverging, / he rolls continually within the worlds. / You have protected here; / with sweet honey-streams, sweet and flowing with honey, / [we come] after you both for the feast of the gods. / Agni has united with Agni; / with the god Savitṛ; / he shines together with Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā samagnistapasā gata | saṃ devena savitrā | saṃ sūryeṇārociṣṭa | dhartā divo vibhāsi rajasaḥ | pṛthivyā dhartā | urorantarikṣasya dhartā | dhartā devo devānām | amartyastapojāḥ | hṛde tvā manase tvā | dive tvā sūryāya tvā
meaning: स्वाहा समग्निस्तपसा गत | सं देवेन सवित्रा | सं सूर्येणारोचिष्ट | धर्ता दिवो विभासि रजसः | पृथिव्या धर्ता | उरोरन्तरिक्षस्य धर्ता | धर्ता देवो देवानाम् | अमर्त्यस्तपोजाः | हृदे त्वा मनसे त्वा | दिवे त्वा सूर्याय त्वा
text_mt: Svāhā! Agni has united with ascetic heat; / with the god Savitṛ; / he has shone together with Sūrya. / Supporter of the sky, you shine over the realm of space; / supporter of the earth; supporter of the broad intermediate space; / supporter, god of the gods; / immortal, born of ascetic heat! / For the heart, to you! For the mind, to you! / For the sky, to you! For Sūrya, to you!

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvamimamadhvaraṃ kṛdhi | divi deveṣu hotrā yaccha | viśvāsāṃ bhuvāṃ pate | viśvasya bhuvanaspate | viśvasya manasaspate | viśvasya vacasaspate | viśvasya tapasaspate | viśvasya brahmaṇaspate | devaśrūstvaṃ deva gharma devānpāhi | tapojāṃ vācamasme niyaccha devāyuvam
meaning: ऊर्ध्वमिममध्वरं कृधि | दिवि देवेषु होत्रा यच्छ | विश्वासां भुवां पते | विश्वस्य भुवनस्पते | विश्वस्य मनसस्पते | विश्वस्य वचसस्पते | विश्वस्य तपसस्पते | विश्वस्य ब्रह्मणस्पते | देवश्रूस्त्वं देव घर्म देवान्पाहि | तपोजां वाचमस्मे नियच्छ देवायुवम्
text_mt: Make this sacrificial rite upright! / Offer the oblations in the sky among the gods, / O lord of all beings, / O lord of the whole world, / O lord of all mind, / O lord of all speech, / O lord of all ascetic heat, / O lord of all sacred lore! / Heard by the gods, O god gharma, protect the gods! / Direct to us god-seeking speech born of ascetic heat!

sanskrit_iast: garbho devānām | pitā matīnām | patiḥ prajānām | matiḥ kavīnām | saṃ devo devena savitrā'yatiṣṭa | saṃ sūryeṇārukta | āyurdāstvamasmabhyaṃ gharma varcodā asi | pitā no'si pitā no bodha | āyurdhāstanūdhāḥ payodhāḥ | varcodā varivodā draviṇodāḥ
meaning: गर्भो देवानाम् | पिता मतीनाम् | पतिः प्रजानाम् | मतिः कवीनाम् | सं देवो देवेन सवित्राऽयतिष्ट | सं सूर्येणारुक्त | आयुर्दास्त्वमस्मभ्यं घर्म वर्चोदा असि | पिता नोऽसि पिता नो बोध | आयुर्धास्तनूधाः पयोधाः | वर्चोदा वरिवोदा द्रविणोदाः
text_mt: Embryo of the gods, / father of thoughts, / lord of offspring, / wisdom of poets! / The god has aligned himself with the god Savitṛ; / he has shone together with Sūrya. / Lifespan-giver to us are you, O gharma; you are the lustre-giver. / You are our father; take notice of us as a father! / Bestower of lifespan, bestower of bodily vigour, bestower of milk, / bestower of lustre, bestower of wide room, bestower of wealth!

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣapra urorvarīyān | aśīmahi tvā mā mā hiṃsīḥ | tvamagne gṛhapatirviśāmasi | viśvāsāṃ mānuṣīṇām | śataṃ pūrbhiryaviṣṭha pāhyaṃhasaḥ | sameddhāraṃ śataṃ himāḥ | tandrāviṇaṃ hārdivānam | ihaiva rātayassantu | tvaṣṭīmatī te sapeya | suretā reto dadhānā | vīraṃ videya tava saṃdṛśi | mā'haṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa viyoṣam
meaning: अन्तरिक्षप्र उरोर्वरीयान् | अशीमहि त्वा मा मा हिंसीः | त्वमग्ने गृहपतिर्विशामसि | विश्वासां मानुषीणाम् | शतं पूर्भिर्यविष्ठ पाह्यंहसः | समेद्धारं शतं हिमाः | तन्द्राविणं हार्दिवानम् | इहैव रातयस्सन्तु | त्वष्टीमती ते सपेय | सुरेता रेतो दधाना | वीरं विदेय तव संदृशि | माऽहं रायस्पोषेण वियोषम्
text_mt: Filling the intermediate space, wider than the wide! / May we attain you; do not harm me! / You, O Agni, are the lord of the house of the clans, / of all human clans; / with a hundred fortresses, O youngest one, protect from distress / the kindler [of your fire] for a hundred winters! / Calming restlessness, delighting the heart; / right here let the gifts remain! / Possessing craftsmanship, may I serve you, / rich in seed, establishing the seed; / may I find a heroic son in your sight; / may I not be separated from the increase of wealth!

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave | aśvinorbāhubhyām | pūṣṇo hastābhyāmādade | adityai rāsnā'si | iḍa ehi | adita ehi | sarasvatyehi | asāvehi | asāvehi | asāvehi
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे | अश्विनोर्बाहुभ्याम् | पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यामाददे | अदित्यै रास्नाऽसि | इड एहि | अदित एहि | सरस्वत्येहि | असावेहि | असावेहि | असावेहि
text_mt: At the impulse of god Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I take you. / You are the girdle of Aditi. / Come, O Iḍā! Come, O Aditi! / Come, O Sarasvatī! Come, O so-and-so! Come, O so-and-so! Come, O so-and-so!

sanskrit_iast: adityā uṣṇīṣamasi | vāyurasyaiḍaḥ | pūṣā tvopāvasṛjatu | aśvibhyāṃ pradāpaya | yaste stanaḥ śaśayo yo mayobhūḥ | yena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi | yo ratnadhā vasuvidyaḥ sudatraḥ | sarasvati tamiha dhātave'kaḥ | usra gharmaṃ śiṃṣa | usra gharmaṃ pāhi
meaning: अदित्या उष्णीषमसि | वायुरस्यैडः | पूषा त्वोपावसृजतु | अश्विभ्यां प्रदापय | यस्ते स्तनः शशयो यो मयोभूः | येन विश्वा पुष्यसि वार्याणि | यो रत्नधा वसुविद्यः सुदत्रः | सरस्वति तमिह धातवेऽकः | उस्र घर्मं शिंष | उस्र घर्मं पाहि
text_mt: You are the headcloth of Aditi. / You are Vāyu, offspring of Iḍā. / May Pūṣan let you go forward. / Make [her] give milk for the Aśvins. / That breast of yours which is inexhaustible, which brings delight, / by which you nourish all desirable things, / which bestows treasures, finds wealth, and gives liberally— / O Sarasvatī, make that available here to be suckled! / O bright cow, provide milk for the gharma! O bright cow, protect the gharma!

sanskrit_iast: gharmāya śiṃṣa | bṛhaspatistvopasīdatu | dānavasstha peravaḥ | viṣvagvṛto lohitena | aśvibhyāṃ pinvasva | sarasvatyai pinvasva | pūṣṇe pinvasva | bṛhaspataye pinvasva | indrāya pinvasva | indrāya pinvasva
meaning: घर्माय शिंष | बृहस्पतिस्त्वोपसीदतु | दानवस्स्थ पेरवः | विष्वग्वृतो लोहितेन | अश्विभ्यां पिन्वस्व | सरस्वत्यै पिन्वस्व | पूष्णे पिन्वस्व | बृहस्पतये पिन्वस्व | इन्द्राय पिन्वस्व | इन्द्राय पिन्वस्व
text_mt: Provide milk for the gharma! / May Bṛhaspati sit down beside you. / You are generous, swelling [with milk], / enclosed all around with red. / Swell for the Aśvins! Swell for Sarasvatī! Swell for Pūṣan! Swell for Bṛhaspati! Swell for Indra! Swell for Indra!

sanskrit_iast: gāyatro'si | traiṣṭubho'si | jāgatamasi | sahorjo bhāgenopa mehi | indrāśvinā madhunassāraghasya | gharmaṃ pāta vasavo yajatā vaṭ | svāhā tvā sūryasya raśmaye vṛṣṭivanaye juhomi | madhu havirasi | sūryasya tapastapa | dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ tvā parigṛhṇāmi
meaning: गायत्रोऽसि | त्रैष्टुभोऽसि | जागतमसि | सहोर्जो भागेनोप मेहि | इन्द्राश्विना मधुनस्सारघस्य | घर्मं पात वसवो यजता वट् | स्वाहा त्वा सूर्यस्य रश्मये वृष्टिवनये जुहोमि | मधु हविरसि | सूर्यस्य तपस्तप | द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां त्वा परिगृह्णामि
text_mt: You belong to the gāyatrī. You belong to the triṣṭubh. You belong to the jagatī. / Come to me with the share of strength and vigour! / O Indra and Aśvins, drink the gharma / of bee-gathered honey, O Vasus worthy of worship, vaṭ! / Svāhā! I offer you to the ray of Sūrya, the winner of rain. / You are a sweet oblation. / Glow with the heat of Sūrya! / I encompass you with heaven and earth.

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣeṇa tvopayacchāmi | devānāṃ tvā pitṛṇāmanumato bhartuṃ śakeyam | tejo'si | tejo'nuprehi | divispṛṅmā mā hiṃsīḥ | antarikṣaspṛṅmā mā hiṃsīḥ | pṛthivispṛṅmā mā hiṃsīḥ | suvarasi suvarme yaccha | divaṃ yaccha divo mā pāhi
meaning: अन्तरिक्षेण त्वोपयच्छामि | देवानां त्वा पितृणामनुमतो भर्तुं शकेयम् | तेजोऽसि | तेजोऽनुप्रेहि | दिविस्पृङ्मा मा हिंसीः | अन्तरिक्षस्पृङ्मा मा हिंसीः | पृथिविस्पृङ्मा मा हिंसीः | सुवरसि सुवर्मे यच्छ | दिवं यच्छ दिवो मा पाहि
text_mt: I support you with the intermediate space. / With the approval of the gods and the fathers, may I be able to bear you. / You are splendour; follow splendour! / Touching the sky, do not harm me! Touching the intermediate space, do not harm me! Touching the earth, do not harm me! / You are heaven; grant me heaven! / Grant the sky; protect me from the sky! / come, protect, swell, I take, and nine.

sanskrit_iast: samudrāya tvā vātāya svāhā | salilāya tvā vātāya svāhā | anādhṛṣyāya tvā vātāya svāhā | apratidhṛṣyāya tvā vātāya svāhā | avasyave tvā vātāya svāhā | duvasvate tvā vātāya svāhā | śimidvate tvā vātāya svāhā | agnaye tvā vasumate svāhā | somāya tvā rudravate svāhā | varuṇāya tvā''dityavate svāhā
meaning: समुद्राय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा | सलिलाय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा | अनाधृष्याय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा | अप्रतिधृष्याय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा | अवस्यवे त्वा वाताय स्वाहा | दुवस्वते त्वा वाताय स्वाहा | शिमिद्वते त्वा वाताय स्वाहा | अग्नये त्वा वसुमते स्वाहा | सोमाय त्वा रुद्रवते स्वाहा | वरुणाय त्वा'ऽदित्यवते स्वाहा
text_mt: Svāhā to you, wind of the ocean! Svāhā to you, wind of the surge! / Svāhā to you, unassailable wind! Svāhā to you, irresistible wind! / Svāhā to you, wind that seeks aid! Svāhā to you, wind that receives worship! / Svāhā to you, violent wind! / Svāhā to you, Agni accompanied by the Vasus! / Svāhā to you, Soma accompanied by the Rudras! / Svāhā to you, Varuṇa accompanied by the Ādityas!

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspataye tvā viśvadevyāvate svāhā | savitre tvarbhumate vibhumate prabhumate vājavate svāhā | yamāya tvā'ṃgirasvate pitṛmate svāhā | viśvā āśā dakṣiṇasat | viśvāndevānayāḍiha | svāhākṛtasya gharmasya | madhoḥ pibatamaśvinā | svāhā'gnaye yajñiyāya | śaṃ yajurbhiḥ | aśvinā gharmaṃ pātaṃ hārdivānam
meaning: बृहस्पतये त्वा विश्वदेव्यावते स्वाहा | सवित्रे त्वर्भुमते विभुमते प्रभुमते वाजवते स्वाहा | यमाय त्वाऽंगिरस्वते पितृमते स्वाहा | विश्वा आशा दक्षिणसत् | विश्वान्देवानयाडिह | स्वाहाकृतस्य घर्मस्य | मधोः पिबतमश्विना | स्वाहाऽग्नये यज्ञियाय | शं यजुर्भिः | अश्विना घर्मं पातं हार्दिवानम्
text_mt: To Bṛhaspati accompanied by all the gods, svāhā! / To Savitṛ accompanied by the Ṛbhus, the Vibhus, the Prabhus, rich in prizes, svāhā! / To Yama accompanied by the Aṅgirases, accompanied by the fathers, svāhā! / Sitting in the south towards all quarters; / he has sacrificed here to all the gods. / Of the gharma consecrated with svāhā, / drink the sweetness, O Aśvins! / Svāhā to Agni worthy of the sacrifice! / Peace through the yajus mantras! / O Aśvins, drink the gharma that delights the heart!

sanskrit_iast: ahardivābhirūtibhiḥ | anu vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī maṃsātām | svāhendrāya | svāhendrā vaṭ | gharmamapātamaśvinā hārdivānam | ahardivābhirūtibhiḥ | anu vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī amaṃsātām | taṃ prāvyaṃ yathā vaṭ | namo dive | namaḥ pṛthivyai
meaning: अहर्दिवाभिरूतिभिः | अनु वां द्यावापृथिवी मंसाताम् | स्वाहेन्द्राय | स्वाहेन्द्रा वट् | घर्ममपातमश्विना हार्दिवानम् | अहर्दिवाभिरूतिभिः | अनु वां द्यावापृथिवी अमंसाताम् | तं प्राव्यं यथा वट् | नमो दिवे | नमः पृथिव्यै
text_mt: With day-by-day protections / may Heaven and Earth approve of you two! / Svāhā to Indra! / Svāhā to Indra, vaṭ! / You have drunk the gharma, O Aśvins, refreshing the heart, / with day-by-day protections. / Heaven and Earth have approved of you two. / Like an object of protection, vaṭ! Homage to the sky! / Homage to the earth!

sanskrit_iast: divi dhā imaṃ yajñam | yajñamimaṃ divi dhāḥ | divaṃ gaccha | antarikṣaṃ gaccha | pṛthivīṃ gaccha | pañca pradiśo gaccha | devāngharmapāngaccha | pitṝngharmapāngaccha
meaning: दिवि धा इमं यज्ञम् | यज्ञमिमं दिवि धाः | दिवं गच्छ | अन्तरिक्षं गच्छ | पृथिवीं गच्छ | पञ्च प्रदिशो गच्छ | देवान्घर्मपान्गच्छ | पितॄन्घर्मपान्गच्छ
text_mt: Place this sacrifice in the sky! / May you place this sacrifice in the sky! Go to the sky! / Go to the intermediate space! Go to the earth! Go to the five directions! Go to the gods who drink the gharma! Go to the fathers who drink the gharma! / To [Varuṇa] accompanied by the Ādityas, svāhā! Refreshing the heart, earth, and eight [mantras].

sanskrit_iast: iṣe pīpihi | ūrje pīpihi | brahmaṇe pīpihi | kṣattrāya pīpihi | adbhyaḥ pīpihi | oṣadhībhyaḥ pīpihi | vanaspatibhyaḥ pīpihi | dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pīpihi | subhūtāya pīpihi | brahmavarcasāya pīpihi
meaning: इषे पीपिहि | ऊर्जे पीपिहि | ब्रह्मणे पीपिहि | क्षत्त्राय पीपिहि | अद्भ्यः पीपिहि | ओषधीभ्यः पीपिहि | वनस्पतिभ्यः पीपिहि | द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां पीपिहि | सुभूताय पीपिहि | ब्रह्मवर्चसाय पीपिहि
text_mt: Swell for food! Swell for strength! Swell for brahman! Swell for the royal power! Swell for the waters! Swell for the plants! Swell for the trees! Swell for Heaven and Earth! Swell for well-being! Swell for brahmic splendor!

sanskrit_iast: yajamānāya pīpihi | mahyaṃ jyaiṣṭhyāya pīpihi | tviṣyai tvā | dyumnāya tvā | indriyāya tvā bhūtyai tvā | dharmā'si sudharmā me nyasme | brahmāṇi dhāraya | kṣattrāṇi dhāraya | viśaṃ dhāraya | nettvā vātasskandayāt
meaning: यजमानाय पीपिहि | मह्यं ज्यैष्ठ्याय पीपिहि | त्विष्यै त्वा | द्युम्नाय त्वा | इन्द्रियाय त्वा भूत्यै त्वा | धर्माऽसि सुधर्मा मे न्यस्मे | ब्रह्माणि धारय | क्षत्त्राणि धारय | विशं धारय | नेत्त्वा वातस्स्कन्दयात्
text_mt: Swell for the sacrificer! Swell for my seniority! For brightness [I take] you! For luster [I take] you! / For sensory power [I take] you! For prosperity [I take] you! / You are the supporter, an excellent supporter for me among our people. Maintain the brahmans! Maintain the royal powers! Maintain the common folk! Lest the wind cause you to spill!

sanskrit_iast: amuṣya tvā prāṇe sādayāmi | amunā saha nirarthaṃ gaccha | yo'smāndveṣṭi | yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ | pūṣṇe śarase svāhā | grāvabhyassvāhā | pratirebhyassvāhā | dyāvāpṛthivībhyāg svāhā | pitṛbhyo gharmapebhyassvāhā | rudrāya rudrahotre svāhā
meaning: अमुष्य त्वा प्राणे सादयामि | अमुना सह निरर्थं गच्छ | योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि | यं च वयं द्विष्मः | पूष्णे शरसे स्वाहा | ग्रावभ्यस्स्वाहा | प्रतिरेभ्यस्स्वाहा | द्यावापृथिवीभ्याग् स्वाहा | पितृभ्यो घर्मपेभ्यस्स्वाहा | रुद्राय रुद्रहोत्रे स्वाहा
text_mt: I set you down in the breath of so-and-so. Go to destruction along with so-and-so, / he who hates us, / and whom we hate. To Pūṣan the strong, svāhā! / To the pressing stones, svāhā! To the protectors, svāhā! To Heaven and Earth, svāhā! / To the fathers who drink the gharma, svāhā! To Rudra, the hotṛ Rudra, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: aharjyotiḥ ketunā juṣatām | sujyotirjyotiṣāg svāhā | rātrirjyotiḥ ketunā juṣatām | sujyotirjyotiṣāg svāhā | apīparo mā'hno rātriyai mā pāhi | eṣā te agne samit | tayā samiddhyasva | āyurme dāḥ | varcasā mā'ñjīḥ | apīparo mā rātriyā ahno mā pāhi
meaning: अहर्ज्योतिः केतुना जुषताम् | सुज्योतिर्ज्योतिषाग् स्वाहा | रात्रिर्ज्योतिः केतुना जुषताम् | सुज्योतिर्ज्योतिषाग् स्वाहा | अपीपरो माऽह्नो रात्रियै मा पाहि | एषा ते अग्ने समित् | तया समिद्ध्यस्व | आयुर्मे दाः | वर्चसा माऽञ्जीः | अपीपरो मा रात्रिया अह्नो मा पाहि
text_mt:
May the day take pleasure in the light with its banner: having good light, svāhā with light! May the night take pleasure in the light with its banner: having good light, svāhā with light! You have brought me across from the day; protect me from the night! This is your kindling stick, O Agni; blaze up with it! Grant me lifespan; anoint me with splendor! / You have brought me across from the night; protect me from the day!

This is your kindling stick, O Agni; blaze up with it! Grant me lifespan; anoint me with splendor! / Agni is light, light is Agni, svāhā! Sūrya is light, light is Sūrya, svāhā! Bhūḥ, svāhā! Offered is the oblation; sweet is the oblation; in Agni most full of Indra!

sanskrit_iast: eṣā te agne samit | tayā samiddhyasva | āyurme dāḥ | varcasā mā'ñjīḥ | agnirjyotirjyotiragnissvāhā | sūryo jyotirjyotissūryassvāhā | bhūssvāhā | hutaṃ haviḥ | madhu haviḥ | indratame'gnau
meaning: एषा ते अग्ने समित् | तया समिद्ध्यस्व | आयुर्मे दाः | वर्चसा माऽञ्जीः | अग्निर्ज्योतिर्ज्योतिरग्निस्स्वाहा | सूर्यो ज्योतिर्ज्योतिस्सूर्यस्स्वाहा | भूस्स्वाहा | हुतं हविः | मधु हविः | इन्द्रतमेऽग्नौ

sanskrit_iast: pitā no'si mā mā hiṃsīḥ | aśyāma te deva gharma | madhumato vājavataḥ pitumataḥ | aṃgirasvatassvadhāvinaḥ | aśīmahi tvā mā mā hiṃsīḥ | svāhā tvā sūryasya raśmibhyaḥ | svāhā tvā nakṣatrebhyaḥ
meaning: पिता नोऽसि मा मा हिंसीः | अश्याम ते देव घर्म | मधुमतो वाजवतः पितुमतः | अंगिरस्वतस्स्वधाविनः | अशीमहि त्वा मा मा हिंसीः | स्वाहा त्वा सूर्यस्य रश्मिभ्यः | स्वाहा त्वा नक्षत्रेभ्यः
text_mt: You are our father; do not harm me! May we partake of you, O divine gharma, / full of sweetness, full of vigor, full of food, / accompanied by the Aṅgirases, possessing svadhā! May we partake of you; do not harm me! / Svāhā to you, to the rays of the sun! Svāhā to you, to the lunar mansions! / Swell for brahmic splendor; lest it spill; to Rudra, the hotṛ Rudra, svāhā; protect me from the day; in Agni; and seven [mantras].

sanskrit_iast: gharma yā te divi śuk | yā gāyatre chandasi | yā brāhmaṇe | yā havirdhāne | tāṃ ta etenāvayaje svāhā | gharma yā te'ntarikṣe śuk | yā traiṣṭubhe chandasi | yā rājanye | yā''gnīddhre | tāṃ ta etenāvayaje svāhā
meaning: घर्म या ते दिवि शुक् | या गायत्रे छन्दसि | या ब्राह्मणे | या हविर्धाने | तां त एतेनावयजे स्वाहा | घर्म या तेऽन्तरिक्षे शुक् | या त्रैष्टुभे छन्दसि | या राजन्ये | या'ऽग्नीद्ध्रे | तां त एतेनावयजे स्वाहा
text_mt: O gharma, whatever heat of yours is in the sky, / whatever in the gāyatrī meter, / whatever in the brāhmaṇa, / whatever in the havirdhāna shed, / that of yours I appease with this, svāhā! O gharma, whatever heat of yours is in the intermediate space, / whatever in the triṣṭubh meter, / whatever in the warrior, / whatever in the āgnīdhra shed, / that of yours I appease with this, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: gharma yā te pṛthivyāṃ śuk | yā jāgate chandasi | yā vaiśye | yā sadasi | tāṃ ta etenāvayaje svāhā | anu no'dyānumatiḥ | anvidanumate tvam | divastvā paraspāyāḥ | antarikṣasya tanuvaḥ pāhi | pṛthivyāstvā dharmaṇā
meaning: घर्म या ते पृथिव्यां शुक् | या जागते छन्दसि | या वैश्ये | या सदसि | तां त एतेनावयजे स्वाहा | अनु नोऽद्यानुमतिः | अन्विदनुमते त्वम् | दिवस्त्वा परस्पायाः | अन्तरिक्षस्य तनुवः पाहि | पृथिव्यास्त्वा धर्मणा
text_mt: O gharma, whatever heat of yours is on the earth, / whatever in the jagatī meter, / whatever in the commoner, / whatever in the sadas shed, / that of yours I appease with this, svāhā! May Anumati approve of us today; / approve, O Anumati, you! / May you protect the bodies from the sky, from the far-protector, / of the intermediate space; by the ordinance of the earth

sanskrit_iast: vayamanukrāmāma suvitāya navyase | brahmaṇastvā paraspāyāḥ | kṣattrasya tanuvaḥ pāhi | viśastvā dharmaṇā | vayamanukrāmāma suvitāya navyase | prāṇasya tvā paraspāyai | cakṣuṣastanuvaḥ pāhi | śrotrasya tvā dharmaṇā | vayamanukrāmāma suvitāya navyase | valgurasi śaṃyudhāyāḥ
meaning: वयमनुक्रामाम सुविताय नव्यसे | ब्रह्मणस्त्वा परस्पायाः | क्षत्त्रस्य तनुवः पाहि | विशस्त्वा धर्मणा | वयमनुक्रामाम सुविताय नव्यसे | प्राणस्य त्वा परस्पायै | चक्षुषस्तनुवः पाहि | श्रोत्रस्य त्वा धर्मणा | वयमनुक्रामाम सुविताय नव्यसे | वल्गुरसि शंयुधायाः
text_mt: may we follow along to a newer easy path! May you protect the bodies from brahman, from the far-protector, / of the royal power; by the ordinance of the common folk / may we follow along to a newer easy path! / From the vital breath, from the far-protector, / protect the bodies of the eye; by the ordinance of the ear / may we follow along to a newer easy path! Handsome you are, bestowing blessing,

sanskrit_iast: śiśurjanadhāyāḥ | śaṃ ca vakṣi pari ca vakṣi | catussraktirnābhirṛtasya | sado viśvāyuḥ śarma saprathāḥ | apa dveṣo apa hvaraḥ | anyadvratasya saścima | gharmaitatte'nnametatpurīṣam | tena vardhasva cā ca pyāyasva | vardhiṣīmahi ca vayam | ā ca pyāsiṣīmahi
meaning: शिशुर्जनधायाः | शं च वक्षि परि च वक्षि | चतुस्स्रक्तिर्नाभिरृतस्य | सदो विश्वायुः शर्म सप्रथाः | अप द्वेषो अप ह्वरः | अन्यद्व्रतस्य सश्चिम | घर्मैतत्तेऽन्नमेतत्पुरीषम् | तेन वर्धस्व चा च प्यायस्व | वर्धिषीमहि च वयम् | आ च प्यासिषीमहि
text_mt: a child supporting the people. Both bring blessing and carry [it] all around! / Four-cornered navel of cosmic order, / sadas full of life, broad shelter! / Away with enmity, away with crookedness! / May we follow another's vow. / O gharma, this is your food, this your earth-bed; / flourish by it and swell! / May we also flourish / and swell!

sanskrit_iast: rantirnāmāsi divyo gandharvaḥ | tasya te padvaddhavirdhānam | agniradhyakṣāḥ | rudro'dhipatiḥ | samahamāyuṣā | saṃ prāṇena | saṃ varcasā | saṃ payasā | saṃ gaupatyena | saṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa
meaning: रन्तिर्नामासि दिव्यो गन्धर्वः | तस्य ते पद्वद्धविर्धानम् | अग्निरध्यक्षाः | रुद्रोऽधिपतिः | समहमायुषा | सं प्राणेन | सं वर्चसा | सं पयसा | सं गौपत्येन | सं रायस्पोषेण
text_mt: Delight is your name, divine gandharva; / as such your havirdhāna shed has feet. / Agni is the overseer, / Rudra the overlord. / May I be united with lifespan, / with vital breath, / with splendor, / with milk, / with ownership of cattle, / with increase of wealth!

sanskrit_iast: vyasau | yo'smāndveṣṭi | yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ | acikradadvṛṣā hariḥ | mahānmitro na darśataḥ | saṃ sūryeṇa rocate | cidasi samudrayoniḥ | indurdakṣaḥ śyena ṛtāvā | hiraṇyapakṣaḥ śakuno bhuraṇyuḥ | mahānthsadhasthe dhruva āniṣattaḥ
meaning: व्यसौ | योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि | यं च वयं द्विष्मः | अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिः | महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः | सं सूर्येण रोचते | चिदसि समुद्रयोनिः | इन्दुर्दक्षः श्येन ऋतावा | हिरण्यपक्षः शकुनो भुरण्युः | महान्थ्सधस्थे ध्रुव आनिषत्तः
text_mt: Departed is so-and-so, / he who hates us / and whom we hate! The tawny bull has roared, / great, visible like Mitra; / he shines together with the sun. / You are thought, having the ocean as womb; / the drop, skillful, the righteous hawk, / the golden-winged soaring bird, / great, firmly seated in the assembly!

sanskrit_iast: namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ | viśvāvasuṃ somagandharvam | āpo dadṛśuṣīḥ | tadṛtenā vyāyann | tadanvavait | indro rārahāṇa āsām | pari sūryasya paridhīṃrapaśyat | viśvāvasurabhi tanno gṛṇātu | divyo gandharvo rajaso vimānaḥ | yadvā ghā satyamuta yanna vidma
meaning: नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः | विश्वावसुं सोमगन्धर्वम् | आपो ददृशुषीः | तदृतेना व्यायन्न् | तदन्ववैत् | इन्द्रो रारहाण आसाम् | परि सूर्यस्य परिधींरपश्यत् | विश्वावसुरभि तन्नो गृणातु | दिव्यो गन्धर्वो रजसो विमानः | यद्वा घा सत्यमुत यन्न विद्म
text_mt: Homage be to you, do not harm me! / To Viśvāvasu, the Soma-gandharva, / the waters came, having seen [him]; / along cosmic order they went; / he followed after that. / Indra, speeding after them, / looked around at the enclosures of the sun. / May Viśvāvasu proclaim that to us, / the divine gandharva, surveyor of the atmospheric realm, / whether that indeed be true or what we do not know!

sanskrit_iast: dhiyo hinvāno dhiya inno avyāt | sasnimavindaccaraṇe nadīnām | apāvṛṇodduro aśmavrajānām | prāsāṃ gandharvo amṛtāni vocat | indro dakṣaṃ parijānādahīnam | etattvaṃ deva gharma devo devānupāgāḥ | idamahaṃ manuṣyo manuṣyān | somapīthānu mehi | saha prajayā saha rāyaspoṣeṇa | sumitrā na āpa oṣadhayassantu
meaning: धियो हिन्वानो धिय इन्नो अव्यात् | सस्निमविन्दच्चरणे नदीनाम् | अपावृणोद्दुरो अश्मव्रजानाम् | प्रासां गन्धर्वो अमृतानि वोचत् | इन्द्रो दक्षं परिजानादहीनम् | एतत्त्वं देव घर्म देवो देवानुपागाः | इदमहं मनुष्यो मनुष्यान् | सोमपीथानु मेहि | सह प्रजया सह रायस्पोषेण | सुमित्रा न आप ओषधयस्सन्तु
text_mt: Impelling thoughts, may he favor our thoughts! / He found the generous one at the roaming of the rivers; / he opened the doors of the stone-stalls; / the gandharva proclaimed their immortalities; / Indra recognized the whole, uninjured skill. / As this, O divine gharma, a god you have gone to the gods; / as this I, a mortal, to mortals. / Following the drinking of Soma, come to me / together with offspring, together with increase of wealth! / Friendly to us let waters and plants be;

sanskrit_iast: durmitrāstasmai bhūyāsuḥ | yo'smāndveṣṭi | yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ | udvayaṃ tamasaspari | udu tyaṃ citram | imamū ṣu tyamasmabhyaṃ sanim | gāyatraṃ navīyāṃsam | agne deveṣu pravocaḥ
meaning: दुर्मित्रास्तस्मै भूयासुः | योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि | यं च वयं द्विष्मः | उद्वयं तमसस्परि | उदु त्यं चित्रम् | इममू षु त्यमस्मभ्यं सनिम् | गायत्रं नवीयांसम् | अग्ने देवेषु प्रवोचः
text_mt: hostile may they be to him / who hates us / and whom we hate! / Up from the darkness we; / Up that wonderful [banner of the sun]; / And this bounty here indeed for us, / the newer gāyatrī chant, / O Agni, do proclaim among the gods! / Whatever in the āgnīdhra; that of yours I appease with this, svāhā; by the ordinance; bestowing blessing; may we swell; with increase; seated; we know; let them be; and eight [mantras].

sanskrit_iast: mahīnāṃ payo'si vihitaṃ devatrā | jyotirbhā asi vanaspatīnāmoṣadhīnāṃ rasaḥ | vājinaṃ tvā vājino'vanayāmaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ manassuvargam
meaning: महीनां पयोऽसि विहितं देवत्रा | ज्योतिर्भा असि वनस्पतीनामोषधीनां रसः | वाजिनं त्वा वाजिनोऽवनयामः | ऊर्ध्वं मनस्सुवर्गम्
text_mt: You are the milk of the great ones, established among the gods; / you are the shining light, the sap of trees and plants. / As vigorous ones we pour you out, the vigorous one; / upward is our mind turned toward heaven!

sanskrit_iast: askāndyauḥ pṛthivīm | askānṛṣabho yuvā gāḥ | skannemā viśvā bhuvanā | skanno yajñaḥ prajanayatu | askānajani prājani | ā skannājjāyate vṛṣā | skannātprajaniṣīmahi
meaning: अस्कान्द्यौः पृथिवीम् | अस्कानृषभो युवा गाः | स्कन्नेमा विश्वा भुवना | स्कन्नो यज्ञः प्रजनयतु | अस्कानजनि प्राजनि | आ स्कन्नाज्जायते वृषा | स्कन्नात्प्रजनिषीमहि
text_mt: The sky leaped upon the earth; / the youthful bull leaped upon the cows; / into these all creatures have leaped; / may the spilled sacrifice generate! / It has leaped, it was born, it was brought forth; / from what has leaped the bull is born; / from what has leaped may we bring forth!

sanskrit_iast: yā purastādvidyudāpatat | tāṃ ta etenāvayaje svāhā | yā dakṣiṇataḥ | yā paścāt | yottarataḥ | yopariṣṭādvidyudāpatat | tāṃ ta etenāvayaje svāhā
meaning: या पुरस्ताद्विद्युदापतत् | तां त एतेनावयजे स्वाहा | या दक्षिणतः | या पश्चात् | योत्तरतः | योपरिष्टाद्विद्युदापतत् | तां त एतेनावयजे स्वाहा
text_mt: Whatever lightning struck from the east, / that of yours I appease with this, svāhā! Whatever from the south, / whatever from the west, / whatever from the north, / whatever lightning struck from above, / that of yours I appease with this, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā'pānāya svāhā | cakṣuṣe svāhā śrotrāya svāhā | manase svāhā vāce sarasvatyai svāhā
meaning: प्राणाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहाऽपानाय स्वाहा | चक्षुषे स्वाहा श्रोत्राय स्वाहा | मनसे स्वाहा वाचे सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा
text_mt: Svāhā to prāṇa! Svāhā to vyāna! Svāhā to apāna! Svāhā to the eye! Svāhā to the ear! Svāhā to the mind! Svāhā to speech, to Sarasvatī!

sanskrit_iast: pūṣṇe svāhā pūṣṇe śarase svāhā | pūṣṇe prapathyāya svāhā pūṣṇe narandhiṣāya svāhā | pūṣṇe'ṅghṛṇaye svāhā pūṣṇe naruṇāya svāhā | pūṣṇe sāketāya svāhā
meaning: पूष्णे स्वाहा पूष्णे शरसे स्वाहा | पूष्णे प्रपथ्याय स्वाहा पूष्णे नरन्धिषाय स्वाहा | पूष्णेऽङ्घृणये स्वाहा पूष्णे नरुणाय स्वाहा | पूष्णे साकेताय स्वाहा
text_mt: Svāhā to Pūṣan! Svāhā to Pūṣan Śaras! Svāhā to Pūṣan Prapathya! Svāhā to Pūṣan Narandhiṣa! Svāhā to Pūṣan Aṅghṛṇi! Svāhā to Pūṣan Naruṇa! Svāhā to Pūṣan Sāketa!

sanskrit_iast: udasya śuṣmādbhānurnārta bibharti | bhāraṃ pṛthivī na bhūma | pra śukraitu devī manīṣā | asmathsutaṣṭo ratho na vājī | arcanta eke mahi sāma manvata | tena sūryamadhārayann | tena sūryamarocayann | gharmaḥ śirastadayamagniḥ | purīṣamasi saṃpriyaṃ prajayā paśubhirbhuvat | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda
meaning: उदस्य शुष्माद्भानुर्नार्त बिभर्ति | भारं पृथिवी न भूम | प्र शुक्रैतु देवी मनीषा | अस्मथ्सुतष्टो रथो न वाजी | अर्चन्त एके महि साम मन्वत | तेन सूर्यमधारयन्न् | तेन सूर्यमरोचयन्न् | घर्मः शिरस्तदयमग्निः | पुरीषमसि संप्रियं प्रजया पशुभिर्भुवत् | प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु | तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद
text_mt: The beam of light arising from his heat does not falter; / the earth bears her load as if [mere] ground. / Let the bright divine thought come forth from us, / like a swift chariot well fashioned. / Chanting, some meditated upon the great sāman; / with it they held fast the sun, / with it they made the sun shine. / The gharma is the head, this same Agni. / You are the rubble, beloved, may it thrive with offspring and cattle! / Let Prajāpati seat you; with that deity, sit firm as Aṅgiras!

sanskrit_iast: yāste agna ārdrā yonayo yāḥ kulāyinīḥ | ye te agna indavo yā u nābhayaḥ | yāste agne tanuva ūrjo nāma | tābhistvamubhayībhissaṃvidānaḥ | prajābhiragne draviṇeha sīda | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda
meaning: यास्ते अग्न आर्द्रा योनयो याः कुलायिनीः | ये ते अग्न इन्दवो या उ नाभयः | यास्ते अग्ने तनुव ऊर्जो नाम | ताभिस्त्वमुभयीभिस्संविदानः | प्रजाभिरग्ने द्रविणेह सीद | प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु | तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद
text_mt: Your moist wombs, O Agni, that have nests; / your drops, O Agni, and your navels; / your forms, O Agni, named 'vigour'— / in harmony with both of those, / sit here, O Agni, with offspring and wealth! / Let Prajāpati seat you; with that deity, sit firm as Aṅgiras!

sanskrit_iast: agnirasi vaiśvānaro'si | saṃvathsaro'si parivathsaro'si | idāvathsaro'sīduvathsaro'si | idvathsaro'si vathsaro'si | tasya te vasantaḥ śiraḥ | grīṣmo dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ | varṣāḥ puccham | śaraduttaraḥ pakṣaḥ | hemanto madhyam | pūrvapakṣāścitayaḥ | aparapakṣāḥ purīṣam | ahorātrāṇīṣṭakāḥ | tasya te māsāścārdhamāsāśca kalpantām | ṛtavaste kalpantām | saṃvathsaraste kalpatām | ahorātrāṇi te kalpantām | eti preti vīti samityuditi | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvassīda
meaning: अग्निरसि वैश्वानरोऽसि | संवथ्सरोऽसि परिवथ्सरोऽसि | इदावथ्सरोऽसीदुवथ्सरोऽसि | इद्वथ्सरोऽसि वथ्सरोऽसि | तस्य ते वसन्तः शिरः | ग्रीष्मो दक्षिणः पक्षः | वर्षाः पुच्छम् | शरदुत्तरः पक्षः | हेमन्तो मध्यम् | पूर्वपक्षाश्चितयः | अपरपक्षाः पुरीषम् | अहोरात्राणीष्टकाः | तस्य ते मासाश्चार्धमासाश्च कल्पन्ताम् | ऋतवस्ते कल्पन्ताम् | संवथ्सरस्ते कल्पताम् | अहोरात्राणि ते कल्पन्ताम् | एति प्रेति वीति समित्युदिति | प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु | तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवस्सीद
text_mt: You are Agni, you are Vaiśvānara; / you are the saṃvatsara, you are the parivatsara; / you are the idāvatsara, you are the iduvatsara; / you are the idvatsara, you are the vatsara. / Of you, spring is the head; / summer is the right wing; / the rains are the tail; / autumn is the left wing; / winter is the middle; / the waxing fortnights are the layers; / the waning fortnights are the rubble; / the days and nights are the bricks. / May your months and half-months be fit; / may your seasons be fit; / may your year be fit; / may your days and nights be fit! / Going, going forth, going away, coming together, rising. / Let Prajāpati seat you; with that deity, sit firm as Aṅgiras!

sanskrit_iast: bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye | ūrdhvo naḥ pāhyaṃhasaḥ | vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnām | yuvānaṃ santaṃ palito jagāra | devasya paśya kāvyaṃ mahitvā'dyā mamāra | sa hyassamāna | yadṛte cidabhiśriṣaḥ | purā jartṛbhya ātṛdaḥ | sandhātā sandhiṃ maghavā purovasuḥ
meaning: भूर्भुवस्सुवः | ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये | ऊर्ध्वो नः पाह्यंहसः | विधुं दद्राणं समने बहूनाम् | युवानं सन्तं पलितो जगार | देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाऽद्या ममार | स ह्यस्समान | यदृते चिदभिश्रिषः | पुरा जर्तृभ्य आतृदः | सन्धाता सन्धिं मघवा पुरोवसुः
text_mt: Bhūr, bhuvas, suvar! / Upright [stand] for our aid; / upright, protect us from distress! / The grey-haired one has swallowed the solitary one, running in the assembly of many, / while yet he was young. / Behold the poet-wisdom of the god: today through his greatness he has died, / who yesterday was alive! / Even without ties, / before the piercings from the neck-joints, / Indra the generous, possessing wealth in front, joins the joint.

sanskrit_iast: niṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ | punarūrjā saha rayyā | mā no gharma vyathito vivyatho naḥ | mā naḥ paramadharaṃ mā rajo'naiḥ | moṣvasmāṃstamasyantarā dhāḥ | mā rudriyāso abhigurvṛdhā naḥ | mā naḥ kratubhirhīḍitebhirasmān | dviṣā sunīte mā parādāḥ | mā no rudro nirṛtirmā no astā | mā dyāvāpṛthivī hīḍiṣātām
meaning: निष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः | पुनरूर्जा सह रय्या | मा नो घर्म व्यथितो विव्यथो नः | मा नः परमधरं मा रजोऽनैः | मोष्वस्मांस्तमस्यन्तरा धाः | मा रुद्रियासो अभिगुर्वृधा नः | मा नः क्रतुभिर्हीडितेभिरस्मान् | द्विषा सुनीते मा परादाः | मा नो रुद्रो निरृतिर्मा नो अस्ता | मा द्यावापृथिवी हीडिषाताम्
text_mt: The repairer of what was broken, once again, / once again together with vigour and wealth. / O gharma, disturbed, do not disturb us! / Do not lead us to the lower, the lowest realm! / Do not put us inside darkness! / Let not the Rudras grow angry and hostile toward us! / Through our offended intents, do not hand us over, / O well-guided one, to the enemy! / Let not Rudra, let not Nirṛti be our thrower! / Let not heaven and earth take offense!

sanskrit_iast: upa no mitrāvaruṇāvihāvatam | anvādīdhyāthāmiha nassakhāyā | ādityānāṃ prasitirhetiḥ | ugrā śatāpāṣṭhā gha viṣā pari ṇo vṛṇaktu | imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi | tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne | tvamagne ayāsi | udvayaṃ tamasaspari | udu tyaṃ citram | vayassuparṇāḥ
meaning: उप नो मित्रावरुणाविहावतम् | अन्वादीध्याथामिह नस्सखाया | आदित्यानां प्रसितिर्हेतिः | उग्रा शतापाष्ठा घ विषा परि णो वृणक्तु | इमं मे वरुण तत्त्वा यामि | त्वं नो अग्ने स त्वं नो अग्ने | त्वमग्ने अयासि | उद्वयं तमसस्परि | उदु त्यं चित्रम् | वयस्सुपर्णाः
text_mt: Come here to our aid, O Mitra and Varuṇa! / Consider us here as two friends! / May the snare, the weapon of the Ādityas, / fierce, barbed with a hundred hooks, containing poison, spare us! / 'This [prayer] of mine, O Varuṇa', 'That I ask of you'; / 'You to us, O Agni', 'He, you to us, O Agni'; 'You, O Agni, Ayās'; / 'Up from the darkness'; 'Up that wonderful [light]'; 'The birds, fair-winged'; / possessing wealth in front; may take offense; the fair-winged ones.

sanskrit_iast: bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | mayi tyadindriyaṃ mahat | mayi dakṣo mayi kratuḥ | mayi dhāyi suvīryam | triśuggharmo vibhātu me | ākūtyā manasā saha | virājā jyotiṣā saha | yajñena payasā saha | brahmaṇā tejasā saha | kṣatreṇa yaśasā saha | satyena tapasā saha | tasya dohamaśīmahi | tasya sumnamaśīmahi | tasya bhakṣamaśīmahi | tasya ta indreṇa pītasya madhumataḥ | upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi
meaning: भूर्भुवस्सुवः | मयि त्यदिन्द्रियं महत् | मयि दक्षो मयि क्रतुः | मयि धायि सुवीर्यम् | त्रिशुग्घर्मो विभातु मे | आकूत्या मनसा सह | विराजा ज्योतिषा सह | यज्ञेन पयसा सह | ब्रह्मणा तेजसा सह | क्षत्रेण यशसा सह | सत्येन तपसा सह | तस्य दोहमशीमहि | तस्य सुम्नमशीमहि | तस्य भक्षमशीमहि | तस्य त इन्द्रेण पीतस्य मधुमतः | उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि
text_mt: Bhūr, bhuvas, suvar! / In me is that great power of Indra; / in me is skill, in me is will; / in me is placed good manly strength. / May the thrice-shining gharma shine brightly for me, / together with intention and mind, / together with the virāj and light, / together with the sacrifice and milk, / together with brahman and fiery energy, / together with royal power and glory, / together with truth and tapas! / May we attain its milking; / may we attain its favor; / may we attain its consumption! / Of you, drunken by Indra, honeyed, / summoned, I, being summoned, partake. / Together with glory and six.

sanskrit_iast: yāste agne ghorāstanuvaḥ | kṣucca tṛṣṇā ca | asnukcānāhutiśca | aśanayā ca pipāsā ca | sediścāmatiśca | etāste agne ghorāstanuvaḥ | tābhiramuṃ gaccha | yo'smāndveṣṭi | yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
meaning: यास्ते अग्ने घोरास्तनुवः | क्षुच्च तृष्णा च | अस्नुक्चानाहुतिश्च | अशनया च पिपासा च | सेदिश्चामतिश्च | एतास्ते अग्ने घोरास्तनुवः | ताभिरमुं गच्छ | योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि | यं च वयं द्विष्मः
text_mt: Those terrible bodies of yours, O Agni: / hunger and thirst, / no ladle and no oblation, / famine and dehydration, / exhaustion and want of thought— / these are your terrible bodies, O Agni. / With them, go against that one / who hates us, / and whom we hate!

sanskrit_iast: snikca snīhitiśca snihitiśca | uṣṇā ca śītā ca | ugrā ca bhīmā ca | sadāmnī sediranirā | etāste agne ghorāstanuvaḥ | tābhiramuṃ gaccha | yo'smāndveṣṭi | yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
meaning: स्निक्च स्नीहितिश्च स्निहितिश्च | उष्णा च शीता च | उग्रा च भीमा च | सदाम्नी सेदिरनिरा | एतास्ते अग्ने घोरास्तनुवः | ताभिरमुं गच्छ | योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि | यं च वयं द्विष्मः
text_mt: Adhesive, destruction, and ruin, / hot and cold, / fierce and terrible, / constant pain, exhaustion, and lack of food— / these are your terrible bodies, O Agni. / With them, go against that one / who hates us, / and whom we hate!

sanskrit_iast: dhuniśca dhvāntaśca dhvanaśca dhvanayaṃśca | nilimpaśca vilimpaśca vikṣipaḥ
meaning: धुनिश्च ध्वान्तश्च ध्वनश्च ध्वनयंश्च | निलिम्पश्च विलिम्पश्च विक्षिपः
text_mt: The roaring one, the dark one, the sounding one, and the maker of sound; / the plastering one, the smearing one, and the scattering one.

sanskrit_iast: ugraśca dhuniśca dhvāntaśca dhvanaśca dhvanayaṃśca | sahasahvāṃśca sahamānaśca sahasvāṃśca sahīyāṃśca | etya pretya vikṣipaḥ
meaning: उग्रश्च धुनिश्च ध्वान्तश्च ध्वनश्च ध्वनयंश्च | सहसह्वांश्च सहमानश्च सहस्वांश्च सहीयांश्च | एत्य प्रेत्य विक्षिपः
text_mt: The fierce one, the roaring one, the dark one, the sounding one, and the maker of sound; / the conqueror, the overcoming one, the powerful one, and the more powerful one; / coming, going away, scattering.

sanskrit_iast: ahorātre tvodīrayatām | ardhamāsāstvodīñjayantu | māsāstvā śrapayantu | ṛtavastvā pacantu | saṃvathsarastvā hantvasau
meaning: अहोरात्रे त्वोदीरयताम् | अर्धमासास्त्वोदीञ्जयन्तु | मासास्त्वा श्रपयन्तु | ऋतवस्त्वा पचन्तु | संवथ्सरस्त्वा हन्त्वसौ
text_mt: May day and night stir you up! / May the half-months agitate you! / May the months cook you! / May the seasons boil you! / May the year slay you, so-and-so!

sanskrit_iast: khaṭphaḍjahi | chindhī bhindhī handhī kaṭ | iti vācaḥ krūrāṇi
meaning: खट्फड्जहि | छिन्धी भिन्धी हन्धी कट् | इति वाचः क्रूराणि
text_mt: Khaṭ! Phaṭ! Slay! / Cut, cleave, strike down, kaṭ! / Such are the cruel words of speech.

sanskrit_iast: vigā indra vicaranthspāśayasva | svapantamindra paśumantamiccha | vajreṇāmuṃ bodhaya durvidatram | svapato'sya prahara bhojanebhyaḥ | agne agninā saṃvadasva | mṛtyo mṛtyunā saṃvadasva | namaste astu bhagavaḥ | sakṛtte agne namaḥ | dviste namaḥ | triste namaḥ | catuste namaḥ | pañcakṛtvaste namaḥ | daśakṛtvaste namaḥ | śatakṛtvaste namaḥ | āsahasrakṛtvaste namaḥ | aparimitakṛtvaste namaḥ | namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ
meaning: विगा इन्द्र विचरन्थ्स्पाशयस्व | स्वपन्तमिन्द्र पशुमन्तमिच्छ | वज्रेणामुं बोधय दुर्विदत्रम् | स्वपतोऽस्य प्रहर भोजनेभ्यः | अग्ने अग्निना संवदस्व | मृत्यो मृत्युना संवदस्व | नमस्ते अस्तु भगवः | सकृत्ते अग्ने नमः | द्विस्ते नमः | त्रिस्ते नमः | चतुस्ते नमः | पञ्चकृत्वस्ते नमः | दशकृत्वस्ते नमः | शतकृत्वस्ते नमः | आसहस्रकृत्वस्ते नमः | अपरिमितकृत्वस्ते नमः | नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः
text_mt: Ensnare the roaming cattle, O Indra! / Seek the sleeping cattle-owner, O Indra! / Awaken that ungenerous one with the thunderbolt! / Strike him, while he sleeps, away from his enjoyments! / Agni, converse with Agni! / Death, converse with Death! / Homage be to you, O Lord! / Once homage to you, O Agni! Twice homage to you! Thrice homage to you! Four times homage to you! / Five times homage to you! Ten times homage to you! A hundred times homage to you! Up to a thousand times homage to you! Uncounted times homage to you! Homage be to you, do not harm me! / Thrice homage to you, and seven.

sanskrit_iast: asṛṅmukho rudhireṇāvyaktaḥ | yamasya dūtaḥ śvapādvidhāvasi | gṛddhraḥ suparṇaḥ kuṇapaṃ niṣevase | yamasya dūtaḥ prahito bhavasya cobhayoḥ
meaning: असृङ्मुखो रुधिरेणाव्यक्तः | यमस्य दूतः श्वपाद्विधावसि | गृद्ध्रः सुपर्णः कुणपं निषेवसे | यमस्य दूतः प्रहितो भवस्य चोभयोः
text_mt: Blood-faced, smeared with gore, / a dog-footed messenger of Yama, you run about. / A vulture, a bird of fair wing, you attend upon a corpse; / you are sent forth as the messenger of Yama and Bhava, of both.

sanskrit_iast: yadetadvṛkaso bhūtvā | vāgdevyabhirāyasi | dviṣantaṃ me'bhirāya | taṃ mṛtyo mṛtyave naya | sa ārtyā''rtimārcchatu
meaning: यदेतद्वृकसो भूत्वा | वाग्देव्यभिरायसि | द्विषन्तं मेऽभिराय | तं मृत्यो मृत्यवे नय | स आर्त्या'ऽर्तिमार्च्छतु
text_mt: Since, having become a she-wolf, / you howl, O goddess of speech, / howl against him who hates me! / Lead him, O Death, unto death! / Let him through suffering meet with suffering!

sanskrit_iast: yadīṣito yadi vā svakāmī | bhayeḍako vadati vācametām | tāmindrāgnī brahmaṇā saṃvidānau | śivāmasmabhyaṃ kṛṇutaṃ gṛheṣu
meaning: यदीषितो यदि वा स्वकामी | भयेडको वदति वाचमेताम् | तामिन्द्राग्नी ब्रह्मणा संविदानौ | शिवामस्मभ्यं कृणुतं गृहेषु
text_mt: Whether impelled or of its own desire, / the fearful ewe speaks this word, / may Indra and Agni, agreeing together through brahman, / make it auspicious for us in our dwellings!

sanskrit_iast: dīrghamukhi durhaṇu | mā sma dakṣiṇato vadaḥ | yadi dakṣiṇato vadāddviṣantaṃ me'vabādhāsai
meaning: दीर्घमुखि दुर्हणु | मा स्म दक्षिणतो वदः | यदि दक्षिणतो वदाद्द्विषन्तं मेऽवबाधासै
text_mt: O long-faced one, evil-jawed one, / do not call from the south! / If you should call from the south, overpower him who hates me!

sanskrit_iast: itthādulūka āpaptat | hiraṇyākṣo ayomukhaḥ | rakṣasāṃ dūta āgataḥ | tamito nāśayāgne
meaning: इत्थादुलूक आपप्तत् | हिरण्याक्षो अयोमुखः | रक्षसां दूत आगतः | तमितो नाशयाग्ने
text_mt: In this way the owl has flown down, / golden-eyed, iron-beaked, / a messenger of the rakṣases arrived. / Drive him away from here, O Agni!

sanskrit_iast: yadetadbhūtānyanvāviśya | daivīṃ vācaṃ vadasi | dviṣato naḥ parāvada | tānmṛtyo mṛtyave naya | ta ārtyā''rtimārcchantu | agninā'gnissaṃvadatām
meaning: यदेतद्भूतान्यन्वाविश्य | दैवीं वाचं वदसि | द्विषतो नः परावद | तान्मृत्यो मृत्यवे नय | त आर्त्या'ऽर्तिमार्च्छन्तु | अग्निनाऽग्निस्संवदताम्
text_mt: Since you, having entered into beings, / speak divine speech, / speak away those who hate us! / Lead them, O Death, unto death! / Let them through suffering meet with suffering! / Let Agni converse with Agni!

sanskrit_iast: prasārya sakthyau patasi | savyamakṣi nipepi ca | meha kasyacanāmamat
meaning: प्रसार्य सक्थ्यौ पतसि | सव्यमक्षि निपेपि च | मेह कस्यचनाममत्
text_mt: Spreading both thighs you fly, / repeatedly winking the left eye; / may it not cause sickness to anyone here!

sanskrit_iast: atriṇā tvā krime hanmi | kaṇvena jamadagninā | viśvāvasorbrahmaṇā hataḥ | krimīṇāṃ rājā | apyeṣāg sthapatirhataḥ | atho mātā'tho pitā | atho sthūrā atho kṣudrāḥ | atho kṛṣṇā atho śvetāḥ | atho āśātikā hatāḥ | śvetābhissaha sarve hatāḥ
meaning: अत्रिणा त्वा क्रिमे हन्मि | कण्वेन जमदग्निना | विश्वावसोर्ब्रह्मणा हतः | क्रिमीणां राजा | अप्येषाग् स्थपतिर्हतः | अथो माताऽथो पिता | अथो स्थूरा अथो क्षुद्राः | अथो कृष्णा अथो श्वेताः | अथो आशातिका हताः | श्वेताभिस्सह सर्वे हताः
text_mt:
With Atri I slay you, worm, with Kaṇva, with Jamadagni. Slain is the king of worms by the brahman of Viśvāvasu. Slain also is their chief; and so their mother, and so their father;
and so the large, and so the small; and so the black, and so the white; and so the āśātikā-worms are slain; all are slain along with the white ones.

sanskrit_iast: āharāvadya | śṛtasya haviṣo yathā | tathsatyam | yadamuṃ yamasya jambhayoḥ | ādadhāmi tathā hi tat | khaṇphaṇmrasi
meaning: आहरावद्य | शृतस्य हविषो यथा | तथ्सत्यम् | यदमुं यमस्य जम्भयोः | आदधामि तथा हि तत् | खण्फण्म्रसि
text_mt: Bring [him] cut up, as of cooked oblation. It is truth. What I place yonder into the jaws of Yama, so indeed it is! Khaṇ, phaṇ, to pieces!

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇā tvā śapāmi | brahmaṇastvā śapathena śapāmi | ghoreṇa tvā bhṛgūṇāṃ cakṣuṣā prekṣe | raudreṇa tvā'ṃgirasāṃ manasā dhyāyāmi | aghasya tvā dhārayā vidyāmi | adharo matpadyasvāsau
meaning: ब्रह्मणा त्वा शपामि | ब्रह्मणस्त्वा शपथेन शपामि | घोरेण त्वा भृगूणां चक्षुषा प्रेक्षे | रौद्रेण त्वाऽंगिरसां मनसा ध्यायामि | अघस्य त्वा धारया विद्यामि | अधरो मत्पद्यस्वासौ
text_mt:
I curse you with brahman; I curse you with the curse of brahman. With the dread eye of the Bhṛgus I gaze upon you; with the fierce mind of the Aṅgirases I meditate upon you.
With a stream of misfortune I pierce you; fall lower than me, so-and-so!

sanskrit_iast: uttuda śimijāvari | talpeje talpa uttuda | girīṃranupraveśaya | marīcīrupa saṃnuda | yāvaditaḥ purastādudayāti sūryaḥ | tāvadito'muṃ nāśaya | yo'smāndveṣṭi | yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
meaning: उत्तुद शिमिजावरि | तल्पेजे तल्प उत्तुद | गिरींरनुप्रवेशय | मरीचीरुप संनुद | यावदितः पुरस्तादुदयाति सूर्यः | तावदितोऽमुं नाशय | योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि | यं च वयं द्विष्मः
text_mt:
Prick him up, Śimijāvarī! Talpeje, prick him up on his bed! Make him enter the mountains! Drive him toward the rays of light! As long as the sun rises here in the east,
for so long drive him away from here—him who hates us, and whom we hate.

text_mt:
Bhūr bhuvas suvaḥ! Bhūr bhuvas suvaḥ! Bhūr bhuvas suvaḥ! Has become truly, has become truly, has become truly. Became manly strength, became manly strength, became manly strength.
Was placed down, was swallowed, was placed down, was swallowed, was placed down, was swallowed. O, upon us, upon us! Heaven-like light.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivī samit | tāmagnissamindhe | sā'gniṃ samindhe | tāmahaṃ samindhe | sā mā samiddhā | āyuṣā tejasā | varcasā śriyā | yaśasā brahmavarcasena | annādyena samintāg svāhā | antarikṣaṃ samit
meaning: पृथिवी समित् | तामग्निस्समिन्धे | साऽग्निं समिन्धे | तामहं समिन्धे | सा मा समिद्धा | आयुषा तेजसा | वर्चसा श्रिया | यशसा ब्रह्मवर्चसेन | अन्नाद्येन समिन्ताग् स्वाहा | अन्तरिक्षं समित्
text_mt: The earth is the kindling-stick. Agni kindles it; it kindles Agni; I kindle it. May it, kindled, kindle me with lifespan, with fiery energy, with brilliance, with fortune, with renown, with the luster of brahman, with food and nourishment. Svāhā! The intermediate space is the kindling-stick.

Kindling-stick, kindles, I will perform my vow, with lifespan, with fiery energy, with brilliance, with fortune, with renown, with the luster of brahman, and eight.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃ no vātaḥ pavatāṃ mātariśvā śaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ | ahāni śaṃ bhavantu naḥ śaṃ rātriḥ prati dhīyatām | śamuṣā no vyucchatu śamāditya udetu naḥ | śivā naḥ śantamā bhava sumṛḍīkā sarasvati | mā te vyoma saṃdṛśi | iḍāyai vāstvasi vāstumadvāstumanto bhūyāsma mā vāstośchithsmahyavāstuḥ sa bhūyādyo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ | pratiṣṭhā'si pratiṣṭhāvanto bhūyāsma mā pratiṣṭhāyāśchithsmahyapratiṣṭhaḥ sa bhūyādyo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ | ā vāta vāhi bheṣajaṃ vi vāta vāhi yadrapaḥ | tvaṃhi viśvabheṣajo devānāṃ dūta īyase | dvāvimau vātau vāta āsindhorāparāvataḥ
meaning: शं नो वातः पवतां मातरिश्वा शं नस्तपतु सूर्यः | अहानि शं भवन्तु नः शं रात्रिः प्रति धीयताम् | शमुषा नो व्युच्छतु शमादित्य उदेतु नः | शिवा नः शन्तमा भव सुमृडीका सरस्वति | मा ते व्योम संदृशि | इडायै वास्त्वसि वास्तुमद्वास्तुमन्तो भूयास्म मा वास्तोश्छिथ्स्मह्यवास्तुः स भूयाद्योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः | प्रतिष्ठाऽसि प्रतिष्ठावन्तो भूयास्म मा प्रतिष्ठायाश्छिथ्स्मह्यप्रतिष्ठः स भूयाद्योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः | आ वात वाहि भेषजं वि वात वाहि यद्रपः | त्वंहि विश्वभेषजो देवानां दूत ईयसे | द्वाविमौ वातौ वात आसिन्धोरापरावतः
text_mt: May the wind blow peace upon us, Mātariśvan; may Sūrya burn peace upon us. May the days bring peace to us; may night be assigned as peace for us. May dawn shine forth peace for us; may Āditya rise as peace for us. Be gracious to us, most peaceful, very merciful, Sarasvatī; may we not see your sky [shorn of light]. You are the site of Iḍā, possessed of a site. May we be possessed of a site; may we not be cut off from our site. May he be without a site who hates us, and whom we hate. You are a foundation; may we be possessed of a foundation; may we not be cut off from our foundation. May he be without a foundation who hates us, and whom we hate. Blow hither, wind, healing; blow away, wind, what is defilement. For you, having all remedies, speed as the messenger of the gods. These two winds blow hither from the river to the far distance.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣaṃ me anya āvātu parā'nyo vātu yadrapaḥ | yadado vāta te gṛhe'mṛtasya nidhirhitaḥ | tato no dehi jīvase tato no dhehi bheṣajam | tato no maha āvaha vāta āvātu bheṣajam | śaṃ bhūrmayobhūrno hṛde pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat | indrasya gṛho'si taṃ tvā prapadye sagussāśvaḥ | saha yanme asti tena | bhūḥ prapadye bhuvaḥ prapadye suvaḥ prapadye bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ prapadye vāyuṃ prapadye'nārtāṃ devatāṃ prapadye'śmānamākhaṇaṃ prapadye prajāpaterbrahmakośaṃ brahma prapadya oṃ prapadye | antarikṣaṃ ma urvantaraṃ bṛhadagnayaḥ parvatāśca yayā vātassvastyā svasti māṃ tayā svastyā svasti mānasāni | prāṇāpānau mṛtyormā pātaṃ prāṇāpānau mā mā hāsiṣṭaṃ mayi medhāṃ mayi prajāṃ mayyagnistejo dadhātu mayi medhāṃ mayi prajāṃ mayīndra indriyaṃ dadhātu mayi medhāṃ mayi prajāṃ mayi sūryo bhrājo dadhātu
meaning: दक्षं मे अन्य आवातु पराऽन्यो वातु यद्रपः | यददो वात ते गृहेऽमृतस्य निधिर्हितः | ततो नो देहि जीवसे ततो नो धेहि भेषजम् | ततो नो मह आवह वात आवातु भेषजम् | शं भूर्मयोभूर्नो हृदे प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् | इन्द्रस्य गृहोऽसि तं त्वा प्रपद्ये सगुस्साश्वः | सह यन्मे अस्ति तेन | भूः प्रपद्ये भुवः प्रपद्ये सुवः प्रपद्ये भूर्भुवस्सुवः प्रपद्ये वायुं प्रपद्येऽनार्तां देवतां प्रपद्येऽश्मानमाखणं प्रपद्ये प्रजापतेर्ब्रह्मकोशं ब्रह्म प्रपद्य ओं प्रपद्ये | अन्तरिक्षं म उर्वन्तरं बृहदग्नयः पर्वताश्च यया वातस्स्वस्त्या स्वस्ति मां तया स्वस्त्या स्वस्ति मानसानि | प्राणापानौ मृत्योर्मा पातं प्राणापानौ मा मा हासिष्टं मयि मेधां मयि प्रजां मय्यग्निस्तेजो दधातु मयि मेधां मयि प्रजां मयीन्द्र इन्द्रियं दधातु मयि मेधां मयि प्रजां मयि सूर्यो भ्राजो दधातु
text_mt: May the one blow capability to me; may the other blow away whatever is defilement. O wind, what treasure of the immortal has been deposited yonder in your house, bestow from that upon us for living; establish from that healing for us; bring hither glory from that for us. May the wind blow hither healing, peace-bringing, delightful to our heart; may it extend our lifespans. You are Indra's house; unto you, such as you are, I enter, with cattle, with horses, together with whatever is mine. Bhūḥ I enter; bhuvaḥ I enter; suvaḥ I enter; bhūr bhuvas suvaḥ I enter. Vāyu I enter; the unafflicted deity I enter; the unbroken stone I enter; Prajāpati's treasure of brahman, brahman, I enter; Om I enter. May the intermediate space be my wide interior; great are the fires and the mountains. With whatever well-being the wind [blows] well-being, may I live well with that well-being. May out-breath and in-breath protect me from death; may out-breath and in-breath not abandon me. In me wisdom, in me offspring, in me may Agni establish fiery energy! In me wisdom, in me offspring, in me may Indra establish power! In me wisdom, in me offspring, in me may Sūrya establish radiance!

sanskrit_iast: dyubhiraktubhiḥ paripātamasmānariṣṭebhiraśvinā saubhagebhiḥ | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditissindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ | kayā naścitra ābhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhassakhā | kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā | kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho mathsadandhasaḥ | dṛḍhā cidāruje vasu | abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām | śataṃ bhavāsyūtibhiḥ | vayaḥ suparṇā upasedurindraṃ priyamedhā ṛṣayo nādhamānāḥ | apa dhvāntamūrṇuhi pūrdhi cakṣurmumugdhyasmānnidhayeva baddhān
meaning: द्युभिरक्तुभिः परिपातमस्मानरिष्टेभिरश्विना सौभगेभिः | तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिस्सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः | कया नश्चित्र आभुवदूती सदावृधस्सखा | कया शचिष्ठया वृता | कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मंहिष्ठो मथ्सदन्धसः | दृढा चिदारुजे वसु | अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम् | शतं भवास्यूतिभिः | वयः सुपर्णा उपसेदुरिन्द्रं प्रियमेधा ऋषयो नाधमानाः | अप ध्वान्तमूर्णुहि पूर्धि चक्षुर्मुमुग्ध्यस्मान्निधयेव बद्धान्
text_mt: By day and by night protect us with uninjured prosperities, O Aśvins! Let Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi, Sindhu, Earth, and Sky magnify this for us! With what aid will he, the wonderful, ever-prospering friend, be present to us? With what most mighty company? What true, most generous exhilaration of pressed juices will exhilarate you to break open even firm treasures? Be well present to us, the helper of friends, of singers, with a hundred aids! The birds of beautiful wings have approached Indra, the Priyamedha seers crying out for help: Unveil the darkness, fill our eye, free us as if bound by a snare!

text_mt:
May the divine Waters be auspicious for our help and for our drinking; / may they flow over us for blessing and peace. / Rulers over desirable treasures, mistresses of peoples, / I ask the Waters for medicine.
Friendly to us be the waters and the plants; unfriendly may they be to him who hates us and whom we hate. / Waters, you are indeed the sources of joy; so set us in strength,
for great and joyous vision. / Whatever is your most auspicious sap, grant us a share of it here,
like loving mothers. / May we go readily to you for him to whose dwelling you refresh,

text_mt:
and, O Waters, bring us to birth. / The earth is peaceful; it is pacified by Agni; peaceful for me, may it pacify my grief. / The intermediate space is peaceful; it is pacified by Vāyu; peaceful for me, may it pacify my grief. / The sky is peaceful; it is pacified by Āditya; peaceful for me, may it pacify my grief. / Earth is peace; intermediate space is peace; sky is peace; the directions are peace; the intermediate directions are peace; Agni is peace; Vāyu is peace; Āditya is peace; the moon is peace; the constellations are peace; the waters are peace; the plants are peace; the trees are peace; the cow is peace; the goat is peace; the horse is peace; the person is peace; brahman is peace; the brāhmaṇa is peace; peace itself is peace; may peace be peace for me. / By that peace, by all peace, I make peace for myself, for two-footed and four-footed; may peace be peace for me. / Here may prosperity, shame, steadfastness, ascetic heat, wisdom, foundation, faith, truth, and dharma arise alongside me as I arise; may prosperity, shame, steadfastness, ascetic heat, wisdom, foundation, faith, truth, and dharma never abandon me. / I have arisen with lifespan, with good lifespan, with the sap of the plants, with the fury of Parjanya; I have arisen after the immortal [gods]. / That bright eye established by the gods, which rises in the east: / may we see for a hundred autumns; may we live for a hundred autumns; may we rejoice for a hundred autumns; may we be glad for a hundred autumns; may we flourish for a hundred autumns; may we hear for a hundred autumns; may we speak forth for a hundred autumns; may we be unconquered for a hundred autumns, and long see Sūrya.
He who has risen from the great ocean, shining out from the midst of the surging flood—may that bull, red-eyed, the wise Sūrya, purify me with his mind. / You are the trickling of brahman; you two are the linchpins of brahman; you are the scattering place of brahman. This great earth is upheld by brahman; the great intermediate space is upheld by it; it has sustained the sky and the earth together with the gods. What I know, may I retain; may the Veda not slip away from me. / May wisdom and discernment enter me united, for the attainment of what has been and what is to be; may I attain the full lifespan, may I attain the full lifespan. / With these chants, O lord of bay horses, swell what has been diminished for us from that place, growing strong.
When you break open the great cowpens for the praisers, then may we have the greatest share. / We have proclaimed the sacred word; let it not abandon us. / Om, peace, peace, peace. || 94 || [Word-index cues:] from afar, may he place, bound, you refresh, for seeing, and seven.

Reverence to speech, O brahman, with the pravargya, in me, pain, with intermediate space, O gharma, which for you, in the sky, heat, it leaped, sky, earth, to us, Mitra and Varuṇa, as this, Vṛkasa, bhūḥ bhuvaḥ suvaḥ, with days, ninety-three.

text_mt: The gods indeed sat for a satra, / bounded by prosperity, desiring glory. / They said: / “Whichever of us shall first attain glory, / that shall be for all of us together.” / Kurukṣetra was their sacrificial altar; / Khāṇḍava was its southern half, / Tūrghna its northern half, / Parīṇat its western half, / the Marus the rubbish-heap.

text_mt: To Makha Vaiṣṇava among them glory came. / He desired it [for himself]; / with it he walked away. / The gods went after him, / seeking to obtain that glory. / As they followed after him, / from his left [arm] the bow was born, / from his right the arrows. / Therefore the bow and arrow have a sacred birth, / for their birth is from sacrifice.

text_mt: for it was chosen in their boon. / They ate through his bowstring. / His bow, springing apart, severed his head. / It rolled across heaven and earth. / Because it rolled forth (prāvartata), / that is the pravargya-nature of the pravargya. / Because it fell with the sound “ghrāṅ”, / that is the gharma-nature of the gharma. / Saying, “The valor of the great one has fallen,” / that is the mahāvīra-nature of the mahāvīra.

The deities divided him among themselves in three parts when he was laid low: Agni [took] the morning pressing; Indra, the midday pressing; the All-Gods, the third pressing. Sacrificing with that headless sacrifice, the sacrificers did not obtain their wishes, nor did they conquer the world of heaven. Those gods said to the two Aśvins:
