He says: 'Possessing self-power, may we partake of thee; harm me not!' for harmlessness. They who perform the pravargya are deprived of brilliance. They consume [it]; they place brilliance in themselves.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvathsaraṃ na māṃsamaśñīyāt | na rāmāmupeyāt | na mṛnmayena pibet | nāsya rāma ucchiṣṭaṃ pibet | teja eva tathsaṃśyati | devāsurāssaṃyattā āsann | te devā vijayamupayantaḥ | vibhrāji saurye brahma saṃnyadadhata | yatkiṃca divākīrtyam | tadetenaiva vratenāgopāyat | tasmādetadvrataṃ cāryam | tejaso gopīthāya | tasmādetāni yajūṃṣi vibhrājaḥ sauryasyetyāhuḥ | svāhā tvā sūryasya raśmibhya iti prātassaṃ sādayati | svāhā tvā nakṣatrebhya iti sāyam | etā vā etasya devatāḥ | tābhirevainaṃ samardhayati
meaning: संवथ्सरं न मांसमश्ञीयात् | न रामामुपेयात् | न मृन्मयेन पिबेत् | नास्य राम उच्छिष्टं पिबेत् | तेज एव तथ्संश्यति | देवासुरास्संयत्ता आसन्न् | ते देवा विजयमुपयन्तः | विभ्राजि सौर्ये ब्रह्म संन्यदधत | यत्किंच दिवाकीर्त्यम् | तदेतेनैव व्रतेनागोपायत् | तस्मादेतद्व्रतं चार्यम् | तेजसो गोपीथाय | तस्मादेतानि यजूंषि विभ्राजः सौर्यस्येत्याहुः | स्वाहा त्वा सूर्यस्य रश्मिभ्य इति प्रातस्सं सादयति | स्वाहा त्वा नक्षत्रेभ्य इति सायम् | एता वा एतस्य देवताः | ताभिरेवैनं समर्धयति
text_mt: For a year he should not eat meat, he should not approach a low-caste woman, he should not drink from an earthen vessel, nor should a low-caste person drink his leftovers. Thus he sharpens brilliance. The gods and the asuras were in conflict. The gods, striving for victory, deposited their sacred lore in the gleaming solar power, along with whatever was to be chanted by day. By this observance they protected it. Therefore this observance is to be kept, to guard brilliance. Therefore they say that these yajuses belong to the gleaming solar power. In the morning he places it with: 'Svāhā to thee, to the rays of the sun!' In the evening with: 'Svāhā to thee, to the constellations!' These are indeed its deities; with them he enriches it. 'The Aśvins did,' he said; 'Go to the quarters,' he said; 'of the fathers'; he makes it swell within the enclosing sticks; 'Hold,' he said; 'voices'; 'drinkers of gharma, to them he offers it'; 'he should look after'; 'Is it to be offered?'; 'in Agni,' he said; 'they place; he protected', and seven.

sanskrit_iast: gharma yā te divi śugiti tisra āhutīrjuhoti | chandobhirevāsyaibhyo lokebhyaḥ śucamavayajate | iyatyagre juhoti | atheyatyatheyati | traya ime lokāḥ | ebhya eva lokebhyaḥ śucamavayajate | anu no'dyānumatirityāhānumatyai | divastvā paraspāyā ityāha | diva evemān lokāndādhāra | brahmaṇastvā paraspāyā ityāha
meaning: घर्म या ते दिवि शुगिति तिस्र आहुतीर्जुहोति | छन्दोभिरेवास्यैभ्यो लोकेभ्यः शुचमवयजते | इयत्यग्रे जुहोति | अथेयत्यथेयति | त्रय इमे लोकाः | एभ्य एव लोकेभ्यः शुचमवयजते | अनु नोऽद्यानुमतिरित्याहानुमत्यै | दिवस्त्वा परस्पाया इत्याह | दिव एवेमान् लोकान्दाधार | ब्रह्मणस्त्वा परस्पाया इत्याह
text_mt: With 'O gharma, what grief of thine is in the sky,' he offers three oblations. By means of the meters, he removes grief from these worlds for him. First he offers [a stick] of such size, then of such size, then of such size. These worlds are three; he removes grief from these worlds. With 'May Anumati favor us today,' he offers for Anumati's favor. He says: 'Thee for the distant protection of heaven.' From heaven he upholds these worlds. He says: 'Thee for the distant protection of brahman.'

sanskrit_iast: eṣveva lokeṣu prajā dādhāra | prāṇasya tvā paraspāyā ityāha | prajāsveva prāṇāndādhāra | śiro vā etadyajñasya | yatpravargyaḥ | asau khalu vā ādityaḥ pravargyaḥ | taṃ yaddakṣiṇā pratyañcamudañcamudvāsayet | jihmaṃ yajñasya śiro haret | prāñcamudvāsayati | purastādeva yajñasya śiraḥ pratidadhāti
meaning: एष्वेव लोकेषु प्रजा दाधार | प्राणस्य त्वा परस्पाया इत्याह | प्रजास्वेव प्राणान्दाधार | शिरो वा एतद्यज्ञस्य | यत्प्रवर्ग्यः | असौ खलु वा आदित्यः प्रवर्ग्यः | तं यद्दक्षिणा प्रत्यञ्चमुदञ्चमुद्वासयेत् | जिह्मं यज्ञस्य शिरो हरेत् | प्राञ्चमुद्वासयति | पुरस्तादेव यज्ञस्य शिरः प्रतिदधाति
text_mt:
In these worlds he upholds creatures. He says: 'Thee for the distant protection of breath.' In creatures he upholds the vital breaths. The head of the sacrifice is indeed this: the pravargya. Yonder Āditya is indeed the pravargya. If he were to remove it to the south, to the west, or to the north, he would lead the head of the sacrifice awry. He removes it to the east; in front he replaces the head of the sacrifice.

He removes it to the east; therefore yonder Āditya rises in the east. They carry along the tongs, the supporting implements, the fans, and the fire-stirrers. He makes it possessed of its self, possessed of its body. Possessed of his self does he become in yonder world, who knows this. They are made of udumbara wood. Udumbara is vigor; he obtains vigor. Following along the path,

sanskrit_iast: prāñcamudvāsayati | tasmādasāvādityaḥ purastādudeti | śaphopayamāndhavitrāṇi dhṛṣṭī ityanvavaharanti | sātmānamevainaṃ satanuṃ karoti | sātmā'muṣmiṃ lloke bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | audumbarāṇi bhavanti | ūrgvā udumbaraḥ | ūrjamevāvarundhe | vartmanā vā anvitya
meaning: प्राञ्चमुद्वासयति | तस्मादसावादित्यः पुरस्तादुदेति | शफोपयमान्धवित्राणि धृष्टी इत्यन्ववहरन्ति | सात्मानमेवैनं सतनुं करोति | सात्माऽमुष्मिं ल्लोके भवति | य एवं वेद | औदुम्बराणि भवन्ति | ऊर्ग्वा उदुम्बरः | ऊर्जमेवावरुन्धे | वर्त्मना वा अन्वित्य

sanskrit_iast: yajñaṃ rakṣāṃsi jighāṃsanti | sāmnā prastotā'nvavaiti | sāma vai rakṣohā | rakṣasāmapahatyai | trirnidhanamupaiti | traya ime lokāḥ | ebhya eva lokebhyo rakṣāṃsyapahanti | puruṣaḥ puruṣo nidhanamupaiti | puruṣaḥ puruṣo hi rakṣasvī | rakṣasāmapahatyai
meaning: यज्ञं रक्षांसि जिघांसन्ति | साम्ना प्रस्तोताऽन्ववैति | साम वै रक्षोहा | रक्षसामपहत्यै | त्रिर्निधनमुपैति | त्रय इमे लोकाः | एभ्य एव लोकेभ्यो रक्षांस्यपहन्ति | पुरुषः पुरुषो निधनमुपैति | पुरुषः पुरुषो हि रक्षस्वी | रक्षसामपहत्यै
text_mt: the rakṣases seek to destroy the sacrifice. The Prastotṛ accompanies it with a sāman. The sāman is indeed a slayer of rakṣases, for the destruction of the rakṣases. He performs the finale three times. These worlds are three; he destroys the rakṣases from these worlds. Man by man, he performs the finale, for man by man is possessed by rakṣases, for the destruction of the rakṣases.

sanskrit_iast: yatpṛthivyāmudvāsayet | pṛthivīṃ śucā'rpayet | yadapsu | apaḥ śucā'rpayet | yadoṣadhīṣu | oṣadhīḥ śucā'rpayet | yadvanaspatiṣu | vanaspatīñchucā'rpayet | hiraṇyaṃ nidhāyodvāsayati | amṛtaṃ vai hiraṇyam
meaning: यत्पृथिव्यामुद्वासयेत् | पृथिवीं शुचाऽर्पयेत् | यदप्सु | अपः शुचाऽर्पयेत् | यदोषधीषु | ओषधीः शुचाऽर्पयेत् | यद्वनस्पतिषु | वनस्पतीञ्छुचाऽर्पयेत् | हिरण्यं निधायोद्वासयति | अमृतं वै हिरण्यम्
text_mt: If he were to remove it on the earth, he would afflict the earth with heat. If in the waters, he would afflict the waters with heat. If among plants, he would afflict plants with heat. If among trees, he would afflict trees with heat. Having laid down gold, he removes it. Gold is indeed immortal life;

sanskrit_iast: amṛta evainaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati | valgurasi śaṃyudhāyā iti triḥ pariṣiñcanparyeti | trivṛdvā agniḥ | yāvānevāgniḥ | tasya śucaṃ śamayati | triḥ punaḥ paryeti | ṣaṭtha saṃpadyante | ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtubhirevāsya śucaṃ śamayati | catussraktirnābhirṛtasyetyāha
meaning: अमृत एवैनं प्रतिष्ठापयति | वल्गुरसि शंयुधाया इति त्रिः परिषिञ्चन्पर्येति | त्रिवृद्वा अग्निः | यावानेवाग्निः | तस्य शुचं शमयति | त्रिः पुनः पर्येति | षट्थ संपद्यन्ते | षड्वा ऋतवः | ऋतुभिरेवास्य शुचं शमयति | चतुस्स्रक्तिर्नाभिरृतस्येत्याह
text_mt: he establishes it in immortal life. Saying 'Thou art attractive, bestower of peace,' he goes around sprinkling it three times. Agni is threefold; as great as Agni is, so he appeases his heat. He goes around three times more; they amount to six. There are six seasons; by the seasons he appeases his heat. He says: 'Four-cornered, the navel of cosmic order.'

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vā ṛtam | tasyā eṣa eva nābhiḥ | yatpravargyaḥ | tasmādevamāha | sado viśvāyurityāha | sado hīyam | apa dveṣo apa hvara ityāha bhrātṛvyāpanutyai | gharmaitatte'nnametatpurīṣamiti dadhnā madhumiśreṇa pūrayati | ūrgvā annādyaṃ dadhi | ūrjaivainamannādyena samardhayati
meaning: इयं वा ऋतम् | तस्या एष एव नाभिः | यत्प्रवर्ग्यः | तस्मादेवमाह | सदो विश्वायुरित्याह | सदो हीयम् | अप द्वेषो अप ह्वर इत्याह भ्रातृव्यापनुत्यै | घर्मैतत्तेऽन्नमेतत्पुरीषमिति दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण पूरयति | ऊर्ग्वा अन्नाद्यं दधि | ऊर्जैवैनमन्नाद्येन समर्धयति
text_mt: This [earth] is indeed truth. This very one is its navel, namely the pravargya. Therefore he speaks thus. "Seat of all life," he says, for this [earth] is a seat. "Away with hatred, away with malice!" he says, for the driving away of rivals. "O gharma, this is your food, this your rubbish," thus he fills [it] with curd mixed with honey. Curd is vigor, the eating of food; with vigor and with the eating of food he prospers him.

sanskrit_iast: anaśanāyuko bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | rantirnāmāsi divyo gandharva ityāha | rūpamevāsyaitanmahimānaṃ rantiṃ bandhutāṃ vyācaṣṭe | samahamāyuṣā saṃ prāṇenetyāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | vyasau yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma ityāha | abhicāra evāsyaiṣaḥ | acikradadvṛṣā harirityāha | vṛṣā hyeṣaḥ
meaning: अनशनायुको भवति | य एवं वेद | रन्तिर्नामासि दिव्यो गन्धर्व इत्याह | रूपमेवास्यैतन्महिमानं रन्तिं बन्धुतां व्याचष्टे | समहमायुषा सं प्राणेनेत्याह | आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते | व्यसौ योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्म इत्याह | अभिचार एवास्यैषः | अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिरित्याह | वृषा ह्येषः
text_mt: He does not become hungry who knows thus. "Delight by name are you, the heavenly gandharva," he says; thus he declares his form, his greatness, his delight, his kinship. "May I be united with lifespan, united with vital breath," he says; this very blessing he invokes. "Broken be that one who hates us and whom we hate!" he says; this is indeed his act of sorcery. "The virile bull, the tawny one, has roared," he says, for he is a bull,

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣā hariḥ | mahānmitro na darśata ityāha | stautyevainametat | cidasi samudrayonirityāha | svāmevainaṃ yoniṃ gamayati | namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīrityāhāhiṃsāyai | viśvāvasuṃ somagandharvamityāha | yadevāsya kriyamāṇasyāntaryanti | tadevāsyaitenāpyāyayati | viśvāvasurabhi tanno gṛṇātvityāha
meaning: वृषा हरिः | महान्मित्रो न दर्शत इत्याह | स्तौत्येवैनमेतत् | चिदसि समुद्रयोनिरित्याह | स्वामेवैनं योनिं गमयति | नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीरित्याहाहिंसायै | विश्वावसुं सोमगन्धर्वमित्याह | यदेवास्य क्रियमाणस्यान्तर्यन्ति | तदेवास्यैतेनाप्याययति | विश्वावसुरभि तन्नो गृणात्वित्याह
text_mt: a virile bull, tawny. "Great, lovely like Mitra," he says; thereby he indeed praises him. "You are thought, having the ocean as your womb," he says; he causes him to go to his own womb. "Homage be to you; do not harm me!" he says, for the sake of non-harm. "Viśvāvasu, the Soma-gandharva," he says; whatever of him as he is being made they interrupt, that very [part] he swells for him with this. "May Viśvāvasu proclaim that for us," he says;

sanskrit_iast: pūrvamevoditam | uttareṇābhigṛṇāti | dhiyo hinvāno dhiya inno avyādityāha | ṛtūnevāsmai kalpayati | prāsāṃ gandharvo amṛtāni vocadityāha | prāṇā vā amṛtāḥ | prāṇānevāsmai kalpayati | etattvaṃ deva gharma devo devānupāgā ityāha | devo hyeṣa sandevānupaiti | idamahaṃ manuṣyo manuṣyānityāha
meaning: पूर्वमेवोदितम् | उत्तरेणाभिगृणाति | धियो हिन्वानो धिय इन्नो अव्यादित्याह | ऋतूनेवास्मै कल्पयति | प्रासां गन्धर्वो अमृतानि वोचदित्याह | प्राणा वा अमृताः | प्राणानेवास्मै कल्पयति | एतत्त्वं देव घर्म देवो देवानुपागा इत्याह | देवो ह्येष सन्देवानुपैति | इदमहं मनुष्यो मनुष्यानित्याह
text_mt: what was spoken before, he confirms with what follows. "Urging our thoughts, may he protect our thoughts," he says; he arranges the seasons for him. "May the gandharva speak of their immortal [realms]," he says; the vital breaths are indeed immortal; he arranges the vital breaths for him. "Being a god, you have gone, O god gharma, to the gods," he says, for being a god, he goes to the gods. "Here I, a mortal, to mortals," he says;

sanskrit_iast: manuṣyo hi | eṣa sanmanuṣyānupaiti | īśvaro vai pravargyamudvāsayann | prajāṃ paśūnthsomapīthamanūdvāsaḥ somapīthānumehi | saha prajayā saha rāyaspoṣeṇetyāha | prajāmeva paśūnthsomapīthamātmandhatte | sumitrā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santvityāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | durmitrāstasmai bhūyāsuryo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma ityāha | abhicāra evāsyaiṣaḥ | pra vā eṣo'smāllokāccyavate | yaḥ pravargyamudvāsayati | udu tyaṃ citramiti saurībhyāmṛgbhyāṃ punaretya gārhapatye juhoti | ayaṃ vai loko gārhapatyaḥ | asminneva loke pratitiṣṭhati | asau khalu vā ādityassuvargo lokaḥ | yathsaurī bhavataḥ | tenaiva suvargāllokānnaiti
meaning: मनुष्यो हि | एष सन्मनुष्यानुपैति | ईश्वरो वै प्रवर्ग्यमुद्वासयन्न् | प्रजां पशून्थ्सोमपीथमनूद्वासः सोमपीथानुमेहि | सह प्रजया सह रायस्पोषेणेत्याह | प्रजामेव पशून्थ्सोमपीथमात्मन्धत्ते | सुमित्रा न आप ओषधयः सन्त्वित्याह | आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते | दुर्मित्रास्तस्मै भूयासुर्योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्म इत्याह | अभिचार एवास्यैषः | प्र वा एषोऽस्माल्लोकाच्च्यवते | यः प्रवर्ग्यमुद्वासयति | उदु त्यं चित्रमिति सौरीभ्यामृग्भ्यां पुनरेत्य गार्हपत्ये जुहोति | अयं वै लोको गार्हपत्यः | अस्मिन्नेव लोके प्रतितिष्ठति | असौ खलु वा आदित्यस्सुवर्गो लोकः | यथ्सौरी भवतः | तेनैव सुवर्गाल्लोकान्नैति
text_mt: for he, being a mortal, goes to mortals. Being capable of it, when removing the pravargya, "Following after the offspring, the cattle, the drinking of Soma, remove yourself; come after the drinking of Soma with offspring, with increase of wealth," he says; he places offspring, cattle, and the drinking of Soma in himself. "May waters and plants be friendly to us," he says; this very blessing he invokes. "May they be unfriendly to him who hates us and whom we hate," he says; this is his act of sorcery. He departs from this world who removes the pravargya. Returning, he offers in the gārhapatya with two verses to Sūrya, beginning with "Up that wondrous [banner of the gods]" and "[The wondrous face of the gods has arisen]"; this world is the gārhapatya; he is established in this very world. That Āditya indeed is the heaven-world; because there are two [verses] to Sūrya, he does not depart from the heaven-world. "From brahman, your protector from afar," he says; he places; following; with rakṣas, for the slaying of rakṣas; gold; he says; for he causes to prosper; "may he proclaim," he says; "to mortals," he says; his this; and eight.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiṃ vai devāḥ śukraṃ payo'duhrann | tadebhyo na vyabhavat | tadagnirvyakarot | tāni śukriyāṇi sāmānyabhavann | teṣāṃ yo raso'tyakṣarat | tāni śukrayajūgṣyabhavan | śukriyāṇāṃ vā etāni śukriyāṇi | sāmapayasaṃ vā etayoranyat | devānāmanyatpayaḥ | yadgoḥ payaḥ
meaning: प्रजापतिं वै देवाः शुक्रं पयोऽदुह्रन्न् | तदेभ्यो न व्यभवत् | तदग्निर्व्यकरोत् | तानि शुक्रियाणि सामान्यभवन्न् | तेषां यो रसोऽत्यक्षरत् | तानि शुक्रयजूग्ष्यभवन् | शुक्रियाणां वा एतानि शुक्रियाणि | सामपयसं वा एतयोरन्यत् | देवानामन्यत्पयः | यद्गोः पयः
text_mt: The gods indeed milked Prajāpati as pure milk. That was not sufficient for them. Agni separated it. They became the pure sāmans. The essence of them which flowed over became the pure yajuses. These are the pure [portions] of the pure [sāmans]. One of these two is the milk of the sāman, the other the milk of the gods. The milk which is of the cow,

sanskrit_iast: tathsāmnaḥ payaḥ | yadajāyai payaḥ | taddevānāṃ payaḥ | tasmādyatraitairyajurbhiścaranti | tatpayasā caranti | prajāpatimeva taddevānpayasā'nnādyena samardhayanti | eṣa ha tvai sākṣātpravargyaṃ bhakṣayati | yasyaivaṃ viduṣaḥ pravargyaḥ pravṛjyate | uttaravedyāmudvāsayettejaskāmasya | tejo vā uttaravediḥ
meaning: तथ्साम्नः पयः | यदजायै पयः | तद्देवानां पयः | तस्माद्यत्रैतैर्यजुर्भिश्चरन्ति | तत्पयसा चरन्ति | प्रजापतिमेव तद्देवान्पयसाऽन्नाद्येन समर्धयन्ति | एष ह त्वै साक्षात्प्रवर्ग्यं भक्षयति | यस्यैवं विदुषः प्रवर्ग्यः प्रवृज्यते | उत्तरवेद्यामुद्वासयेत्तेजस्कामस्य | तेजो वा उत्तरवेदिः
text_mt: that is the milk of the sāman. The milk which is of the goat, that is the milk of the gods. Therefore wherever they perform [the rite] with these yajuses, there they perform [it] with milk. Thereby they prosper Prajāpati and the gods with milk and with the eating of food. He indeed partakes of the pravargya visibly, for whom, knowing thus, the pravargya is prepared. He should remove it upon the uttaravedi for one who desires splendor; the uttaravedi is splendor,

sanskrit_iast: tejaḥ pravargyaḥ | tejasaiva tejassamardhayati | uttaravedyāmudvāsayedannakāmasya | śiro vā etadyajñasya | yatpravargyaḥ | mukhamuttaravediḥ | śīrṣṇaiva mukhaṃ saṃdadhātyannādyāya | annāda eva bhavati | yatra khalu vā etamudvāsitaṃ vayāṃsi paryāsate | pari vai tāṃ samāṃ prajā vayāṃsyāsate
meaning: तेजः प्रवर्ग्यः | तेजसैव तेजस्समर्धयति | उत्तरवेद्यामुद्वासयेदन्नकामस्य | शिरो वा एतद्यज्ञस्य | यत्प्रवर्ग्यः | मुखमुत्तरवेदिः | शीर्ष्णैव मुखं संदधात्यन्नाद्याय | अन्नाद एव भवति | यत्र खलु वा एतमुद्वासितं वयांसि पर्यासते | परि वै तां समां प्रजा वयांस्यासते
text_mt: the pravargya is splendor; with splendor he prospers splendor. He should remove it upon the uttaravedi for one who desires food. That which is the pravargya is the head of the sacrifice; the uttaravedi is the mouth; by means of the head he puts together the mouth for the eating of food; he becomes an eater of food. Where birds sit around this [pravargya] when it is removed, birds indeed sit around the offspring for that year.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāduttaravedyāmevodvāsayet | prajānāṃ gopīthāya | puro vā paścādvodvāsayet | purastādvā etajjyotirudeti | tatpaścānnimrocati | svāmevainaṃ yonimanūdvāsayati | apāṃ madhya udvāsayet | apāṃ vā etanmadhyājjyotirajāyata | jyotiḥ pravargyaḥ | sva evainaṃ yonau pratiṣṭhāpayati
meaning: तस्मादुत्तरवेद्यामेवोद्वासयेत् | प्रजानां गोपीथाय | पुरो वा पश्चाद्वोद्वासयेत् | पुरस्ताद्वा एतज्ज्योतिरुदेति | तत्पश्चान्निम्रोचति | स्वामेवैनं योनिमनूद्वासयति | अपां मध्य उद्वासयेत् | अपां वा एतन्मध्याज्ज्योतिरजायत | ज्योतिः प्रवर्ग्यः | स्व एवैनं योनौ प्रतिष्ठापयति
text_mt: Therefore he should remove it only upon the uttaravedi, for the protection of the offspring. He should remove it either in the east or in the west. This light rises in the east; it sets in the west; he removes him along after his own womb. He should remove it in the midst of the waters; this light was born from the midst of the waters; the pravargya is light; he establishes him in his own womb.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dviṣyāt | yatra sa syāt | tasyāṃ diśyudvāsayet | eṣa vā agnirvaiśvānaraḥ | yatpravargyaḥ | agninaivainaṃ vaiśvānareṇābhipravartayati | audumbaryāṃ śākhāyāmudvāsayet | ūrgvā udumbaraḥ | annaṃ prāṇaḥ | śuggharmaḥ
meaning: यं द्विष्यात् | यत्र स स्यात् | तस्यां दिश्युद्वासयेत् | एष वा अग्निर्वैश्वानरः | यत्प्रवर्ग्यः | अग्निनैवैनं वैश्वानरेणाभिप्रवर्तयति | औदुम्बर्यां शाखायामुद्वासयेत् | ऊर्ग्वा उदुम्बरः | अन्नं प्राणः | शुग्घर्मः
text_mt: Whomever he hates, where that one may be, in that direction he should remove it. That which is the pravargya is Agni Vaiśvānara; with Agni Vaiśvānara he sets it rolling toward him. He should remove it upon an udumbara branch. The udumbara is vigor; food is vital breath; the gharma is burning heat.

sanskrit_iast: idamahamamuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya śucā prāṇamapi dahāmītyāha | śucaivāsya prāṇamapi dahati | tājagārtimārcchati | yatra darbhā upadīkasantatāssyuḥ | tadudvāsayedvṛṣṭikāmasya | etā vā apāmanūjjhāvaryo nāma | yaddarbhāḥ | asau khalu vā āditya ito vṛṣṭimudīrayati | asāvevāsmā ādityo vṛṣṭiṃ niyacchati | tā āpo niyatā dhanvanā yanti
meaning: इदमहममुष्यामुष्यायणस्य शुचा प्राणमपि दहामीत्याह | शुचैवास्य प्राणमपि दहति | ताजगार्तिमार्च्छति | यत्र दर्भा उपदीकसन्ततास्स्युः | तदुद्वासयेद्वृष्टिकामस्य | एता वा अपामनूज्झावर्यो नाम | यद्दर्भाः | असौ खलु वा आदित्य इतो वृष्टिमुदीरयति | असावेवास्मा आदित्यो वृष्टिं नियच्छति | ता आपो नियता धन्वना यन्ति
text_mt: "Here I burn up with burning heat the vital breath of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so," he says; with burning heat he burns up his vital breath; instantly he meets with ruin. Where darbha grass is infested with termites, there he should remove it for one who desires rain. Those which are darbha grass are named "the streams that flow after the waters". That Āditya indeed stirs up rain from here; that Āditya bestows rain upon him; those waters go restrained through the desert. / Milk of the cow; uttaravedi; they sit; he establishes; the gharma; they go.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatissaṃbhriyamāṇaḥ | saṃrāṭth saṃbhṛtaḥ | gharmaḥ pravṛktaḥ | mahāvīra udvāsitaḥ | asau khalu vāvaiṣa ādityaḥ | yatpravargyaḥ | sa etāni nāmānyakuruta | ya evaṃ veda | vidurenaṃ nāmnā | brahmavādino vadanti
meaning: प्रजापतिस्संभ्रियमाणः | संराट्थ् संभृतः | घर्मः प्रवृक्तः | महावीर उद्वासितः | असौ खलु वावैष आदित्यः | यत्प्रवर्ग्यः | स एतानि नामान्यकुरुत | य एवं वेद | विदुरेनं नाम्ना | ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति
text_mt: Being gathered together, [he is] Prajāpati; gathered together, he is the sovereign; placed on the fire, he is the gharma; removed, he is the mahāvīra. That Āditya indeed is this pravargya. He made these names. Whoever knows thus, they know him by name. The exponents of brahman say:

sanskrit_iast: yo vai vasīyāṃsaṃ yathānāmamupacarati | puṇyārtiṃ vai sa tasmai kāmayate | puṇyārtimasmai kāmayante | ya evaṃ veda | tasmādevaṃ vidvān | gharma iti divā''cakṣīta | samrāḍiti naktam | ete vā etasya priye tanuvau | ete asya priye nāmanī | priyayaivainaṃ tanuvā
meaning: यो वै वसीयांसं यथानाममुपचरति | पुण्यार्तिं वै स तस्मै कामयते | पुण्यार्तिमस्मै कामयन्ते | य एवं वेद | तस्मादेवं विद्वान् | घर्म इति दिवा'ऽचक्षीत | सम्राडिति नक्तम् | एते वा एतस्य प्रिये तनुवौ | एते अस्य प्रिये नामनी | प्रिययैवैनं तनुवा
text_mt: "He who approaches the better [person] according to his name, he indeed desires good fortune for him; they desire good fortune for him who knows thus." Therefore, knowing thus, one should declare him by day as "gharma", by night as "sovereign". These are his two dear bodies, these his two dear names; with his dear body

sanskrit_iast: priyeṇa nāmnā samardhayati | kīrtirasya pūrvā gacchati janatāmāyataḥ | gāyatrī devebhyo'pākrāmat | tāṃ devāḥ pravargyeṇaivānu vyabhavann | pravargyeṇāpnuvan | yaccaturviṃśatiḥ kṛtvaḥ pravargyaṃ pravṛṇakti | gāyatrīmeva tadanu vibhavati | gāyatrīmāpnoti | pūrvā'sya janaṃ yataḥ kīrtirgacchati | vaiśvadevaḥ saṃsannaḥ
meaning: प्रियेण नाम्ना समर्धयति | कीर्तिरस्य पूर्वा गच्छति जनतामायतः | गायत्री देवेभ्योऽपाक्रामत् | तां देवाः प्रवर्ग्येणैवानु व्यभवन्न् | प्रवर्ग्येणाप्नुवन् | यच्चतुर्विंशतिः कृत्वः प्रवर्ग्यं प्रवृणक्ति | गायत्रीमेव तदनु विभवति | गायत्रीमाप्नोति | पूर्वाऽस्य जनं यतः कीर्तिर्गच्छति | वैश्वदेवः संसन्नः
text_mt: and with his dear name he prospers him. His fame goes forth to the people before he arrives. The gāyatrī departed from the gods. The gods reached her by means of the pravargya; they obtained [her] by the pravargya. In that he prepares the pravargya twenty-four times, thereby he reaches the gāyatrī, he obtains the gāyatrī. His fame goes forth to the people before he arrives. Being set down, he belongs to the Viśvedevas.

sanskrit_iast: vasavaḥ pravṛktaḥ | somo'bhikīryamāṇaḥ | āśvinaḥ payasyānīyamāne | mārutaḥ kvathann | pauṣṇa udantaḥ | sārasvato viṣyandamānaḥ | maitraḥ śaro gṛhītaḥ | teja udyato vāyuḥ | hriyamāṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ | hūyamāno vāgghutaḥ
meaning: वसवः प्रवृक्तः | सोमोऽभिकीर्यमाणः | आश्विनः पयस्यानीयमाने | मारुतः क्वथन्न् | पौष्ण उदन्तः | सारस्वतो विष्यन्दमानः | मैत्रः शरो गृहीतः | तेज उद्यतो वायुः | ह्रियमाणः प्रजापतिः | हूयमानो वाग्घुतः
text_mt: When it is set on the fire, it is the Vasus; when it is scattered over, it is Soma; when the milk is poured in, it belongs to the Aśvins; / when boiling, it belongs to the Maruts; when bubbling over, it belongs to Pūṣan; when overflowing, it belongs to Sarasvatī; when the cream is taken, it belongs to Mitra; when lifted up, it is heat and Vāyu; / when carried, it is Prajāpati; when offered, it is speech offered.

sanskrit_iast: asau khalu vāvaiṣa ādityaḥ | yatpravargyaḥ | sa etāni nāmānyakuruta | ya evaṃ veda | vidurenaṃ nāmnā | brahmavādino vadanti | yanmṛnmayamāhutiṃ nāśnute'tha | kasmādeṣo'śnuta iti | vāgeṣa iti brūyāt | vācyeva vācaṃ dadhāti
meaning: असौ खलु वावैष आदित्यः | यत्प्रवर्ग्यः | स एतानि नामान्यकुरुत | य एवं वेद | विदुरेनं नाम्ना | ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति | यन्मृन्मयमाहुतिं नाश्नुतेऽथ | कस्मादेषोऽश्नुत इति | वागेष इति ब्रूयात् | वाच्येव वाचं दधाति
text_mt: That one indeed is this Āditya, that which is the pravargya. He assumed these names. He who knows thus, they know him by name. The knowers of brahman say: / 'Since an earthen vessel does not taste of the oblation, then / why does this one taste?' He should say, 'This is speech; / in speech alone he places speech.'

sanskrit_iast: tasmādaśnute | prajāpatirvā eṣa dvādaśadhā vihitaḥ | yatpravargyaḥ | yatprāgavakāśebhyaḥ | tena prajā asṛjata | avakāśairdevāsurānasṛjata | yadūrdhvamavakāśebhyaḥ | tenānnamasṛjata | annaṃ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpatirvāvaiṣaḥ
meaning: तस्मादश्नुते | प्रजापतिर्वा एष द्वादशधा विहितः | यत्प्रवर्ग्यः | यत्प्रागवकाशेभ्यः | तेन प्रजा असृजत | अवकाशैर्देवासुरानसृजत | यदूर्ध्वमवकाशेभ्यः | तेनान्नमसृजत | अन्नं प्रजापतिः | प्रजापतिर्वावैषः
text_mt: Therefore it tastes [the oblation]. Prajāpati indeed is this one arranged in twelve parts, that which is the pravargya. / That which is prior to the glances, by that he created offspring; by the glances he created the gods and the asuras; that which is above the glances, by that he created food. Food is Prajāpati. / This one indeed is Prajāpati. / They say: 'With the body, seated, being offered, speech offered, he places this.'

sanskrit_iast: savitā bhūtvā prathame'hanpravṛjyate | tena kāmāṃ eti | yaddvitīye'hanpravṛjyate | agnirbhūtvā devāneti | yattṛtīye'hanpravṛjyate | vāyurbhūtvā prāṇāneti | yaccaturthe'hanpravṛjyate | ādityo bhūtvā raśmīneti | yatpañcame'hanpravṛjyate | candramā bhūtvā nakṣatrāṇyeti
meaning: सविता भूत्वा प्रथमेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | तेन कामां एति | यद्द्वितीयेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | अग्निर्भूत्वा देवानेति | यत्तृतीयेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | वायुर्भूत्वा प्राणानेति | यच्चतुर्थेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | आदित्यो भूत्वा रश्मीनेति | यत्पञ्चमेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | चन्द्रमा भूत्वा नक्षत्राण्येति
text_mt: Having become Savitṛ, it is set on the fire on the first day; through that he attains desires. When it is set on the fire on the second day, having become Agni he attains the gods. When it is set on the fire on the third day, having become Vāyu he attains the vital breaths. / When it is set on the fire on the fourth day, having become Āditya he attains the rays. / When it is set on the fire on the fifth day, having become the moon he attains the lunar mansions.

sanskrit_iast: yatṣaṣṭhe'hanpravṛjyate | ṛturbhūtvā saṃvathsarameti | yathsaptame'hanpravṛjyate | dhātā bhūtvā śakvarīmeti | yadaṣṭame'hanpravṛjyate | bṛhaspatirbhūtvā gāyatrīmeti | yannavame'hanpravṛjyate | mitro bhūtvā trivṛta imān lokāneti | yaddaśame'hanpravṛjyate | varuṇo bhūtvā virājameti
meaning: यत्षष्ठेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | ऋतुर्भूत्वा संवथ्सरमेति | यथ्सप्तमेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | धाता भूत्वा शक्वरीमेति | यदष्टमेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | बृहस्पतिर्भूत्वा गायत्रीमेति | यन्नवमेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | मित्रो भूत्वा त्रिवृत इमान् लोकानेति | यद्दशमेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | वरुणो भूत्वा विराजमेति
text_mt: When it is set on the fire on the sixth day, having become the season he attains the year. When it is set on the fire on the seventh day, having become Dhātṛ he attains the śakvarī. / When it is set on the fire on the eighth day, having become Bṛhaspati he attains the gāyatrī. / When it is set on the fire on the ninth day, having become Mitra he attains these threefold worlds. / When it is set on the fire on the tenth day, having become Varuṇa he attains the virāj.

sanskrit_iast: yadekādaśe'hanpravṛjyate | indro bhūtvā triṣṭubhameti | yaddvādaśe'hanpravṛjyate | somo bhūtvā sutyāmeti | yatpurastādupasadāṃ pravṛjyate | tasmāditaḥ parāṅamūṃ llokāṃstapanneti | yadupariṣṭādupasadāṃ pravṛjyate | tasmādamuto'rvāṅimāṃ llokāṃstapanneti | ya evaṃ veda | aiva tapati
meaning: यदेकादशेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | इन्द्रो भूत्वा त्रिष्टुभमेति | यद्द्वादशेऽहन्प्रवृज्यते | सोमो भूत्वा सुत्यामेति | यत्पुरस्तादुपसदां प्रवृज्यते | तस्मादितः पराङमूं ल्लोकांस्तपन्नेति | यदुपरिष्टादुपसदां प्रवृज्यते | तस्मादमुतोऽर्वाङिमां ल्लोकांस्तपन्नेति | य एवं वेद | ऐव तपति
text_mt: When it is set on the fire on the eleventh day, having become Indra he attains the triṣṭubh. When it is set on the fire on the twelfth day, having become Soma he attains the Soma-pressing day. / When it is set on the fire before the upasads, therefore burning from here facing away he goes to yonder worlds; when it is set on the fire after the upasads, therefore burning from over there facing hither he goes to these worlds. He who knows thus indeed burns. / He attains the lunar mansions, he attains the virāj, he burns. || 12 || The gods indeed [went to] a satra; of Savitṛ; in the enclosed; O brahman, we shall proceed; may Agni [protect] you; head, neck; divine cord; all regions; O gharma, that which of you; Prajāpati; brilliant; Prajāpati being gathered; having become Savitṛ: twelve. || 12 || The gods indeed [went to] a satra; that acacia; in the enclosed; successively; then of the rakṣases; two summer [months] for him; brahman indeed of the gods; O Aśvins, drink the gharma; the vital breath indeed is the bull; Hari; who indeed to the wealthier according to the name: one hundred and eight. || 108 || The gods indeed [went to] a satra; he indeed burns.

sanskrit_iast: pareyuvāṃsaṃ pravato mahīranu bahubhyaḥ panthāmanapaspaśānam | vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā duvasyata | idaṃ tvā vastraṃ prathamaṃ nvāgannapaitadūha yadihābibhaḥ purā | iṣṭāpūrtamanusaṃpaśya dakṣiṇāṃ yathā te dattaṃ bahudhā vi bandhuṣu | imau yunajmi te vahnī asunīthāya voḍhave | yābhyāṃ yamasya sādanaṃ sukṛtāṃ cāpi gacchatāt | pūṣā tvetaścyāvayatu pravidvānanaṣṭapaśurbhuvanasya gopāḥ | sa tvaitebhyaḥ paridadāt pitṛbhyo'gnirdevebhyaḥ suvidatrebhyaḥ | pūṣemā āśā anuveda sarvāsso asmāṃ abhayatamena neṣat | svastidā aghṛṇissarvavīro'prayucchanpura etu pravidvān
meaning: परेयुवांसं प्रवतो महीरनु बहुभ्यः पन्थामनपस्पशानम् | वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानां यमं राजानं हविषा दुवस्यत | इदं त्वा वस्त्रं प्रथमं न्वागन्नपैतदूह यदिहाबिभः पुरा | इष्टापूर्तमनुसंपश्य दक्षिणां यथा ते दत्तं बहुधा वि बन्धुषु | इमौ युनज्मि ते वह्नी असुनीथाय वोढवे | याभ्यां यमस्य सादनं सुकृतां चापि गच्छतात् | पूषा त्वेतश्च्यावयतु प्रविद्वाननष्टपशुर्भुवनस्य गोपाः | स त्वैतेभ्यः परिददात् पितृभ्योऽग्निर्देवेभ्यः सुविदत्रेभ्यः | पूषेमा आशा अनुवेद सर्वास्सो अस्मां अभयतमेन नेषत् | स्वस्तिदा अघृणिस्सर्ववीरोऽप्रयुच्छन्पुर एतु प्रविद्वान्
text_mt: To him who passed away along the great slopes, spying out the path for many, / to the son of Vivasvat, the gatherer of people, king Yama, honor with an oblation. / This garment has now come to you first; cast off this which you wore here before. / Look along to the sacrifice and pious works, to the sacrificial gift, as was given by you in many ways among relatives. / I yoke these two draft-animals of yours to carry you to the life beyond, / by which you shall go to the seat of Yama and of the doers of good deeds. / May Pūṣan, all-knowing, whose cattle are not lost, guardian of the world, remove you hence; / may he deliver you to these fathers, and may Agni [deliver you] to the benevolent gods. / Pūṣan knows all these quarters; may he lead us by the most fearless [path]. / Giving well-being, glowing, with all heroes, unheedless, may the all-knowing one go before.

sanskrit_iast: āyurviśvāyuḥ paripāsati tvā pūṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt | yatrāsate sukṛto yatra te yayustatra tvā devassavitā dadhātu | bhuvanasya pata idaṃ haviḥ | agnaye rayimate svāhā | puruṣasya sayāvaryapedaghāni mṛjmahe | yathā no atra nāparaḥ purā jarasa āyati | puruṣasya sayāvari vi te prāṇamasisrasam | śarīreṇa mahīmihi svadhayehi pitṝnupa prajayā'smānihāvaha | maivaṃ māṃstā priye'haṃ devī satī pitṛlokaṃ yadaiṣi | viśvavārā nabhasā saṃvyayantyubhau no lokau payasā'bhyāvavṛthsva
meaning: आयुर्विश्वायुः परिपासति त्वा पूषा त्वा पातु प्रपथे पुरस्तात् | यत्रासते सुकृतो यत्र ते ययुस्तत्र त्वा देवस्सविता दधातु | भुवनस्य पत इदं हविः | अग्नये रयिमते स्वाहा | पुरुषस्य सयावर्यपेदघानि मृज्महे | यथा नो अत्र नापरः पुरा जरस आयति | पुरुषस्य सयावरि वि ते प्राणमसिस्रसम् | शरीरेण महीमिहि स्वधयेहि पितॄनुप प्रजयाऽस्मानिहावह | मैवं मांस्ता प्रियेऽहं देवी सती पितृलोकं यदैषि | विश्ववारा नभसा संव्ययन्त्युभौ नो लोकौ पयसाऽभ्याववृथ्स्व
text_mt: May the lifespan, the all-life, protect you round about; may Pūṣan protect you on the distant path ahead. / Where the doers of good deeds sit, where they have gone, there may the god Savitṛ place you. / O lord of the world, this is the oblation; svāhā to Agni the wealthy. / O female companion of the man, we wipe away the sins, / so that no other here of ours may go [hence] before old age. / O female companion of the man, I have released your vital breath; go to the earth with your body, go to the fathers with the svadhā-call, bring us here with offspring. / Do not think thus, O dear one; being a goddess when you go to the world of the fathers, / all-desirable, clothing yourself with the atmosphere, turn back to both our worlds with milk.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ nārī patilokaṃ vṛṇānā nipadyata upa tvā martya pretam | viśvaṃ purāṇamanupālayantī tasyai prajāṃ draviṇaṃ ceha dhehi | udīrṣva nāryabhi jīvalokamitāsumetamupaśeṣa ehi | hastagrābhasya didhiṣostvametatpatyurjanitvamabhi saṃbabhūva | suvarṇaṃ hastādādadānā mṛtasya śriyai brahmaṇe tejase balāya | atraiva tvamiha vayaṃsuśevā viśvāsspṛdho abhimātīrjayema | dhanurhastādādadānā mṛtasya śriyai kṣatrāyaujase balāya | atraiva tvamiha vayaṃ suśevā viśvāsspṛdho abhimātīrjayema | maṇiṃ hastādādadānā mṛtasya śriyai viśe puṣṭyai balāya | atraiva tvamiha vayaṃ suśevā viśvāsspṛdho abhimātīrjayema
meaning: इयं नारी पतिलोकं वृणाना निपद्यत उप त्वा मर्त्य प्रेतम् | विश्वं पुराणमनुपालयन्ती तस्यै प्रजां द्रविणं चेह धेहि | उदीर्ष्व नार्यभि जीवलोकमितासुमेतमुपशेष एहि | हस्तग्राभस्य दिधिषोस्त्वमेतत्पत्युर्जनित्वमभि संबभूव | सुवर्णं हस्तादाददाना मृतस्य श्रियै ब्रह्मणे तेजसे बलाय | अत्रैव त्वमिह वयंसुशेवा विश्वास्स्पृधो अभिमातीर्जयेम | धनुर्हस्तादाददाना मृतस्य श्रियै क्षत्रायौजसे बलाय | अत्रैव त्वमिह वयं सुशेवा विश्वास्स्पृधो अभिमातीर्जयेम | मणिं हस्तादाददाना मृतस्य श्रियै विशे पुष्ट्यै बलाय | अत्रैव त्वमिह वयं सुशेवा विश्वास्स्पृधो अभिमातीर्जयेम
text_mt: This woman, choosing the world of her husband, lies down beside you, the mortal who have died, / observing the universal ancient custom; bestow upon her here offspring and wealth. / Arise, O woman, toward the world of the living; you lie beside this one whose life has departed; come! / You have entered into this wifehood of a husband who takes your hand and desires you. / Taking the gold from the hand of the dead man, for splendor, for brahman, for heat, for strength: / right here, you, may we here, very gracious, conquer all rivals and adversaries. / Taking the bow from the hand of the dead man, for splendor, for the kṣatra, for vigor, for strength: / right here, you, may we here, very gracious, conquer all rivals and adversaries. / Taking the jewel from the hand of the dead man, for splendor, for the people, for nourishment, for strength: / right here, you, may we here, very gracious, conquer all rivals and adversaries.

sanskrit_iast: imamagne camasaṃ mā vijīhvaraḥ priyo devānāmuta somyānām | eṣa yaścamaso devapānastasmindevā amṛtā mādayantām | agnervarma pari gobhirvyayasva saṃprorṇuṣva medasā pīvasā ca | nettvā dhṛṣṇurharasā jarhṛṣāṇo dadhadvidhakṣyanparyaṅkhayātai | mainamagne vidaho mā'bhiśoco mā'sya tvacaṃ cikṣipo mā śarīram | yadā śṛtaṃ karavo jātavedo'themenaṃ prahiṇutātpitṛbhyaḥ | śṛtaṃ yadā'karasi jātavedo'themenaṃ paridattātpitṛbhyaḥ | yadā gacchātyasunītimetāmathā devānāṃ vaśanīrbhavāti | sūryaṃ te cakṣurgacchatu vātamātmā dyāṃ ca gaccha pṛthivīṃ ca dharmaṇā | apo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu pratitiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ | ajo'bhāgastapasā taṃ tapasva taṃ te śocistapatu taṃ te arciḥ | yāste śivāstanuvo jātavedastābhirvahemaṃ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokāḥ | ayaṃ vai tvamasmādadhi tvametadayaṃ vai tadasya yonirasi | vaiśvānaraḥ putraḥ pitre lokakṛjjātavedo vahemaṃ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokāḥ
meaning: इममग्ने चमसं मा विजीह्वरः प्रियो देवानामुत सोम्यानाम् | एष यश्चमसो देवपानस्तस्मिन्देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम् | अग्नेर्वर्म परि गोभिर्व्ययस्व संप्रोर्णुष्व मेदसा पीवसा च | नेत्त्वा धृष्णुर्हरसा जर्हृषाणो दधद्विधक्ष्यन्पर्यङ्खयातै | मैनमग्ने विदहो माऽभिशोचो माऽस्य त्वचं चिक्षिपो मा शरीरम् | यदा शृतं करवो जातवेदोऽथेमेनं प्रहिणुतात्पितृभ्यः | शृतं यदाऽकरसि जातवेदोऽथेमेनं परिदत्तात्पितृभ्यः | यदा गच्छात्यसुनीतिमेतामथा देवानां वशनीर्भवाति | सूर्यं ते चक्षुर्गच्छतु वातमात्मा द्यां च गच्छ पृथिवीं च धर्मणा | अपो वा गच्छ यदि तत्र ते हितमोषधीषु प्रतितिष्ठा शरीरैः | अजोऽभागस्तपसा तं तपस्व तं ते शोचिस्तपतु तं ते अर्चिः | यास्ते शिवास्तनुवो जातवेदस्ताभिर्वहेमं सुकृतां यत्र लोकाः | अयं वै त्वमस्मादधि त्वमेतदयं वै तदस्य योनिरसि | वैश्वानरः पुत्रः पित्रे लोककृज्जातवेदो वहेमं सुकृतां यत्र लोकाः
text_mt: Do not overturn this drinking vessel, O Agni; it is dear to the gods and to those who partake of Soma. / This drinking vessel, which is a drink for the gods—in it let the immortal gods rejoice. / Clothe yourself in Agni's armor against the cows; wrap yourself well in fat and suet, / lest the bold one, exulting with his flame, seizing [you] and intending to consume [you], should toss you about. / Do not burn him through, O Agni; do not scorch him; do not cast away his skin, nor his body. / When you make him cooked, O Jātavedas, then send him on to the fathers. / When you have made him cooked, O Jātavedas, then deliver him over to the fathers. / When he goes along this spirit-path, then he shall become a ruler of the gods. / Let your eye go to Sūrya, your breath to the wind; go to the sky and to the earth according to dharma. / Or go to the waters, if it is salutary for you there; stand firm in the plants with your limbs. / The unborn portion—burn that with your ascetic heat; let your glow burn that, [and] that flame of yours. / With those auspicious bodies of yours, O Jātavedas, carry this man to where the worlds of the righteous are. / This indeed is you; from him you come forth; this indeed is that; you are his womb. / May Vaiśvānara, a son making a world for his father, O Jātavedas, carry him to where the worlds of the righteous are. / Turning [to him] knowingly, may we overcome all rivals and foes; with limbs, and four.

sanskrit_iast: ya etasya patho goptārastebhyassvāhā ya etasya patho rakṣitārastebhyassvāhā ya etasya patho'bhirakṣitārastebhyassvāhā''khyātre svāhā'pākhyātre svāhā'bhilālapate svāhā'palālapate svāhā'gnaye karmakṛte svāhā yamatra nādhīmastasmai svāhā | yasta idhmaṃ jabharathsiṣvidāno mūrdhānaṃ vāta tapate tvāyā | divo viśvasmāthsīmaghāyata uruṣyaḥ | asmāttvamadhi jāto'si tvadayaṃ jāyatāṃ punaḥ | agnaye vaiśvānarāya suvargāya lokāya svāhā
meaning: य एतस्य पथो गोप्तारस्तेभ्यस्स्वाहा य एतस्य पथो रक्षितारस्तेभ्यस्स्वाहा य एतस्य पथोऽभिरक्षितारस्तेभ्यस्स्वाहा'ऽख्यात्रे स्वाहाऽपाख्यात्रे स्वाहाऽभिलालपते स्वाहाऽपलालपते स्वाहाऽग्नये कर्मकृते स्वाहा यमत्र नाधीमस्तस्मै स्वाहा | यस्त इध्मं जभरथ्सिष्विदानो मूर्धानं वात तपते त्वाया | दिवो विश्वस्माथ्सीमघायत उरुष्यः | अस्मात्त्वमधि जातोऽसि त्वदयं जायतां पुनः | अग्नये वैश्वानराय सुवर्गाय लोकाय स्वाहा
text_mt: To those who are the guardians of this path, svāhā! To those who are the protectors of this path, svāhā! To those who are the overseers of this path, svāhā! To the proclaimer, svāhā! To the denouncer, svāhā! To the babbler, svāhā! To the chatterer, svāhā! To Agni, the worker of deeds, svāhā! To him whom we do not remember here, svāhā! / He who brought you firewood, sweating, [holding] his head high, O wind, he burns for your sake; / protect him from every harm from the sky. / From this [man] you were born; from you let this [man] be born again. / To Agni Vaiśvānara, for the heavenly world, svāhā! / Those who of this; from you; five.

sanskrit_iast: pra ketunā bṛhatā bhātyagnirāvirviśvāni vṛṣabho roravīti | divaścidantādupa māmudānaḍapāmupasthe mahiṣo vavardha | idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃviśasva | saṃveśanastanuvai cāruredhi priyo devānāṃ parame sadhasthe | nāke suparṇamupa yatpatantaṃ hṛdā venanto abhyacakṣata tvā | hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yonau śakunaṃ bhuraṇyum | atidrava sārameyau śvānau caturakṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā | athā pitṝnthsuvidatrāṃ apīhi yamena ye sadhamādaṃ madanti | yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau caturakṣau pathirakṣī nṛcakṣasā | tābhyāṃ rājanparidehyenaṃ svasti cāsmā anamīvaṃ ca dhehi
meaning: प्र केतुना बृहता भात्यग्निराविर्विश्वानि वृषभो रोरवीति | दिवश्चिदन्तादुप मामुदानडपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध | इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा संविशस्व | संवेशनस्तनुवै चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे सधस्थे | नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तं हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा | हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युम् | अतिद्रव सारमेयौ श्वानौ चतुरक्षौ शबलौ साधुना पथा | अथा पितॄन्थ्सुविदत्रां अपीहि यमेन ये सधमादं मदन्ति | यौ ते श्वानौ यम रक्षितारौ चतुरक्षौ पथिरक्षी नृचक्षसा | ताभ्यां राजन्परिदेह्येनं स्वस्ति चास्मा अनमीवं च धेहि
text_mt: Agni shines forth with a lofty banner; the bull roars loudly, making all things manifest. / He has reached up to me even from the end of the sky; the buffalo has grown mighty in the lap of the waters. / This one [part] is yours; that other one beyond is yours; unite with the third light. / In entering [it], be lovely for your body, dear to the gods in the highest assembly. / When they beheld you in their hearts, yearning, flying up as a fair-winged bird to the firmament— / golden-winged, messenger of Varuṇa, the swift bird in the lap of Yama. / Run past the two dogs, the descendants of Saramā, four-eyed, brindled, along the good path. / Then go to the kindly fathers, who rejoice together in common feast with Yama. / Those two dogs of yours, O Yama, the guardians, four-eyed, path-protecting, men-watching: / entrust this man to them, O king, and grant him well-being and freedom from sickness.

sanskrit_iast: uruṇasāvasutṛpāvulumbalau yamasya dūtau carato'vaśāṃanu | tāvasmabhyaṃ dṛśaye sūryāya punardattāvasumadyeha bhadram | soma ekebhyaḥ pavate ghṛtameka upāsate | yebhyo madhu pradhāvati tāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt | ye yudhyante pradhaneṣu śūrāso ye tanutyajaḥ | ye vā sahasradakṣiṇāstāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt | tapasā ye anādhṛṣyāstapasā ye suvargatāḥ | tapo ye cakrire mahattāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt | aśmanvatī revatīḥ saṃrabhadhvamuttiṣṭhata prataratā sakhāyaḥ | atrā jahāma ye asannaśevāḥ śivān vayamabhi vājānuttarema
meaning: उरुणसावसुतृपावुलुम्बलौ यमस्य दूतौ चरतोऽवशांअनु | तावस्मभ्यं दृशये सूर्याय पुनर्दत्तावसुमद्येह भद्रम् | सोम एकेभ्यः पवते घृतमेक उपासते | येभ्यो मधु प्रधावति तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् | ये युध्यन्ते प्रधनेषु शूरासो ये तनुत्यजः | ये वा सहस्रदक्षिणास्तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् | तपसा ये अनाधृष्यास्तपसा ये सुवर्गताः | तपो ये चक्रिरे महत्तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् | अश्मन्वती रेवतीः संरभध्वमुत्तिष्ठत प्रतरता सखायः | अत्रा जहाम ये असन्नशेवाः शिवान् वयमभि वाजानुत्तरेम
text_mt: Broad-nosed, life-devouring, strong, the two messengers of Yama wander among men according to his will. / May they give back to us here, that we may see Sūrya, our good, rich in life! / For some Soma clarifies; some attend on ghee; / for those for whom honey flows forth—even to those let him go. / Those heroes who fight in battles, who cast away their bodies, / or who give thousands of sacrificial gifts—even to those let him go. / Those who are unassailable by their ascetic heat, who by ascetic heat have gone to heaven, / who have performed great ascetic heat—even to those let him go. / Grasp the stone-filled, rich [waters]; rise up, cross over, O friends! / Here let us leave behind those who are unkind; may we cross over to auspicious strengths.

sanskrit_iast: yadvai devasya savituḥ pavitraṃ sahasradhāraṃ vitatamantarikṣe | yenāpunādindramanārtamārtyai tenāhaṃ māṃsarvatanuṃ punāmi | yā rāṣṭrātpannādapayanti śākhā abhimṛtā nṛpatimicchamānāḥ | dhātustāssarvāḥ pavanena pūtāḥ prajayā'smānrayyā varcasā saṃsṛjātha | udvayaṃ tamasaspari paśyanto jyotiruttaram | devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam | dhātā punātu savitā punātu | agnestejasā sūryasya varcasā
meaning: यद्वै देवस्य सवितुः पवित्रं सहस्रधारं विततमन्तरिक्षे | येनापुनादिन्द्रमनार्तमार्त्यै तेनाहं मांसर्वतनुं पुनामि | या राष्ट्रात्पन्नादपयन्ति शाखा अभिमृता नृपतिमिच्छमानाः | धातुस्तास्सर्वाः पवनेन पूताः प्रजयाऽस्मान्रय्या वर्चसा संसृजाथ | उद्वयं तमसस्परि पश्यन्तो ज्योतिरुत्तरम् | देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम् | धाता पुनातु सविता पुनातु | अग्नेस्तेजसा सूर्यस्य वर्चसा
text_mt: The sieve of the divine Savitṛ, thousand-streamed, stretched out in the intermediate space, / with which he purified Indra who was afflicted from his distress—with that I purify myself, complete in all my body. / The branches which, touched [by death], fall away from the fallen realm, seeking a lord of men— / may Dhātṛ, with all of them purified by his purifying breeze, unite us with offspring, with wealth, with radiance. / Looking up from beyond the darkness to the higher light, / we have come to the god Sūrya among the gods, the highest light. / May Dhātṛ purify; may Savitṛ purify, / with the brilliance of Agni, with the splendor of Sūrya. / Grant; may we cross over; eight.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ te agnimamanthāma vṛṣabhāyeva paktave | imaṃ taṃ śamayāmasi kṣīreṇa codakena ca | yaṃ tvamagne samadahastvamu nirvāpayā punaḥ | kyāmbūratra jāyatāṃ pākadūrvāvyalkaśā | śītike śītikāvati hlāduke hlādukāvati | maṇḍūkyā susaṅgamayemaṃ svagniṃ śamaya | śaṃ te dhanvanyā āpaḥ śamu te santvanūkyāḥ | śaṃ te samudriyā āpaḥ śamu te santu varṣyāḥ | śaṃ te sravantīstanuve śamu te santu kūpyāḥ | śaṃ te nīhāro varṣatu śamu pṛṣvā'vaśīyatām
meaning: यं ते अग्निममन्थाम वृषभायेव पक्तवे | इमं तं शमयामसि क्षीरेण चोदकेन च | यं त्वमग्ने समदहस्त्वमु निर्वापया पुनः | क्याम्बूरत्र जायतां पाकदूर्वाव्यल्कशा | शीतिके शीतिकावति ह्लादुके ह्लादुकावति | मण्डूक्या सुसङ्गमयेमं स्वग्निं शमय | शं ते धन्वन्या आपः शमु ते सन्त्वनूक्याः | शं ते समुद्रिया आपः शमु ते सन्तु वर्ष्याः | शं ते स्रवन्तीस्तनुवे शमु ते सन्तु कूप्याः | शं ते नीहारो वर्षतु शमु पृष्वाऽवशीयताम्
text_mt: That fire of yours which we churned out, as if to cook for a bull— / that very one we extinguish for you with milk and with water. / That which you have burned, O Agni, do you yourself extinguish again; / let the kyāmbū plant grow here, the ripe dūrvā grass, and the vyalkaśā plant. / O cold one, possessing coolness, O refreshing one, possessing refreshment! / Having met well with the female frog, extinguish this fire of yours. / Auspicious to you be the waters of the desert; auspicious to you be those of the marsh; / auspicious to you be the waters of the sea; auspicious to you be those of the rain. / Auspicious to you be the flowing waters for your body; auspicious to you be those of the wells; / auspicious to you let the mist rain down; auspiciously let the frost fall.

sanskrit_iast: avasṛja punaragne pitṛbhyo yasta āhutaścarati svadhābhiḥ | āyurvasāna upayātu śeṣaṃ saṃgacchatāṃ tanuvā jātavedaḥ | saṃgacchasva pitṛbhissaṃ svadhābhissamiṣṭāpūrtena parame vyomann | yatra bhūmyai vṛṇase tatra gaccha tatra tvā devassavitā dadhātu | yatte kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda pipīlaḥ sarpa uta vā śvāpadaḥ | agniṣṭadviśvādanṛṇaṃ kṛṇotu somaśca yo brāhmaṇamāviveśa | uttiṣṭhātastanuvaṃ sambharasva meha gātramavahā mā śarīram | yatra bhūmyai vṛṇase tatra gaccha tatra tvā devassavitā dadhātu | idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃviśasva | saṃveśanastanuvai cāruredhi priyo devānāṃ parame sadhasthe | uttiṣṭha prehi pradravaukaḥ kṛṇuṣva parame vyoman | yamena tvaṃ yamyā saṃvidānottamaṃ nākamadhirohemam | aśmanvatī revatīryadvai devasya savituḥ pavitraṃ yā rāṣṭrātpannādudvayaṃ tamasaspari dhātā punātu | asmāttvamadhijāto'syayaṃ tvadadhijāyatām | agnaye vaiśvānarāya suvargāya lokāya svāhā
meaning: अवसृज पुनरग्ने पितृभ्यो यस्त आहुतश्चरति स्वधाभिः | आयुर्वसान उपयातु शेषं संगच्छतां तनुवा जातवेदः | संगच्छस्व पितृभिस्सं स्वधाभिस्समिष्टापूर्तेन परमे व्योमन्न् | यत्र भूम्यै वृणसे तत्र गच्छ तत्र त्वा देवस्सविता दधातु | यत्ते कृष्णः शकुन आतुतोद पिपीलः सर्प उत वा श्वापदः | अग्निष्टद्विश्वादनृणं कृणोतु सोमश्च यो ब्राह्मणमाविवेश | उत्तिष्ठातस्तनुवं सम्भरस्व मेह गात्रमवहा मा शरीरम् | यत्र भूम्यै वृणसे तत्र गच्छ तत्र त्वा देवस्सविता दधातु | इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा संविशस्व | संवेशनस्तनुवै चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे सधस्थे | उत्तिष्ठ प्रेहि प्रद्रवौकः कृणुष्व परमे व्योमन् | यमेन त्वं यम्या संविदानोत्तमं नाकमधिरोहेमम् | अश्मन्वती रेवतीर्यद्वै देवस्य सवितुः पवित्रं या राष्ट्रात्पन्नादुद्वयं तमसस्परि धाता पुनातु | अस्मात्त्वमधिजातोऽस्ययं त्वदधिजायताम् | अग्नये वैश्वानराय सुवर्गाय लोकाय स्वाहा
text_mt: Release [him] again, O Agni, to the fathers—he who, offered to you, walks with ancestral offerings. / Wearing lifespan, let him reach what remains [of his family]; let him unite with his body, O Jātavedas! / Unite with the fathers, unite with the ancestral offerings, unite with what has been sacrificed and bestowed, in the highest firmament. / Go to that place on earth which you choose; there let the god Savitṛ place you. / What the black bird has pecked of you, or the ant, the snake, or the wild beast— / may Agni the all-devourer make that free from debt, and Soma who has entered into the brāhmaṇa. / Rise up from here, gather your body together; do not leave a limb or a body behind here. / Go to that place on earth which you choose; there let the god Savitṛ place you. / This one [part] is yours; that other one beyond is yours; unite with the third light; / in entering [it], be lovely for your body, dear to the gods in the highest assembly. / Rise up, go forth, run forward, make an abode in the highest firmament! / In agreement with Yama and Yamī, ascend this highest heaven! / Stone-filled, rich; the sieve of the divine Savitṛ; which from the fallen realm; looking up from beyond the darkness; may Dhātṛ purify. / From this [man] you were born; let this [man] be born from you. / To Agni Vaiśvānara, for the heavenly world, svāhā! / Let fall; in the assembly; and five.

sanskrit_iast: āyātu devassumanābhirūtibhiryamo ha veha prayatābhiraktā | āsīdatāṃ suprayate ha barhiṣyūrjāya jātyai mama śatruhatyai | yame iva yatamāne yadaitaṃ pra vāṃ bharanmānuṣā devayantaḥ | āsīdataṃ svamu lokaṃ vidāne svāsasthe bhavatamindave naḥ | yamāya somaṃsunuta yamāya juhutā haviḥ | yamaṃha yajño gacchatyagnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ | yamāya ghṛtavaddhavirjuhota pra ca tiṣṭhata | sa no deveṣvāyamaddīrghamāyuḥ prajīvase | yamāya madhumattamaṃ rājñe havyaṃ juhotana | idaṃ nama ṛṣibhyaḥ pūrvajebhyaḥ pūrvebhyaḥ pathikṛdbhyaḥ
meaning: आयातु देवस्सुमनाभिरूतिभिर्यमो ह वेह प्रयताभिरक्ता | आसीदतां सुप्रयते ह बर्हिष्यूर्जाय जात्यै मम शत्रुहत्यै | यमे इव यतमाने यदैतं प्र वां भरन्मानुषा देवयन्तः | आसीदतं स्वमु लोकं विदाने स्वासस्थे भवतमिन्दवे नः | यमाय सोमंसुनुत यमाय जुहुता हविः | यमंह यज्ञो गच्छत्यग्निदूतो अरंकृतः | यमाय घृतवद्धविर्जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत | स नो देवेष्वायमद्दीर्घमायुः प्रजीवसे | यमाय मधुमत्तमं राज्ञे हव्यं जुहोतन | इदं नम ऋषिभ्यः पूर्वजेभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यः पथिकृद्भ्यः
text_mt: May the god Yama come here with well-minded aids, anointed with offerings! / May both sit on the well-prepared sacrificial grass for strength, for our family, for slaying my enemies! / When you two strove like twin [horses], the god-fearing mortals brought you forth. / Sit down in your own world, knowing [it], be well-seated for our Soma! / Press the Soma for Yama, offer the oblation to Yama! / To Yama goes the sacrifice made ready, with Agni as its messenger. / Offer to Yama an oblation with ghee, and stand forth! / May he extend for us among the gods a long lifespan to live! / Offer the sweetest oblation to Yama the king! / Here is reverence to the earlier-born seers, the former path-makers!

sanskrit_iast: yo'sya kauṣṭhya jagataḥ pārthivasyaika idvaśī | yamaṃ bhaṅgyaśravo gāya yo rājā'naparodhyaḥ | yamaṃ gāya bhaṅgyaśravo yo rājā'naparodhyaḥ | yenāpo nadyo dhanvāni yena dyauḥ pṛthivī dṛḍhā | hiraṇyakakṣyānthsudhurān hiraṇyākṣānayaśśaphān | aśvānanaśyato dānaṃ yamo rājā'bhitiṣṭhati | yamo dādhāra pṛthivīṃ yamo viśvamidaṃ jagat | yamāya sarvamitrasthe yatprāṇadvāyurakṣitam | yathā pañca yathā ṣaḍyathā pañcadarṣayaḥ | yamaṃ yo vidyāthsa brūyādyathaika ṛṣirvijānate
meaning: योऽस्य कौष्ठ्य जगतः पार्थिवस्यैक इद्वशी | यमं भङ्ग्यश्रवो गाय यो राजाऽनपरोध्यः | यमं गाय भङ्ग्यश्रवो यो राजाऽनपरोध्यः | येनापो नद्यो धन्वानि येन द्यौः पृथिवी दृढा | हिरण्यकक्ष्यान्थ्सुधुरान् हिरण्याक्षानयश्शफान् | अश्वाननश्यतो दानं यमो राजाऽभितिष्ठति | यमो दाधार पृथिवीं यमो विश्वमिदं जगत् | यमाय सर्वमित्रस्थे यत्प्राणद्वायुरक्षितम् | यथा पञ्च यथा षड्यथा पञ्चदर्षयः | यमं यो विद्याथ्स ब्रूयाद्यथैक ऋषिर्विजानते
text_mt: He who is the sole controller of this earthly, granary-held world— / sing, O Bhaṅgyaśravas, of Yama, the king who cannot be held back! / Sing of Yama, O Bhaṅgyaśravas, the king who cannot be held back! / By whom the waters, the rivers, the deserts, by whom sky and earth are made firm! / Yama the king mounts the gift of horses: / golden-girthed, easy-yoked, golden-eyed, iron-hoofed, never perishing! / Yama has upheld the earth; Yama, all this moving world; / in Yama's realm rests all that breathes, protected by Vāyu! / As the five, as the six, as the fifteen seers— / whoever might know Yama, let him speak as the one seer knows!

sanskrit_iast: trikadrukebhiḥ patati ṣaḍurvīrekamidbṛhat | gāyatrī triṣṭupchandāṃsi sarvā tā yama āhitā | aharaharnayamāno gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ jagat | vaivasvato na tṛpyati pañcabhirmānavairyamaḥ | vaivasvate vivicyante yame rājani te janāḥ | ye ceha satyenecchante ya u cānṛtavādinaḥ | te rājanniha vivicyante'thā yanti tvāmupa | devāṃśca ye namasyanti brāhmaṇāṃścāpacityati | yasminvṛkṣe supalāśe devaiḥ saṃpibate yamaḥ | atrā no viśpatiḥ pitā purāṇā anuvenati
meaning: त्रिकद्रुकेभिः पतति षडुर्वीरेकमिद्बृहत् | गायत्री त्रिष्टुप्छन्दांसि सर्वा ता यम आहिता | अहरहर्नयमानो गामश्वं पुरुषं जगत् | वैवस्वतो न तृप्यति पञ्चभिर्मानवैर्यमः | वैवस्वते विविच्यन्ते यमे राजनि ते जनाः | ये चेह सत्येनेच्छन्ते य उ चानृतवादिनः | ते राजन्निह विविच्यन्तेऽथा यन्ति त्वामुप | देवांश्च ये नमस्यन्ति ब्राह्मणांश्चापचित्यति | यस्मिन्वृक्षे सुपलाशे देवैः संपिबते यमः | अत्रा नो विश्पतिः पिता पुराणा अनुवेनति
text_mt: Across the Trikadruka [days] flies the one great [sun] over the six wide spaces; / the gāyatrī, the triṣṭubh, the meters—all these are placed in Yama. / Day by day driving off cow, horse, person, and moving creation, / Vaivasvata Yama is not sated with the five human [races]. / In the realm of King Yama, son of Vivasvat, those people are set apart: / both those who seek here through truth and those who speak falsehood. / They, O king, are separated here, and then they approach you; / and those who pay reverence to the gods and honor the brāhmaṇas. / Beneath the tree of fair foliage where Yama drinks together with the gods, / there our father, lord of the clan, gazes after the ancients; / he gazes after those who know the path-makers.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānare haviridaṃ juhomi sāhasramuthsaṃ śatadhārametam | tasminneṣa pitaraṃ pitāmahaṃ prapitāmahaṃ bibharatpinvamāne | drapsaścaskanda pṛthivīmanu dyāmimaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrvaḥ | tṛtīyaṃ yonimanu saṃcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomyanu sapta hotrāḥ | imaṃ samudraṃ śatadhāramuthsaṃ vyacyamānaṃ bhuvanasya madhye | ghṛtaṃ duhānāmaditiṃ janāyāgne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyomann | apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto ye'tra stha purāṇā ye ca nūtanāḥ | ahobhiradbhiraktubhirvyaktaṃ yamo dadātvavasānamasmai | savitaitāni śarīrāṇi pṛthivyai māturupastha ādadhe | tebhiryujyantāmaghniyāḥ
meaning: वैश्वानरे हविरिदं जुहोमि साहस्रमुथ्सं शतधारमेतम् | तस्मिन्नेष पितरं पितामहं प्रपितामहं बिभरत्पिन्वमाने | द्रप्सश्चस्कन्द पृथिवीमनु द्यामिमं च योनिमनु यश्च पूर्वः | तृतीयं योनिमनु संचरन्तं द्रप्सं जुहोम्यनु सप्त होत्राः | इमं समुद्रं शतधारमुथ्सं व्यच्यमानं भुवनस्य मध्ये | घृतं दुहानामदितिं जनायाग्ने मा हिंसीः परमे व्योमन्न् | अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातो येऽत्र स्थ पुराणा ये च नूतनाः | अहोभिरद्भिरक्तुभिर्व्यक्तं यमो ददात्ववसानमस्मै | सवितैतानि शरीराणि पृथिव्यै मातुरुपस्थ आदधे | तेभिर्युज्यन्तामघ्नियाः
text_mt: I offer this oblation into Vaiśvānara, this thousandfold spring of a hundred streams; / in that swelling [spring] may he nourish father, grandfather, and great-grandfather! / The drop leaped down along the earth, along the sky, along this womb, and along the previous one; / along the third womb wandering, I offer the drop along with the seven priestly offices. / This ocean, this hundred-streamed spring, expanding in the middle of the world, / Aditi yielding ghee for the people—O Agni, harm her not in the highest firmament! / Go away, depart, crawl away from here, you who are ancient here and you who are new! / May Yama give him a resting-place, marked out by days, waters, and nights! / Savitṛ has placed these bones in the lap of mother earth; / to them let the cows be yoked!

sanskrit_iast: śunaṃ vāhāḥ śunaṃ nārāḥ śunaṃ kṛṣatu lāṅgalam | śunaṃ varatrā badhyantāṃ śunamaṣṭrāmudiṅgaya śunāsīrā śunamasmāsu dhattam | śunāsīrāvimāṃ vācaṃ yaddivi cakrathuḥ payaḥ | tenemāmupasiñcatam | sīte vandāmahe tvā'rvācī subhage bhava | yathā nassubhagā sasi yathā nassuphalā sasi | savitaitāni śarīrāṇi pṛthivyai māturupastha ādadhe | tebhiradite śambhava | vimucyadhvamaghniyā devayānā atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya | jyotirāpāma suvaraganma
meaning: शुनं वाहाः शुनं नाराः शुनं कृषतु लाङ्गलम् | शुनं वरत्रा बध्यन्तां शुनमष्ट्रामुदिङ्गय शुनासीरा शुनमस्मासु धत्तम् | शुनासीराविमां वाचं यद्दिवि चक्रथुः पयः | तेनेमामुपसिञ्चतम् | सीते वन्दामहे त्वाऽर्वाची सुभगे भव | यथा नस्सुभगा ससि यथा नस्सुफला ससि | सवितैतानि शरीराणि पृथिव्यै मातुरुपस्थ आदधे | तेभिरदिते शम्भव | विमुच्यध्वमघ्निया देवयाना अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्य | ज्योतिरापाम सुवरगन्म
text_mt: Prosperously let the draught-animals [draw], prosperously the men, prosperously let the plow furrow! / Prosperously let the straps be bound, prosperously raise the goad! / O Śunāsīra, bestow prosperity upon us! / O Śunāsīra, the milk which you two made in the sky— / with that sprinkle this [furrow]! / O Furrow, we praise you; turn favorably toward us, fortunate one, / so that you may be fortunate for us, so that you may be rich in fruit for us! / Savitṛ has placed these bones in the lap of mother earth; / through them, O Aditi, become auspicious! / Be unyoked, cows that travel the path of the gods; we have crossed to the far shore of this darkness! / We have attained light, we have gone to heaven!

sanskrit_iast: pra vātā vānti patayanti vidyuta udoṣadhīrjihate pinvate suvaḥ | irā viśvasmai bhuvanāya jāyate yatparjanyaḥ pṛthivīṃ retasā'vati | yathā yamāya hārmyamavapanpañca mānavāḥ | evaṃ vapāmi hārmyaṃ yathā'sāma jīvaloke bhūrayaḥ | citasstha paricita ūrdhvacitaḥ śrayadhvaṃ pitaro devatā | prajāpatirvassādayatu tayā devatayā | āpyāyasva saṃ te
meaning: प्र वाता वान्ति पतयन्ति विद्युत उदोषधीर्जिहते पिन्वते सुवः | इरा विश्वस्मै भुवनाय जायते यत्पर्जन्यः पृथिवीं रेतसाऽवति | यथा यमाय हार्म्यमवपन्पञ्च मानवाः | एवं वपामि हार्म्यं यथाऽसाम जीवलोके भूरयः | चितस्स्थ परिचित ऊर्ध्वचितः श्रयध्वं पितरो देवता | प्रजापतिर्वस्सादयतु तया देवतया | आप्यायस्व सं ते
text_mt: The winds blow forth, the lightnings flash, the plants shoot up, heaven swells! / Nourishment is born for the whole world when Parjanya favors the earth with seed. / Just as the five [tribes of] men built a mansion for Yama, / so do I build a mansion, so that we may be many in the world of the living! / You are piled, piled around, piled upward; rest [here], O fathers, [as] deities! / May Prajāpati settle you with that deity! / 'Swell up', 'May [the juices] flow together for you'— / cows, we have gone, and the seven.

sanskrit_iast: utte tabhnomi pṛthivīṃ tvatparīmaṃ lokaṃ nidadhanmo ahaṃriṣam | etāg sthūṇāṃ pitaro dhārayantu te'trā yamaḥ sādanātte minotu | upasarpa mātaraṃ bhūmimetāmuruvyacasaṃ pṛthivīṃ suśevām | ūrṇamradā yuvatirdakṣiṇāvatyeṣā tvā pātu nirṛtyā upasthe | ucchmañcasva pṛthivi mā vibādhithāḥ sūpāyanā'smai bhava sūpavañcanā | mātā putraṃ yathā sicā'bhyenaṃ bhūmi vṛṇu | ucchmañcamānā pṛthivī hi tiṣṭhasi sahasraṃ mita upa hi śrayantām | te gṛhāso madhuścuto viśvāhā'smai śaraṇāssantvatra | eṇīrdhānā hariṇīrarjunīssantu dhenavaḥ | tilavathsā ūrjamasmai duhānā viśvāhā santvanapasphurantīḥ
meaning: उत्ते तभ्नोमि पृथिवीं त्वत्परीमं लोकं निदधन्मो अहंरिषम् | एताग् स्थूणां पितरो धारयन्तु तेऽत्रा यमः सादनात्ते मिनोतु | उपसर्प मातरं भूमिमेतामुरुव्यचसं पृथिवीं सुशेवाम् | ऊर्णम्रदा युवतिर्दक्षिणावत्येषा त्वा पातु निरृत्या उपस्थे | उच्छ्मञ्चस्व पृथिवि मा विबाधिथाः सूपायनाऽस्मै भव सूपवञ्चना | माता पुत्रं यथा सिचाऽभ्येनं भूमि वृणु | उच्छ्मञ्चमाना पृथिवी हि तिष्ठसि सहस्रं मित उप हि श्रयन्ताम् | ते गृहासो मधुश्चुतो विश्वाहाऽस्मै शरणास्सन्त्वत्र | एणीर्धाना हरिणीरर्जुनीस्सन्तु धेनवः | तिलवथ्सा ऊर्जमस्मै दुहाना विश्वाहा सन्त्वनपस्फुरन्तीः
text_mt: I prop up the earth away from you; placing down this clod may I not be harmed! / May the fathers uphold this pillar for you; there let Yama build dwellings for you! / Approach this mother earth, the wide-extending, very kindly earth! / Soft as wool, a young woman rich in gifts, may she protect you from the lap of Nirṛti! / Arch upward, O earth, do not press down; be easy of approach to him, easy of access! / Cover him, O earth, as a mother covers her son with the hem of her garment! / Rising upward, O earth, do stand firm; let a thousand pillars be set up beside [him]! / May those dwellings, dripping with honey, be a refuge for him here for all days! / Let there be dappled, tawny, and white cows; / like cows with sesame-calves yielding strength to him, may they be unkicking for all days!

sanskrit_iast: eṣā te yamasādane svadhā nidhīyate gṛhe | akṣitirnāma te asau | idaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ prabharema barhirdevebhyo jīvanta uttaraṃ bharema | tattvamārohāso medhyo bhavaṃ yamena tvaṃ yamyā saṃvidānaḥ | mā tvā vṛkṣau saṃbādhiṣṭāṃ mā mātā pṛthivi tvam | pitṝn hyatra gacchāsyedhāsaṃ yamarājye | mā tvā vṛkṣau saṃbādhethāṃ mā mātā pṛthivī mahī | vaivasvataṃ hi gacchāsi yamarājye virājasi | naḷaṃ plavamārohaitaṃ naḷena patho'nvihi | sa tvaṃ naḷaplavo bhūtvā saṃtara pratarottara
meaning: एषा ते यमसादने स्वधा निधीयते गृहे | अक्षितिर्नाम ते असौ | इदं पितृभ्यः प्रभरेम बर्हिर्देवेभ्यो जीवन्त उत्तरं भरेम | तत्त्वमारोहासो मेध्यो भवं यमेन त्वं यम्या संविदानः | मा त्वा वृक्षौ संबाधिष्टां मा माता पृथिवि त्वम् | पितॄन् ह्यत्र गच्छास्येधासं यमराज्ये | मा त्वा वृक्षौ संबाधेथां मा माता पृथिवी मही | वैवस्वतं हि गच्छासि यमराज्ये विराजसि | नऌअं प्लवमारोहैतं नऌएन पथोऽन्विहि | स त्वं नऌअप्लवो भूत्वा संतर प्रतरोत्तर
text_mt: This funeral food is deposited for you in Yama's seat, in the house; / 'Imperishable' is your name, O so-and-so! / We would spread this sacrificial grass for the fathers; living, we would spread a further one for the gods. / Mount that [path], become fit for sacrifice, uniting with Yama, with Yamī! / Let the two trees not crush you, nor mother earth here! / For here you will go to the fathers, flourishing in Yama's kingdom. / Let the two trees not press upon you, nor mother earth the great! / For you will go to the son of Vivasvat; you shine as sovereign in Yama's kingdom. / Mount this reed-raft, follow the paths with the reed! / Having become a reed-raft, cross over, cross further, cross beyond!

sanskrit_iast: savitaitāni śarīrāṇi pṛthivyai māturupastha ādadhe | tebhyaḥ pṛthivi śambhava | ṣaḍḍhotā sūryaṃ te cakṣurgacchatu vātamātmā dyāṃ ca gaccha pṛthivīṃ ca dharmaṇā | apo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu pratitiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ | paraṃ mṛtyo anuparehi panthāṃ yaste sva itaro devayānāt | cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān | śaṃ vātaḥ śaṃhi te ghṛṇiḥ śamu te santvoṣadhīḥ | kalpantāṃ me diśaḥ śagmāḥ | pṛthivyāstvā loke sādayāmyamuṣya śarmāsi pitaro devatā | prajāpatistvā sādayatu tayā devatayā | antarikṣasya tvā divastvā diśāṃ tvā nākasya tvā pṛṣṭhe bradhnasya tvā viṣṭape sādayāmyamuṣya śarmāsi pitaro devatā | prajāpatistvā sādayatu tayā devatayā
meaning: सवितैतानि शरीराणि पृथिव्यै मातुरुपस्थ आदधे | तेभ्यः पृथिवि शम्भव | षड्ढोता सूर्यं ते चक्षुर्गच्छतु वातमात्मा द्यां च गच्छ पृथिवीं च धर्मणा | अपो वा गच्छ यदि तत्र ते हितमोषधीषु प्रतितिष्ठा शरीरैः | परं मृत्यो अनुपरेहि पन्थां यस्ते स्व इतरो देवयानात् | चक्षुष्मते शृण्वते ते ब्रवीमि मा नः प्रजां रीरिषो मोत वीरान् | शं वातः शंहि ते घृणिः शमु ते सन्त्वोषधीः | कल्पन्तां मे दिशः शग्माः | पृथिव्यास्त्वा लोके सादयाम्यमुष्य शर्मासि पितरो देवता | प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु तया देवतया | अन्तरिक्षस्य त्वा दिवस्त्वा दिशां त्वा नाकस्य त्वा पृष्ठे ब्रध्नस्य त्वा विष्टपे सादयाम्यमुष्य शर्मासि पितरो देवता | प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु तया देवतया
text_mt: Savitṛ has placed these bones in the lap of mother Earth. / Be auspicious to them, O Earth! / The six-hotṛ formula: May your eye go to Sūrya, your breath to Vāyu; go to the sky and to the earth in accordance with dharma. / Or go to the waters, if it is beneficial for you there; take your stand in the plants with your bodily parts. / Go along a farther path, O Death, which is your own, distinct from the path of the gods. / To you who have eyes and who hear, I say: Do not harm our offspring, nor our heroes! / May the wind be pleasant, pleasant for you the sunshine, and pleasant for you may the plants be! / May the regions be propitious and helpful to me! / I place you in the world of the earth; you are the shelter of so-and-so; the fathers are the deity. / May Prajāpati place you with that deity! / On the back of the intermediate space, on the back of the sky, of the quarters, of the firmament, on the summit of the bright sun I place you; you are the shelter of so-and-so; the fathers are the deity. / May Prajāpati place you with that deity! / unresisting, following, deity, and two.

sanskrit_iast: apūpavānghṛtavāṃścarureha sīdatūttabhnuvanpṛthivīṃ dyāmutopari | yonikṛtaḥ pathikṛtassaparyata ye devānāṃ ghṛtabhāgā iha stha | eṣā te yamasādane svadhā nidhīyate gṛhe'sau | daśākṣarā tāṃ rakṣasva tāṃ gopāyasva tāṃ te paridadāmi tasyāṃ tvā mā dabhanpitaro devatā | prajāpatistvā sādayatu tayā devatayā | apūpavāñchṛtavān kṣīravān dadhivān madhumāṃścarureha sīdatūttabhnuvanpṛthivīṃ dyāmutopari | yonikṛtaḥ pathikṛtassaparyata ye devānāṃ śṛtabhāgāḥ kṣīrabhāgā dadhibhāgā madhubhāgā iha stha | eṣā te yamasādane svadhā nidhīyate gṛhe'sau | śatākṣarā sahasrākṣarā'yutākṣarā'cyutākṣarā tāṃ rakṣasva tāṃ gopāyasva tāṃ te paridadāmi tasyāṃ tvāmādabhanpitaro devatā | prajāpatistvā sādayatu tayā devatayā
meaning: अपूपवान्घृतवांश्चरुरेह सीदतूत्तभ्नुवन्पृथिवीं द्यामुतोपरि | योनिकृतः पथिकृतस्सपर्यत ये देवानां घृतभागा इह स्थ | एषा ते यमसादने स्वधा निधीयते गृहेऽसौ | दशाक्षरा तां रक्षस्व तां गोपायस्व तां ते परिददामि तस्यां त्वा मा दभन्पितरो देवता | प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु तया देवतया | अपूपवाञ्छृतवान् क्षीरवान् दधिवान् मधुमांश्चरुरेह सीदतूत्तभ्नुवन्पृथिवीं द्यामुतोपरि | योनिकृतः पथिकृतस्सपर्यत ये देवानां शृतभागाः क्षीरभागा दधिभागा मधुभागा इह स्थ | एषा ते यमसादने स्वधा निधीयते गृहेऽसौ | शताक्षरा सहस्राक्षराऽयुताक्षराऽच्युताक्षरा तां रक्षस्व तां गोपायस्व तां ते परिददामि तस्यां त्वामादभन्पितरो देवता | प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु तया देवतया
text_mt: May the sacrificial pot, accompanied by cake and possessing clarified butter, sit down here, supporting the earth and the sky above. / Honoring, maker of the womb, maker of the path, you who are here the gods' share of clarified butter! / This svadhā is deposited for you in the house, in the dwelling of Yama, O so-and-so. / Having ten syllables: protect it, guard it, I entrust it to you; let not the fathers, the deities, harm you in it. / May Prajāpati place you with that deity! / May the sacrificial pot, accompanied by cake, boiled [rice], milk, curds, and honey, sit down here, supporting the earth and the sky above. / Honoring, maker of the womb, maker of the path, you who are here the gods' share of boiled [rice], share of milk, share of curds, share of honey! / This svadhā is deposited for you in the house, in the dwelling of Yama, O so-and-so. / Having a hundred syllables, having a thousand syllables, having ten thousand syllables, having imperishable syllables: protect it, guard it, I entrust it to you; let not the fathers, the deities, harm you in it. / May Prajāpati place you with that deity! / Accompanied by cake, so-and-so, ten.

sanskrit_iast: etāste svadhā amṛtāḥ karomi yāste dhānāḥ parikirāmyatra | tāste yamaḥ pitṛbhissaṃvidāno'tra dhenūḥ kāmadughāḥ karotu | tvāmarjunauṣadhīnāṃ payo brahmāṇa idviduḥ | tāsāṃ tvā madhyādādade carubhyo apidhātave | dūrvāṇāg stambamāharaitāṃ priyatamāṃ mama | imāṃ diśaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ bhūyiṣṭhā'nu virohatu | kāśānāg stambamāhara rakṣasāmapahatyai | ya etasyai diśaḥ parābhavannaghāyavo yathā te nābhavānpunaḥ | darbhāṇāg stambamāhara pitṛṇāmoṣadhīṃ priyām | anvasyai mūlaṃ jīvādanu kāṇḍamatho phalam
meaning: एतास्ते स्वधा अमृताः करोमि यास्ते धानाः परिकिराम्यत्र | तास्ते यमः पितृभिस्संविदानोऽत्र धेनूः कामदुघाः करोतु | त्वामर्जुनौषधीनां पयो ब्रह्माण इद्विदुः | तासां त्वा मध्यादाददे चरुभ्यो अपिधातवे | दूर्वाणाग् स्तम्बमाहरैतां प्रियतमां मम | इमां दिशं मनुष्याणां भूयिष्ठाऽनु विरोहतु | काशानाग् स्तम्बमाहर रक्षसामपहत्यै | य एतस्यै दिशः पराभवन्नघायवो यथा ते नाभवान्पुनः | दर्भाणाग् स्तम्बमाहर पितृणामोषधीं प्रियाम् | अन्वस्यै मूलं जीवादनु काण्डमथो फलम्
text_mt: These svadhā offerings of yours I make immortal, these parched grains which I scatter around here for you. / May Yama, in harmony with the fathers, make them for you here into cows that yield all desires! / The brāhmaṇas know you, O white one, as the milk of the plants; / from among them I take you to cover the sacrificial pots. / Bring a clump of dūrvā grass, this which is most dear to me; / may it grow abundantly following this direction of mortal men. / Bring a clump of kāśa grass for smiting the rakṣases, / so that those malicious ones who were ruined from this direction shall not arise again. / Bring a clump of darbha grass, the dear plant of the fathers; / may it live following its root, then its stalk, then its fruit!

sanskrit_iast: lokaṃ pṛṇa tā asya sūdadohasaḥ | śaṃ vātaḥ śaṃ hite ghṛṇiḥ śamu te santvoṣadhīḥ | kalpantāṃ te diśassarvāḥ | idameva meto'parāmārtimārāma kāṃcana | tathā tadaśvibhyāṃ kṛtaṃ mitreṇa varuṇena ca | varaṇo vārayādidaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ | ārtyai nirṛtyai dveṣācca vanaspatiḥ | vidhṛtirasi vidhārayāsmadaghā dveṣāṃsi śami śamayāsmadaghā dveṣāṃsi yava yavayāsmadaghā dveṣāṃsi | pṛthivīṃ gacchāntarikṣaṃ gaccha divaṃ gaccha diśo gaccha suvargaccha suvargaccha diśo gaccha divaṃ gacchāntarikṣaṃ gaccha pṛthivīṃ gacchāpo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu pratitiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ | aśmanvatī revatīryadvai devasya savituḥ pavitraṃ yā rāṣṭrātpannādudvayaṃ tamasaspari dhātā punātu
meaning: लोकं पृण ता अस्य सूददोहसः | शं वातः शं हिते घृणिः शमु ते सन्त्वोषधीः | कल्पन्तां ते दिशस्सर्वाः | इदमेव मेतोऽपरामार्तिमाराम कांचन | तथा तदश्विभ्यां कृतं मित्रेण वरुणेन च | वरणो वारयादिदं देवो वनस्पतिः | आर्त्यै निरृत्यै द्वेषाच्च वनस्पतिः | विधृतिरसि विधारयास्मदघा द्वेषांसि शमि शमयास्मदघा द्वेषांसि यव यवयास्मदघा द्वेषांसि | पृथिवीं गच्छान्तरिक्षं गच्छ दिवं गच्छ दिशो गच्छ सुवर्गच्छ सुवर्गच्छ दिशो गच्छ दिवं गच्छान्तरिक्षं गच्छ पृथिवीं गच्छापो वा गच्छ यदि तत्र ते हितमोषधीषु प्रतितिष्ठा शरीरैः | अश्मन्वती रेवतीर्यद्वै देवस्य सवितुः पवित्रं या राष्ट्रात्पन्नादुद्वयं तमसस्परि धाता पुनातु
text_mt: Fill the world; these are his well-milked streams. / May the wind be pleasant, pleasant for you the sunshine, and pleasant for you may the plants be! / May all the quarters be propitious to you! / May we avert this very misfortune, any other distress; / thus was it done by the two Aśvins, by Mitra and by Varuṇa. / May the varaṇa, the divine tree, ward it off; / the tree [shall protect] from distress, from Nirṛti, and from hatred. / You are the support, support us against evils and hatreds; O śamī, pacify our evils and hatreds; O barley (yava), ward off (yavaya) our evils and hatreds. / Go to the earth, go to the intermediate space, go to the sky, go to the quarters, go to heaven; go to heaven, go to the quarters, go to the sky, go to the intermediate space, go to the earth; or go to the waters, if it is beneficial for you there; take your stand in the plants with your bodily parts. / 'The stony [river] flows, full of wealth,' 'Whatever the sieve of the divine Savitṛ,' 'Which from the fallen kingdom,' 'Looking up beyond the darkness,' 'May Dhātṛ purify' / fruit, may purify.

sanskrit_iast: ārohatā''yurjarasaṃ gṛṇānā anupūrvaṃ yatamānā yatiṣṭa | iha tvaṣṭā sujanimā suratno dīrghamāyuḥ karatu jīvase vaḥ | yathā'hānyanupūrvaṃ bhavanti yathartava ṛtubhiryanti klṛptāḥ | yathā na pūrvamaparo jahātyevā dhātarāyūṃṣi kalpayaiṣām | na hi te agne tanuvai krūraṃ cakāra martyaḥ | kapirbabhasti tejanaṃ punarjarāyu gauriva | apa naḥ śośucadaghamagne śuśuddhyā rayim | apa naḥ śośucadaghaṃ mṛtyave svāhā | anaḍvāhamanvārabhāmahe svastaye | sa na indra iva devebhyo vahnissaṃpāraṇo bhava
meaning: आरोहता'ऽयुर्जरसं गृणाना अनुपूर्वं यतमाना यतिष्ट | इह त्वष्टा सुजनिमा सुरत्नो दीर्घमायुः करतु जीवसे वः | यथाऽहान्यनुपूर्वं भवन्ति यथर्तव ऋतुभिर्यन्ति क्लृप्ताः | यथा न पूर्वमपरो जहात्येवा धातरायूंषि कल्पयैषाम् | न हि ते अग्ने तनुवै क्रूरं चकार मर्त्यः | कपिर्बभस्ति तेजनं पुनर्जरायु गौरिव | अप नः शोशुचदघमग्ने शुशुद्ध्या रयिम् | अप नः शोशुचदघं मृत्यवे स्वाहा | अनड्वाहमन्वारभामहे स्वस्तये | स न इन्द्र इव देवेभ्यो वह्निस्संपारणो भव
text_mt: Ascend lifespan, choosing old age, striving in succession, as many as you are; / may Tvaṣṭṛ here, of good birth and rich in jewels, make long lifespan for you to live! / As the days come in succession, as the seasons proceed properly ordered with the seasons, / as the younger does not abandon the elder, so, O Dhātṛ, arrange the lifespans of these! / For no mortal, O Agni, has done violence to your body; / the monkey devours the burning point, like a cow [eating] her afterbirth again. / Burning away our evil, O Agni, purify wealth for us; / burning away our evil, svāhā to Death! / We take hold of the draft-ox for well-being; / may he, like Indra for the gods, be a bearer who carries us through!

sanskrit_iast: ime jīvā vi mṛtairāvavartinnabhūdbhadrā devahūtiṃ no adya | prāñjo'gāmā nṛtaye hasāya drāghīya āyuḥ pratarāṃ dadhānāḥ | mṛtyoḥ padaṃ yopayanto yadaima drāghīya āyuḥ pratarāṃ dadhānāḥ | āpyāyamānāḥ prajayā dhanena śuddhāḥ pūtā bhavatha yajñiyāsaḥ | imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi mā no'nu gādaparo ardhametam | śataṃ jīvantu śaradaḥ purūcīstiro mṛtyuṃ dadmahe parvatena | imā nārīravidhavāḥ supatnīrāñjanena sarpiṣā saṃmṛśantām | anaśravo anamīvāssuśevā ārohantu janayo yonimagre | yadāñjanaṃ traikakudaṃ jātaṃ himavataspari | tenāmṛtasya mūlenārātīrjambhayāmasi | yathā tvamudbhinathsyoṣadhe pṛthivyā adhi | evamima udbhindantu kīrtyā yaśasā brahmavarcasena | ajo'syajāsmadaghā dveṣāṃsi yavo'si yavayāsmadaghā dveṣāṃsi
meaning: इमे जीवा वि मृतैराववर्तिन्नभूद्भद्रा देवहूतिं नो अद्य | प्राञ्जोऽगामा नृतये हसाय द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरां दधानाः | मृत्योः पदं योपयन्तो यदैम द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरां दधानाः | आप्यायमानाः प्रजया धनेन शुद्धाः पूता भवथ यज्ञियासः | इमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि मा नोऽनु गादपरो अर्धमेतम् | शतं जीवन्तु शरदः पुरूचीस्तिरो मृत्युं दद्महे पर्वतेन | इमा नारीरविधवाः सुपत्नीराञ्जनेन सर्पिषा संमृशन्ताम् | अनश्रवो अनमीवास्सुशेवा आरोहन्तु जनयो योनिमग्रे | यदाञ्जनं त्रैककुदं जातं हिमवतस्परि | तेनामृतस्य मूलेनारातीर्जम्भयामसि | यथा त्वमुद्भिनथ्स्योषधे पृथिव्या अधि | एवमिम उद्भिन्दन्तु कीर्त्या यशसा ब्रह्मवर्चसेन | अजोऽस्यजास्मदघा द्वेषांसि यवोऽसि यवयास्मदघा द्वेषांसि
text_mt: These living ones have turned away from the dead; auspicious for us today has been the invocation of the gods. / We have gone forward to dance, to laughter, attaining a longer, further lifespan. / Obliterating the footstep of Death as we come, attaining a longer, further lifespan, / abounding in offspring and wealth, become pure, cleansed, worthy of sacrifice! / I place this perimeter for the living, lest any other of ours go to this region. / May they live a hundred full autumns; we conceal Death with a mountain. / Let these women, not widows, having good husbands, touch [their eyes] with ointment and clarified butter. / Free from tears, free from disease, having good comforts, let the wives ascend to the womb first. / The ointment which comes from Mount Trikakud, born from the Himavat, / with that root of immortality we crush the adversaries. / As you burst forth, O plant, upon the earth, / so may these burst forth with fame, renown, and spiritual luster. / You are the driver (aja): drive away (aja) our evils and hatreds; you are barley (yava): ward off (yavaya) our evils and hatreds. / be, we crush, and three.

sanskrit_iast: apa naḥ śośucadaghamagne śuśuddhyā rayim | apa naḥ śośucadagham | sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe | apa naḥ śośucadagham | pra yadbhandiṣṭha eṣāṃ prāsmākāsaśca sūrayaḥ | apa naḥ śośucadagham | pra yadagnessahasvato viśvato yanti sūrayaḥ | apa naḥ śośucadagham | pra yatte agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam | apa naḥ śośucadagham
meaning: अप नः शोशुचदघमग्ने शुशुद्ध्या रयिम् | अप नः शोशुचदघम् | सुक्षेत्रिया सुगातुया वसूया च यजामहे | अप नः शोशुचदघम् | प्र यद्भन्दिष्ठ एषां प्रास्माकासश्च सूरयः | अप नः शोशुचदघम् | प्र यदग्नेस्सहस्वतो विश्वतो यन्ति सूरयः | अप नः शोशुचदघम् | प्र यत्ते अग्ने सूरयो जायेमहि प्र ते वयम् | अप नः शोशुचदघम्
text_mt: Burning away our evil, O Agni, purify wealth for us; / burn away our evil! / With desire for good fields, with desire for good paths, and with desire for wealth, we sacrifice; / burn away our evil! / That the most praising among these and our patrons may advance; / burn away our evil! / That the patrons of Agni the powerful may go forth on every side; / burn away our evil! / That we, your patrons, O Agni, may be born forward, that we [may advance] for you; / burn away our evil!

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūrasi | apa naḥ śośucadagham | dviṣo no viśvato mukhā'ti nāveva pāraya | apa naḥ śośucadagham | sa nassindhumiva nāvayā'tiparṣā svastaye | apa naḥ śośucadagham | āpaḥ pravaṇādiva yatīrapāsmathsyandatāmagham | apa naḥ śośucadagham | udvanādudakānīvāpāsmathsyandatāmagham | apa naḥ śośucadagham | ānandāya pramodāya punarāgāg svāngṛhān | apa naḥ śośucadagham | na vai tatra pramīyate gauraśvaḥ puruṣaḥ paśuḥ | yatredaṃ brahma kriyate paridhirjīvanāya kamapa naḥ śośucadagham
meaning: त्वं हि विश्वतोमुख विश्वतः परिभूरसि | अप नः शोशुचदघम् | द्विषो नो विश्वतो मुखाऽति नावेव पारय | अप नः शोशुचदघम् | स नस्सिन्धुमिव नावयाऽतिपर्षा स्वस्तये | अप नः शोशुचदघम् | आपः प्रवणादिव यतीरपास्मथ्स्यन्दतामघम् | अप नः शोशुचदघम् | उद्वनादुदकानीवापास्मथ्स्यन्दतामघम् | अप नः शोशुचदघम् | आनन्दाय प्रमोदाय पुनरागाग् स्वान्गृहान् | अप नः शोशुचदघम् | न वै तत्र प्रमीयते गौरश्वः पुरुषः पशुः | यत्रेदं ब्रह्म क्रियते परिधिर्जीवनाय कमप नः शोशुचदघम्
text_mt:
For facing in all directions, you encompass [us] on every side: may evil blaze away from us! / Transport us across our enemies from every side as if in a boat: may evil blaze away from us!
Transport us across for our well-being as across the river in a boat: may evil blaze away from us!
As waters flow downhill, so may evil stream away from us: may evil blaze away from us! / As waters flow out from a raised grove, so may evil stream away from us: may evil blaze away from us!
For bliss, for delight, return to your own home: may evil blaze away from us!
Neither cow nor horse, nor person nor beast perishes there, / where this brahman is made as an enclosure for life: may evil blaze away from us!
[Verse-count: 'agham', 'aghaṃ', and four.]

sanskrit_iast: apaśyāma yuvatimācarantīṃ mṛtāya jīvāṃ pariṇīyamānām | andhena yā tamasā prāvṛtā'si prācīmavācīmavayannariṣṭyai | mayaitāṃ māṃstāṃ bhriyamāṇā devī satī pitṛlokaṃ yadaiṣi | viśvavārā nabhasā saṃvyayantyubhau no lokau payasā''vṛṇīhi | rayiṣṭhāmagniṃ madhumantamūrmiṇamūrjassantaṃ tvā payasopasaṃsadema | saṃ rayyā samu varcasā sacasvā nassvastaye | ye jīvā ye ca mṛtā ye jātā ye ca jantyāḥ | tebhyo ghṛtasya dhārayituṃ madhudhārā vyundatī | mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāg svasā''dityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ | pra ṇu vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa | pibatūdakaṃ tṛṇānyattu | omuthsṛjata
