meaning: अपश्याम युवतिमाचरन्तीं मृताय जीवां परिणीयमानाम् | अन्धेन या तमसा प्रावृताऽसि प्राचीमवाचीमवयन्नरिष्ट्यै | मयैतां मांस्तां भ्रियमाणा देवी सती पितृलोकं यदैषि | विश्ववारा नभसा संव्ययन्त्युभौ नो लोकौ पयसा'ऽवृणीहि | रयिष्ठामग्निं मधुमन्तमूर्मिणमूर्जस्सन्तं त्वा पयसोपसंसदेम | सं रय्या समु वर्चसा सचस्वा नस्स्वस्तये | ये जीवा ये च मृता ये जाता ये च जन्त्याः | तेभ्यो घृतस्य धारयितुं मधुधारा व्युन्दती | माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनाग् स्वसा'ऽदित्यानाममृतस्य नाभिः | प्र णु वोचं चिकितुषे जनाय मा गामनागामदितिं वधिष्ट | पिबतूदकं तृणान्यत्तु | ओमुथ्सृजत
text_mt:
We saw the young woman moving about, a living woman being led around for the dead. / You who are shrouded in blind darkness, going eastward, going downward for unharmedness: / with me as your companion, being borne along, when being a goddess you go to the world of the fathers, / all-desirable, clothing yourself with the atmosphere, cover both our worlds with milk. / Sitting on wealth, we would approach you with milk, Agni full of sweetness, surging, being full of vigor. / Unite us with wealth and with luster for our well-being. / Those who are living and those who are dead, those who are born and those to be born: / for them to hold a stream of ghee, the stream of sweetness trickles. / Mother of the Rudras, daughter of the Vasus, sister of the Ādityas, navel of immortality: / I now say to the attentive person: do not kill the cow, the guiltless Aditi. / Let her drink water; let her eat grass. / Om, release her! / [Verse-count: 'vadhiṣṭa' and two. 12.]

meaning: शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः | शं नो भवत्वर्यमा | शं न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः | शं नो विष्णुरुरुक्रमः | नमो ब्रह्मणे | नमस्ते वायो | त्वमेव प्रत्यक्षं ब्रह्मासि | त्वमेव प्रत्यक्षं ब्रह्म वदिष्यामि | ऋतं वदिष्यामि | सत्यं वदिष्यामि | तन्मामवतु | तद्वक्तारमवतु | अवतु माम् | अवतु वक्तारम् | ओं शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः
text_mt: May Mitra be propitious to us, propitious Varuṇa; may Aryaman be propitious to us; may Indra and Bṛhaspati be propitious to us; may Viṣṇu of wide stride be propitious to us. Homage to brahman! Homage to you, Vāyu! / You alone are the directly perceived brahman; I will declare you alone as the directly perceived brahman. I will speak the cosmic order; I will speak the truth. May that protect me; may that protect the speaker. May it protect me; / may it protect the speaker. Om, peace, peace, peace. / ['I will speak the truth', and five.]

text_mt: Om. We will explain phonetics: sound, tone, measure, force, melody, connection. Thus is declared the chapter on phonetics. / ['phonetics', five.]

sanskrit_iast: saha nau yaśaḥ | saha nau brahmavarcasam | athātassaṃhitāyā upaniṣadaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | pañcasvadhikaraṇeṣu | adhiloka madhijyautiṣa madhividya madhipraja madhyātmam | tā mahāsaṃhitā ityācakṣate | athādhilokam | pṛthivī pūrvarūpam | dyauruttararūpam | ākāśassandhiḥ
meaning: सह नौ यशः | सह नौ ब्रह्मवर्चसम् | अथातस्संहिताया उपनिषदं व्याख्यास्यामः | पञ्चस्वधिकरणेषु | अधिलोक मधिज्यौतिष मधिविद्य मधिप्रज मध्यात्मम् | ता महासंहिता इत्याचक्षते | अथाधिलोकम् | पृथिवी पूर्वरूपम् | द्यौरुत्तररूपम् | आकाशस्सन्धिः
text_mt: Together may fame be ours; together may splendor of brahman be ours. Now therefore we will explain the Upaniṣad of the Saṃhitā in five topics: concerning the worlds, concerning the lights, concerning knowledge, concerning offspring, concerning the self. These they call the great conjunctions. Now, concerning the worlds: earth is the prior form; the sky is the latter form; space is the junction;

sanskrit_iast: vāyussandhānam | ityadhilokam | athādhijyautiṣam | agniḥ pūrvarūpam | āditya uttararūpam | āpassandhiḥ | vaidyutassandhānam | ityadhijyautiṣam | athādhividyam | ācāryaḥ pūrvarūpam
meaning: वायुस्सन्धानम् | इत्यधिलोकम् | अथाधिज्यौतिषम् | अग्निः पूर्वरूपम् | आदित्य उत्तररूपम् | आपस्सन्धिः | वैद्युतस्सन्धानम् | इत्यधिज्यौतिषम् | अथाधिविद्यम् | आचार्यः पूर्वरूपम्
text_mt: Vāyu is the connection. Thus concerning the worlds. Now, concerning the lights: Agni is the prior form; / Āditya is the latter form; the waters are the junction; lightning is the connection. Thus concerning the lights. / Now, concerning knowledge: the teacher is the prior form;

sanskrit_iast: antevāsyuttararūpam | vidyā sandhiḥ | pravacanaṃ sandhānam | ityadhividyam | athādhiprajam | mātā pūrvarūpam | pitottararūpam | prajā sandhiḥ | prajananaṃ sandhānam | ityadhiprajam
meaning: अन्तेवास्युत्तररूपम् | विद्या सन्धिः | प्रवचनं सन्धानम् | इत्यधिविद्यम् | अथाधिप्रजम् | माता पूर्वरूपम् | पितोत्तररूपम् | प्रजा सन्धिः | प्रजननं सन्धानम् | इत्यधिप्रजम्
text_mt: the pupil is the latter form; knowledge is the junction; instruction is the connection. / Thus concerning knowledge. Now, concerning offspring: the mother is the prior form; the father is the latter form; offspring is the junction; procreation is the connection. Thus concerning offspring.

sanskrit_iast: athādhyātmam | adharā hanuḥ pūrvarūpam | uttarā hanuruttararūpam | vāksandhiḥ | jihvā sandhānam | ityadhyātmam | itīmā mahāsaṃhitāḥ | ya evametā mahāsaṃhitā vyākhyātā veda | sandhīyate prajayā paśubhiḥ | brahmavarcasenānnādyena suvargyeṇa lokena
meaning: अथाध्यात्मम् | अधरा हनुः पूर्वरूपम् | उत्तरा हनुरुत्तररूपम् | वाक्सन्धिः | जिह्वा सन्धानम् | इत्यध्यात्मम् | इतीमा महासंहिताः | य एवमेता महासंहिता व्याख्याता वेद | सन्धीयते प्रजया पशुभिः | ब्रह्मवर्चसेनान्नाद्येन सुवर्ग्येण लोकेन
text_mt: Now, concerning the self: the lower jaw is the prior form; the upper jaw is the latter form; speech is the junction; / the tongue is the connection. Thus concerning the self. These are the great conjunctions. He who knows these great conjunctions thus explained / is joined with offspring, with cattle, with splendor of brahman, with food to eat, with the heavenly world. / ['junction', 'the teacher is the prior form', 'thus concerning offspring', 'world'.]

sanskrit_iast: yaśchandasāmṛṣabho viśvarūpaḥ | chandobhyo'dhyamṛtāthsaṃ babhūva | sa mendro medhayā spṛṇotu | amṛtasya deva dhāraṇo bhūyāsam | śarīraṃ me vicarṣaṇam | jihvā me madhumattamā | karṇābhyāṃ bhūri viśruvam | brahmaṇaḥ kośo'si medhayā'pihitaḥ | śrutaṃ me gopāya | āvahantī vitanvānā
meaning: यश्छन्दसामृषभो विश्वरूपः | छन्दोभ्योऽध्यमृताथ्सं बभूव | स मेन्द्रो मेधया स्पृणोतु | अमृतस्य देव धारणो भूयासम् | शरीरं मे विचर्षणम् | जिह्वा मे मधुमत्तमा | कर्णाभ्यां भूरि विश्रुवम् | ब्रह्मणः कोशोऽसि मेधयाऽपिहितः | श्रुतं मे गोपाय | आवहन्ती वितन्वाना
text_mt: He who is the bull of the Vedic meters, multiform, who arose from the Vedic meters above the immortal: / may he, Indra, strengthen me with wisdom. May I, O god, become a bearer of the immortal. May my body be vigorous; may my tongue be sweetest; may I hear abundantly with my ears. You are the sheath of brahman, covered by wisdom; preserve what I have heard. Bringing and extending,

sanskrit_iast: kurvāṇā cīramātmanaḥ | vāsāṃ si mama gāvaśca | annapāne ca sarvadā | tato me śriyamāvaha | lomaśāṃ paśubhissaha svāhā | ā mā yantu brahmacāriṇassvāhā | vi mā''yantu brahmacāriṇassvāhā | pra mā''yantu brahmacāriṇassvāhā | damāyantu brahmacāriṇassvāhā | śamāyantu brahmacāriṇassvāhā
meaning: कुर्वाणा चीरमात्मनः | वासां सि मम गावश्च | अन्नपाने च सर्वदा | ततो मे श्रियमावह | लोमशां पशुभिस्सह स्वाहा | आ मा यन्तु ब्रह्मचारिणस्स्वाहा | वि मा'ऽयन्तु ब्रह्मचारिणस्स्वाहा | प्र मा'ऽयन्तु ब्रह्मचारिणस्स्वाहा | दमायन्तु ब्रह्मचारिणस्स्वाहा | शमायन्तु ब्रह्मचारिणस्स्वाहा
text_mt: making for herself forever clothes, and cattle for me, / and food and drink at all times—then bring to me prosperity, / possessing wool, along with cattle, svāhā! / May students of brahman come to me, svāhā! / May students of brahman come apart to me, svāhā! / May students of brahman come forward to me, svāhā! / May students of brahman come with self-restraint, svāhā! / May students of brahman come with tranquility, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: yaśo jane'sāni svāhā | śreyān vasyaso'sāni svāhā | taṃ tvā bhaga praviśāni svāhā | sa mā bhaga praviśa svāhā | tasminthsahasraśākhe | ni bhagāhaṃ tvayi mṛje svāhā | yathā''paḥ pravatā''yanti | yathā māsā aharjaram | evaṃ māṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ | dhātarāyantu sarvatassvāhā | prativeśo'si pra mā bhāhi pra mā padyasva
meaning: यशो जनेऽसानि स्वाहा | श्रेयान् वस्यसोऽसानि स्वाहा | तं त्वा भग प्रविशानि स्वाहा | स मा भग प्रविश स्वाहा | तस्मिन्थ्सहस्रशाखे | नि भगाहं त्वयि मृजे स्वाहा | यथा'ऽपः प्रवता'ऽयन्ति | यथा मासा अहर्जरम् | एवं मां ब्रह्मचारिणः | धातरायन्तु सर्वतस्स्वाहा | प्रतिवेशोऽसि प्र मा भाहि प्र मा पद्यस्व
text_mt: May I be glorious among the people, svāhā! May I be more prosperous than the wealthy, svāhā! O Bhaga, may I enter into you, svāhā! O Bhaga, do you enter into me, svāhā! In that one of a thousand branches, / O Bhaga, I cleanse myself in you, svāhā! As waters flow downward, as the months flow into the consumer of days, so, O Dhātṛ, may students of brahman come to me from all sides, svāhā! You are a refuge: shine forth to me, come to me! / [Pratīka index: vitanvānā, śamāyantu brahmacāriṇaḥ svāhā, dhātar āyantu sarvataḥ svāhā, and one.]

sanskrit_iast: bhūrbhuvassuvariti vā etāstisro vyāhṛtayaḥ | tāsāmu ha smai tāṃ caturthīm | māhācamasyaḥ pravedayate | maha iti | tadbrahma | sa ātmā | aṅgānyanyā devatāḥ | bhūriti vā ayaṃ lokaḥ | bhuva ityantarikṣam | suvarityasau lokaḥ
meaning: भूर्भुवस्सुवरिति वा एतास्तिस्रो व्याहृतयः | तासामु ह स्मै तां चतुर्थीम् | माहाचमस्यः प्रवेदयते | मह इति | तद्ब्रह्म | स आत्मा | अङ्गान्यन्या देवताः | भूरिति वा अयं लोकः | भुव इत्यन्तरिक्षम् | सुवरित्यसौ लोकः
text_mt: Bhūr, bhuvas, suvar—these, indeed, are the three sacred utterances. And of them, Māhācamasya made known a fourth: 'mahas.' That is brahman. That is the self. The other deities are its limbs. 'Bhūr', indeed, is this world. 'Bhuvas' is the intermediate space. 'Suvar' is that world.

sanskrit_iast: maha ityādityaḥ | ādityena vāva sarve lokā mahīyante | bhūriti vā agniḥ | bhuva iti vāyuḥ | suvarityādityaḥ | maha iti candramāḥ | candramasā vāva sarvāṇi jyotīṃṣi mahīyante | bhūriti vā ṛcaḥ | bhuva iti sāmāni | suvariti yajūṃṣi
meaning: मह इत्यादित्यः | आदित्येन वाव सर्वे लोका महीयन्ते | भूरिति वा अग्निः | भुव इति वायुः | सुवरित्यादित्यः | मह इति चन्द्रमाः | चन्द्रमसा वाव सर्वाणि ज्योतींषि महीयन्ते | भूरिति वा ऋचः | भुव इति सामानि | सुवरिति यजूंषि
text_mt: 'Mahas' is Āditya; by Āditya, indeed, do all worlds thrive. 'Bhūr', indeed, is Agni. 'Bhuvas' is Vāyu. 'Suvar' is Āditya. 'Mahas' is the moon; by the moon, indeed, do all lights thrive. 'Bhūr', indeed, is the ṛc-verses. 'Bhuvas' is the sāman-chants. 'Suvar' is the yajus-formulas.

sanskrit_iast: maha iti brahma | brahmaṇā vāva sarve vedā mahīyante | bhūriti vai prāṇaḥ | bhuva ityapānaḥ | suvariti vyānaḥ | maha ityannam | annena vāva sarve prāṇā mahīyante | tā vā etāścatasraścaturdhā | catasraścatasro vyāhṛtayaḥ | tā yo veda | sa veda brahma | sarve'smai devā balimāvahanti
meaning: मह इति ब्रह्म | ब्रह्मणा वाव सर्वे वेदा महीयन्ते | भूरिति वै प्राणः | भुव इत्यपानः | सुवरिति व्यानः | मह इत्यन्नम् | अन्नेन वाव सर्वे प्राणा महीयन्ते | ता वा एताश्चतस्रश्चतुर्धा | चतस्रश्चतस्रो व्याहृतयः | ता यो वेद | स वेद ब्रह्म | सर्वेऽस्मै देवा बलिमावहन्ति
text_mt: 'Mahas' is brahman; by brahman, indeed, do all Vedas thrive. 'Bhūr', indeed, is the outgoing breath. 'Bhuvas' is the downward breath. 'Suvar' is the diffused breath. 'Mahas' is food; by food, indeed, do all vital breaths thrive. These four, indeed, are fourfold; there are four sacred utterances, each fourfold. Whoever knows them, he knows brahman. All the gods bring tribute to him. / [Pratīka index: asau lokaḥ, yajūṃṣi, veda, and two.]

sanskrit_iast: sa ya eṣo'ntarhṛdaya ākāśaḥ | tasminnayaṃ puruṣo manomayaḥ | amṛto hiraṇmayaḥ | antareṇa tāluke | ya eṣa stana ivāvalambate | sendrayoniḥ | yatrāsau keśānto vivartate | vyapohya śīrṣakapāle | bhūrityagnau pratitiṣṭhati | bhuva iti vāyau
meaning: स य एषोऽन्तर्हृदय आकाशः | तस्मिन्नयं पुरुषो मनोमयः | अमृतो हिरण्मयः | अन्तरेण तालुके | य एष स्तन इवावलम्बते | सेन्द्रयोनिः | यत्रासौ केशान्तो विवर्तते | व्यपोह्य शीर्षकपाले | भूरित्यग्नौ प्रतितिष्ठति | भुव इति वायौ
text_mt: This space that is within the heart, within it is this person consisting of mind, immortal, golden. Between the two palates, that which hangs down like a nipple—that is the womb of Indra, where the border of the hair parts, cleaving the two halves of the skull. Saying 'bhūr', he stands firm in Agni; saying 'bhuvas', in Vāyu;

sanskrit_iast: suvarityāditye | maha iti brahmaṇi | āpnoti svārājyam | āpnoti manasaspatim | vākpatiścakṣuṣpatiḥ | śrotrapatirvijñānapatiḥ | etattato bhavati | ākāśaśarīraṃ brahma | satyātma prāṇārāmaṃ mana ānandam | śāntisamṛddhamamṛtam | iti prācīnayogyopāssva
meaning: सुवरित्यादित्ये | मह इति ब्रह्मणि | आप्नोति स्वाराज्यम् | आप्नोति मनसस्पतिम् | वाक्पतिश्चक्षुष्पतिः | श्रोत्रपतिर्विज्ञानपतिः | एतत्ततो भवति | आकाशशरीरं ब्रह्म | सत्यात्म प्राणारामं मन आनन्दम् | शान्तिसमृद्धममृतम् | इति प्राचीनयोग्योपास्स्व
text_mt: saying 'suvar', in Āditya; saying 'mahas', in brahman. He attains self-rule; he attains the lord of mind; he becomes lord of speech, lord of sight, lord of hearing, lord of discernment. Beyond that, he becomes this: brahman whose body is space, whose self is truth, whose pleasure is the vital breath, whose delight is the mind, rich in peace, immortal. Thus meditate, O Prācīnayogya! / [Pratīka index: vāyau, amṛtam, and one.]

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyantarikṣaṃ dyaurdiśo'vāntaradiśāḥ | agnirvāyurādityaścandramā nakṣatrāṇi | āpa oṣadhayo vanaspataya ākāśa ātmā | ityadhibhūtam | athādhyātmam | prāṇo vyāno'pāna udānassamānaḥ | cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ mano vāktvak | carma māṃsaṃ snāvāsthi majjā | etadadhividhāya ṛṣiravocat | pāṅktaṃ vā idaṃ sarvam | pāṅktenaiva pāṅktaṃ spṛṇotīti
meaning: पृथिव्यन्तरिक्षं द्यौर्दिशोऽवान्तरदिशाः | अग्निर्वायुरादित्यश्चन्द्रमा नक्षत्राणि | आप ओषधयो वनस्पतय आकाश आत्मा | इत्यधिभूतम् | अथाध्यात्मम् | प्राणो व्यानोऽपान उदानस्समानः | चक्षुः श्रोत्रं मनो वाक्त्वक् | चर्म मांसं स्नावास्थि मज्जा | एतदधिविधाय ऋषिरवोचत् | पाङ्क्तं वा इदं सर्वम् | पाङ्क्तेनैव पाङ्क्तं स्पृणोतीति
text_mt: Earth, intermediate space, sky, the quarters, the intermediate quarters; Agni, Vāyu, Āditya, the moon, the constellations; the waters, the plants, the trees, space, the body: this is with respect to the elements. Now with respect to the self: the outgoing breath, the diffused breath, the downward breath, the upward breath, the equalising breath; sight, hearing, mind, speech, skin; hide, flesh, sinew, bone, marrow. Having distinguished this, the seer said: 'Fivefold, indeed, is all this; by the fivefold does one support the fivefold.' / [Pratīka index: sarvam, and one.]

sanskrit_iast: omiti brahma | omitīdaṃ sarvam | omityetadanukṛti ha sma vā apyo śrāvayetyāśrāvayanti | omiti sāmāni gāyanti | oṃ śomiti śastrāṇi śaṃsanti | omityadhvaryuḥ pratigaraṃ pratigṛṇāti | omiti brahmā prasauti | omityagnihotramanujānāti | omiti brāhmaṇaḥ pravakṣyannāha brahmopāpnavānīti | brahmaivopāpnoti
meaning: ओमिति ब्रह्म | ओमितीदं सर्वम् | ओमित्येतदनुकृति ह स्म वा अप्यो श्रावयेत्याश्रावयन्ति | ओमिति सामानि गायन्ति | ओं शोमिति शस्त्राणि शंसन्ति | ओमित्यध्वर्युः प्रतिगरं प्रतिगृणाति | ओमिति ब्रह्मा प्रसौति | ओमित्यग्निहोत्रमनुजानाति | ओमिति ब्राह्मणः प्रवक्ष्यन्नाह ब्रह्मोपाप्नवानीति | ब्रह्मैवोपाप्नोति
text_mt: Om is brahman. Om is all this. Om is that assent; for indeed they recite, 'Make [them] listen!' with Om. With Om they sing the sāmans. With 'Oṃ śom' they recite the praise-hymns. With Om the Adhvaryu pronounces the response. With Om the Brahmā priest gives his assent. With Om one permits the Agnihotra. With Om a brāhmaṇa, about to recite, says, 'May I attain brahman!' He attains brahman indeed. / [Pratīka index: om, ten.]

sanskrit_iast: ṛtaṃ ca svādhyāyapravacane ca | satyaṃ ca svādhyāyapravacane ca | tapaśca svādhyāyapravacane ca | damaśca svādhyāyapravacane ca | śamaśca svādhyāyapravacane ca | agnayaśca svādhyāyapravacane ca | agnihotraṃ ca svādhyāyapravacane ca | atithayaśca svādhyāyapravacane ca | mānuṣaṃ ca svādhyāyapravacane ca | prajā ca svādhyāyapravacane ca | prajanaśca svādhyāyapravacane ca | prajātiśca svādhyāyapravacane ca | satyamiti satyavacā rāthītaraḥ | tapa iti taponityaḥ pauruśiṣṭiḥ | svādhyāyapravacane eveti nāko maudgalyaḥ | taddhi tapastaddhi tapaḥ
meaning: ऋतं च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | सत्यं च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | तपश्च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | दमश्च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | शमश्च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | अग्नयश्च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | अग्निहोत्रं च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | अतिथयश्च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | मानुषं च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | प्रजा च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | प्रजनश्च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | प्रजातिश्च स्वाध्यायप्रवचने च | सत्यमिति सत्यवचा राथीतरः | तप इति तपोनित्यः पौरुशिष्टिः | स्वाध्यायप्रवचने एवेति नाको मौद्गल्यः | तद्धि तपस्तद्धि तपः
text_mt: Right order, and study and teaching. Truth, and study and teaching. Ascetic heat, and study and teaching. Self-control, and study and teaching. Quietude, and study and teaching. The sacred fires, and study and teaching. The Agnihotra, and study and teaching. Guests, and study and teaching. What is human, and study and teaching. Progeny, and study and teaching. Procreation, and study and teaching. Propagation, and study and teaching. 'Truth,' says Satyavacas Rāthītara. 'Ascetic heat,' says Taponitya Pauruśiṣṭi. 'Study and teaching alone,' says Nāka Maudgalya; for that is ascetic heat, that is ascetic heat. / [Pratīka index: prajā ca svādhyāyapravacane ca, and six.]

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ vṛkṣasya rerivā | kīrtiḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ gireriva | ūrdhvapavitro vājinīva svamṛtamasmi | draviṇaṃ savarcasam | sumedhā amṛtokṣitaḥ | iti triśaṅkorvedānuvacanam
meaning: अहं वृक्षस्य रेरिवा | कीर्तिः पृष्ठं गिरेरिव | ऊर्ध्वपवित्रो वाजिनीव स्वमृतमस्मि | द्रविणं सवर्चसम् | सुमेधा अमृतोक्षितः | इति त्रिशङ्कोर्वेदानुवचनम्
text_mt: I am the mover of the tree! / My fame is like the crest of a mountain! / High and pure, like the immortal in the sun, I am glorious wealth, / of good wisdom, immortal, undecaying! / Such is the post-Vedic recitation of Triśaṅku. / [Pratīka index: aham, six.]

sanskrit_iast: vedamanūcyācāryo'ntevāsinamanuśāsti | satyaṃ vada | dharmaṃ cara | svādhyāyānmā pramadaḥ | ācāryāya priyaṃ dhanamāhṛtya prajātantuṃ mā vyavacchethsīḥ | satyānna pramaditavyam | dharmānna pramaditavyam | kuśalānna pramaditavyam | bhūtyai na pramaditavyam | svādhyāyapravacanābhyāṃ na pramaditavyam
meaning: वेदमनूच्याचार्योऽन्तेवासिनमनुशास्ति | सत्यं वद | धर्मं चर | स्वाध्यायान्मा प्रमदः | आचार्याय प्रियं धनमाहृत्य प्रजातन्तुं मा व्यवच्छेथ्सीः | सत्यान्न प्रमदितव्यम् | धर्मान्न प्रमदितव्यम् | कुशलान्न प्रमदितव्यम् | भूत्यै न प्रमदितव्यम् | स्वाध्यायप्रवचनाभ्यां न प्रमदितव्यम्
text_mt: Having taught the Veda, the teacher instructs the pupil: Speak the truth. Practise dharma. Do not neglect your study. Having brought to the teacher the wealth he desires, do not cut off the thread of progeny. One should not swerve from truth. One should not swerve from dharma. One should not swerve from what is advantageous. One should not swerve from prosperity. One should not swerve from study and teaching.

sanskrit_iast: devapitṛkāryābhyāṃ na pramaditavyam | mātṛdevo bhava | pitṛdevo bhava | ācāryadevo bhava | atithidevo bhava | yānyanavadyāni karmāṇi | tāni sevitavyāni | no itarāṇi | yānyasmākaṃ sucaritāni | tāni tvayopāsyāni
meaning: देवपितृकार्याभ्यां न प्रमदितव्यम् | मातृदेवो भव | पितृदेवो भव | आचार्यदेवो भव | अतिथिदेवो भव | यान्यनवद्यानि कर्माणि | तानि सेवितव्यानि | नो इतराणि | यान्यस्माकं सुचरितानि | तानि त्वयोपास्यानि
text_mt: One should not swerve from duties to the gods and the fathers. Treat your mother as a god. Treat your father as a god. Treat your teacher as a god. Treat your guest as a god. Those deeds that are blameless, those should be cultivated, not others. Those conduct of ours that are good, those should be honoured by you,

sanskrit_iast: no itarāṇi | ye ke cāsmacchreyāṃso brāhmaṇāḥ | teṣāṃ tvayā''sane na praśvasitavyam | śraddhayā deyam | aśraddhayā'deyam | śriyā deyam | hriyā deyam | bhiyā deyam | saṃvidā deyam | atha yadi te karmavicikithsā vā vṛttavicikithsā vā syāt
meaning: नो इतराणि | ये के चास्मच्छ्रेयांसो ब्राह्मणाः | तेषां त्वया'ऽसने न प्रश्वसितव्यम् | श्रद्धया देयम् | अश्रद्धयाऽदेयम् | श्रिया देयम् | ह्रिया देयम् | भिया देयम् | संविदा देयम् | अथ यदि ते कर्मविचिकिथ्सा वा वृत्तविचिकिथ्सा वा स्यात्
text_mt: not others. And whatever brāhmaṇas are superior to us, in their presence you should not breathe forth. One should give with faith. One should not give without faith. One should give with abundance. One should give with modesty. One should give with awe. One should give with sympathy. Now, if you should have any doubt regarding action or doubt regarding conduct,

sanskrit_iast: ye tatra brāhmaṇāḥ saṃmarśinaḥ | yuktā āyuktāḥ | alūkṣā dharmakāmāssyuḥ | yathā te tatra varterann | tathā tatra vartethāḥ | athābhyākhyāteṣu | ye tatra brāhmaṇāssaṃmarśinaḥ | yuktā āyuktāḥ | alūkṣā dharmakāmāssyuḥ | yathā te teṣu varterann | tathā teṣu vartethāḥ | eṣa ādeśaḥ | eṣa upadeśaḥ | eṣā vedopaniṣat | etadanuśāsanam | evamupāsitavyam | evamu caitadupāsyam
meaning: ये तत्र ब्राह्मणाः संमर्शिनः | युक्ता आयुक्ताः | अलूक्षा धर्मकामास्स्युः | यथा ते तत्र वर्तेरन्न् | तथा तत्र वर्तेथाः | अथाभ्याख्यातेषु | ये तत्र ब्राह्मणास्संमर्शिनः | युक्ता आयुक्ताः | अलूक्षा धर्मकामास्स्युः | यथा ते तेषु वर्तेरन्न् | तथा तेषु वर्तेथाः | एष आदेशः | एष उपदेशः | एषा वेदोपनिषत् | एतदनुशासनम् | एवमुपासितव्यम् | एवमु चैतदुपास्यम्
text_mt: whatever brāhmaṇas there are who are deliberative, experienced, independent, gentle, lovers of dharma—as they would conduct themselves there, so should you conduct yourself there. Then regarding those accused of blame: whatever brāhmaṇas there are who are deliberative, experienced, independent, gentle, lovers of dharma—as they would conduct themselves toward them, so should you conduct yourself toward them. This is the command. This is the instruction. This is the secret doctrine of the Veda. This is the injunction. In this way it should be worshipped. And thus, indeed, this should be revered. / [Pratīka index: svādhyāyapravacanābhyāṃ na pramaditavyam, tāni tvayopāsyāni, syāt, teṣu varteran, and seven.]

sanskrit_iast: śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ | śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā | śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ | śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ | namo brahmaṇe | namaste vāyo | tvameva pratyakṣaṃ brahmāsi | tvāmeva pratyakṣaṃ brahmāvādiṣam | ṛtamavādiṣam | satyamavādiṣam | tanmāmāvīt | tadvaktāramāvīt | āvīnmām | āvīdvaktāram | oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ
meaning: शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः | शं नो भवत्वर्यमा | शं न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः | शं नो विष्णुरुरुक्रमः | नमो ब्रह्मणे | नमस्ते वायो | त्वमेव प्रत्यक्षं ब्रह्मासि | त्वामेव प्रत्यक्षं ब्रह्मावादिषम् | ऋतमवादिषम् | सत्यमवादिषम् | तन्मामावीत् | तद्वक्तारमावीत् | आवीन्माम् | आवीद्वक्तारम् | ओं शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः
text_mt:
May Mitra be auspicious to us, and Varuṇa auspicious; may Aryaman be auspicious to us; may Indra and Bṛhaspati be auspicious to us; may Viṣṇu of wide stride be auspicious to us. Homage to brahman! Homage to you, Vāyu! You alone are the directly perceived brahman. You alone have I declared as the directly perceived brahman; I have spoken the right; I have spoken truth. That has protected me; that has protected the speaker. It has protected me; it has protected the speaker. Oṃ, peace, peace, peace!
[I have spoken truth, and five]
12: May [Mitra] be auspicious to us; the study; together may he [protect] us two; he who of meters; earth; that which; earth; oṃ; and right; I; having taught the Veda; may [Mitra] be auspicious to us: twelve. 12: May [Mitra] be auspicious to us; mahas; thus Āditya; not the others: twenty-three. 23: May [Mitra] be auspicious to us; peace, peace.

May Mitra be auspicious to us, and Varuṇa auspicious; may Aryaman be auspicious to us; may Indra and Bṛhaspati be auspicious to us; may Viṣṇu of wide stride be auspicious to us. Homage to brahman! Homage to you, Vāyu!
You alone are the directly perceived brahman. You alone will I declare as the directly perceived brahman; I will speak the right; I will speak truth. May that protect me; may that protect the speaker. May it protect me;
may it protect the speaker. Oṃ, peace, peace, peace!

sanskrit_iast: brahmavidāpnoti param | tadeṣā'bhyuktā | satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma | yo veda nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ parame vyomann | so'śnute sarvānkāmānthsaha | brahmaṇā vipaściteti | tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśassaṃbhūtaḥ | ākāśādvāyuḥ | vāyoragniḥ | agnerāpaḥ | adbhyaḥ pṛthivī | pṛthivyā oṣadhayaḥ | oṣadhībhyo'nnam | annātpuruṣaḥ | sa vā eṣa puruṣo'nnarasamayaḥ | tasyedameva śiraḥ | ayaṃ dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ | ayamuttaraḥ pakṣaḥ | ayamātmā | idaṃ pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā | tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati
meaning: ब्रह्मविदाप्नोति परम् | तदेषाऽभ्युक्ता | सत्यं ज्ञानमनन्तं ब्रह्म | यो वेद निहितं गुहायां परमे व्योमन्न् | सोऽश्नुते सर्वान्कामान्थ्सह | ब्रह्मणा विपश्चितेति | तस्माद्वा एतस्मादात्मन आकाशस्संभूतः | आकाशाद्वायुः | वायोरग्निः | अग्नेरापः | अद्भ्यः पृथिवी | पृथिव्या ओषधयः | ओषधीभ्योऽन्नम् | अन्नात्पुरुषः | स वा एष पुरुषोऽन्नरसमयः | तस्येदमेव शिरः | अयं दक्षिणः पक्षः | अयमुत्तरः पक्षः | अयमात्मा | इदं पुच्छं प्रतिष्ठा | तदप्येष श्लोको भवति
text_mt:
The knower of brahman attains the supreme. Concerning that, this verse is spoken:
Brahman is truth, knowledge, infinite.
He who knows it hidden in the secret place, in the highest heaven,
attains all desires together
with the wise brahman.
From that very Self, space arose;
from space, wind; from wind, fire; from fire, water; from water, earth; from earth, plants; from plants, food; from food, man. This man consists indeed of the essence of food. This is indeed his head; this is the right wing; this is the left wing; this is the trunk; this tail is the support. On that also there is this verse:

sanskrit_iast: annādvai prajāḥ prajāyante | yāḥ kāśca pṛthivīg śritāḥ | atho annenaiva jīvanti | athainadapi yantyantataḥ | annaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ jyeṣṭham | tasmāthsarvauṣadhamucyate | sarvaṃ vai te'nnamāpnuvanti | ye'nnaṃ brahmopāsate | annaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ jyeṣṭham | tasmāthsarvauṣadhamucyate | annādbhūtāni jāyante | jātānyannena vardhante | adyate'tti ca bhūtāni | tasmādannaṃ taducyata iti | tasmādvā etasmādannarasamayāt | anyo'ntara ātmā prāṇamayaḥ | tenaiṣa pūrṇaḥ | sa vā eṣa puruṣavidha eva | tasya puruṣavidhatām | anvayaṃ puruṣavidhaḥ | tasya prāṇa eva śiraḥ | vyāno dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ | apāna uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ | ākāśa ātmā | pṛthivī pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā | tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati
meaning: अन्नाद्वै प्रजाः प्रजायन्ते | याः काश्च पृथिवीग् श्रिताः | अथो अन्नेनैव जीवन्ति | अथैनदपि यन्त्यन्ततः | अन्नं हि भूतानां ज्येष्ठम् | तस्माथ्सर्वौषधमुच्यते | सर्वं वै तेऽन्नमाप्नुवन्ति | येऽन्नं ब्रह्मोपासते | अन्नं हि भूतानां ज्येष्ठम् | तस्माथ्सर्वौषधमुच्यते | अन्नाद्भूतानि जायन्ते | जातान्यन्नेन वर्धन्ते | अद्यतेऽत्ति च भूतानि | तस्मादन्नं तदुच्यत इति | तस्माद्वा एतस्मादन्नरसमयात् | अन्योऽन्तर आत्मा प्राणमयः | तेनैष पूर्णः | स वा एष पुरुषविध एव | तस्य पुरुषविधताम् | अन्वयं पुरुषविधः | तस्य प्राण एव शिरः | व्यानो दक्षिणः पक्षः | अपान उत्तरः पक्षः | आकाश आत्मा | पृथिवी पुच्छं प्रतिष्ठा | तदप्येष श्लोको भवति

sanskrit_iast: prāṇaṃ devā anuprāṇanti | manuṣyāḥ paśavaśca ye | prāṇo hi bhūtānāmāyuḥ | tasmāthsarvāyuṣamucyate | sarvameva ta āyuryanti | ye prāṇaṃ brahmopāsate | prāṇo hi bhūtānāmāyuḥ | tasmāthsarvāyuṣamucyata iti | tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā | yaḥ pūrvasya | tasmādvā etasmātprāṇamayāt | anyo'ntara ātmā manomayaḥ | tenaiṣa pūrṇaḥ | sa vā eṣa puruṣavidha eva | tasya puruṣavidhatām | anvayaṃ puruṣavidhaḥ | tasya yajureva śiraḥ | ṛgdakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ | sāmottaraḥ pakṣaḥ | ādeśa ātmā | atharvāṅgirasaḥ pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā | tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati
meaning: प्राणं देवा अनुप्राणन्ति | मनुष्याः पशवश्च ये | प्राणो हि भूतानामायुः | तस्माथ्सर्वायुषमुच्यते | सर्वमेव त आयुर्यन्ति | ये प्राणं ब्रह्मोपासते | प्राणो हि भूतानामायुः | तस्माथ्सर्वायुषमुच्यत इति | तस्यैष एव शारीर आत्मा | यः पूर्वस्य | तस्माद्वा एतस्मात्प्राणमयात् | अन्योऽन्तर आत्मा मनोमयः | तेनैष पूर्णः | स वा एष पुरुषविध एव | तस्य पुरुषविधताम् | अन्वयं पुरुषविधः | तस्य यजुरेव शिरः | ऋग्दक्षिणः पक्षः | सामोत्तरः पक्षः | आदेश आत्मा | अथर्वाङ्गिरसः पुच्छं प्रतिष्ठा | तदप्येष श्लोको भवति

sanskrit_iast: yato vāco nivartante | aprāpya manasā saha | ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān | na bibheti kadācaneti | tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā | yaḥ pūrvasya | tasmādvā etasmānmanomayāt | anyo'ntara ātmā vijñānamayaḥ | tenaiṣa pūrṇaḥ | sa vā eṣa puruṣavidha eva | tasya puruṣavidhatām | anvayaṃ puruṣavidhaḥ | tasya śraddhaiva śiraḥ | ṛtaṃ dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ | satyamuttaraḥ pakṣaḥ | yoga ātmā | mahaḥ pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā | tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati
meaning: यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते | अप्राप्य मनसा सह | आनन्दं ब्रह्मणो विद्वान् | न बिभेति कदाचनेति | तस्यैष एव शारीर आत्मा | यः पूर्वस्य | तस्माद्वा एतस्मान्मनोमयात् | अन्योऽन्तर आत्मा विज्ञानमयः | तेनैष पूर्णः | स वा एष पुरुषविध एव | तस्य पुरुषविधताम् | अन्वयं पुरुषविधः | तस्य श्रद्धैव शिरः | ऋतं दक्षिणः पक्षः | सत्यमुत्तरः पक्षः | योग आत्मा | महः पुच्छं प्रतिष्ठा | तदप्येष श्लोको भवति
text_mt:
Whence words turn back,
together with the mind, not having reached [it]—
knowing the bliss of brahman,
he fears not anything ever.
This is indeed the bodily Self of that former one. Distinct from this [Self] consisting of mind, there is another, inner Self consisting of understanding. By that, this is filled. That one is indeed shaped like a man. In accordance with its human shape, this one is shaped like a man. Its head is faith alone; the right is the right wing; truth is the left wing; yoga is the trunk; mahas is the tail, the support. On that also there is this verse:

sanskrit_iast: vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute | karmāṇi tanute'pi ca | vijñānaṃ devāssarve | brahma jyeṣṭhamupāsate | vijñānaṃ brahma cedveda | tasmāccenna pramādyati | śarīre pāpmano hitvā | sarvānkāmānthsamaśnuta iti | tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā | yaḥ pūrvasya | tasmādvā etasmādvijñānamayāt | anyo'ntara ātmā''nandamayaḥ | tenaiṣa pūrṇaḥ | sa vā eṣa puruṣavidha eva | tasya puruṣavidhatām | anvayaṃ puruṣavidhaḥ | tasya priyameva śiraḥ | modo dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ | pramoda uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ | ānanda ātmā | brahma pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā | tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati
meaning: विज्ञानं यज्ञं तनुते | कर्माणि तनुतेऽपि च | विज्ञानं देवास्सर्वे | ब्रह्म ज्येष्ठमुपासते | विज्ञानं ब्रह्म चेद्वेद | तस्माच्चेन्न प्रमाद्यति | शरीरे पाप्मनो हित्वा | सर्वान्कामान्थ्समश्नुत इति | तस्यैष एव शारीर आत्मा | यः पूर्वस्य | तस्माद्वा एतस्माद्विज्ञानमयात् | अन्योऽन्तर आत्मा'ऽनन्दमयः | तेनैष पूर्णः | स वा एष पुरुषविध एव | तस्य पुरुषविधताम् | अन्वयं पुरुषविधः | तस्य प्रियमेव शिरः | मोदो दक्षिणः पक्षः | प्रमोद उत्तरः पक्षः | आनन्द आत्मा | ब्रह्म पुच्छं प्रतिष्ठा | तदप्येष श्लोको भवति
text_mt:
Understanding extends the sacrifice,
and it extends rites as well.
Understanding do all the gods
revere as the eldest brahman.
If one knows understanding as brahman,
and does not swerve from it,
casting off sins in the body,
he attains all desires.
This is indeed the bodily Self of that former one. Distinct from this [Self] consisting of understanding, there is another, inner Self consisting of bliss.
By that, this is filled. That one is indeed shaped like a man. In accordance with its human shape, this one is shaped like a man. Its head is love alone; joy is the right wing; delight is the left wing; bliss is the trunk; brahman is the tail, the support. On that also there is this verse:

sanskrit_iast: asanneva sa bhavati | asadbrahmeti veda cet | asti brahmeti cedveda | santamenaṃ tato viduriti | tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā | yaḥ pūrvasya | athāto'nupraśnāḥ | utāvidvānamuṃ lokaṃ pretya | kaścana gacchatī | āho vidvānamuṃ lokaṃ pretya | kaścithsamaśnutāu | so'kāmayata | bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti | sa tapo'tapyata | sa tapastaptvā | idaṃ sarvamasṛjata | yadidaṃ kiṃca | tathsṛṣṭvā | tadevānuprāviśat | tadanupraviśya | sacca tyaccābhavat | niruktaṃ cāniruktaṃ ca | nilayanaṃ cānilayanaṃ ca | vijñānaṃ cāvijñānaṃ ca | satyaṃ cānṛtaṃ ca satyamabhavat | yadidaṃ kiṃca | tathsatyamityācakṣate | tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati

text_mt:
He becomes non-existent indeed,
if he knows brahman as non-existent.
If he knows that brahman is,
then they know him as existing.
This is indeed the bodily Self of that former one.
Now, then, follow questions: Does any non-knower, on departing, go to yonder world? Or does any knower, on departing, attain yonder world? He desired: "May I be many, may I be born." He performed ascetic heat. Having performed ascetic heat, he emitted all this, whatever there is here. Having emitted it, he entered into that very thing. Having entered into it,
he became the actual and the beyond, the defined and the undefined, the rooted and the rootless, understanding and non-understanding, truth and falsehood: the truth became [all this], whatever there is here. That they call truth. On that also there is this verse:

text_mt: "Non-being, truly, was this in the beginning; / From that, indeed, being was born. / That made itself by itself; / Therefore, it is called well-made." / That which is well-made, that indeed is the essence. Having obtained that essence, one becomes blissful. For who indeed would breathe out, who would breathe in, if this space were not bliss? For he alone causes bliss. When indeed he finds fearless standing in this invisible, bodiless, unexpressed, unhoused [brahman], then he has attained fearlessness. When, however, he makes even the slightest difference in it, then fear arises for him. That indeed is the fear of the wise man who does not reflect. On that too there is this verse:

meaning: भीषाऽस्माद्वातः पवते | भीषोदेति सूर्यः | भीषाऽस्मादग्निश्चेन्द्रश्च | मृत्युर्धावति पञ्चम इति | सैषा'ऽनन्दस्य मीमांसा भवति | युवा स्याथ्साधुयुवाऽध्यायकः | आशिष्ठो दृढिष्ठो बलिष्ठः | तस्येयं पृथिवी सर्वा वित्तस्य पूर्णा स्यात् | स एको मानुष आनन्दः | ते ये शतं मानुषा आनन्दाः | स एको मनुष्यगन्धर्वाणामानन्दः | श्रोत्रियस्य चाकामहतस्य | ते ये शतं मनुष्यगन्धर्वाणामानन्दाः | स एको देवगन्धर्वाणामानन्दः | श्रोत्रियस्य चाकामहतस्य | ते ये शतं देवगन्धर्वाणामानन्दाः | स एकः पितृणां चिरलोकलोकानामानन्दः | श्रोत्रियस्य चाकामहतस्य | ते ये शतं पितृणां चिरलोकलोकानामानन्दाः | स एक आजानजानां देवानामानन्दः | श्रोत्रियस्य चाकामहतस्य | ते ये शतमाजानजानां देवानामानन्दाः | स एकः कर्मदेवानां देवानामानन्दः | ये कर्मणा देवानपियन्ति | श्रोत्रियस्य चाकामहतस्य | ते ये शतं कर्मदेवानां देवानामानन्दाः | स एको देवानामानन्दः | श्रोत्रियस्य चाकामहतस्य | ते ये शतं देवानामानन्दाः | स एक इन्द्रस्या'ऽनन्दः || श्रोत्रियस्य चाकामहतस्य | ते ये शतमिन्द्रस्या'ऽनन्दाः | स एको बृहस्पतेरानन्दः | श्रोत्रियस्य चाकामहतस्य | ते ये शतं बृहस्पतेरानन्दाः | स एकः प्रजापतेरानन्दः | श्रोत्रियस्य चाकामहतस्य | ते ये शतं प्रजापतेरानन्दाः | स एको ब्रह्मण आनन्दः | श्रोत्रियस्य चाकामहतस्य | स यश्चायं पुरुषे | यश्चासावादित्ये | स एकः | स य एवंवित् | अस्माल्लोकात्प्रेत्य | एतमन्नमयमात्मानमुपसंक्रामति | एतं प्राणमयमात्मानमुपसंक्रामति | एतं मनोमयमात्मानमुपसंक्रामति | एतं विज्ञानमयमात्मानमुपसंक्रामति | एतमानन्दमयमात्मानमुपसंक्रामति | तदप्येष श्लोको भवति
text_mt: "Through fear of him the wind blows, / Through fear rises Sūrya; / Through fear of him Agni and Indra, / And Death as the fifth runs." / This is the inquiry into bliss: Suppose there is a youth, a noble youth, learned in the Veda, swiftest, firmest, strongest; for him this whole earth should be full of wealth: that is one human bliss. A hundred of those human blisses make one bliss of the human Gandharvas, and of a Vedic scholar free from desire. A hundred of those blisses of the human Gandharvas make one bliss of the divine Gandharvas, and of a Vedic scholar free from desire. A hundred of those blisses of the divine Gandharvas make one bliss of the fathers residing in long-enduring worlds, and of a Vedic scholar free from desire. A hundred of those blisses of the fathers residing in long-enduring worlds make one bliss of the gods born by birth, and of a Vedic scholar free from desire. A hundred of those blisses of the gods born by birth make one bliss of the gods of action, who attain the gods through action, and of a Vedic scholar free from desire. A hundred of those blisses of the gods of action make one bliss of the gods, and of a Vedic scholar free from desire. A hundred of those blisses of the gods make one bliss of Indra, and of a Vedic scholar free from desire. A hundred of those blisses of Indra make one bliss of Bṛhaspati, and of a Vedic scholar free from desire. A hundred of those blisses of Bṛhaspati make one bliss of Prajāpati, and of a Vedic scholar free from desire. A hundred of those blisses of Prajāpati make one bliss of brahman, and of a Vedic scholar free from desire. He who is here in the person and he who is there in Āditya—he is one. He who knows thus, departing from this world, reaches this self consisting of food, reaches this self consisting of vital breath, reaches this self consisting of mind, reaches this self consisting of understanding, reaches this self consisting of bliss. On that too there is this verse:

sanskrit_iast: yato vāco nivartante | aprāpya manasā saha | ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān | na bibheti kutaścaneti | etaṃ ha vāva na tapati | kimahaṃ sādhu nākaravam | kimahaṃ pāpamakaravamiti | sa ya evaṃ vidvānete ātmānaṃ spṛṇute | ubhe hyevaiṣa ete ātmānaṃ spṛṇute | ya evaṃ veda | ityupaniṣat

text_mt:
"Whence words turn back, / Together with the mind, not having reached it; / Knowing the bliss of brahman, / One does not fear from anywhere." / Truly, such a one does not torment himself [thinking]: "Why did I not do what is good? Why did I do what is evil?" He who knows thus strengthens his self with both of these; for he who knows thus indeed strengthens his self with both of these. Thus the Upaniṣad.

text_mt: Bhṛgu, indeed, the son of Varuṇa, approached his father Varuṇa: "Revered Sir, teach me brahman." To him he declared this: "Food, vital breath, sight, hearing, mind, speech." To him he said: "That from which these beings are born, that by which, being born, they live, that into which, departing, they enter—seek to know that; that is brahman." He performed ascetic heat. Having performed ascetic heat,

text_mt: He recognized: "Food is brahman." For from food alone, indeed, these beings are born; by food, being born, they live; into food, departing, they enter. Having understood that, he again approached his father Varuṇa: "Revered Sir, teach me brahman." To him he said: "Seek to know brahman by ascetic heat; ascetic heat is brahman." He performed ascetic heat. Having performed ascetic heat,

text_mt: He recognized: "Vital breath is brahman." For from vital breath alone, indeed, these beings are born; by vital breath, being born, they live; into vital breath, departing, they enter. Having understood that, he again approached his father Varuṇa: "Revered Sir, teach me brahman." To him he said: "Seek to know brahman by ascetic heat; ascetic heat is brahman." He performed ascetic heat. Having performed ascetic heat,

text_mt: He recognized: "Mind is brahman." For from mind alone, indeed, these beings are born; by mind, being born, they live; into mind, departing, they enter. Having understood that, he again approached his father Varuṇa: "Revered Sir, teach me brahman." To him he said: "Seek to know brahman by ascetic heat; ascetic heat is brahman." He performed ascetic heat. Having performed ascetic heat,

text_mt:
He understood: 'Understanding is brahman.' For indeed, from understanding these beings are born; born, by understanding they live; towards understanding they depart and enter [it]. Having understood that, he approached again his father Varuṇa: 'Teach me, venerable sir, brahman.' He said to him: 'Desire to understand brahman through ascetic heat. Ascetic heat is brahman.' He performed ascetic heat. Having performed ascetic heat,

He understood: 'Bliss is brahman.' For indeed, from bliss these beings are born; born, by bliss they live; towards bliss they depart and enter [it]. This is the wisdom taught by Bhṛgu and Varuṇa, established in the highest sky. He who knows thus becomes established; he becomes possessed of food, an eater of food; he becomes great in offspring, in cattle, in the luster of brahman; great in fame.

text_mt: One should not despise food. That is the vow. Vital breath is food; the body is the eater of food. The body is established in vital breath; vital breath is established in the body. Thus this food is established in food. He who knows this food established in food becomes established; he becomes possessed of food, an eater of food; he becomes great in offspring, in cattle, in the luster of brahman; great in fame.

He who knows this food established in food becomes established; he becomes possessed of food, an eater of food; he becomes great in offspring, in cattle, in the luster of brahman; great in fame.

He who knows this food established in food becomes established; he becomes possessed of food, an eater of food; he becomes great in offspring, in cattle, in the luster of brahman; great in fame.

text_mt: One should not turn away anyone from one's dwelling. That is the vow. Therefore, by whatever means, one should obtain much food. 'Food has been prepared for him,' they say. If this food is prepared at the beginning, food is prepared for him at the beginning. If this food is prepared in the middle, food is prepared for him in the middle. If this food is prepared at the end, food is prepared for him at the end. [So it is for him] who knows thus. As preservation in speech; as acquisition and preservation in the out-breath and the in-breath; as work in the hands; as movement in the feet; as excretion in the anus—these are the human recognitions. Now the divine ones: as satisfaction in rain; as strength in lightning; as fame in cattle; as light in the stars; as procreation, immortality, and bliss in the genitals; as all in space. One should meditate on it as support; he becomes supported. One should meditate on it as greatness; he becomes great. One should meditate on it as thought; he becomes thoughtful. One should meditate on it as homage; desires bend down to him. One should meditate on it as brahman; he becomes possessed of brahman. One should meditate on it as the dying around brahman; around him die his hating rivals, around him [die] his hostile foes. And he who is here in the person, and he who is there in the Āditya—he is one. He who knows thus, departing from this world, reaching this self consisting of food, reaching this self consisting of vital breath, reaching this self consisting of mind, reaching this self consisting of understanding, reaching this self consisting of bliss, traversing these worlds eating what food he desires and assuming what form he desires, sits singing this sāman: 'Hā 3 vu, hā 3 vu, hā 3 vu! I am food, I am food, I am food! I am the eater of food, I am the eater of food, I am the eater of food! I am the maker of the verse, I am the maker of the verse, I am the maker of the verse! I am the firstborn of truth, earlier than the gods, the navel of the immortal! Whoever gives me, he indeed has preserved me! I, as food, eat the eater of food! I have overcome the whole universe! Heaven-like is the light!' He who knows thus [reaches this]. Such is the Upaniṣad. / [Mnemonic index and word counts: is prepared, lightning, he becomes thoughtful, one, hā 3 vu, he who knows thus, and one. 10. / Bhṛgu to him, whence they enter, desire to understand that, that thirteen, food, vital breath, mind, understanding—having understood that, ascetic heat, twelve, twelve, bliss, thus this ten, one should not despise food, vital breath, body, one should not reject food, water, light, one should make much food, earth, space, eleven, eleven, not anyone, sixty-one, ten.]

text_mt: Beyond the water, in the middle of the world, on the back of the firmament, greater than the great; having thoroughly entered the lights with bright luster, Prajāpati moves inside the womb. In whom all this unites and disperses, in whom all the gods have seated themselves—that alone is what was, and that what will be, in the imperishable, highest sky. By which the atmosphere, the sky, and the wide earth are enveloped, by which Āditya burns with brilliance and splendor; which poets weave inside the ocean, which imperishable highest [abode] creatures [inhabit]; from which the source of the world was born, which discharged living beings upon the earth by water; which entered plants, men, cattle, and beings moving and unmoving; higher than this there is nothing else, for it is subtler [than the subtle], higher than the high, greater than the great, which is one, unmanifest, infinite in form, the universe, ancient, beyond darkness.

sanskrit_iast: tadevartaṃ tadu satyamāhustadeva brahma paramaṃ kavīnām | iṣṭāpūrtaṃ bahudhā jātaṃ jāyamānaṃ viśvaṃ bibharti bhuvanasya nābhiḥ | tadevāgnistadvāyustathsūryastadu candramāḥ | tadeva śukramamṛtaṃ tadbrahma tadāpassa prajāpatiḥ | sarve nimeṣā jajñire vidyutaḥ puruṣādadhi | kalā muhūrtāḥ kāṣṭhāścāhorātrāśca sarvaśaḥ | ardhamāsā māsā ṛtavaḥ saṃvathsaraśca kalpantām | sa āpaḥ pradughe ubhe ime antarikṣamatho suvaḥ | nainamūrdhvaṃ na tiryañcaṃ na madhye parijagrabhat | na tasyeśe kaścana tasya nāma mahadyaśaḥ
meaning: तदेवर्तं तदु सत्यमाहुस्तदेव ब्रह्म परमं कवीनाम् | इष्टापूर्तं बहुधा जातं जायमानं विश्वं बिभर्ति भुवनस्य नाभिः | तदेवाग्निस्तद्वायुस्तथ्सूर्यस्तदु चन्द्रमाः | तदेव शुक्रममृतं तद्ब्रह्म तदापस्स प्रजापतिः | सर्वे निमेषा जज्ञिरे विद्युतः पुरुषादधि | कला मुहूर्ताः काष्ठाश्चाहोरात्राश्च सर्वशः | अर्धमासा मासा ऋतवः संवथ्सरश्च कल्पन्ताम् | स आपः प्रदुघे उभे इमे अन्तरिक्षमथो सुवः | नैनमूर्ध्वं न तिर्यञ्चं न मध्ये परिजग्रभत् | न तस्येशे कश्चन तस्य नाम महद्यशः
text_mt: That alone they call ṛta, that alone truth; that alone is the supreme brahman of the seers. / The navel of the world sustains all that is born and being born in many forms as sacrifice and charitable work. That alone is Agni, that is Vāyu, that is Sūrya, and that is Candramas; that alone is the bright, the immortal; that is brahman, that is the waters, he is Prajāpati. All twinking units of time were born from the flashing Puruṣa; the kalās, muhūrtas, kāṣṭhās, and days and nights entirely; / the half-months, months, seasons, and the year let them be fashioned. He milked out the waters, these two [worlds], the intermediate space, and also heaven. None has grasped him above, nor across, nor in the middle. No one rules over him; great renown is his name.

sanskrit_iast: na saṃdṛśe tiṣṭhati rūpamasya na cakṣuṣā paśyati kaścanainam | hṛdā manīṣā manasā'bhiklṛpto ya enaṃ viduramṛtāste bhavanti | adbhyassaṃbhūto hiraṇyagarbha ityaṣṭau | eṣa hi devaḥ pradiśo'nu sarvāḥ pūrvo hi jātassa u garbhe antaḥ | sa vijāyamānassa janiṣyamāṇaḥ pratyaṅmukhāstiṣṭhati viśvatomukhaḥ | viśvataścakṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvatohasta uta viśvataspāt | saṃ bāhubhyāṃ namati saṃ patatrairdyāvāpṛthivī janayandeva ekaḥ | venastatpaśyanviśvā bhuvanāni vidvān yatra viśvaṃ bhavatyekanīḷam | yasminnidaṃ saṃ ca vi caikaṃ sa otaḥ protaśca vibhuḥ prajāsu | pra tadvoce amṛtaṃ nu vidvāngandharvo nāma nihitaṃ guhāsu
meaning: न संदृशे तिष्ठति रूपमस्य न चक्षुषा पश्यति कश्चनैनम् | हृदा मनीषा मनसाऽभिक्लृप्तो य एनं विदुरमृतास्ते भवन्ति | अद्भ्यस्संभूतो हिरण्यगर्भ इत्यष्टौ | एष हि देवः प्रदिशोऽनु सर्वाः पूर्वो हि जातस्स उ गर्भे अन्तः | स विजायमानस्स जनिष्यमाणः प्रत्यङ्मुखास्तिष्ठति विश्वतोमुखः | विश्वतश्चक्षुरुत विश्वतोमुखो विश्वतोहस्त उत विश्वतस्पात् | सं बाहुभ्यां नमति सं पतत्रैर्द्यावापृथिवी जनयन्देव एकः | वेनस्तत्पश्यन्विश्वा भुवनानि विद्वान् यत्र विश्वं भवत्येकनीऌअम् | यस्मिन्निदं सं च वि चैकं स ओतः प्रोतश्च विभुः प्रजासु | प्र तद्वोचे अमृतं नु विद्वान्गन्धर्वो नाम निहितं गुहासु
text_mt: His form does not stand in visibility; no one sees him with the eye. Those who know him through the heart, through the intellect, through the mind as thus configured become immortal. Eight [verses beginning with] "Arisen from the waters" and "Hiranyagarbha". For this god extends along all the directions; indeed, he was born first, and he is within the womb. Being born and about to be born, he stands facing every being, facing in every direction. With eyes everywhere and face everywhere, with hands everywhere and feet everywhere, the one god, generating heaven and earth, welds them together with his two arms and with his wings. Vena, seeing that, knowing all worlds where everything becomes of a single nest; in whom all this unites and dissolves, he, the all-pervading, is woven warp and woof in his creatures. Let me now proclaim that immortal name, known to the gandharva, hidden in secret caves.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi padā nihitā guhāsu yastadveda savituḥ pitā sat | sa no bandhurjanitā sa vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā | yatra devā amṛtamānaśānāstṛtīye dhāmānyabhyairayanta | pari dyāvāpṛthivī yanti sadyaḥ pari lokānpari diśaḥ pari suvaḥ | ṛtasya tantuṃ vitataṃ vicṛtya tadapaśyattadabhavatprajāsu | parītya lokānparītya bhūtāni parītya sarvāḥ pradiśo diśaśca | prajāpatiḥ prathamajā ṛtasyātmanā''tmānamabhisaṃbabhūva | sadasaspatimadbhutaṃ priyamindrasya kāmyam | saniṃ medhāmayāsiṣam | uddīpyasva jātavedo'paghnannirṛtiṃ mama
meaning: त्रीणि पदा निहिता गुहासु यस्तद्वेद सवितुः पिता सत् | स नो बन्धुर्जनिता स विधाता धामानि वेद भुवनानि विश्वा | यत्र देवा अमृतमानशानास्तृतीये धामान्यभ्यैरयन्त | परि द्यावापृथिवी यन्ति सद्यः परि लोकान्परि दिशः परि सुवः | ऋतस्य तन्तुं विततं विचृत्य तदपश्यत्तदभवत्प्रजासु | परीत्य लोकान्परीत्य भूतानि परीत्य सर्वाः प्रदिशो दिशश्च | प्रजापतिः प्रथमजा ऋतस्यात्मना'ऽत्मानमभिसंबभूव | सदसस्पतिमद्भुतं प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् | सनिं मेधामयासिषम् | उद्दीप्यस्व जातवेदोऽपघ्नन्निरृतिं मम
text_mt: Three steps are laid down in secret caves; he who knows that shall be the father of Savitṛ. He is our kin, our progenitor, he is the ordainer; he knows the stations and all the worlds, where the gods, having attained immortality, moved upward to the stations in the third [world]. Moving quickly around heaven and earth, around the worlds, around the quarters, around heaven, having unfastened the outstretched thread of ṛta, he saw that, he became that in the creatures. / Having traversed the worlds, having traversed the beings, having traversed all the intermediate directions and the quarters, Prajāpati, the firstborn of ṛta, attained union of himself with himself through himself. / The marvelous lord of the assembly, dear and desirable to Indra, have I approached for gain and wisdom. / Flare up, O Jātavedas, driving away my misfortune.

sanskrit_iast: paśūṃśca mahyamāvaha jīvanaṃ ca diśo diśa | mā no hiṃsījjātavedo gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ jagat | abibhradagna āgahi śriyā mā paripātaya | puruṣasya vidma sahasrākṣasya mahādevasya dhīmahi | tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt | tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt | tatpuruṣāya vidmahe vakratuṇḍāya dhīmahi | tanno dantiḥ pracodayāt | tatpuruṣāya vidmahe cakratuṇḍāya dhīmahi
meaning: पशूंश्च मह्यमावह जीवनं च दिशो दिश | मा नो हिंसीज्जातवेदो गामश्वं पुरुषं जगत् | अबिभ्रदग्न आगहि श्रिया मा परिपातय | पुरुषस्य विद्म सहस्राक्षस्य महादेवस्य धीमहि | तन्नो रुद्रः प्रचोदयात् | तत्पुरुषाय विद्महे महादेवाय धीमहि | तन्नो रुद्रः प्रचोदयात् | तत्पुरुषाय विद्महे वक्रतुण्डाय धीमहि | तन्नो दन्तिः प्रचोदयात् | तत्पुरुषाय विद्महे चक्रतुण्डाय धीमहि
text_mt: Bring me cattle and livelihood, from quarter to quarter. May Jātavedas not harm our cow, horse, person, or living creature. Carrying [offerings], O Agni, come; encompass me with prosperity. / We know the Puruṣa; we meditate on the thousand-eyed Mahādeva; may Rudra inspire us to that. We know Tatpuruṣa; we meditate on Mahādeva; may Rudra inspire us to that. / We know Tatpuruṣa; we meditate on the curved-tusked one; may the tusked one inspire us to that. / We know Tatpuruṣa; we meditate on the wheel-snouted one;

sanskrit_iast: tanno nandiḥ pracodayāt | tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahāsenāya dhīmahi | tannaṣṣaṇmukhaḥ pracodayāt | tatpuruṣāya vidmahe suvarṇapakṣāya dhīmahi | tanno garuḍaḥ pracodayāt | vedātmanāya vidmahe hiraṇyagarbhāya dhīmahi | tanno brahma pracodayāt | nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi | tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt | vajranakhāya vidmahe tīkṣṇadaggṣṭrāya dhīmahi
meaning: तन्नो नन्दिः प्रचोदयात् | तत्पुरुषाय विद्महे महासेनाय धीमहि | तन्नष्षण्मुखः प्रचोदयात् | तत्पुरुषाय विद्महे सुवर्णपक्षाय धीमहि | तन्नो गरुडः प्रचोदयात् | वेदात्मनाय विद्महे हिरण्यगर्भाय धीमहि | तन्नो ब्रह्म प्रचोदयात् | नारायणाय विद्महे वासुदेवाय धीमहि | तन्नो विष्णुः प्रचोदयात् | वज्रनखाय विद्महे तीक्ष्णदग्ग्ष्ट्राय धीमहि
text_mt: may Nandi inspire us to that. We know Tatpuruṣa; we meditate on Mahāsena; / may the six-faced one inspire us to that. We know Tatpuruṣa; we meditate on the golden-winged one; / may Garuḍa inspire us to that. We know the one whose self is the Veda; we meditate on Hiraṇyagarbha; may Brahman inspire us to that. We know Nārāyaṇa; we meditate on Vāsudeva; / may Viṣṇu inspire us to that. We know the one with adamantine claws; we meditate on the one with sharp fangs;

sanskrit_iast: tanno nārasiṃhaḥ pracodayāt | bhāskarāya vidmahe mahadyutikarāya dhīmahi | tanno ādityaḥ pracodayāt | vaiśvānarāya vidmahe lālīlāya dhīmahi | tanno agniḥ pracodayāt | kātyāyanāya vidmahe kanyakumāri dhīmahi | tanno durgiḥ pracodayāt | sahasraparamā devī śatamūlā śatāṅkurā | sarvaṃ haratu me pāpaṃ dūrvā dussvapnanāśanī | kāṇḍātkāṇḍātprarohantī paruṣaḥparuṣaḥ pari
meaning: तन्नो नारसिंहः प्रचोदयात् | भास्कराय विद्महे महद्युतिकराय धीमहि | तन्नो आदित्यः प्रचोदयात् | वैश्वानराय विद्महे लालीलाय धीमहि | तन्नो अग्निः प्रचोदयात् | कात्यायनाय विद्महे कन्यकुमारि धीमहि | तन्नो दुर्गिः प्रचोदयात् | सहस्रपरमा देवी शतमूला शताङ्कुरा | सर्वं हरतु मे पापं दूर्वा दुस्स्वप्ननाशनी | काण्डात्काण्डात्प्ररोहन्ती परुषःपरुषः परि
text_mt: may Narasiṃha inspire us to that. We know Bhāskara; we meditate on the maker of great radiance; may Āditya inspire us to that. We know Vaiśvānara; we meditate on the dancing flame; may Agni inspire us to that. We know Kātyāyana; we meditate on Kanyakumārī; may Durgi inspire us to that. The goddess having a thousand as her highest, with a hundred roots and a hundred shoots, / may the dūrvā grass, destroyer of bad dreams, take away all my sin. Sprouting from joint to joint, from node to node,

sanskrit_iast: evā no dūrve pratanu sahasreṇa śatena ca | yā śatena pratanoṣi sahasreṇa virohasi | tasyāste devīṣṭake vidhema haviṣā vayam | aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasundharā | śirasā dhārayiṣyāmi rakṣasva māṃ padepade | bhūmirdhenurdharaṇī lokadhāriṇī | uddhṛtā'si varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā | mṛttike hana me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | mṛttike brahmadattā''si kāśyapenābhimantritā | mṛttike dehi me puṣṭiṃ tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
meaning: एवा नो दूर्वे प्रतनु सहस्रेण शतेन च | या शतेन प्रतनोषि सहस्रेण विरोहसि | तस्यास्ते देवीष्टके विधेम हविषा वयम् | अश्वक्रान्ते रथक्रान्ते विष्णुक्रान्ते वसुन्धरा | शिरसा धारयिष्यामि रक्षस्व मां पदेपदे | भूमिर्धेनुर्धरणी लोकधारिणी | उद्धृताऽसि वराहेण कृष्णेन शतबाहुना | मृत्तिके हन मे पापं यन्मया दुष्कृतं कृतम् | मृत्तिके ब्रह्मदत्ता'ऽसि काश्यपेनाभिमन्त्रिता | मृत्तिके देहि मे पुष्टिं त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्
text_mt: even so, O dūrvā, extend us with a thousand and with a hundred. You who extend with a hundred and sprout with a thousand, to you, divine brick, we would offer worship with oblation. / Stridden over by horses, stridden over by chariots, stridden over by Viṣṇu, O earth, I shall carry [you] on my head; protect me at every step. Earth, milk-cow, supporter, sustainer of the world, you were lifted up by the black hundred-armed boar. O earth, destroy my sin, whatever misdeed has been done by me. O earth, you are given by brahman, consecrated by Kaśyapa. / O earth, grant me nourishment; everything is established upon you.

sanskrit_iast: mṛttike pratiṣṭhite sarvaṃ tanme nirṇuda mṛttike | tayā hatena pāpena gacchāmi paramāṃ gatim | yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi | maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtaye vidviṣo vimṛdho jahi | svastidā viśaspatirvṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī | vṛṣendraḥ pura etu nassvastidā abhayaṃkaraḥ | svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāssvasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemissvasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu | āpānta manyustṛpalaprabharmā dhuniḥ śimīvāñcharumāṃ ṛjīṣī | somo viśvānyatasā vanāni nārvāgindraṃ pratimānāni debhuḥ
meaning: मृत्तिके प्रतिष्ठिते सर्वं तन्मे निर्णुद मृत्तिके | तया हतेन पापेन गच्छामि परमां गतिम् | यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि | मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये विद्विषो विमृधो जहि | स्वस्तिदा विशस्पतिर्वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी | वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नस्स्वस्तिदा अभयंकरः | स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवास्स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः | स्वस्ति नस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिस्स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु | आपान्त मन्युस्तृपलप्रभर्मा धुनिः शिमीवाञ्छरुमां ऋजीषी | सोमो विश्वान्यतसा वनानि नार्वागिन्द्रं प्रतिमानानि देभुः
text_mt: O earth, on whom all is established, cast that away for me, O earth. With my sin destroyed by her, I go to the supreme path. Whence we fear, O Indra, make us free from fear from that. O bounteous one, grant that to us for our help; strike down the haters, the adversaries. Bestower of well-being, lord of the clan, slayer of Vṛtra, subduer of adversaries, / may bull Indra go before us, bestower of well-being, maker of fearlessness. May Indra of ancient fame grant us well-being; may Pūṣan who knows all grant us well-being; may Tārkṣya of uninjured felly grant us well-being; may Bṛhaspati ordain well-being for us. / Having drunk of the fury, bearing it in a drop, shaking, powerful, arrow-bearing, bearing the residue, Soma, [rushing through] all the low-lying forests—the adversaries could not overcome Indra.

sanskrit_iast: brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastādvi sīmatassuruco vena āvaḥ | sa budhniyā upamā asya viṣṭhāssataśca yonimasataśca vivaḥ | syonā pṛthivi bhavā nṛkṣarā niveśanī | yacchā naḥ śarma saprathāḥ | gandhadvārāṃ durādharṣāṃ nityapuṣṭāṃ karīṣiṇīm | īśvarīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyam | śrīrme bhajatu | alakṣmīrme naśyatu | viṣṇumukhā vai devāśchandobhirimān lokānanapajayyamabhyajayan | mahāṃ indro vajrabāhuḥ ṣoḍaśī śarma yacchatu
meaning: ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद्वि सीमतस्सुरुचो वेन आवः | स बुध्निया उपमा अस्य विष्ठास्सतश्च योनिमसतश्च विवः | स्योना पृथिवि भवा नृक्षरा निवेशनी | यच्छा नः शर्म सप्रथाः | गन्धद्वारां दुराधर्षां नित्यपुष्टां करीषिणीम् | ईश्वरीं सर्वभूतानां तामिहोपह्वये श्रियम् | श्रीर्मे भजतु | अलक्ष्मीर्मे नश्यतु | विष्णुमुखा वै देवाश्छन्दोभिरिमान् लोकाननपजय्यमभ्यजयन् | महां इन्द्रो वज्रबाहुः षोडशी शर्म यच्छतु
text_mt: Brahman born first in the east, Vena revealed from the shining boundary. / He revealed its fundamental, highest stations, and the womb of being and non-being. Be pleasant, O earth, free from thorns, a resting-place; grant us broad shelter. / Her whose gate is fragrance, unassailable, constantly nourished, rich in dung, sovereign over all beings—here I invoke that Śrī. May Śrī attend me; may Alakṣmī perish from me. / The gods, with Viṣṇu at their head, conquered these worlds with metres so as not to be conquered. May great Indra of the thunderbolt-arm, the sixteen-fold, grant us shelter.

sanskrit_iast: svasti no maghavā karotu hantu pāpmānaṃ yo'smāndveṣṭi | somānagg svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate | kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijam | śarīraṃ yajñaśamalaṃ kusīdaṃ tasminthsīdatu yo'smāndveṣṭi | caraṇaṃ pavitraṃ vitataṃ purāṇaṃ yena pūtastarati duṣkṛtāni | tena pavitreṇa śuddhena pūtā ati pāpmānamarātiṃ tarema | sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahañchūra vidvān | jahi śatrūṃrapa mṛdho nudasvāthābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ | sumitrā na āpa oṣadhayassantu durmitrāstasmai bhūyāsuryo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ | āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana
meaning: स्वस्ति नो मघवा करोतु हन्तु पाप्मानं योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि | सोमानग्ग् स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते | कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजम् | शरीरं यज्ञशमलं कुसीदं तस्मिन्थ्सीदतु योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि | चरणं पवित्रं विततं पुराणं येन पूतस्तरति दुष्कृतानि | तेन पवित्रेण शुद्धेन पूता अति पाप्मानमरातिं तरेम | सजोषा इन्द्र सगणो मरुद्भिः सोमं पिब वृत्रहञ्छूर विद्वान् | जहि शत्रूंरप मृधो नुदस्वाथाभयं कृणुहि विश्वतो नः | सुमित्रा न आप ओषधयस्सन्तु दुर्मित्रास्तस्मै भूयासुर्योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः | आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन
text_mt: May Maghavan bring us well-being; may he slay the evil [one] who hates us. / Make Soma sweet-sounding, O Brahmaṇaspati, / as Kakṣīvant, the son of Uśij. / The body, the stain of the sacrifice, usury—may he who hates us sit in that. / The wide-spread, ancient purifying strainer by which purified one crosses beyond misdeeds— / by that strainer, clean and pure, may we cross beyond evil and enmity. / Harmonious, O Indra, with your troop of Maruts, drink the Soma, O Vṛtra-slayer, heroic and wise. / Slay the enemies, thrust away the adversaries, and make us fearless from every side. / May the waters and the plants be friendly to us; may they be unfriendly to him who hates us and whom we hate. / Waters, you are indeed the sources of joy; so grant us strength

sanskrit_iast: mahe raṇāya cakṣase | yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ | uśatīriva mātaraḥ | tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha | āpo janayathā ca naḥ | hiraṇyaśṛṅgaṃ varuṇaṃ prapadye tīrthaṃ me dehi yācitaḥ | yanmayā bhuktamasādhūnāṃ pāpebhyaśca pratigrahaḥ | yanme manasā vācā karmaṇā vā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | tanna indro varuṇo bṛhaspatissavitā ca punantu punaḥ punaḥ | namo'gnaye'psumate nama indrāya namo varuṇāya namo vāruṇyai namo'dbhyaḥ
meaning: महे रणाय चक्षसे | यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः | उशतीरिव मातरः | तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ | आपो जनयथा च नः | हिरण्यशृङ्गं वरुणं प्रपद्ये तीर्थं मे देहि याचितः | यन्मया भुक्तमसाधूनां पापेभ्यश्च प्रतिग्रहः | यन्मे मनसा वाचा कर्मणा वा दुष्कृतं कृतम् | तन्न इन्द्रो वरुणो बृहस्पतिस्सविता च पुनन्तु पुनः पुनः | नमोऽग्नयेऽप्सुमते नम इन्द्राय नमो वरुणाय नमो वारुण्यै नमोऽद्भ्यः
text_mt: for great and delightful sight. / Whatever is your most auspicious essence, make us partake of that here, / like longing mothers. / To that [essence] may we readily go, to whose dwelling you quicken [us]; / and bring us forth [to life], O waters. / I take refuge in golden-horned Varuṇa; besought, give me a sacred ford. / Whatever of unrighteous men has been eaten by me, and [whatever] acceptance of gifts from the wicked, / whatever misdeed has been done by me in mind, speech, or action, / may Indra, Varuṇa, Bṛhaspati, and Savitṛ purify us of that again and again. / Homage to Agni who is in the waters; homage to Indra; homage to Varuṇa; homage to Vāruṇī; homage to the waters.

sanskrit_iast: yadapāṃ krūraṃ yadamedhyaṃ yadaśāntaṃ tadapagacchatāt | atyāśanādatīpānādyacca ugrātpratigrahāt | tanno varuṇo rājā pāṇinā hyavamarśatu | so'hamapāpo virajo nirmukto muktakilbiṣaḥ | nākasya pṛṣṭhamāruhya gacchedbrahma salokatām | yaścāpsu varuṇassa punātvaghamarṣaṇaḥ | imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati śutudri stomaṃ sacatā paruṣṇiyā | asikniyā marudvṛdhe vitastayā''rjīkīye śṛṇuhyā suṣomayā | ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cābhīddhāttapaso'dhyajāyata | tato rātrirajāyata tataḥ samudro arṇavaḥ
meaning: यदपां क्रूरं यदमेध्यं यदशान्तं तदपगच्छतात् | अत्याशनादतीपानाद्यच्च उग्रात्प्रतिग्रहात् | तन्नो वरुणो राजा पाणिना ह्यवमर्शतु | सोऽहमपापो विरजो निर्मुक्तो मुक्तकिल्बिषः | नाकस्य पृष्ठमारुह्य गच्छेद्ब्रह्म सलोकताम् | यश्चाप्सु वरुणस्स पुनात्वघमर्षणः | इमं मे गङ्गे यमुने सरस्वति शुतुद्रि स्तोमं सचता परुष्णिया | असिक्निया मरुद्वृधे वितस्तया'ऽर्जीकीये शृणुह्या सुषोमया | ऋतं च सत्यं चाभीद्धात्तपसोऽध्यजायत | ततो रात्रिरजायत ततः समुद्रो अर्णवः
text_mt: Whatever of the waters is cruel, whatever is impure, whatever is unpacified, may that go away. / From overeating, from overdrinking, and from a terrible acceptance of gifts, / may King Varuṇa wipe us clean with his hand. / So, freed from evil, stainless, liberated, with faults discarded, / climbing up to the ridge of the firmament, may I attain common world with brahman. / And Varuṇa, who is in the waters, the expeller of sin, may he purify [us]. / O Gaṅgā, Yamunā, Sarasvatī, Śutudrī, along with Paruṣṇī, attend to this my praise; / with Asiknī, O Marudvṛdhā, with Vitastā, Ārjīkīyā, listen with Suṣomā. / Cosmic order and truth were born from kindled ascetic heat; / from that, night was born; from that, the billowy ocean.

sanskrit_iast: samudrādarṇavādadhi saṃvathsaro ajāyata | ahorātrāṇi vidadhadviśvasya miṣato vaśī | sūryācandramasau dhātā yathāpūrvamakalpayat | divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣamatho suvaḥ | yatpṛthivyāṃ rajassvamāntarikṣe virodasī | imāṃstadāpo varuṇaḥ punātvaghamarṣaṇaḥ | punantu vasavaḥ punātu varuṇaḥ punātvaghamarṣaṇaḥ | eṣa bhūtasya madhye bhuvanasya goptā | eṣa puṇyakṛtāṃ lokāneṣa mṛtyorhiraṇmayam | dyāvāpṛthivyorhiraṇmayaṃ saṃśritaṃ suvaḥ
meaning: समुद्रादर्णवादधि संवथ्सरो अजायत | अहोरात्राणि विदधद्विश्वस्य मिषतो वशी | सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ धाता यथापूर्वमकल्पयत् | दिवं च पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षमथो सुवः | यत्पृथिव्यां रजस्स्वमान्तरिक्षे विरोदसी | इमांस्तदापो वरुणः पुनात्वघमर्षणः | पुनन्तु वसवः पुनातु वरुणः पुनात्वघमर्षणः | एष भूतस्य मध्ये भुवनस्य गोप्ता | एष पुण्यकृतां लोकानेष मृत्योर्हिरण्मयम् | द्यावापृथिव्योर्हिरण्मयं संश्रितं सुवः
text_mt: From the billowy ocean the year was born, / ordaining days and nights, the ruler of all that blinks. / Sūrya and the moon Dhātṛ fashioned according to what was before, / and the sky, and the earth, and the intermediate space, and then heaven. / Whatever dust is on the earth, in the intermediate space, between heaven and earth— / may these waters, [may] Varuṇa, the expeller of sin, purify that. / May the Vasus purify, may Varuṇa purify, may the expeller of sin purify. / He is the protector of the world in the midst of creation; / he [protects] the worlds of those who have done merit, he the golden [world] from death, / the golden heaven resting upon heaven and earth.

sanskrit_iast: sa nassuvaḥ saṃśiśādhi | ārdraṃ jvalati jyotirahamasmi | jyotirjvalati brahmāhamasmi | yo'hamasmi brahmāhamasmi | ahamasmi brahmāhamasmi | ahamevāhaṃ māṃ juhomi svāhā | akāryakāryavakīrṇī steno bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ | varuṇo'pāmaghamarṣaṇastasmāt pāpāt pramucyate | rajobhūmistva māṃ rodayasva pravadanti dhīrāḥ | ākrānthsamudraḥ prathame vidharmañjanayanprajā bhuvanasya rājā | vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avye bṛhathsomo vāvṛdhe suvāna induḥ
meaning: स नस्सुवः संशिशाधि | आर्द्रं ज्वलति ज्योतिरहमस्मि | ज्योतिर्ज्वलति ब्रह्माहमस्मि | योऽहमस्मि ब्रह्माहमस्मि | अहमस्मि ब्रह्माहमस्मि | अहमेवाहं मां जुहोमि स्वाहा | अकार्यकार्यवकीर्णी स्तेनो भ्रूणहा गुरुतल्पगः | वरुणोऽपामघमर्षणस्तस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते | रजोभूमिस्त्व मां रोदयस्व प्रवदन्ति धीराः | आक्रान्थ्समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मञ्जनयन्प्रजा भुवनस्य राजा | वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बृहथ्सोमो वावृधे सुवान इन्दुः
text_mt: Do you sharpen that heaven for us. / Moisture burns; light am I. / Light burns; brahman am I. / Who I am, brahman am I. / I am, brahman am I. / Myself alone, myself I offer, svāhā. / One who has done what should not be done, a violator of vows, a thief, a killer of an embryo, a violator of the teacher’s bed— / Varuṇa, the expeller of sin in the waters, is freed from that sin. / "O Earth, realm of dust, do not make me weep," the wise proclaim. / The ocean stepped forward in the first ordinance, bringing forth creatures, the king of the world; / the bull on the strainer, upon the sheep's fleece, great Soma, being pressed, the drop increased. / In front, renown is deposited in the secret places. We meditate on Cakratuṇḍa, we meditate on Tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭra; firmly established around, they deceived; may he grant; grant; from the waters; the ocean; heaven; the king, and one. 1. / Rudra, and Rudra, and Dantin, and Nandin, and Ṣaṇmukha, / Garuḍa, Brahman, and Viṣṇu, and Narasiṃha likewise, / Āditya, Agni, and Durgi in order, twelve in the water: / ma ma va ca ma su ve nā va bhā vai kātyāyanāya.

sanskrit_iast: jātavedase sunavāma somamarātīyato nidahāti vedaḥ | sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva sindhuṃ duritā'tyagniḥ | tāmagnivarṇāṃ tapasā jvalantīṃ vairocanīṃ karmaphaleṣu juṣṭām | durgāṃ devīṃ śaraṇamahaṃ prapadye sutarasi tarase namaḥ | agne tvaṃ pārayā navyo asmānthsvastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā | pūśca pṛthvī bahulā na urvī bhavā tokāya tanayāya śaṃyoḥ | viśvāni no durgahā jātavedassindhuṃ na nāvā duritā'tiparṣi | agne atrivanmanasā gṛṇāno'smākaṃ bodhyavitā tanūnām | pṛtanājitaṃ sahamānamugramagniṃ huvema paramāthsadhasthāt | sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā kṣāmaddevo atiduritā'tyagniḥ | pratnoṣi kamīḍyo adhvareṣu sanācca hotā navyaśca sathsi | svāṃ cāgne tanuvaṃ piprayasvāsmabhyaṃ ca saubhagamāyajasva | gobhirjuṣṭamayujo niṣiktaṃ tavendra viṣṇoranusaṃcarema | nākasya pṛṣṭhamabhi saṃvasāno vaiṣṇavīṃ loka iha mādayantām
meaning: जातवेदसे सुनवाम सोममरातीयतो निदहाति वेदः | स नः पर्षदति दुर्गाणि विश्वा नावेव सिन्धुं दुरिताऽत्यग्निः | तामग्निवर्णां तपसा ज्वलन्तीं वैरोचनीं कर्मफलेषु जुष्टाम् | दुर्गां देवीं शरणमहं प्रपद्ये सुतरसि तरसे नमः | अग्ने त्वं पारया नव्यो अस्मान्थ्स्वस्तिभिरति दुर्गाणि विश्वा | पूश्च पृथ्वी बहुला न उर्वी भवा तोकाय तनयाय शंयोः | विश्वानि नो दुर्गहा जातवेदस्सिन्धुं न नावा दुरिताऽतिपर्षि | अग्ने अत्रिवन्मनसा गृणानोऽस्माकं बोध्यविता तनूनाम् | पृतनाजितं सहमानमुग्रमग्निं हुवेम परमाथ्सधस्थात् | स नः पर्षदति दुर्गाणि विश्वा क्षामद्देवो अतिदुरिताऽत्यग्निः | प्रत्नोषि कमीड्यो अध्वरेषु सनाच्च होता नव्यश्च सथ्सि | स्वां चाग्ने तनुवं पिप्रयस्वास्मभ्यं च सौभगमायजस्व | गोभिर्जुष्टमयुजो निषिक्तं तवेन्द्र विष्णोरनुसंचरेम | नाकस्य पृष्ठमभि संवसानो वैष्णवीं लोक इह मादयन्ताम्
text_mt: For Jātavedas let us press the Soma; may he burn away the property of the one acting as enemy. / May he, Agni, carry us across all difficulties, as if across a river by boat, over hardships. / Her, of the color of Agni, blazing with ascetic heat, daughter of the sun, cherished in the fruits of action, / to Durgā, the goddess, I take refuge; well-crossing, homage to [your] swiftness. / O Agni, worthy of praise, carry us across all difficulties with blessings; / become a wide, abundant, broad fortress for our children and descendants, for well-being. / Bearing [us] across all difficulties, O Jātavedas, carry [us] over hardships, as across a river by boat; / O Agni, being praised in mind like Atri, be the protector of our bodies. / Let us invoke from the highest dwelling-place Agni, conqueror of armies, overcoming, fierce; / may he, the god, burn away, Agni [carry us] across all difficulties, over hardships. / You are the ancient one, delightful, to be praised at the sacrifices, and from of old you sit as the newer Hotṛ; / O Agni, gladden your own body, and sacrifice for us good fortune. / Welcomed by cows, unyoked, poured out, may we follow after yours, O Indra and Viṣṇu. / Dwelling upon the ridge of the firmament, may they delight here in the Vaiṣṇava world. / Over hardships, Agni; and four.

sanskrit_iast: bhūrannamagnaye pṛthivyai svāhā bhuvo'nnaṃ vāyave'ntarikṣāya svāhā suvarannamādityāya dive svāhā bhūrbhuvassuvarannaṃ candramase digbhyassvāhā namo devebhyassvadhā pitṛbhyo bhūrbhuvassuvarannamom
meaning: भूरन्नमग्नये पृथिव्यै स्वाहा भुवोऽन्नं वायवेऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा सुवरन्नमादित्याय दिवे स्वाहा भूर्भुवस्सुवरन्नं चन्द्रमसे दिग्भ्यस्स्वाहा नमो देवेभ्यस्स्वधा पितृभ्यो भूर्भुवस्सुवरन्नमोम्
text_mt: Bhūḥ, food, to Agni, to the earth, svāhā! Bhuvaḥ, food, to Vāyu, to the intermediate space, svāhā! Suvar, food, to Āditya, to the sky, svāhā! Bhūr-bhuvas-suvar, food, to the moon, to the quarters, svāhā! Homage to the gods! Svadhā to the fathers! Bhūr-bhuvas-suvar, food, om!

sanskrit_iast: bhūragnaye pṛthivyai svāhā bhuvo vāyave'ntarikṣāya svāhā suvarādityāya dive svāhā bhūrbhuvassuvaścandramase digbhyassvāhā namo devebhyassvadhā pitṛbhyo bhūrbhuvassuvaragna om
meaning: भूरग्नये पृथिव्यै स्वाहा भुवो वायवेऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा सुवरादित्याय दिवे स्वाहा भूर्भुवस्सुवश्चन्द्रमसे दिग्भ्यस्स्वाहा नमो देवेभ्यस्स्वधा पितृभ्यो भूर्भुवस्सुवरग्न ओम्
text_mt: Bhūḥ, to Agni, to the earth, svāhā! Bhuvaḥ, to Vāyu, to the intermediate space, svāhā! Suvar, to Āditya, to the sky, svāhā! Bhūr-bhuvas-suvaḥ, to the moon, to the quarters, svāhā! Homage to the gods! Svadhā to the fathers! Bhūr-bhuvas-suvar, Agni, om!

sanskrit_iast: bhūragnaye ca pṛthivyai ca mahate ca svāhā bhuvo vāyave cāntarikṣāya ca mahate ca svāhā suvarādityāya ca dive ca mahate ca svāhā bhūrbhuvassuvaścandramase ca nakṣatrebhyaśca digbhyaśca mahate ca svāhā namo devebhyassvadhā pitṛbhyo bhūrbhuvassuvarmaharom
meaning: भूरग्नये च पृथिव्यै च महते च स्वाहा भुवो वायवे चान्तरिक्षाय च महते च स्वाहा सुवरादित्याय च दिवे च महते च स्वाहा भूर्भुवस्सुवश्चन्द्रमसे च नक्षत्रेभ्यश्च दिग्भ्यश्च महते च स्वाहा नमो देवेभ्यस्स्वधा पितृभ्यो भूर्भुवस्सुवर्महरोम्
text_mt: Bhūḥ, to Agni, and to the earth, and to the Great, svāhā! Bhuvaḥ, to Vāyu, and to the intermediate space, and to the Great, svāhā! Suvar, to Āditya, and to the sky, and to the Great, svāhā! Bhūr-bhuvas-suvaḥ, to the moon, and to the lunar mansions, and to the quarters, and to the Great, svāhā! Homage to the gods! Svadhā to the fathers! Bhūr-bhuvas-suvar, mahas, om!

sanskrit_iast: pāhi no agna enase svāhā | pāhi no viśvavedase svāhā | yajñaṃ pāhi vibhāvaso svāhā | sarvaṃ pāhi śatakrato svāhā
meaning: पाहि नो अग्न एनसे स्वाहा | पाहि नो विश्ववेदसे स्वाहा | यज्ञं पाहि विभावसो स्वाहा | सर्वं पाहि शतक्रतो स्वाहा
text_mt: Protect us, O Agni, from sin, svāhā! / Protect us, O all-possessing one, svāhā! / Protect the sacrifice, O radiant one, svāhā! / Protect everything, O you of a hundred rites, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: pāhi no agna ekayā | pāhyuta dvitīyayā | pāhyūrjaṃ tṛtīyayā | pāhi gīrbhiścatasṛbhirvaso svāhā
meaning: पाहि नो अग्न एकया | पाह्युत द्वितीयया | पाह्यूर्जं तृतीयया | पाहि गीर्भिश्चतसृभिर्वसो स्वाहा
text_mt: Protect us, O Agni, with the first [verse]; / protect also with the second; / protect our strength with the third; / protect with four songs, O Vasu, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: yaśchandasāmṛṣabho viśvarūpaśchandobhyaścandāṃsyāviveśa | satāṃ śikyaḥ purovācopaniṣadindro jyeṣṭha indriyāya ṛṣibhyo namo devebhyassvadhā pitṛbhyo bhūrbhuvassuvaśchanda om
meaning: यश्छन्दसामृषभो विश्वरूपश्छन्दोभ्यश्चन्दांस्याविवेश | सतां शिक्यः पुरोवाचोपनिषदिन्द्रो ज्येष्ठ इन्द्रियाय ऋषिभ्यो नमो देवेभ्यस्स्वधा पितृभ्यो भूर्भुवस्सुवश्छन्द ओम्
text_mt: He who is the bull of the metres, possessing every form, who from the metres entered into the metres, / the support of the good, the preliminary utterance, the secret teaching, Indra the eldest, for vigour: homage to the seers, to the gods! Svadhā to the fathers! Bhūr, bhuvas, suvar! The metre: Om!

sanskrit_iast: namo brahmaṇe dhāraṇaṃ me astvanirākaraṇaṃ dhārayitā bhūyāsaṃ karṇayoḥ śrutaṃ mā cyoḍhvaṃ mamāmuṣya om
meaning: नमो ब्रह्मणे धारणं मे अस्त्वनिराकरणं धारयिता भूयासं कर्णयोः श्रुतं मा च्योढ्वं ममामुष्य ओम्
text_mt: Homage to brahman! May retaining be mine, may there be no rejection! May I become one who retains! May what has been heard by my ears not slip away from me, [the son/disciple] of so-and-so! Om!

sanskrit_iast: ṛtaṃ tapassattyaṃ tapaḥ śrutaṃ tapaḥ śāntaṃ tapo damastapaḥ śamastapo dānaṃ tapo yajñaṃ tapo bhūrbhuvassuvarbrahmaitadupāsyaitattapaḥ
meaning: ऋतं तपस्सत्त्यं तपः श्रुतं तपः शान्तं तपो दमस्तपः शमस्तपो दानं तपो यज्ञं तपो भूर्भुवस्सुवर्ब्रह्मैतदुपास्यैतत्तपः
text_mt: Cosmic order is ascetic heat. Truth is ascetic heat. Sacred learning is ascetic heat. Peaceful composure is ascetic heat. Self-restraint is ascetic heat. Tranquillity is ascetic heat. Generosity is ascetic heat. Sacrifice is ascetic heat. Bhūr, bhuvas, suvar is brahman: this is to be meditated upon; this is ascetic heat.

sanskrit_iast: yathā vṛkṣasya saṃpuṣpitasya dūrādgandho vātyevaṃ puṇyasya karmaṇo dūrādgandho vāti yathā'sidhārāṃ karte'vahitāmavakrāme yadyuve yuve havā vihvayiṣyāmi kartaṃ patiṣyāmītyevamamṛtādātmānaṃ jugupset
meaning: यथा वृक्षस्य संपुष्पितस्य दूराद्गन्धो वात्येवं पुण्यस्य कर्मणो दूराद्गन्धो वाति यथाऽसिधारां कर्तेऽवहितामवक्रामे यद्युवे युवे हवा विह्वयिष्यामि कर्तं पतिष्यामीत्येवममृतादात्मानं जुगुप्सेत्
text_mt: Just as the fragrance of a tree in full bloom blows from afar, so the fragrance of a meritorious deed blows from afar. Just as one might step onto the edge of a sword placed over a pit, [thinking,] 'If I stagger, indeed I shall falter, I shall fall into the pit'—so should one guard oneself against falling away from the immortal.

sanskrit_iast: aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahīyānātmā guhāyāṃ nihito'sya jantoḥ | tamakratuṃ paśyati vītaśoko dhātuḥ prasādānmahimānamīśam | sapta prāṇāḥ prabhavanti tasmāthsaptārciṣassamidhassapta jihvāḥ | sapta ime lokā yeṣu caranti prāṇā guhāśayāṃ nihitāssaptasapta | atassamudrā girayaśca sarve'smāthsyandante sindhavassarvarūpāḥ | ataśca viśvā oṣadhayo rasācca yenaiṣa bhūtastiṣṭhatyantarātmā | brahmā devānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnāmṛṣirviprāṇāṃ mahiṣo mṛgāṇām | śyeno gṛddhrāṇāg svadhitirvanānāṃ somaḥ pavitramatyeti rebhann | ajāmekāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ bahvīṃ prajāṃ janayantīṃ sarūpām | ajo hyeko juṣamāṇo'nuśete jahātyenāṃ bhuktabhogāmajo'nyaḥ
meaning: अणोरणीयान्महतो महीयानात्मा गुहायां निहितोऽस्य जन्तोः | तमक्रतुं पश्यति वीतशोको धातुः प्रसादान्महिमानमीशम् | सप्त प्राणाः प्रभवन्ति तस्माथ्सप्तार्चिषस्समिधस्सप्त जिह्वाः | सप्त इमे लोका येषु चरन्ति प्राणा गुहाशयां निहितास्सप्तसप्त | अतस्समुद्रा गिरयश्च सर्वेऽस्माथ्स्यन्दन्ते सिन्धवस्सर्वरूपाः | अतश्च विश्वा ओषधयो रसाच्च येनैष भूतस्तिष्ठत्यन्तरात्मा | ब्रह्मा देवानां पदवीः कवीनामृषिर्विप्राणां महिषो मृगाणाम् | श्येनो गृद्ध्राणाग् स्वधितिर्वनानां सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन्न् | अजामेकां लोहितशुक्लकृष्णां बह्वीं प्रजां जनयन्तीं सरूपाम् | अजो ह्येको जुषमाणोऽनुशेते जहात्येनां भुक्तभोगामजोऽन्यः
text_mt: Subtler than the subtle, greater than the great, the self is placed in the hidden cave of this living creature. / Free from sorrow, through the grace of the creator, he sees that ruler, without ritual action, and [his] greatness. / From him originate the seven vital breaths, the seven flames, the firewood, the seven tongues; / these seven worlds in which the vital breaths move, placed in the hidden cave, seven by seven. / From him come all the oceans and mountains; from him flow rivers of every form. / And from him come all plants and juices, by which this inner self remains existing among beings. / Brahman of the gods, leader of the wise, seer of the inspired poets, water-buffalo of wild animals, / falcon of vultures, axe of the forests—resounding, Soma passes beyond the purifying strainer. / One she-goat, red, white, and black, producing abundant offspring of like form: / one he-goat, delighting in her, lies by her; another he-goat abandons her after her pleasures have been enjoyed.

sanskrit_iast: haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat | nṛṣadvarasadṛtasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat | ghṛtaṃ mimikṣire ghṛtamasya yonirghṛte śrito ghṛtamuvasya dhāma | anuṣvadhamāvaha mādayasva svāhākṛtaṃ vṛṣabha vakṣi havyam | samudrādūrmirmadhumāṃ udāradupāṃśunā samamṛtatvamānaṭ | ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ | vayaṃ nāma prabravāmā ghṛtenāsmin yajñe dhārayāmā namobhiḥ | upa brahmā śṛṇavacchasyamānaṃ catuḥ śṛṅgo'vamīdgaura etat | catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya | tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti maho devo martyāṃ āviveśa
meaning: हंसः शुचिषद्वसुरन्तरिक्षसद्धोता वेदिषदतिथिर्दुरोणसत् | नृषद्वरसदृतसद्व्योमसदब्जा गोजा ऋतजा अद्रिजा ऋतं बृहत् | घृतं मिमिक्षिरे घृतमस्य योनिर्घृते श्रितो घृतमुवस्य धाम | अनुष्वधमावह मादयस्व स्वाहाकृतं वृषभ वक्षि हव्यम् | समुद्रादूर्मिर्मधुमां उदारदुपांशुना सममृतत्वमानट् | घृतस्य नाम गुह्यं यदस्ति जिह्वा देवानाममृतस्य नाभिः | वयं नाम प्रब्रवामा घृतेनास्मिन् यज्ञे धारयामा नमोभिः | उप ब्रह्मा शृणवच्छस्यमानं चतुः शृङ्गोऽवमीद्गौर एतत् | चत्वारि शृङ्गा त्रयो अस्य पादा द्वे शीर्षे सप्त हस्तासो अस्य | त्रिधा बद्धो वृषभो रोरवीति महो देवो मर्त्यां आविवेश
text_mt: The swan seated in the clear sky, the Vasu seated in the intermediate space, the Hotṛ seated at the altar, the guest seated in the house, / seated among men, seated in the best [place], seated in cosmic order, seated in the sky, born of water, born of cows, born of cosmic order, born of rock, the great cosmic order. / They have sprinkled the clarified butter; clarified butter is his womb; he rests upon clarified butter; clarified butter indeed is his domain. / Bring [the gods] according to your custom; rejoice!
