O bull, carry the oblation made with svāhā! / From the ocean the honey-rich wave arose; through the silent [mantra] it attained immortality. / The secret name of clarified butter that exists is the tongue of the gods, the navel of immortality. / Let us proclaim that name with clarified butter in this sacrifice; let us sustain it with homages. / May the priest hear [this] being recited; the four-horned ox bellowed this. / Four are his horns, three his feet, two his heads, seven his hands; / bound in three ways, the bull bellows aloud; the great god has entered mortals.

sanskrit_iast: tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhirguhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtamanvavindann | indra ekaṃ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venādekaṃ svadhayā niṣṭatakṣuḥ | yo devānāṃ prathamaṃ purastādviśvādhiyo rudro maharṣiḥ | hiraṇyagarbhaṃ paśyata jāyamānaṃ sa no devaḥ śubhayā smṛtyāssaṃyunaktu | yasmātparaṃ nāparamasti kiṃcidyasmānnāṇīyo na jyāyo'sti kaścit | vṛkṣa iva stabdho divi tiṣṭhatyekastenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa sarvam | na karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena tyāgenaike amṛtatvamānaśuḥ | pareṇa nākaṃ nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ vibhrājadetadyatayo viśanti | vedāntavijñānasuniścitārthāḥ saṃnyāsayogādyatayaḥ śuddhasattvāḥ | te brahmaloke tu parāntakāle parāmṛtātparimucyanti sarve | dahraṃ vipāpaṃ parameśmabhūtaṃ yatpuṇḍarīkaṃ puramadhyasaṃstham | tatrāpi dahraṃ gaganaṃ viśokastasmin yadantastadupāsitavyam | yo vedādau svaraḥ prokto vedānte ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ | tasya prakṛtilīnasya yaḥ parassa maheśvaraḥ
meaning: त्रिधा हितं पणिभिर्गुह्यमानं गवि देवासो घृतमन्वविन्दन्न् | इन्द्र एकं सूर्य एकं जजान वेनादेकं स्वधया निष्टतक्षुः | यो देवानां प्रथमं पुरस्ताद्विश्वाधियो रुद्रो महर्षिः | हिरण्यगर्भं पश्यत जायमानं स नो देवः शुभया स्मृत्यास्संयुनक्तु | यस्मात्परं नापरमस्ति किंचिद्यस्मान्नाणीयो न ज्यायोऽस्ति कश्चित् | वृक्ष इव स्तब्धो दिवि तिष्ठत्येकस्तेनेदं पूर्णं पुरुषेण सर्वम् | न कर्मणा न प्रजया धनेन त्यागेनैके अमृतत्वमानशुः | परेण नाकं निहितं गुहायां विभ्राजदेतद्यतयो विशन्ति | वेदान्तविज्ञानसुनिश्चितार्थाः संन्यासयोगाद्यतयः शुद्धसत्त्वाः | ते ब्रह्मलोके तु परान्तकाले परामृतात्परिमुच्यन्ति सर्वे | दह्रं विपापं परमेश्मभूतं यत्पुण्डरीकं पुरमध्यसंस्थम् | तत्रापि दह्रं गगनं विशोकस्तस्मिन् यदन्तस्तदुपासितव्यम् | यो वेदादौ स्वरः प्रोक्तो वेदान्ते च प्रतिष्ठितः | तस्य प्रकृतिलीनस्य यः परस्स महेश्वरः
text_mt: Set down in three ways, hidden by the Paṇis, the gods found the clarified butter in the cow. / Indra generated one, Sūrya one; from Vena they carved out one with their inherent power. / He who is prior to the gods, the foremost, of all-comprehending mind, Rudra, the great seer, / who beheld Hiraṇyagarbha being born—may that god join us with auspicious memory! / Other than whom there is nothing higher, than whom none is subtler nor greater; / like a tree, he stands immovable, alone in the sky: by that person all this is filled. / Not by ritual action, not by offspring, nor by wealth, but by renunciation alone did some attain immortality. / Set beyond the firmament, shining in the hidden cave, this the ascetics enter. / Having well-ascertained the meaning of the knowledge of the Vedānta, the ascetics of purified nature through the yoga of renunciation, / all of them, at the time of final end, are fully released from supreme immortality in the world of brahman. / Small, free from sin, being the supreme abode, is the lotus situated in the middle of the city; / there too is a small, sorrowless sky: what is within that is to be meditated upon. / That sound which is proclaimed at the beginning of the Veda and established in the Vedānta: / he who is beyond it when it has dissolved into nature is Maheśvara. / Another unborn one has entered; all four.

sanskrit_iast: sahasraśīrṣaṃ devaṃ viśvākṣaṃ viśvaśaṃbhuvam | viśvaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam | viśvataḥ paramānnityaṃ viśvaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim | viśvamevedaṃ puruṣastadviśvamupajīvati | patiṃ viśvasyātmeśvaraṃ śāśvataṃ śivamacyutam | nārāyaṇaṃ mahājñeyaṃ viśvātmānaṃ parāyaṇam | nārāyaṇa paro jyotirātmā nārayaṇaḥ paraḥ | nārāyaṇa paraṃ brahmatattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | nārāyaṇa paro dhyātā dhyānaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | yacca kiṃcijjagathsarvaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate'pi vā
meaning: सहस्रशीर्षं देवं विश्वाक्षं विश्वशंभुवम् | विश्वं नारायणं देवमक्षरं परमं पदम् | विश्वतः परमान्नित्यं विश्वं नारायणं हरिम् | विश्वमेवेदं पुरुषस्तद्विश्वमुपजीवति | पतिं विश्वस्यात्मेश्वरं शाश्वतं शिवमच्युतम् | नारायणं महाज्ञेयं विश्वात्मानं परायणम् | नारायण परो ज्योतिरात्मा नारयणः परः | नारायण परं ब्रह्मतत्त्वं नारायणः परः | नारायण परो ध्याता ध्यानं नारायणः परः | यच्च किंचिज्जगथ्सर्वं दृश्यते श्रूयतेऽपि वा
text_mt: The thousand-headed god, all-seeing, bringing auspiciousness to all, / the universe, Nārāyaṇa, the god, the imperishable, the supreme state; / beyond everything, eternal, the universe, Nārāyaṇa, Hari; / this person indeed is the universe; upon that the universe subsists; / the master of the universe, the lord of the self, constant, auspicious, unswerving, / Nārāyaṇa, the great object of knowledge, the self of the universe, the supreme resort. / Nārāyaṇa is the supreme light; Nārāyaṇa is the supreme self. / Nārāyaṇa is the supreme brahman; Nārāyaṇa is the supreme reality. / Nārāyaṇa is the supreme meditator; Nārāyaṇa is supreme meditation. / And whatever in this entire world is seen or heard,

sanskrit_iast: antarbahiśca tathsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇassthitaḥ | anantamavyayaṃ kaviṃ samudre'ntaṃ viśvaśambhuvam | padmakośapratīkāśaṃ hṛdayaṃ cāpyadhomukham | adho niṣṭyā vitastyānte nābhyāmupari tiṣṭhati | jvālamālākulaṃ bhātī viśvasyāyatanaṃ mahat | santataṃ śilābhistu lambatyākośasannibham | tasyānte suṣiraṃ sūkṣmaṃ tasminthsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | tasya madhye mahānagnirviśvārcirviśvatomukhaḥ | so'grabhugvibhajantiṣṭhannāhāramajaraḥ kaviḥ | tiryagūrdhvamadhaḥ śāyī raśmayastasya santatā | santāpayati svaṃ dehamāpādatalamastakaḥ | tasya madhye vahniśikhā aṇīyordhvā vyavasthitaḥ | nīlatoyadamadhyasthādvidyullekheva bhāsvarā | nīvāraśūkavattanvī pītā bhāsvatyaṇūpamā | tasyāḥ śikhāyā madhye paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ | sa brahma sa śivaḥ sa hariḥ sendraḥ so'kṣaraḥ paramassvarāṭ
meaning: अन्तर्बहिश्च तथ्सर्वं व्याप्य नारायणस्स्थितः | अनन्तमव्ययं कविं समुद्रेऽन्तं विश्वशम्भुवम् | पद्मकोशप्रतीकाशं हृदयं चाप्यधोमुखम् | अधो निष्ट्या वितस्त्यान्ते नाभ्यामुपरि तिष्ठति | ज्वालमालाकुलं भाती विश्वस्यायतनं महत् | सन्ततं शिलाभिस्तु लम्बत्याकोशसन्निभम् | तस्यान्ते सुषिरं सूक्ष्मं तस्मिन्थ्सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् | तस्य मध्ये महानग्निर्विश्वार्चिर्विश्वतोमुखः | सोऽग्रभुग्विभजन्तिष्ठन्नाहारमजरः कविः | तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधः शायी रश्मयस्तस्य सन्तता | सन्तापयति स्वं देहमापादतलमस्तकः | तस्य मध्ये वह्निशिखा अणीयोर्ध्वा व्यवस्थितः | नीलतोयदमध्यस्थाद्विद्युल्लेखेव भास्वरा | नीवारशूकवत्तन्वी पीता भास्वत्यणूपमा | तस्याः शिखाया मध्ये परमात्मा व्यवस्थितः | स ब्रह्म स शिवः स हरिः सेन्द्रः सोऽक्षरः परमस्स्वराट्
text_mt: Pervading all that, inside and outside, Nārāyaṇa stands. / The endless, imperishable sage, resting in the ocean, bringing auspiciousness to all; / like a lotus bud, the heart hangs downward, / a span below the throat, positioned above the navel, / shining, filled with a garland of flames, the great abode of the universe, / continuously [hanging] like a downward bud with its sinews. / At its end is a fine aperture; in that all is established. / In the middle of it is a great fire, with rays on all sides, facing all directions; / he, consuming the first [portion], dividing [food], standing undying, the sage; / lying across, upward, and downward, his rays are spread out; / he warms his own body from the soles of the feet to the head. / In the middle of it is a flame of fire, subtler, standing upward, / brilliant like a streak of lightning in the midst of a dark cloud, / slender as the beard of a wild rice grain, yellow, radiant, atom-like. / In the middle of that flame the supreme self is situated. / He is Brahmā, he is Śiva, he is Hari, he is Indra, he is the imperishable, supreme sovereign. / Or indeed, continuous, and six.

sanskrit_iast: ādityo vā eṣa etanmaṇḍalaṃ tapati tatra tā ṛcastadṛcā maṇḍalaṃ sa ṛcāṃ loko'tha ya eṣa etasminmaṇḍale'rcirdīpyate tāni sāmāni sa sāmnāṃ loko'tha ya eṣa etasminmaṇḍale'rciṣi puruṣastāni yajūṃṣi sa yajuṣā maṇḍalaṃ sa yajuṣāṃ lokassaiṣā trayyeva vidyā tapati ya eṣo'ntarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣaḥ
meaning: आदित्यो वा एष एतन्मण्डलं तपति तत्र ता ऋचस्तदृचा मण्डलं स ऋचां लोकोऽथ य एष एतस्मिन्मण्डलेऽर्चिर्दीप्यते तानि सामानि स साम्नां लोकोऽथ य एष एतस्मिन्मण्डलेऽर्चिषि पुरुषस्तानि यजूंषि स यजुषा मण्डलं स यजुषां लोकस्सैषा त्रय्येव विद्या तपति य एषोऽन्तरादित्ये हिरण्मयः पुरुषः
text_mt: This Āditya indeed warms this orb; there are those ṛcs; that orb belongs to the ṛc; it is the world of the ṛcs. Now, the flame that blazes in this orb: those are the sāmans; that is the world of the sāmans. Now, the person who is in this flame in the orb: those are the yajuses; he is the orb of the yajuses; he is the world of the yajuses. It is this threefold knowledge itself that warms—he who is this golden person within Āditya.

sanskrit_iast: ādityo vai teja ojo balaṃ yaśaścakṣuḥ śrotramātmā mano manyurmanurmṛtyuḥ satyo mitro vāyurākāśaḥ prāṇo lokapālaḥ kaḥ kiṃ kaṃ tathsatyamannamamṛto jīvo viśvaḥ katamaḥ svayaṃbhu brahmaitadamṛta eṣa puruṣa eṣa bhūtānāmadhipatirbrahmaṇaḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnotyetāsāmeva devatānāṃ sāyujyaṃ sārṣṭitāṃ samānalokatāmāpnoti ya evaṃ vedetyupaniṣat
meaning: आदित्यो वै तेज ओजो बलं यशश्चक्षुः श्रोत्रमात्मा मनो मन्युर्मनुर्मृत्युः सत्यो मित्रो वायुराकाशः प्राणो लोकपालः कः किं कं तथ्सत्यमन्नममृतो जीवो विश्वः कतमः स्वयंभु ब्रह्मैतदमृत एष पुरुष एष भूतानामधिपतिर्ब्रह्मणः सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोत्येतासामेव देवतानां सायुज्यं सार्ष्टितां समानलोकतामाप्नोति य एवं वेदेत्युपनिषत्
text_mt: Āditya is splendor, vigor, strength, fame, sight, hearing, the self, the mind, wrath, Manu, death, truth, Mitra, Vāyu, space, the vital breath, the guardian of the world, Ka, Kiṃ, Kaṃ. That is truth, food, the immortal, the living being, the universe, whichsoever [deity], the self-existent. This is brahman, the immortal; this is the puruṣa; this is the overlord of beings. He attains union with brahman, sharing of the world with [brahman]; he attains union, equal power, and sharing of the same world with these very deities, who knows thus. Such is the Upaniṣad.

sanskrit_iast: nidhanapataye namaḥ | nidhanapatāntikāya namaḥ | ūrdhvāya namaḥ | ūrdhvaliṅgāya namaḥ | hiraṇyāya namaḥ | hiraṇyaliṅgāya namaḥ | suvarṇāya namaḥ | suvarṇaliṅgāya namaḥ | divyāya namaḥ | divyaliṅgāya namaḥ
meaning: निधनपतये नमः | निधनपतान्तिकाय नमः | ऊर्ध्वाय नमः | ऊर्ध्वलिङ्गाय नमः | हिरण्याय नमः | हिरण्यलिङ्गाय नमः | सुवर्णाय नमः | सुवर्णलिङ्गाय नमः | दिव्याय नमः | दिव्यलिङ्गाय नमः
text_mt: Homage to the lord of dissolution! Homage to the ender of dissolution! Homage to the upward one! Homage to the upward-liṅga! Homage to the golden one! Homage to the golden-liṅga! Homage to the lustrous gold! Homage to the lustrous gold-liṅga! Homage to the celestial one! Homage to the celestial-liṅga!

sanskrit_iast: bhavāya namaḥ | bhavaliṅgāya namaḥ | śarvāya namaḥ | śarvaliṅgāya namaḥ | śivāya namaḥ | śivaliṅgāya namaḥ | jvalāya namaḥ | jvalaliṅgāya namaḥ | ātmāya namaḥ | ātmaliṅgāya namaḥ | paramāya namaḥ | paramaliṅgāya namaḥ | etathsomasya sūryasya sarvaliṅgaṃ sthāpayati pāṇimantraṃ pavitram
meaning: भवाय नमः | भवलिङ्गाय नमः | शर्वाय नमः | शर्वलिङ्गाय नमः | शिवाय नमः | शिवलिङ्गाय नमः | ज्वलाय नमः | ज्वललिङ्गाय नमः | आत्माय नमः | आत्मलिङ्गाय नमः | परमाय नमः | परमलिङ्गाय नमः | एतथ्सोमस्य सूर्यस्य सर्वलिङ्गं स्थापयति पाणिमन्त्रं पवित्रम्
text_mt: Homage to Bhava! Homage to the Bhava-liṅga! Homage to Śarva! Homage to the Śarva-liṅga! / Homage to Śiva! Homage to the Śiva-liṅga! Homage to the blazing one! Homage to the blazing-liṅga! Homage to the Self! Homage to the Self-liṅga! Homage to the supreme one! Homage to the supreme-liṅga! One establishes all this liṅga of Soma, of Sūrya, with the hand-mantra, the purifier.

sanskrit_iast: sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namo namaḥ | bhavebhave nātibhave bhavasva mām | bhavodbhavāya namaḥ
meaning: सद्योजातं प्रपद्यामि सद्योजाताय वै नमो नमः | भवेभवे नातिभवे भवस्व माम् | भवोद्भवाय नमः
text_mt: I take refuge in Sadyojāta; homage, homage indeed to Sadyojāta! In birth after birth, do not thrust me beyond birth; be present for me! Homage to the source of existence!

sanskrit_iast: vāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhāya namaḥ śreṣṭhāya namo rudrāya namaḥ kālāya namaḥ kalavikaraṇāya namo balavikaraṇāya namo balāya namo balapramathanāya namassarvabhūtadamanāya namo manonmanāya namaḥ
meaning: वामदेवाय नमो ज्येष्ठाय नमः श्रेष्ठाय नमो रुद्राय नमः कालाय नमः कलविकरणाय नमो बलविकरणाय नमो बलाय नमो बलप्रमथनाय नमस्सर्वभूतदमनाय नमो मनोन्मनाय नमः
text_mt: Homage to Vāmadeva, homage to the eldest, homage to the best, homage to Rudra, homage to Kāla, homage to the dispenser of time, homage to the dispenser of power, homage to power, homage to the crusher of power, homage to the subduer of all beings, homage to the disturber of the mind!

sanskrit_iast: aghorebhyo'tha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ | sarvebhyassarva śarvebhyo namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ
meaning: अघोरेभ्योऽथ घोरेभ्यो घोरघोरतरेभ्यः | सर्वेभ्यस्सर्व शर्वेभ्यो नमस्ते अस्तु रुद्ररूपेभ्यः
text_mt: To the un-terrific, and to the terrific, and to the exceedingly terrific forms, / to all, to all Śarva's [forms], homage be to you, Rudra-forms!

sanskrit_iast: tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt
meaning: तत्पुरुषाय विद्महे महादेवाय धीमहि | तन्नो रुद्रः प्रचोदयात्
text_mt: We know that Puruṣa; we meditate upon Mahādeva; / may that Rudra inspire us.

sanskrit_iast: īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmīśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādhipatirbrahmaṇo'dhipatirbrahmā śivo me astu sadāśivom
meaning: ईशानः सर्वविद्यानामीश्वरः सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्माधिपतिर्ब्रह्मणोऽधिपतिर्ब्रह्मा शिवो मे अस्तु सदाशिवोम्
text_mt: The ruler of all sciences, the lord of all beings, the overlord of Brahmā, the overlord of brahman, Brahmā, may Śiva be Sadāśiva to me. Om.

sanskrit_iast: namo hiraṇyabāhave hiraṇyavarṇāya hiraṇyarūpāya hiraṇyapataye'mbikāpataya umāpataye paśupataye namo namaḥ
meaning: नमो हिरण्यबाहवे हिरण्यवर्णाय हिरण्यरूपाय हिरण्यपतयेऽम्बिकापतय उमापतये पशुपतये नमो नमः
text_mt: Homage to the golden-armed one, to the golden-colored one, to the golden-formed one, to the golden lord, to the lord of Ambikā, to the lord of Umā, to the lord of beasts, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast: ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalam | ūrdhvaretaṃ virūpākṣaṃ viśvarūpāya vai namo namaḥ
meaning: ऋतं सत्यं परं ब्रह्म पुरुषं कृष्णपिङ्गलम् | ऊर्ध्वरेतं विरूपाक्षं विश्वरूपाय वै नमो नमः
text_mt: The cosmic order, truth, supreme brahman, the dark-and-tawny puruṣa, / of drawn-up seed, diverse-eyed: homage, homage indeed to the all-formed one!

sanskrit_iast: sarvo vai rudrastasmai rudrāya namo astu | puruṣo vai rudrassanmaho namonamaḥ | viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ bhuvanaṃ citraṃ bahudhā jātaṃ jāyamānaṃ ca yat | sarvo hyeṣa rudrastasmai rudrāya namo astu
meaning: सर्वो वै रुद्रस्तस्मै रुद्राय नमो अस्तु | पुरुषो वै रुद्रस्सन्महो नमोनमः | विश्वं भूतं भुवनं चित्रं बहुधा जातं जायमानं च यत् | सर्वो ह्येष रुद्रस्तस्मै रुद्राय नमो अस्तु
text_mt: Rudra indeed is everything; let there be homage to that Rudra! Rudra indeed is the puruṣa, the real majesty; homage, homage! The universe, what has been, what is, the manifold, born in many ways and what is being born—all this indeed is Rudra; let there be homage to that Rudra!

sanskrit_iast: kadrudrāya pracetase mīḍhuṣṭamāya tavyase | vocema śaṃtamaṃ hṛde | sarvo hyeṣa rudrastasmai rudrāya namo astu
meaning: कद्रुद्राय प्रचेतसे मीढुष्टमाय तव्यसे | वोचेम शंतमं हृदे | सर्वो ह्येष रुद्रस्तस्मै रुद्राय नमो अस्तु
text_mt: What [hymn] might we speak to Rudra, the wise, the most bountiful, the strongest, / most comforting to the heart? For all this is Rudra; let there be homage to that Rudra!

sanskrit_iast: yasya vaikaṅkatyagnihotrahavaṇī bhavati pratyevāsyāhutayastiṣṭhantyatho pratiṣṭhityai
meaning: यस्य वैकङ्कत्यग्निहोत्रहवणी भवति प्रत्येवास्याहुतयस्तिष्ठन्त्यथो प्रतिष्ठित्यै
text_mt: He whose Agnihotra-ladle is made of vikankata wood—his oblations firmly stand, and [it serves] for firm standing.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṇuṣva pāja iti pañca
meaning: कृणुष्व पाज इति पञ्च

sanskrit_iast: aditirdevā gandharvā manuṣyāḥ pitaro'surāsteṣāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ mātā medinī mahatā mahī sāvitrī gāyatrī jagatyurvī pṛthvī bahulā viśvā bhūtā katamā kāyā sā satyetyamṛteti vasiṣṭhaḥ
meaning: अदितिर्देवा गन्धर्वा मनुष्याः पितरोऽसुरास्तेषां सर्वभूतानां माता मेदिनी महता मही सावित्री गायत्री जगत्युर्वी पृथ्वी बहुला विश्वा भूता कतमा काया सा सत्येत्यमृतेति वसिष्ठः
text_mt: Aditi, the gods, the gandharvas, human beings, the fathers, the asuras—of these, of all beings, the mother is the earth, wide by greatness, Sāvitrī, gāyatrī, jagatī, the broad, the earth, the abundant, the universe, beings; which [one], what [one is she]? She is truth, she is immortal—[so says] Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast: āpo vā idaṃ sarvaṃ viśvā bhūtānyāpaḥ prāṇā vā āpaḥ paśava āpo'nnamāpo'mṛtamāpaḥ samrāḍāpo virāḍāpaḥ svarāḍāpaśchandāṃsyāpo jyotīgṣyāpo yajūgṣyāpaḥ satyamāpaḥ sarvā devatā āpo bhūrbhuvaḥ suvarāpa om
meaning: आपो वा इदं सर्वं विश्वा भूतान्यापः प्राणा वा आपः पशव आपोऽन्नमापोऽमृतमापः सम्राडापो विराडापः स्वराडापश्छन्दांस्यापो ज्योतीग्ष्यापो यजूग्ष्यापः सत्यमापः सर्वा देवता आपो भूर्भुवः सुवराप ओम्
text_mt: Water indeed is all this; all beings are water; the vital breaths indeed are water; animals are water; food is water; the immortal is water; the sovereign ruler is water; the virāj is water; the self-ruler is water; the meters are water; the lights are water; the yajus formulas are water; truth is water; all deities are water; earth, intermediate space, and heaven are water. Om.

sanskrit_iast: āpaḥ punantu pṛthivīṃ pṛthivī pūtā punātu mām | punantu brahmaṇaspatirbrahma pūtā punātu mām || yaducchiṣṭamabhojyaṃ yadvā duścaritaṃ mama | sarvaṃ punantu māmāpo'satāṃ ca pratigrahagg svāhā
meaning: आपः पुनन्तु पृथिवीं पृथिवी पूता पुनातु माम् | पुनन्तु ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्ब्रह्म पूता पुनातु माम् || यदुच्छिष्टमभोज्यं यद्वा दुश्चरितं मम | सर्वं पुनन्तु मामापोऽसतां च प्रतिग्रहग्ग् स्वाहा
text_mt: May the waters purify the earth; may the purified earth purify me. / May Brahmaṇaspati purify; may purified brahman purify me. / Whatever leavings, what is uneatable, or whatever bad deed is mine, / may the waters purify all of me, and the acceptance of gifts from the wicked, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: agniśca mā manyuśca manyupatayaśca manyukṛtebhyaḥ | pāpebhyo rakṣantām | yadahnā pāpamakārṣam | manasā vācā hastābhyām | padbhyāmudareṇa śiśnā | ahastadavalumpatu | yatkiṃca duritaṃ mayi | idamahaṃ māmamṛtayonau | satye jyotiṣi juhomi svāhā
meaning: अग्निश्च मा मन्युश्च मन्युपतयश्च मन्युकृतेभ्यः | पापेभ्यो रक्षन्ताम् | यदह्ना पापमकार्षम् | मनसा वाचा हस्ताभ्याम् | पद्भ्यामुदरेण शिश्ना | अहस्तदवलुम्पतु | यत्किंच दुरितं मयि | इदमहं माममृतयोनौ | सत्ये ज्योतिषि जुहोमि स्वाहा
text_mt: May Agni, wrath, and the lords of wrath protect me from the evils committed through wrath. / Whatever evil I have done by day, / with the mind, with speech, with the two hands, / with the two feet, with the belly, with the phallus— / may the day efface that. / Whatever sin is in me, / that self of mine, in the womb of immortality, / in the true light, I offer, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: sūryaśca mā manyuśca manyupatayaśca manyukṛtebhyaḥ | pāpebhyo rakṣantām | yadrātriyā pāpamakārṣam | manasā vācā hastābhyām | padbhyāmudareṇa śiśnā | rātristadavalumpatu | yatkiṃca duritaṃ mayi | idamahaṃ māmamṛtayonau | sūrye jyotiṣi juhomi svāhā
meaning: सूर्यश्च मा मन्युश्च मन्युपतयश्च मन्युकृतेभ्यः | पापेभ्यो रक्षन्ताम् | यद्रात्रिया पापमकार्षम् | मनसा वाचा हस्ताभ्याम् | पद्भ्यामुदरेण शिश्ना | रात्रिस्तदवलुम्पतु | यत्किंच दुरितं मयि | इदमहं माममृतयोनौ | सूर्ये ज्योतिषि जुहोमि स्वाहा
text_mt: May Sūrya, wrath, and the lords of wrath protect me from the evils committed through wrath. / Whatever evil I have done by night, / with the mind, with speech, with the two hands, / with the two feet, with the belly, with the phallus— / may the night efface that. / Whatever sin is in me, / that self of mine, in the womb of immortality, / in the solar light, I offer, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: omityekākṣaraṃ brahma | agnirdevatā brahma ityārṣam | gāyatraṃ chandaṃ paramātmaṃ sarūpam | sāyujyaṃ viniyogam
meaning: ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म | अग्निर्देवता ब्रह्म इत्यार्षम् | गायत्रं छन्दं परमात्मं सरूपम् | सायुज्यं विनियोगम्
text_mt: “Om” is the single-syllable brahman. Agni is the deity; “brahman” is the seer-lineage. The meter is gāyatrī; its form is the supreme self. Its ritual application is union.

sanskrit_iast: āyātu varadā devī akṣaraṃ brahma sammitam | gāyatrīṃ chandasāṃ mātedaṃ brahma juṣasva me | yadahnātkurute pāpaṃ tadahnātpratimucyate | yadrātriyātkurute pāpaṃ tadrātriyātpratimucyate | sarvavarṇe mahādevi sandhyāvidye sarasvati
meaning: आयातु वरदा देवी अक्षरं ब्रह्म सम्मितम् | गायत्रीं छन्दसां मातेदं ब्रह्म जुषस्व मे | यदह्नात्कुरुते पापं तदह्नात्प्रतिमुच्यते | यद्रात्रियात्कुरुते पापं तद्रात्रियात्प्रतिमुच्यते | सर्ववर्णे महादेवि सन्ध्याविद्ये सरस्वति
text_mt: May the boon-granting goddess come, commensurate with the imperishable brahman, / gāyatrī, the mother of the meters; delight in this prayer of mine. / Whatever evil one does by day, from that of the day one is freed; / whatever evil one does by night, from that of the night one is freed; / O all-colored great goddess, knowledge of the twilight, Sarasvatī!

sanskrit_iast: ojo'si saho'si balamasi bhrājo'si devānāṃ dhāmanāmā'si viśvamasi viśvāyussarvamasi sarvāyurabhibhūroṃ gāyatrīmāvāhayāmi sāvitrīmāvāhayāmi sarasvatīmāvāhayāmi chandarṣīnāvāhayāmi śriyamāvāhayāmi gāyatriyā gāyatrīcchando viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ savitā devatā'gnirmukhaṃ brahmā śiro viṣṇurhṛdayaṃ rudraḥ śikhā pṛthivī yoniḥ prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānā saprāṇā śvetavarṇā sāṃkhyāyanasagotrā gāyatrī caturviṃśatyakṣarā tripadā ṣaṭakukṣiḥ pañcaśīrṣopanayane viniyoga oṃ bhūḥ | oṃ bhuvaḥ | oṃ suvaḥ | oṃ mahaḥ | oṃ janaḥ | oṃ tapaḥ || oṃ satyam | oṃ tathsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt | omāpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṃ brahma bhūrbhuvassuvarom
meaning: ओजोऽसि सहोऽसि बलमसि भ्राजोऽसि देवानां धामनामाऽसि विश्वमसि विश्वायुस्सर्वमसि सर्वायुरभिभूरों गायत्रीमावाहयामि सावित्रीमावाहयामि सरस्वतीमावाहयामि छन्दर्षीनावाहयामि श्रियमावाहयामि गायत्रिया गायत्रीच्छन्दो विश्वामित्र ऋषिः सविता देवताऽग्निर्मुखं ब्रह्मा शिरो विष्णुर्हृदयं रुद्रः शिखा पृथिवी योनिः प्राणापानव्यानोदानसमाना सप्राणा श्वेतवर्णा सांख्यायनसगोत्रा गायत्री चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा त्रिपदा षटकुक्षिः पञ्चशीर्षोपनयने विनियोग ओं भूः | ओं भुवः | ओं सुवः | ओं महः | ओं जनः | ओं तपः || ओं सत्यम् | ओं तथ्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि | धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् | ओमापो ज्योती रसोऽमृतं ब्रह्म भूर्भुवस्सुवरोम्
text_mt: You are vigor, you are overpowering might, you are strength, you are brilliance, you are the abode and the name of the gods, you are the universe, you are all life, you are everything, you are all life, the victorious one. Om, I invoke the gāyatrī, I invoke the sāvitrī, I invoke Sarasvatī, I invoke the meter-seers, I invoke Śrī. For the gāyatrī, the meter is gāyatrī, Viśvāmitra is the seer, Savitṛ is the deity, Agni is the mouth, Brahmā is the head, Viṣṇu is the heart, Rudra is the tuft of hair, the earth is the womb, prāṇa, apāna, vyāna, udāna, and samāna [are the vital breaths], possessed of vital breath, white-colored, of the Sāṅkhyāyana lineage, the gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables, three feet, six bellies, five heads; the application is in the sacred thread ceremony. Om bhūḥ. Om bhuvaḥ. Om suvaḥ. Om mahaḥ. Om janaḥ. Om tapaḥ. Om satyam. Om: May we meditate upon that choice splendor of the god Savitṛ, who shall impel our thoughts. Om, water, light, sap, immortal, brahman, bhūr, bhuvas, suvar, om.

sanskrit_iast: uttame śikhare jāte bhūmyāṃ parvatamūrdhani | brāhmaṇebhyo'bhyanujñātā gaccha devi yathāsukham | stuto mayā varadā vedamātā pracodayantī pavane dvijātā | āyuḥ pṛthivyāṃ draviṇaṃ brahmavarcasaṃ mahyaṃ dattvā prajātuṃ brahmalokam
meaning: उत्तमे शिखरे जाते भूम्यां पर्वतमूर्धनि | ब्राह्मणेभ्योऽभ्यनुज्ञाता गच्छ देवि यथासुखम् | स्तुतो मया वरदा वेदमाता प्रचोदयन्ती पवने द्विजाता | आयुः पृथिव्यां द्रविणं ब्रह्मवर्चसं मह्यं दत्त्वा प्रजातुं ब्रह्मलोकम्
text_mt: Born on the highest summit, on the peak of the mountain on earth, / permitted by the brāhmaṇas, depart, O goddess, at your pleasure! / Praised by me, the boon-granting mother of the Vedas, inspiring in the wind, twice-born, / granting me lifespan on earth, wealth, and brāhmaṇical splendor, to go forth to the world of brahman!

sanskrit_iast: ghṛṇissūrya ādityo na prabhā vātyakṣaram | madhu kṣaranti tadrasam | satyaṃ vai tadrasamāpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṃ brahma bhūrbhuvassuvarom
meaning: घृणिस्सूर्य आदित्यो न प्रभा वात्यक्षरम् | मधु क्षरन्ति तद्रसम् | सत्यं वै तद्रसमापो ज्योती रसोऽमृतं ब्रह्म भूर्भुवस्सुवरोम्
text_mt: The heat of the sun, Āditya, does not cease to shine, the imperishable. They trickle honey, that essence. / Truth indeed is that essence: water, light, sap, immortal, brahman, bhūr, bhuvas, suvar, om.

sanskrit_iast: brahmametu mām | madhumetu mām | brahmameva madhumetu mām | yāste soma prajā vathso'bhi so aham | duṣṣvapnahanduruṣṣaha | yāste soma prāṇāṃstāñjuhomi | trisuparṇamayācitaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyāt | brahmahatyāṃ vā ete ghnanti | ye brāhmaṇāstrisuparṇaṃ paṭhanti | te somaṃ prāpnuvanti | āsahasrātpaṅktiṃ punanti | om
meaning: ब्रह्ममेतु माम् | मधुमेतु माम् | ब्रह्ममेव मधुमेतु माम् | यास्ते सोम प्रजा वथ्सोऽभि सो अहम् | दुष्ष्वप्नहन्दुरुष्षह | यास्ते सोम प्राणांस्ताञ्जुहोमि | त्रिसुपर्णमयाचितं ब्राह्मणाय दद्यात् | ब्रह्महत्यां वा एते घ्नन्ति | ये ब्राह्मणास्त्रिसुपर्णं पठन्ति | ते सोमं प्राप्नुवन्ति | आसहस्रात्पङ्क्तिं पुनन्ति | ओम्
text_mt: May brahman come to me. May honey come to me. May brahman alone come to me as honey. O Soma, whatever offspring of yours is a calf, that am I. Slayer of bad dreams, unbearable to evil. Whatever vital breaths are yours, O Soma, those I offer. One should give the Trisuparṇa unasked to a brāhmaṇa. They indeed destroy the sin of slaying a brāhmaṇa, those brāhmaṇas who recite the Trisuparṇa. They attain Soma. / They purify a row up to a thousand. Om.

sanskrit_iast: brahma medhayā | madhu medhayā | brahmameva madhu medhayā | adyā no deva savitaḥ prajāvathsāvīḥ saubhagam | parā duṣṣvapniyaṃ suva | viśvāni deva savitarduritāni parāsuva | yadbhadraṃ tanma āsuva | madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ | madhu naktamutoṣasi madhumatpārthivaṃ rajaḥ | madhu dyaurastu naḥ pitā | madhu mānno vanaspatirmadhumāṃ astu sūryaḥ | mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu naḥ | ya imaṃ trisuparṇamayācitaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyāt | bhrūṇahatyāṃ vā ete ghnanti | ye brāhmaṇāstrisuparṇaṃ paṭhanti | te somaṃ prāpnuvanti | āsahasrātpaṅktiṃ punanti | om
meaning: ब्रह्म मेधया | मधु मेधया | ब्रह्ममेव मधु मेधया | अद्या नो देव सवितः प्रजावथ्सावीः सौभगम् | परा दुष्ष्वप्नियं सुव | विश्वानि देव सवितर्दुरितानि परासुव | यद्भद्रं तन्म आसुव | मधु वाता ऋतायते मधु क्षरन्ति सिन्धवः | माध्वीर्नः सन्त्वोषधीः | मधु नक्तमुतोषसि मधुमत्पार्थिवं रजः | मधु द्यौरस्तु नः पिता | मधु मान्नो वनस्पतिर्मधुमां अस्तु सूर्यः | माध्वीर्गावो भवन्तु नः | य इमं त्रिसुपर्णमयाचितं ब्राह्मणाय दद्यात् | भ्रूणहत्यां वा एते घ्नन्ति | ये ब्राह्मणास्त्रिसुपर्णं पठन्ति | ते सोमं प्राप्नुवन्ति | आसहस्रात्पङ्क्तिं पुनन्ति | ओम्
text_mt: Brahman through wisdom. Honey through wisdom. Brahman alone as honey through wisdom. Today, O god Savitṛ, impel good fortune for us with offspring. Impel away bad dreams. / O god Savitṛ, drive away all misfortunes; impel toward us that which is auspicious. May the winds blow honey for him who observes the cosmic order; may the rivers flow honey; may the plants be sweet for us. May night be honey and morning; may the earthly realm be full of honey; may father sky be honey for us. May the lord of the forest be full of honey for us; may Sūrya be full of honey; may the cows be sweet for us. Whoever should give this Trisuparṇa unasked to a brāhmaṇa—they indeed destroy the sin of slaying an embryo, those brāhmaṇas who recite the Trisuparṇa. They attain Soma. / They purify a row up to a thousand. Om.

sanskrit_iast: brahma medhavā | madhu medhavā | brahmameva madhu medhavā | brahmā devānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnāmṛṣirviprāṇāṃ mahiṣo mṛgāṇām | śyeno gṛddhrāṇāg svadhitirvanānāṃ somaḥ pavitramatyeti rebhann | haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat | nṛṣadvarasadṛtasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat | ṛce tvā ruce tvā samithsravanti sarito na dhenāḥ | antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ | ghṛtasya dhārā abhicākaśīmi | hiraṇyayo vetaso maddhya āsām | tasminthsuparṇo madhukṛtkulāyī bhajannāste madhu devatābhyaḥ | tasyāsate harayaḥ sapta tīre svadhāṃ duhānā amṛtasya dhārām | ya idaṃ trisuparṇamayācitaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyāt | vīrahatyāṃ vā ete ghnanti | ye brāhmaṇāstrisuparṇaṃ paṭhanti | te somaṃ prāpnuvanti | āsahasrātpaṅktiṃ punanti | om
meaning: ब्रह्म मेधवा | मधु मेधवा | ब्रह्ममेव मधु मेधवा | ब्रह्मा देवानां पदवीः कवीनामृषिर्विप्राणां महिषो मृगाणाम् | श्येनो गृद्ध्राणाग् स्वधितिर्वनानां सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन्न् | हंसः शुचिषद्वसुरन्तरिक्षसद्धोता वेदिषदतिथिर्दुरोणसत् | नृषद्वरसदृतसद्व्योमसदब्जा गोजा ऋतजा अद्रिजा ऋतं बृहत् | ऋचे त्वा रुचे त्वा समिथ्स्रवन्ति सरितो न धेनाः | अन्तर्हृदा मनसा पूयमानाः | घृतस्य धारा अभिचाकशीमि | हिरण्ययो वेतसो मद्ध्य आसाम् | तस्मिन्थ्सुपर्णो मधुकृत्कुलायी भजन्नास्ते मधु देवताभ्यः | तस्यासते हरयः सप्त तीरे स्वधां दुहाना अमृतस्य धाराम् | य इदं त्रिसुपर्णमयाचितं ब्राह्मणाय दद्यात् | वीरहत्यां वा एते घ्नन्ति | ये ब्राह्मणास्त्रिसुपर्णं पठन्ति | ते सोमं प्राप्नुवन्ति | आसहस्रात्पङ्क्तिं पुनन्ति | ओम्
text_mt: Brahman through wisdom. Honey through wisdom. Brahman alone as honey through wisdom. Brahman among the gods, leader among the poets, seer among the inspired, buffalo among the beasts, falcon among the vultures, axe among the forests—Soma passes resoundingly through the purifier. / The swan dwelling in the pure, the Vasu dwelling in the intermediate space, the Hotṛ dwelling at the altar, the guest dwelling in the house, / dwelling among men, dwelling in the highest, dwelling in the cosmic order, dwelling in the sky, born of water, born of cows, born of the cosmic order, born of the rock, the great cosmic order. For the ṛc [I offer] to you, for light [I offer] to you; the streams of clarified butter flow together like milch cows, / purified within by the heart, by the mind; I behold the streams of clarified butter. / In their midst is the golden reed; therein the fair-winged bird, the honey-maker, nesting, sits bestowing honey upon the deities. On its bank sit the seven bay steeds, milking the svadhā, the stream of immortality. Whoever should give this Trisuparṇa unasked to a brāhmaṇa—they indeed destroy the sin of slaying a hero, those brāhmaṇas who recite the Trisuparṇa. / They attain Soma. They purify a row up to a thousand. Om.

sanskrit_iast: medhā devī juṣamāṇā na āgādviśvācī bhadrā sumanasyamānā | tvayā juṣṭā nudamānā duruktānbṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ | tvayā juṣṭa ṛṣirbhavati devi tvayā brahmā gataśrīruta tvayā | tvayā juṣṭaścitraṃ vindate vasu sā no juṣasva draviṇo na medhe
meaning: मेधा देवी जुषमाणा न आगाद्विश्वाची भद्रा सुमनस्यमाना | त्वया जुष्टा नुदमाना दुरुक्तान्बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः | त्वया जुष्ट ऋषिर्भवति देवि त्वया ब्रह्मा गतश्रीरुत त्वया | त्वया जुष्टश्चित्रं विन्दते वसु सा नो जुषस्व द्रविणो न मेधे
text_mt: May goddess Wisdom, being pleased, come to us, all-embracing, auspicious, and well-minded. / Cherished by you, driving away harsh words, may we speak mightily in the assembly, rich in heroic sons. Cherished by you, one becomes a seer, O goddess; by you a brāhmaṇa; and by you one who has attained glory. Cherished by you, one obtains manifold wealth; as such, be pleased with us, O Wisdom, like wealth.

sanskrit_iast: medhāṃ ma indro dadātu medhāṃ devī sarasvatī | medhāṃ me aśvināvubhāvādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā | apsarāsu ca yā medhā gandharveṣu ca yanmanaḥ | daivīṃ medhā sarasvatī sā māṃ medhā surabhirjuṣatāg svāhā
meaning: मेधां म इन्द्रो ददातु मेधां देवी सरस्वती | मेधां मे अश्विनावुभावाधत्तां पुष्करस्रजा | अप्सरासु च या मेधा गन्धर्वेषु च यन्मनः | दैवीं मेधा सरस्वती सा मां मेधा सुरभिर्जुषताग् स्वाहा
text_mt:
May Indra grant me wisdom; may goddess Sarasvatī grant me wisdom. May both Aśvins, garlanded with blue lotuses, bestow wisdom upon me. That wisdom which is in the Apsarases, and that mind which is in the Gandharvas, the divine wisdom, Sarasvatī—may that fragrant wisdom be pleased with me, svāhā.

May fragrant Wisdom, multiform, golden-colored, moving, accessible to all, / vigor-filled, swelling with milk, may that fair-faced Wisdom be pleased with me.

sanskrit_iast: ā māṃ medhā surabhirviśvarūpā hiraṇyavarṇā jagatī jagamyā | ūrjasvatī payasā pinvamānā sā māṃ medhā supratīkā juṣantām
meaning: आ मां मेधा सुरभिर्विश्वरूपा हिरण्यवर्णा जगती जगम्या | ऊर्जस्वती पयसा पिन्वमाना सा मां मेधा सुप्रतीका जुषन्ताम्

sanskrit_iast: mayi medhāṃ mayi prajāṃ mayyagnistejo dadhātu mayi medhāṃ mayi prajāṃ mayīndra indriyaṃ dadhātu mayi medhāṃ mayi prajāṃ mayi sūryo bhrājo dadhātu
meaning: मयि मेधां मयि प्रजां मय्यग्निस्तेजो दधातु मयि मेधां मयि प्रजां मयीन्द्र इन्द्रियं दधातु मयि मेधां मयि प्रजां मयि सूर्यो भ्राजो दधातु
text_mt: May Agni place wisdom in me, offspring in me, fiery brilliance in me. May Indra place wisdom in me, offspring in me, sensory power in me. May Sūrya place wisdom in me, offspring in me, radiant splendor in me.

sanskrit_iast: apaitu mṛtyuramṛtaṃ na āganvaivasvato no abhayaṃ kṛṇotu | parṇaṃ vanaspaterivābhi naḥ śīyatāṃ rayissacatāṃ naḥ śacīpatiḥ
meaning: अपैतु मृत्युरमृतं न आगन्वैवस्वतो नो अभयं कृणोतु | पर्णं वनस्पतेरिवाभि नः शीयतां रयिस्सचतां नः शचीपतिः
text_mt: May death depart; may immortality come to us; may the son of Vivasvat make fearlessness for us. Like a leaf from a tree, may wealth fall to us; may the lord of power accompany us.

sanskrit_iast: paraṃ mṛtyo anu parehi panthāṃ yaste sva itaro devayānāt | cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān
meaning: परं मृत्यो अनु परेहि पन्थां यस्ते स्व इतरो देवयानात् | चक्षुष्मते शृण्वते ते ब्रवीमि मा नः प्रजां रीरिषो मोत वीरान्
text_mt: O Death, go along your own further path, which is other than the path of the gods. / To you who see and hear, I speak: do not harm our offspring, nor our heroic sons.

sanskrit_iast: vātaṃ prāṇaṃ manasā'nvārabhāmahe prajāpatiṃ yo bhuvanasya gopāḥ | sa no mṛtyostrāyatāṃ pātvaṃhaso jyogjīvā jarāmaśīmahi
meaning: वातं प्राणं मनसाऽन्वारभामहे प्रजापतिं यो भुवनस्य गोपाः | स नो मृत्योस्त्रायतां पात्वंहसो ज्योग्जीवा जरामशीमहि
text_mt: With our mind we reach out to the wind, the vital breath, and to Prajāpati, who is the guardian of the world. / May he protect us from death, guard us from distress; living long, may we attain old age.

sanskrit_iast: amutrabhūyādadha yadyamasya bṛhaspate abhiśasteramuñcaḥ | pratyauhatāmaśvinā mṛtyumasmaddevānāmagne bhiṣajā śacībhiḥ
meaning: अमुत्रभूयादध यद्यमस्य बृहस्पते अभिशस्तेरमुञ्चः | प्रत्यौहतामश्विना मृत्युमस्मद्देवानामग्ने भिषजा शचीभिः
text_mt: If from the other world, from the curse of Yama, O Bṛhaspati, you have delivered [us], / may the two Aśvins, the physicians among the gods, turn death away from us by their powers, O Agni.

sanskrit_iast: hariṃ harantamanuyanti devā viśvasyeśānaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ matīnām | brahma sarūpamanu medamāgādayanaṃ mā vivadhīrvikramasva
meaning: हरिं हरन्तमनुयन्ति देवा विश्वस्येशानं वृषभं मतीनाम् | ब्रह्म सरूपमनु मेदमागादयनं मा विवधीर्विक्रमस्व
text_mt: The gods follow the bay stallion as he carries off, the lord of all, the bull of thoughts. / Conformed to brahman, may this path come to me; do not cut off my way, take your stride.

sanskrit_iast: śalkairagnimindhāna ubhau lokau sanemaham | ubhayorlokayorṛdhvā'ti mṛtyuṃ tarāmyaham
meaning: शल्कैरग्निमिन्धान उभौ लोकौ सनेमहम् | उभयोर्लोकयोरृध्वाऽति मृत्युं तराम्यहम्
text_mt: Kindling Agni with splinters of wood, may I win both worlds. / Prospering in both worlds, I cross beyond death.

sanskrit_iast: mā chido mṛtyo mā vadhīrmā me balaṃ vivṛho mā pramoṣīḥ | prajāṃ mā me rīriṣa āyurugra nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā haviṣā vidhema
meaning: मा छिदो मृत्यो मा वधीर्मा मे बलं विवृहो मा प्रमोषीः | प्रजां मा मे रीरिष आयुरुग्र नृचक्षसं त्वा हविषा विधेम
text_mt: Do not cut me down, O Death, do not slay me, do not crush my strength, do not rob me. Do not harm my offspring, my lifespan, O fierce one; we would worship you, who observe men, with an oblation.

sanskrit_iast: mā no mahāntamuta mā no arbhakaṃ mā na ukṣantamuta mā na ukṣitam | mā no vadhīḥ pitaraṃ mota mātaraṃ priyā mā nastanuvo rudra rīriṣaḥ
meaning: मा नो महान्तमुत मा नो अर्भकं मा न उक्षन्तमुत मा न उक्षितम् | मा नो वधीः पितरं मोत मातरं प्रिया मा नस्तनुवो रुद्र रीरिषः
text_mt: Do not [harm] the great among us, nor the small among us, nor him who grows, nor him who has grown. / Do not slay our father, nor our mother; do not harm our dear bodies, O Rudra.

sanskrit_iast: mā nastoke tanaye mā na āyuṣi mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ | vīrānmā no rudra bhāmito vadhīrhaviṣmanto namasā vidhema te
meaning: मा नस्तोके तनये मा न आयुषि मा नो गोषु मा नो अश्वेषु रीरिषः | वीरान्मा नो रुद्र भामितो वधीर्हविष्मन्तो नमसा विधेम ते
text_mt: Do not harm us in our children, in our descendants, in our lifespan, nor in our cattle, nor in our horses. / In your anger do not slay our heroic sons, O Rudra; bearing oblations, we would worship you with reverence.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā jātāni pari tā babhūva | yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
meaning: प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विश्वा जातानि परि ता बभूव | यत्कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नो अस्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्
text_mt: O Prajāpati, none other than you has encompassed all these created things. Whatever we desire when offering to you, may that be ours; may we be masters of riches.

sanskrit_iast: svastidā viśaspatirvṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī | vṛṣendraḥ pura etu nassvastidā abhayaṃkaraḥ
meaning: स्वस्तिदा विशस्पतिर्वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी | वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नस्स्वस्तिदा अभयंकरः
text_mt: Bestower of well-being, lord of the clan, slayer of Vṛtra, disperser of foes, the ruler, / may the bull Indra go before us, bestowing well-being, bringing fearlessness.

sanskrit_iast: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam | urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt
meaning: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् | उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात्
text_mt: We sacrifice to the three-eyed one, fragrant, increaser of nourishment. / Like a cucumber from its stalk, may I be released from death, not from immortality.

sanskrit_iast: ye te sahasramayutaṃ pāśā mṛtyo martyāya hantave | tān yajñasya māyayā sarvānavayajāmahe
meaning: ये ते सहस्रमयुतं पाशा मृत्यो मर्त्याय हन्तवे | तान् यज्ञस्य मायया सर्वानवयजामहे
text_mt: Whatever thousand and myriad snares of yours, O Death, are set for slaying mortals, / all those we cast off through the power of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: mṛtyave svāhā mṛtyave svāhā
meaning: मृत्यवे स्वाहा मृत्यवे स्वाहा
text_mt: To Death, svāhā; to Death, svāhā.

sanskrit_iast: devakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | manuṣyakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | pitṛkṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | ātmakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | anyakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | asmatkṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi svāhā | yaddivā ca naktaṃ cainaścakṛma tasyāvayajanamasi svāhā | yathsvapantaśca jāgrataścainaścakṛma tasyāvayajanamasi svāhā | yathsuṣuptaśca jāgrataścainaścakṛma tasyāvayajanamasi svāhā | yadvidvāṃsaścāvidvāṃsaścainaścakṛma tasyāvayajanamasi svāhā | enasa enaso'vayajanamasi svāhā
meaning: देवकृतस्यैनसोऽवयजनमसि स्वाहा | मनुष्यकृतस्यैनसोऽवयजनमसि स्वाहा | पितृकृतस्यैनसोऽवयजनमसि स्वाहा | आत्मकृतस्यैनसोऽवयजनमसि स्वाहा | अन्यकृतस्यैनसोऽवयजनमसि स्वाहा | अस्मत्कृतस्यैनसोऽवयजनमसि स्वाहा | यद्दिवा च नक्तं चैनश्चकृम तस्यावयजनमसि स्वाहा | यथ्स्वपन्तश्च जाग्रतश्चैनश्चकृम तस्यावयजनमसि स्वाहा | यथ्सुषुप्तश्च जाग्रतश्चैनश्चकृम तस्यावयजनमसि स्वाहा | यद्विद्वांसश्चाविद्वांसश्चैनश्चकृम तस्यावयजनमसि स्वाहा | एनस एनसोऽवयजनमसि स्वाहा
text_mt: You are the expiation of sin committed against the gods, svāhā. You are the expiation of sin committed against humans, svāhā. You are the expiation of sin committed against the fathers, svāhā. You are the expiation of sin committed by oneself, svāhā. You are the expiation of sin committed by another, svāhā. / You are the expiation of sin committed by us, svāhā. Whatever sin we have committed by day and by night, you are its expiation, svāhā. Whatever sin we have committed while sleeping and while awake, you are its expiation, svāhā. / Whatever sin we have committed in deep sleep and while awake, you are its expiation, svāhā. Whatever sin we have committed knowing and unknowingly, you are its expiation, svāhā. You are the expiation of every sin, svāhā.

sanskrit_iast: yadvo devāścakṛma jihvayā guru manaso vā prayutī devaheḍanam | arā vāyo no abhi ducchunāyate tasmintadeno vasavo nidhetana svāhā
meaning: यद्वो देवाश्चकृम जिह्वया गुरु मनसो वा प्रयुती देवहेडनम् | अरा वायो नो अभि दुच्छुनायते तस्मिन्तदेनो वसवो निधेतन स्वाहा
text_mt: Whatever grave offense against the gods we have committed with the tongue, or through negligence of mind, O gods, / on him who, as an enemy, plots evil against us, on him lay that sin, O Vasus, svāhā.

sanskrit_iast: kāmo'kārṣīnnamo namaḥ | kāmo'kārṣītkāmaḥ karoti nāhaṃ karomi kāmaḥ kartā nāhaṃ kartā kāmaḥ kārayitā nāhaṃ kārayitā eṣa te kāma kāmāya svāhā
meaning: कामोऽकार्षीन्नमो नमः | कामोऽकार्षीत्कामः करोति नाहं करोमि कामः कर्ता नाहं कर्ता कामः कारयिता नाहं कारयिता एष ते काम कामाय स्वाहा
text_mt: Desire did it: homage, homage! Desire did it; desire acts, not I; desire is the agent, I am not the agent; desire causes action, I do not cause action. This is yours, O desire, to desire, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: manyurakārṣīnnamo namaḥ | manyurakārṣīnmanyuḥ karoti nāhaṃ karomi manyuḥ kartā nāhaṃ kartā manyuḥ kārayitā nāhaṃ kārayitā eṣa te manyo manyave svāhā
meaning: मन्युरकार्षीन्नमो नमः | मन्युरकार्षीन्मन्युः करोति नाहं करोमि मन्युः कर्ता नाहं कर्ता मन्युः कारयिता नाहं कारयिता एष ते मन्यो मन्यवे स्वाहा
text_mt: Anger did it: homage, homage! Anger did it; anger acts, not I; anger is the agent, I am not the agent; anger causes action, I do not cause action. This is yours, O anger, to anger, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: tilāñjuhomi sarasāṃ sapiṣṭāngandhāra mama citte ramantu svāhā | gāvo hiraṇyaṃ dhanamannapānaṃ sarveṣāg śriyai svāhā | śriyaṃ ca lakṣmiṃ ca puṣṭiṃ ca kīrtiṃ cā''nṛṇyatām | brahmaṇyaṃ bahuputratām | śraddhāmedhe prajāḥ saṃdadātu svāhā
meaning: तिलाञ्जुहोमि सरसां सपिष्टान्गन्धार मम चित्ते रमन्तु स्वाहा | गावो हिरण्यं धनमन्नपानं सर्वेषाग् श्रियै स्वाहा | श्रियं च लक्ष्मिं च पुष्टिं च कीर्तिं चा'ऽनृण्यताम् | ब्रह्मण्यं बहुपुत्रताम् | श्रद्धामेधे प्रजाः संददातु स्वाहा
text_mt: I offer sesame seeds full of sap, ground, fragrant; may they delight in my mind, svāhā! / Cattle, gold, wealth, food and drink, for the prosperity of all, svāhā! / Prosperity and fortune and nourishment and fame and freedom from debt, / priestly status, having many sons, / may [he] grant faith, wisdom, and progeny, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: tilāḥ kṛṣṇāstilāḥ śvetāstilāḥ saumyā vaśānugāḥ | tilāḥ punantu me pāpaṃ yatkiñcidduritaṃ mayi svāhā || corasyānnaṃ navaśrāddhaṃ brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ | gosteyaṃ surāpānaṃ bhrūṇahatyā tilā śāntiṃ śamayantu svāhā || śrīśca lakṣmīśca puṣṭīśca kīrtiṃ cā''nṛṇyatām | brahmaṇyaṃ bahuputratām | śraddhāmedhe prajñā tu jātavedaḥ saṃdadātu svāhā
meaning: तिलाः कृष्णास्तिलाः श्वेतास्तिलाः सौम्या वशानुगाः | तिलाः पुनन्तु मे पापं यत्किञ्चिद्दुरितं मयि स्वाहा || चोरस्यान्नं नवश्राद्धं ब्रह्महा गुरुतल्पगः | गोस्तेयं सुरापानं भ्रूणहत्या तिला शान्तिं शमयन्तु स्वाहा || श्रीश्च लक्ष्मीश्च पुष्टीश्च कीर्तिं चा'ऽनृण्यताम् | ब्रह्मण्यं बहुपुत्रताम् | श्रद्धामेधे प्रज्ञा तु जातवेदः संददातु स्वाहा
text_mt: Black sesame seeds, white sesame seeds, sesame seeds dedicated to Soma, obedient: / may the sesame seeds purify my sin, whatever misfortune is in me, svāhā! / The food of a thief, a new funeral feast, killing a brāhmaṇa, defiling the guru's bed, / theft of cows, drinking liquor, killing an embryo—may the sesame seeds bring peace and pacify [them], svāhā! / Prosperity and fortune and nourishment and fame and freedom from debt, / priestly status, having many sons, / may Jātavedas grant faith, wisdom, and understanding, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānā me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | vāṅmanaścakṣuḥ śrotrajihvāghrāṇareto buddhyākūtiḥ saṃkalpā me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | tvakcarma māṃsa rudhira medo majjā snāyavo'sthīni me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | śiraḥpāṇi pāda pārśva pṛṣṭhorūdara jaṅgha śiśnopastha pāyavo me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | uttiṣṭha puruṣa harita piṅgala lohitākṣi dehi dehi dadāpayitā me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā
meaning: प्राणापानव्यानोदानसमाना मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | वाङ्मनश्चक्षुः श्रोत्रजिह्वाघ्राणरेतो बुद्ध्याकूतिः संकल्पा मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | त्वक्चर्म मांस रुधिर मेदो मज्जा स्नायवोऽस्थीनि मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | शिरःपाणि पाद पार्श्व पृष्ठोरूदर जङ्घ शिश्नोपस्थ पायवो मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | उत्तिष्ठ पुरुष हरित पिङ्गल लोहिताक्षि देहि देहि ददापयिता मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा
text_mt: May my prāṇa, apāna, vyāna, udāna, and samāna breaths be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! May my speech, mind, eye, ear, tongue, smell, semen, intellect, intention, and resolve be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! May my outer skin, inner hide, flesh, blood, fat, marrow, sinews, and bones be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! May my head, hands, feet, sides, back, thighs, belly, shanks, penis, lap, and anus be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! Arise, O person, tawny, reddish-brown, red-eyed; give, give! May my prompter of giving be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyāpastejo vāyurākāśā me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | śabdasparśarūparasagandhā me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | manovākkāyakarmāṇi me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | avyaktabhāvairahaṃkārairjyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | ātmā me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | antarātmā me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | paramātmā me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā | kṣudhe svāhā | kṣutpipāsāya svāhā | viviṭṭyai svāhā | ṛgvidhānāya svāhā | kaṣotkāya svāhā | kṣutpipāsāmalaṃ jyeṣṭhāmalakṣmīrnāśayāmyaham | abhūtimasamṛddhiṃ ca sarvānnirṇuda me pāpmānaṃ svāhā | annamaya prāṇamaya manomaya vijñāna mayamānandamayamātmā me śudhyantāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā
meaning: पृथिव्यापस्तेजो वायुराकाशा मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | शब्दस्पर्शरूपरसगन्धा मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | मनोवाक्कायकर्माणि मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | अव्यक्तभावैरहंकारैर्ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | आत्मा मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | अन्तरात्मा मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | परमात्मा मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा | क्षुधे स्वाहा | क्षुत्पिपासाय स्वाहा | विविट्ट्यै स्वाहा | ऋग्विधानाय स्वाहा | कषोत्काय स्वाहा | क्षुत्पिपासामलं ज्येष्ठामलक्ष्मीर्नाशयाम्यहम् | अभूतिमसमृद्धिं च सर्वान्निर्णुद मे पाप्मानं स्वाहा | अन्नमय प्राणमय मनोमय विज्ञान मयमानन्दमयमात्मा मे शुध्यन्तां ज्योतिरहं विरजा विपाप्मा भूयासं स्वाहा
text_mt: May earth, water, fire, wind, and space for me be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! May sound, touch, form, taste, and smell for me be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! May the actions of my mind, speech, and body be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! Through unmanifest states and through egos, may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! May my self be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! May my inner self be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! May my supreme self be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā! To hunger, svāhā! To hunger and thirst, svāhā! To distress, svāhā! To the Ṛgveda rite, svāhā! To Kaṣotka, svāhā! I destroy the defilement of hunger and thirst, the elder misfortune; drive away from me misfortune, failure, and all evil, svāhā! May my self consisting of food, consisting of vital breath, consisting of mind, consisting of consciousness, and consisting of bliss be purified; may I become light, free from dust, free from evil, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: agnaye svāhā | viśvebhyo devebhyassvāhā | dhruvāya bhūmāya svāhā | dhruvakṣitaye svāhā | acyutakṣitaye svāhā | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā | dharmāya svāhā | adharmāya svāhā | adbhyassvāhā | oṣadhivanaspatibhyaḥ svāhā
meaning: अग्नये स्वाहा | विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यस्स्वाहा | ध्रुवाय भूमाय स्वाहा | ध्रुवक्षितये स्वाहा | अच्युतक्षितये स्वाहा | अग्नये स्विष्टकृते स्वाहा | धर्माय स्वाहा | अधर्माय स्वाहा | अद्भ्यस्स्वाहा | ओषधिवनस्पतिभ्यः स्वाहा
text_mt: To Agni, svāhā! To all the gods, svāhā! To the fixed, the immense, svāhā! To the firm foundation, svāhā! To the unshakeable foundation, svāhā! To Agni Sviṣṭakṛt, svāhā! To dharma, svāhā! To adharma, svāhā! To the waters, svāhā! To herbs and trees, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: rakṣodevajanebhyassvāhā | gṛhyābhyassvāhā | avasānebhyassvāhā | avasānapatibhyassvāhā | sarvabhūtebhyassvāhā | kāmāya svāhā | antarikṣāya svāhā | yadejati jagati yacca ceṣṭati nāmno bhāgo'yaṃ nāmne svāhā | pṛthivyai svāhā | antarikṣāya svāhā
meaning: रक्षोदेवजनेभ्यस्स्वाहा | गृह्याभ्यस्स्वाहा | अवसानेभ्यस्स्वाहा | अवसानपतिभ्यस्स्वाहा | सर्वभूतेभ्यस्स्वाहा | कामाय स्वाहा | अन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा | यदेजति जगति यच्च चेष्टति नाम्नो भागोऽयं नाम्ने स्वाहा | पृथिव्यै स्वाहा | अन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा
text_mt: To the rakṣas-folk and god-folk, svāhā! To the household [spirits], svāhā! To the settlements, svāhā! To the lords of the settlements, svāhā! To all beings, svāhā! To desire, svāhā! To intermediate space, svāhā! Whatever stirs in the world and whatever moves, this is the share of name; to name, svāhā! To the earth, svāhā! To intermediate space, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: dive svāhā | sūryāya svāhā | candramase svāhā | nakṣatrebhyassvāhā | indrāya svāhā | bṛhaspataye svāhā | prajāpataye svāhā | brahmaṇe svāhā | svadhā pitṛbhyassvāhā | namo rudrāya paśupataye svāhā
meaning: दिवे स्वाहा | सूर्याय स्वाहा | चन्द्रमसे स्वाहा | नक्षत्रेभ्यस्स्वाहा | इन्द्राय स्वाहा | बृहस्पतये स्वाहा | प्रजापतये स्वाहा | ब्रह्मणे स्वाहा | स्वधा पितृभ्यस्स्वाहा | नमो रुद्राय पशुपतये स्वाहा
text_mt: To the sky, svāhā! To Sūrya, svāhā! To the moon, svāhā! To the lunar mansions, svāhā! To Indra, svāhā! To Bṛhaspati, svāhā! To Prajāpati, svāhā! To brahman, svāhā! Svadhā to the fathers, svāhā! Homage to Rudra, lord of beasts, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: devebhyassvāhā | pitṛbhyassvadhā'stu | bhūtebhyo namaḥ | manuṣyebhyo hantā | prajāpataye svāhā | parameṣṭhine svāhā | yathā kūpaḥ śatadhāraḥ sahasradhāro akṣitaḥ | evā me astu dhānyaṃ sahasradhāramakṣitam | dhanadhānyai svāhā | ye bhūtāḥ pracaranti divānaktaṃ balimicchanto vitudasya preṣyāḥ | tebhyo baliṃ puṣṭikāmo harāmi mayi puṣṭiṃ puṣṭipatirdadhātu svāhā
meaning: देवेभ्यस्स्वाहा | पितृभ्यस्स्वधाऽस्तु | भूतेभ्यो नमः | मनुष्येभ्यो हन्ता | प्रजापतये स्वाहा | परमेष्ठिने स्वाहा | यथा कूपः शतधारः सहस्रधारो अक्षितः | एवा मे अस्तु धान्यं सहस्रधारमक्षितम् | धनधान्यै स्वाहा | ये भूताः प्रचरन्ति दिवानक्तं बलिमिच्छन्तो वितुदस्य प्रेष्याः | तेभ्यो बलिं पुष्टिकामो हरामि मयि पुष्टिं पुष्टिपतिर्दधातु स्वाहा
text_mt: To the gods, svāhā! To the fathers be svadhā! Homage to the beings! / To humans: hanta! To Prajāpati, svāhā! To Parameṣṭhin, svāhā! / As a well with a hundred streams, with a thousand streams, is inexhaustible, / so may my grain with a thousand streams be inexhaustible! To wealth and grain, svāhā! The beings who roam by day and night desiring an offering, the messengers of Vituda— / to them, desiring nourishment, I carry an offering; may the lord of nourishment bestow nourishment upon me, svāhā! / To herbs and trees, svāhā; to intermediate space, svāhā; homage to Rudra, lord of beasts, svāhā; the messengers of Vituda, and one.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ tadbrahma | oṃ tadvāyuḥ | oṃ tadātmā | oṃ tathsatyam | oṃ tathsarvam | oṃ tatpurornamaḥ | antaścarati bhūteṣu guhāyāṃ viśvamūrtiṣu | tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvamindrastvaṃ rudrastvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ brahma tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ | tvaṃ tadāpa āpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṃ brahma bhūrbhuvassuvarom
meaning: ओं तद्ब्रह्म | ओं तद्वायुः | ओं तदात्मा | ओं तथ्सत्यम् | ओं तथ्सर्वम् | ओं तत्पुरोर्नमः | अन्तश्चरति भूतेषु गुहायां विश्वमूर्तिषु | त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वमिन्द्रस्त्वं रुद्रस्त्वं विष्णुस्त्वं ब्रह्म त्वं प्रजापतिः | त्वं तदाप आपो ज्योती रसोऽमृतं ब्रह्म भूर्भुवस्सुवरोम्
text_mt: Oṃ, that is brahman; Oṃ, that is Vāyu; Oṃ, that is the self; Oṃ, that is truth; Oṃ, that is all; / Oṃ, homage to that Puruṣa! He moves within all beings, in the cave, multiform. You are the sacrifice, you are the vaṣaṭ-call, you are Indra, you are Rudra, you are Viṣṇu, you are brahman, you are Prajāpati. You are those waters, waters, light, essence, immortal brahman, bhūr bhuvas suvar, oṃ!

sanskrit_iast: śraddhāyāṃ prāṇe niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śraddhāyāmapāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śraddhāyāṃ vyāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śraddhāyāmudāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śraddhāyāṃ samāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | brahmaṇi ma ātmā'mṛtatvāya | amṛtopastaraṇamasi | śraddhāyāṃ prāṇe niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | prāṇāya svāhā | śraddhāyāmapāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | apānāya svāhā | śraddhāyāṃ vyāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | vyānāya svāhā | śraddhāyāmudāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | udānāya svāhā | śraddhāyāṃ samāne niviṣṭo'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | samānāya svāhā | brahmaṇi ma ātmā'mṛtatvāya | amṛtāpidhānamasi
meaning: श्रद्धायां प्राणे निविष्टोऽमृतं जुहोमि | श्रद्धायामपाने निविष्टोऽमृतं जुहोमि | श्रद्धायां व्याने निविष्टोऽमृतं जुहोमि | श्रद्धायामुदाने निविष्टोऽमृतं जुहोमि | श्रद्धायां समाने निविष्टोऽमृतं जुहोमि | ब्रह्मणि म आत्माऽमृतत्वाय | अमृतोपस्तरणमसि | श्रद्धायां प्राणे निविष्टोऽमृतं जुहोमि | शिवो मा विशाप्रदाहाय | प्राणाय स्वाहा | श्रद्धायामपाने निविष्टोऽमृतं जुहोमि | शिवो मा विशाप्रदाहाय | अपानाय स्वाहा | श्रद्धायां व्याने निविष्टोऽमृतं जुहोमि | शिवो मा विशाप्रदाहाय | व्यानाय स्वाहा | श्रद्धायामुदाने निविष्टोऽमृतं जुहोमि | शिवो मा विशाप्रदाहाय | उदानाय स्वाहा | श्रद्धायां समाने निविष्टोऽमृतं जुहोमि | शिवो मा विशाप्रदाहाय | समानाय स्वाहा | ब्रह्मणि म आत्माऽमृतत्वाय | अमृतापिधानमसि
text_mt: Entered into faith, into the prāṇa breath, I offer the immortal. Entered into faith, into the apāna breath, I offer the immortal. Entered into faith, into the vyāna breath, I offer the immortal. Entered into faith, into the udāna breath, I offer the immortal. Entered into faith, into the samāna breath, I offer the immortal. In brahman is my self, for immortality. / You are the under-spreading of the immortal. Entered into faith, into the prāṇa breath, I offer the immortal; enter me auspiciously, without burning! To prāṇa, svāhā! Entered into faith, into the apāna breath, I offer the immortal; enter me auspiciously, without burning! To apāna, svāhā! Entered into faith, into the vyāna breath, I offer the immortal; enter me auspiciously, without burning! To vyāna, svāhā! / Entered into faith, into the udāna breath, I offer the immortal; enter me auspiciously, without burning! / To udāna, svāhā! Entered into faith, into the samāna breath, I offer the immortal; enter me auspiciously, without burning! To samāna, svāhā! In brahman is my self, for immortality. / You are the covering of the immortal.

sanskrit_iast: śraddhāyāṃ prāṇe niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | prāṇamannenāpyāyasva | śraddhāyāmapāne niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | apānamannenāpyāyasva | śraddhāyāṃ vyāne niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | vyānamannenāpyāyasva | śraddhāyāmudāne niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | udānamannenāpyāyasva | śraddhāyāṃ samāne niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | samānamannenāpyāyasva
meaning: श्रद्धायां प्राणे निविश्यामृतं हुतम् | प्राणमन्नेनाप्यायस्व | श्रद्धायामपाने निविश्यामृतं हुतम् | अपानमन्नेनाप्यायस्व | श्रद्धायां व्याने निविश्यामृतं हुतम् | व्यानमन्नेनाप्यायस्व | श्रद्धायामुदाने निविश्यामृतं हुतम् | उदानमन्नेनाप्यायस्व | श्रद्धायां समाने निविश्यामृतं हुतम् | समानमन्नेनाप्यायस्व
text_mt:
Having entered into faith, into the vital breath, the immortal [food] is offered; nourish the vital breath with food.
Having entered into faith, into the apāna breath, the immortal [food] is offered; nourish the apāna breath with food.
Having entered into faith, into the vyāna breath, the immortal [food] is offered; nourish the vyāna breath with food.
Having entered into faith, into the udāna breath, the immortal [food] is offered; nourish the udāna breath with food.
Having entered into faith, into the samāna breath, the immortal [food] is offered; nourish the samāna breath with food.

sanskrit_iast: aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo'ṅguṣṭhaṃ ca samāśritaḥ | īśassarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ prīṇāti viśvabhuk
meaning: अङ्गुष्ठमात्रः पुरुषोऽङ्गुष्ठं च समाश्रितः | ईशस्सर्वस्य जगतः प्रभुः प्रीणाति विश्वभुक्
text_mt: The Puruṣa of the size of a thumb, having resorted to the thumb, the ruler of the whole world, the master, all-consuming, rejoices.

sanskrit_iast: vāṅma āsann | nasoḥ prāṇaḥ | akṣyoścakṣuḥ | karṇayoḥ śrotram | bāhuvorbalam | ūruvorojaḥ | ariṣṭā viśvānyaṅgāni tanūḥ | tanuvā me saha namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ
meaning: वाङ्म आसन्न् | नसोः प्राणः | अक्ष्योश्चक्षुः | कर्णयोः श्रोत्रम् | बाहुवोर्बलम् | ऊरुवोरोजः | अरिष्टा विश्वान्यङ्गानि तनूः | तनुवा मे सह नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः
text_mt:
May speech [remain] in my mouth, the vital breath in my nostrils, sight in my eyes, hearing in my ears,
strength in my arms, vigor in my thighs, all my limbs uninjured, [and my] body!
Together with my body, homage be to you; do not harm me!

sanskrit_iast: vayassuparṇā upasedurindraṃ priyamedhā ṛṣayo nādhamānāḥ | apa dhvāntamūrṇuhi pūrddhi cakṣurmumugdhyasmānnidhaye'va baddhān
meaning: वयस्सुपर्णा उपसेदुरिन्द्रं प्रियमेधा ऋषयो नाधमानाः | अप ध्वान्तमूर्णुहि पूर्द्धि चक्षुर्मुमुग्ध्यस्मान्निधयेऽव बद्धान्
text_mt:
Like birds with beautiful wings, the seers, the Priyamedhas, approached Indra, seeking help:
"Dispel the darkness, fill our eyes [with light], release us who are bound as if in a snare!"

sanskrit_iast: prāṇānāṃ granthirasi rudro mā viśāntakaḥ | tenānnenāpyāyasva
meaning: प्राणानां ग्रन्थिरसि रुद्रो मा विशान्तकः | तेनान्नेनाप्यायस्व
text_mt:
You are the knot of the vital breaths; do not enter me as Rudra the end-maker.
By that food, be nourished!

sanskrit_iast: namo rudrāya viṣṇave mṛtyurme pāhi
meaning: नमो रुद्राय विष्णवे मृत्युर्मे पाहि
text_mt: Homage to Rudra, to Viṣṇu! Protect my death [from me]!

sanskrit_iast: tvamagne dyubhistvamāśu śukṣaṇistvamadbhyastvamaśmanaspari | tvaṃ vanebhyastvamoṣadhībhyastvaṃ nṛṇāṃ nṛpate jāyase śuciḥ
meaning: त्वमग्ने द्युभिस्त्वमाशु शुक्षणिस्त्वमद्भ्यस्त्वमश्मनस्परि | त्वं वनेभ्यस्त्वमोषधीभ्यस्त्वं नृणां नृपते जायसे शुचिः
text_mt:
You, Agni, [are born] with the days; you, swift, shining; you from the waters, you from the rock;
you from the forests, you from the plants; you, lord of men, are born pure among men.

text_mt: "Truth is supreme, supreme is truth! By truth they never fall from the world of heaven, for truth belongs to the virtuous; therefore they delight in truth." "Ascetic heat!" they say; there is no ascetic heat higher than fasting, for what is the highest ascetic heat is unassailable, is inviolable; therefore they delight in ascetic heat. "Restraint!" say the chaste students continuously; therefore they delight in restraint. "Tranquility!" say the sages in the forest; therefore they delight in tranquility. "Giving!" all beings praise; nothing is harder to surpass than giving; therefore they delight in giving. "Dharma!" they say; by dharma all this is encompassed; nothing is harder to surpass than dharma; therefore they delight in dharma. "Procreation!" say the many; therefore most beings are born; therefore the most delight in procreation. "The fires!" he says; therefore the fires are to be established. "The agnihotra!" he says; therefore they delight in the agnihotra. "Sacrifice!" they say; for the gods are the sacrifice; therefore they delight in sacrifice. "Mental [worship]!" say the wise; therefore the wise alone delight in mental [worship]. "Renunciation!" say they: [it is] Brahman, for Brahman is the supreme, and supreme is Brahman. Truly, all these other supreme [practices] renunciation surpassed. He who knows thus [attains this]. Such is the Upaniṣad.

text_mt: Āruṇi Suparṇeya, descendant of Prajāpati, approached his father Prajāpati: 'What do the venerable ones declare to be supreme?' He said to him: 'By truth the wind blows; by truth Āditya shines in the sky; truth is the foundation of speech; on truth everything is established; therefore they declare truth to be supreme. By ascetic heat the gods attained godhead in the beginning; by ascetic heat the seers found heaven; by ascetic heat let us drive away rivals and enemies; on ascetic heat everything is established; therefore they declare ascetic heat to be supreme. By self-restraint the restrained shake off evil; by self-restraint Vedic students went to heaven; self-restraint is unassailable for living beings; on self-restraint everything is established; therefore they declare self-restraint to be supreme. By tranquility the tranquil practice what is auspicious; by tranquility the silent sages found the firmament; tranquility is unassailable for living beings; on tranquility everything is established; therefore they declare tranquility to be supreme. Giving is the defense of sacrifices, the priestly gift in the world; all beings subsist on the giver; by giving they drove away enemies; by giving foes become friends; on giving everything is established; therefore they declare giving to be supreme. Dharma is the foundation of the whole world; in the world beings approach the most righteous; by dharma one drives away evil; on dharma everything is established; therefore they declare dharma to be supreme. Procreation is indeed the foundation in the world; properly extending the thread of offspring, one becomes debt-free to the fathers; that indeed is one's debt-freedom; therefore they declare procreation to be supreme. The fires are indeed the threefold knowledge, the path of the gods; the Gārhapatya is the Ṛk, the earth, the Rathantara; the Anvāhāryapacana is the Yajus, the intermediate space, the Vāmadevya; the Āhavanīya is the Sāman, the world of heaven, the Bṛhat; therefore they declare the fires to be supreme. The Agnihotra in evening and morning is the expiation of households, well-sacrificed, well-offered, the beginning of sacrifice-rites, the light of the world of heaven; therefore they declare the Agnihotra to be supreme. "Sacrifice," they say, for by sacrifice the gods went to the sky; by sacrifice they drove away the asuras; by sacrifice foes become friends; on sacrifice everything is established; therefore they declare sacrifice to be supreme. The mental is indeed connected to Prajāpati, a purifier; with the mental mind one sees properly; the mental seers created creatures; on the mental everything is established; therefore they declare the mental to be supreme. Wise men declare renunciation to be brahman; brahman is the universe; which [is he]? The self-existent Prajāpati is the year. The year is that Āditya; he who is this person in Āditya is Parameṣṭhin, brahman, the Self. By the rays with which Āditya gives heat, Parjanya rains; by Parjanya herbs and trees are produced; by herbs and trees food comes to be; by food the vital breaths; by the vital breaths strength; by strength ascetic heat; by ascetic heat faith; by faith wisdom; by wisdom intellect; by intellect mind; by mind peace; by peace consciousness; by consciousness memory; by memory recollection; by recollection understanding; by understanding one causes the Self to be known; therefore giving food, one gives all these. From food come the vital breaths of living beings; by the vital breaths, mind; and from mind, understanding; from understanding, bliss; brahman is the womb. He indeed is this fivefold person, having five selves, by whom all this is interwoven: earth and intermediate space, sky, quarters, and intermediate directions. He indeed is all this world; he is the past, he the future; formed by desire to know, born of truth, dwelling in wealth, faith, true, glorious, superior to ascetic heat. Knowing him thus with mind and heart, as one who knows, do not again approach death. Therefore they declare renunciation to be superior to these ascetic heats. "A delightful treasure you are, all-pervading; in the vital breath you are the uniter; O brahman, you are the supporter of all; you are the giver of luster; you are Agni; you are the giver of splendor; you are of Sūrya; you are the giver of brilliance; you are of the moon. You are taken with a vessel; to you, to the greatness of brahman, [I offer]." With "Om" one should yoke oneself. This indeed is the great Upaniṣad, the secret of the gods; he who knows thus attains the greatness of brahman; therefore, the greatness of brahman. Thus the Upaniṣad.'

For him who knows thus, of this sacrifice the self is the sacrificer, faith is the wife, the body is the kindling wood, the chest is the altar, the bodily hairs are the sacrificial grass, the Veda is the lock of hair, the heart is the sacrificial post, desire is the clarified butter, fury is the sacrificial animal, ascetic heat is the fire, self-restraint is the slaughterer, the sacrificial gift [is distributed], speech is the hotṛ, vital breath is the udgātṛ, the eye is the adhvaryu, the mind is the brahman, the ear is the agnīdh. As long as he lives, that is the consecration. What he eats, that is the oblation; what he drinks, that is his drinking of soma; when he amuses himself, that is the upasads; when he walks about, sits down, and rises up, that is the pravargya; what is his mouth, that is the āhavanīya; what utterance he makes, that is the offering; what his discernment is, that he pours out; what he eats evening and morning, that is the kindling wood; what he does in the morning, at midday, and in the evening, those are the pressings; what the days and nights are, they are the new- and full-moon sacrifices; what the half-months and months are, they are the four-month seasonal sacrifices; what the seasons are, they are the animal offerings; what the years and circular years are, they are the series of sacrificial days. This satra is indeed one where all one's possessions are given away; that death [comes], that is the concluding bath. This indeed is the Agnihotra satra that ends only with old age or death. The wise man who knows thus, dying during the sun's northern course, going indeed to the greatness of the gods, attains union with Āditya. Now, he who dies during the southern course, going indeed to the greatness of the fathers, attains union with the moon and attains the same world. These two glories of the sun and the moon the knowing brāhmaṇa conquers; therefore he attains the glory of brahman; therefore he attains the glory of brahman. [Thus is the Upaniṣad.]
